programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: To resolve the murder of an elected woman's daughter, a fashion designer or a crisis management consultant, New York police inspectors investigate the field and gather evidence that criminalizes the suspects. They work in conjunction with the Manhattan Attorney's Office assistants who prepare the indictments that will be presented to the court. After Anthony Anderson left, Mehcad Brooks, seen in "Desperate Housewives", joined the casting in the role of Inspector Jalen Shaw.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.desc-more: In the heart of the picturesque coastal town of Sète, a complex picture of the daily life of its inhabitants is revealed. Soon, members of the Delcourt, Vallorta and Moreno families found themselves involved in a web of family mysteries and dramas. Doctors, police officers, lawyers and ordinary citizens find themselves trained in a series of extraordinary events, facing challenges both personal and professional.

programme.title: France / Argentina
programme.desc: On the final day of the championship, the XV of France will return to Argentina with the ambition to consolidate its first place in the Northern Hemisphere and qualify for the grand final in London at the end of the month. Antoine Dupont and his team-mates, who came out of a resounding victory (21-19) on 13 November against South Africa, must ensure the essentials and finish the work against the Pumas on this last day of regular phase. If they win, they will play the title of this new championship of nations in London on Sunday, November 29 against the team that finished in the top of the southern hemisphere: a group where New Zealand and South Africa are in a elbow to elbow. Note the expected great return of Matthieu Jalibert to the opening, after two months of recovery due to injury to the UBB's opener.

programme.title: Hunger Games: the snake and the singing bird ballad
programme.desc: In the near future, a young man from a family that was once rich and powerful suddenly sees himself given the opportunity to forge an extraordinary destiny.
programme.desc-more: In a Panem still marked by the scars of Obscurs Days, the Snow family is in decline. Coriolanus Snow (Tom Blyth), a teenager, found himself orphaned by a father after the brutal death of his patriarch, Crassus, during a bloody rebellion. Three years later, while the Capitol imposed its authority on the Districts, the country was plunged into poverty and fear. Hunger Games, a show of survival and cruelty, are established to maintain control over the population. At the dawn of this new era, Coriolanus was selected from among twenty-four students to become mentor of a tribute. He was charged with guiding and preparing his protégé for the arena, and faced moral dilemmas and power challenges. Between personal ambition and loyalty, Coriolanus will have to navigate a world where survival is a cruel game, thus laying the foundations of the man he will become.

programme.title: Ghost S.O.S.: Ice Threat
programme.desc: In New York, a team of ghost hunters is facing the arrival of an army of spectra that threaten to plunge the Earth into a glacial era.
programme.desc-more: In 1904, firefighters from New York were called urgently to a large city hotel, where they discovered a gallery of ghostly characters preserved in the ice. One hundred and twenty years later, Gary Grooberson, Callie Spengler and his children settled in New York where they hunted ghosts as a recomposed family. But their interventions in the street cause damage that is blamed on them by the mayor of the city, the irascible Walter Peck. It's the least of their problems, because a relic could free a horde of ghosts in New York. Callie and Gary then appealed to the historical team of Ghost S.O.S.

programme.title: The Countess of Monte Cristo
programme.desc: On the track of Faria's treasure, Mercedes discovers his new powers. With the help of smuggler Bertuccio, she became the Countess of Monte Cristo.
programme.desc-more: Marseille, 1815. Mercedès Herrera (Audrey Fleurot) is ready for anything for the man she loves, Edmond Dantes (Waël Sersoub), a sailor promised to a bright future. But their happiness is cruelly broken by ruthless betrayal. Edmond, wrongly accused, is torn from Mercedes and thrown into the depths of the Château d'If, without hope of returning. Devasted but determined, Mercedes is embarking on a wild race to save him, but Edmond is killed in their escape attempt and she herself is locked up, condemned to languishing in a cell close to the one that sheltered the love of her life. In this abyss of pain, everything seems lost. Mercedès now has only one goal, taking revenge on those who destroyed his life: Fernand (Thierry Godard), his own cousin, secretly in love with her; Danglars (Éric Elmosnino), an ambitious manipulator; and especially Héloïse de Villefort (Zabou Breitman), the implacable woman of the city's prosecutor.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Benson's trying to help the gang member who attacked him, while Duarte finds evidence that's going to shock everyone. End of hiring new inspectors.
programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: A recognized physicist is being engaged by the United States to complete a scientific project aimed at revolutionizing world history.
programme.desc-more: In 1953, at the heart of a period of political paranoia known as the "witch hunt", Robert Oppenheimer (Cillian Murphy), the father of the atomic bomb, met with a secret commission. Accused of his political commitments on the left and of his relations with members of the Communist Party, he must defend his scientific and personal heritage. As he prepares to read a statement to clarify his position, Oppenheimer re-exists in his memories, evoking his intellectual youth marked by his studies in the United Kingdom. He also recalled his central role in the "Manhattan Project", a crucial initiative of the Second World War to create a nuclear weapon for the United States. Between moral dilemmas and internal struggles, Oppenheimer must navigate a world where his scientific genius is both admired and feared, while confronting the devastating consequences of his choices.

programme.title: Captain Marleau
programme.desc: Marleau investigates the death of a man in a region marked by religious tensions. The case reveals community conflicts and family secrets.
programme.desc-more: In this new season of "Captain Marleau", broadcast in 2020, the famous investigator with flamboyant personality returns with her inimitable style that mixes acerbic humour and sharp intuition. Marleau, interpreted by actress Corinne Masiero, is distinguished by his exaggerated manners and his frankness, but it is above all his sense of the extraordinary deduction that imposes him as one of the most feared detectives. As the episodes progress, we witness the resolution of mysterious murders and complex cases, each investigation being cleverly built around a suspect individual, whom Marleau skilfully hunts. She does not hesitate to interfere with the lives of those she suspects, observing their actions, behaviors and interactions in order to discover the mysteries surrounding them. His ability to decode unsaid and to untrace lies makes him an investigative specialist, capable of reversing the most tense situations. In this season, Marleau is confronted with a variety of things, ranging from a mystery surrounding a disputed legacy to a series of disappearances in a small village. Each plot is interspersed with interactions with colorful characters that enrich the painting, mixing comedy with drama. The tension is palpable in his entourage, where confidence can easily squabble under the sharp eye of the captain.

programme.title: The Apprenticeship
programme.desc: In the 1970s, young Donald Trump saw his career take off after entering into a Faustian pact with a brilliant lawyer in New York.
programme.desc-more: In a setting that evokes the power struggles and the disproportionate ambitions of modern America, The Apprentice offers a fascinating look at the tumultuous beginnings of a young Donald Trump (Sebastian Stan). In the 1970s, as the country is in the midst of a transformation, Trump began to forge his destiny at the intersection of business and politics. In search of influence and success, he crossed Roy Cohn's (Jeremy Strong) route, a conservative lawyer with a flamboyant character and implacable strategy. The latter becomes his mentor, initiates Trump to the archanes of power, and this, through a pact that seems promising but carries within him the seeds of a devouring ambition. As Trump navigates a world of alliances and betrayals, he faces personal and professional challenges that will test his integrity and ambition. The stakes are constantly increasing as Trump proves to be willing to sacrifice everything to reach his dreams, while Cohn, the master of political manipulation, reveals a world where success has a price.

programme.title: The art of crime
programme.desc: A young woman is found murdered in a photo studio. Antoine and Florence discover that this murder is linked to a masterpiece by Edward Manet.
programme.desc-more: In a photo studio, Emma Wurtz's lifeless body (Eléonore Bernheim), a 25-year-old legal secretary, is discovered, immerse the art world in deep dismay. This mysterious murder is amplified by a selfie erased two hours after her death, where Emma poses alongside an iconic painting by Edward Manet, "At Tortoni", a masterpiece that has been missing for more than thirty years during the famous flight of the Gardner Museum in Boston. Faced with this enigma, Florence (Nicolas Gob), an art lover and experienced investigator, turns to Jean-Louis Marquet (Philippe Duclos), a renowned detective in the field of stolen works, to assist him in this complex affair. However, Marquet's arrival did not please Antoine (Benjamin Egner), who was fighting against his own growing feelings for Florence, fuelling palpable tension between the protagonists. As the investigation progresses, buried secrets threaten to burst, revealing a criminal network in the heart of the art world.

programme.title: The most beautiful country in the world Opus 4
programme.desc: An exploration of the fauna and wild landscapes of France, from the metropolis to the superb overseas territories rich in biodiversity.
programme.desc-more: Portrait of a wild France with fabulous landscapes, refuge of unsuspected animal species. In addition to singular stories, this trip evokes a history that goes beyond the borders of this land with a temperate climate whose nature is beating at the rhythm of the four seasons, to the discovery of parts of France scattered throughout the world's oceans that gather 80% of the country's biodiversity, in the mysterious forests of Guyana, the volcanoism of Réunion Island, the diversity of the Antilles, the atolls of Polynesia and the coral barrier of New Caledonia. A discovery of the immense diversity of its nature, geology and peoples, in what they have most surprising and moving.

programme.title: Consent
programme.desc: In 1985, in Paris, Vanessa, 13, witnessed the conversations of a dinner with her mother. The focus of the table is Gabriel Matzneff, a writer who describes in his works his intimate relations with minors. Matzneff, though busy in seducing her audience, quickly noticed the teenage girl, presented by her mother as a passionate reader of literature. A few months later, Vanessa accompanied the writer to the maid's room, which served as his office. The man proposes that the adolescent should do her education in all fields.

programme.title: The evening continues, the debate continues
Let's educate our sons
programme.desc: After the Pelicot case, this film gives the floor to men who want things to change, convinced that education about violence begins at an early age.
programme.desc-more: The vast majority of physical and psychological violence is perpetrated by men. Beyond the human tragedies they cause, these violence have a huge cost to society: health care costs, legal costs, compensation for victims. Men who have taken a step back from their past violent behaviour tell of the evolution of their relationship to manhood and its injunctions. All are formal: education on violence begins at an early age, and for society to evolve, it is necessary to review the education of boys.

programme.title: Youth in (re)transition find its way
programme.desc: Without questioning the advances in law, this film focuses on the growing demand for transition for minors and its medical care. A complex subject.
programme.desc-more: Often in a state of suffering, more and more teenagers want to transition, i.e. change gender. But while greater visibility is given to transidentity, units dedicated to the transition of young people to hospital are saturated. There are 9 of them in France. At the CHRU in Lille, Lino, Emilio, and Orion are among the 400 young transgender patients of Professor François Medjkane, but 400 others are on waiting list. In adulthood, certain.e.s. resume the opposite path, now wishing to detransition.

programme.title: Captain Marleau
programme.desc: With her staggered humour, her fearsome flair and her occasional chapka, Captain Marleau is disrouting those who cross her route. Sent to the most unlikely crime scenes, she doesn't have her own to make talk about the toughest clues and the most stubborn suspects. It is the result of which innocent people are put out of the way, the culprits are confused and the mysteries are solved in a whirlwind of good words and with a strong Northern accent. It is impossible to resist this amazing mixture of sagacity and joviality. Season 4 is up to previous season, which has a spectacular gallery of famous guests.
programme.desc-more: Captain Marleau (Corinne Masiero), an inspector with a sharp intuition, finds herself immersed in a series of investigations as delicate as they are confusing. When an ex-policeman is the subject of an attempted murder, Marleau tries to convince her to testify. However, the victim, haunted by fear for the safety of his loved ones, remains silent. While this case seems to be resolved, Marleau is quickly confronted with another mystery: a man on the run, accused of killing his own son. Not believing in his guilt, Marleau decided to temporarily hide him, endangering his own career. His determination led him to collaborate with an English detective, while a British journalist was kidnapped. Through these surveys, Marleau navigates a world of colourful characters, with remarkable appearances of guests like David Suchet and Yolande Moreau, enriching a captivating intrigue.

programme.title: Love
programme.desc: In a couple in high school, a woman and a man, whose fates seem to be linked, end up finding themselves years after their painful separation.
programme.desc-more: In a port town in the north of France, in the mid-1980s, Clotaire (François Civil), a rebellious teenager from a difficult neighbourhood, experienced intense love for Jackie (Adèle Exarchopoulos), a student classmate. While Jackie is dedicated to her studies and dreams of a promising future, Clotaire prefers to mix with a group of young people with questionable intentions. Their passionate but tumultuous relationship takes a tragic turn when Clotaire is imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, causing their love to implode. Ten years later, the reunion between Cloutaire and Jackie, now married to a wealthy entrepreneur, is becoming complex. Claire, determined to regain her heart, will have to navigate through the tensions of their common past and the realities of their respective lives, while Jackie struggles between her duty as a married woman and the feelings that reborn on the surface.

Case concluded, everyone has something to sell
Different, so what?
programme.desc: International Day of Persons with Disabilities, 3 December, invites us to work towards inclusion and to better understand the daily lives and difficulties of those who hope and expect progress towards a fully accessible society. This essential question is at the heart of this exceptional mechanism led by Léa Salamé, to mark the minds, break the received ideas, taboos, and show the path that remains to be taken to improve society and the well-being of all. This new format combines documentary in immersion and back to the stage with many guests and personalities, opening and questioning the French's view of disability and integration of differences.

programme.title: Different, so what?, the next one.
programme.desc: On the stage, Léa Salamé extends the evening with many guests, including Matthieu Lartot, Olivier Goy, Sarah Talbi, Gilbert Montagné, Michaël Jérémiasz and Guillaume de Tonquédec, who share their experience, confront the views and try to open the dialogue on the question of disability and how to improve the daily lives of those concerned. An evening to understand, question, change the look and remind that the difference is part of our common humanity.

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: After the robbery of an old lady's garage, investigators discover that the thief has 50% DNA in common with Lieutenant Erwan Lebellec.
programme.desc-more: Called for a robbery, the gendarmes found on the scene two evidences that this is not an ordinary fact: an old lady scared, mother of serial killer Fabrice Guillomin, and traces of blood. These are the burglar's and it has 50% DNA in common... Lieutenant Erwan Lebellec! In the face of this worrying situation, Erwan must reveal part of his past. Ten years ago, while he was a student, his best friend Johanna Dupieux suddenly disappeared. According to the M.O., she was killed by Guillomin. Except that, unlike the bodies of the other victims, Johanna's body was never found. If Erwan tried to "put" this drama behind him, his mother refused to turn the page. For nearly 10 years, she has been pursuing an investigation, amateur, to understand what happened to Johanna.

programme.title: 50 years of Number One - Les Carpentier

programme.desc-more: Between 1975 and 1982, producers Maritie and Gilbert Carpentier and their mythical show, "Number One", delighted the viewers on Saturday evenings. Their show brought together the talents of the time for a show worthy of Broadway. Fifty years later, some of the greatest artists who participated in "Number One" agreed to resume their success from the 1970s to the 1980s, alongside the new generation. This is the occasion of new duos, specially designed for this event. As at the time, it is an evening between artists, without animator, but with treasures of archives, to see or see this golden age of varieties and its essential figures.

programme.title: Musical Comedies made in France
programme.desc: From "Starmania" to superproductions of the 2000s like "Le Roi Soleil", this documentary traces the invention of a genre to French: musical comedy.
programme.desc-more: The journey of French musicals, from Starmania to the current superproductions, is a significant chapter in the hexagonal cultural history. These scenic works generate musical compositions entered into collective memory such as "The Wish of Love" or "The Time of Cathedrals". A mosaic of excerpts, television shows and behind-the-scenes sequences illustrates this artistic epic. The actors, producers and creators share their memories of these performances that go through the eras. This singular artistic form continues to enrich our musical repertoire.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: In order to enjoy a prototype of the Startruc robot that only comes out in a month, Anatole and Jason are being locked in the search galleries.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.desc: Pushed into his favorite video game, Marcus has to go through many levels to beat the game. However, the star of the game also exists in the real world.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: Jean-Christophe Bellon, a local notable and president of the Memorial Amicale of the Great Meaux War, was murdered. Karine Lelièvre is in charge of the investigation.
programme.desc-more: A commemorative event in Meaux turns into a drama with the death of the president of the organizing association. The authorities entrust the investigation to Lieutenant Karine Lelièvre, to whom Captain Isabelle Guercher is assistant. The two women are sworn enemies and navigate between their differences and the demands of the investigation. Their research is gradually leading them to a disconcerting discovery: murder is intimately linked to their common history. This revelation forces them to reconsider their past and mutual animosity.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: While a man is found dead, tied to a menhir, the police officers who investigate will bring out the buried traumas of Belle-Ile.
programme.desc-more: On a captivating journey through France, "Mothers to..." plunges spectators into the heart of regions rich in history and culture, where every murder revealed is intimately linked to a local legend or a landmark event. Each episode highlights a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, whose skills are not always limited to those of the law enforcement agencies. These characters, sometimes from a variety of backgrounds, mix their talents and perspectives to solve complex puzzles that shake local communities. As investigations, tensions and affinities develop, adding a romantic and human dimension to their investigations. Between police intrigues and cultural discoveries, this series will seduce polar lovers while immersing them in the French heritage, making each murder a mystery to be deciphered, and a story to tell.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Princess is missing. As Anatole just discovered a television series on Sherlock Holmes, he decided to conduct the investigation in the manner of the famous detective. But Olympus also thinks she's Sherlock Holmes and also conducts an investigation. Goliath, his grandmother's little dog is missing. It's serious. Will the detectives be up to their investigation?
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Vera's investigations
programme.desc: Since 1977, five old friends of the high school have met every five years, on the evening of Christmas Eve, in a house. But this year, one of them is found hanged there.
programme.desc-more: The famous presenter Rick Kelsall appears hanging in his room, the day after an evening with old friends in high school. programme.title: Vera's investigations
programme.desc: The head of security at Peyton's container port is killed. We're thinking of a robbery that went wrong, but Vera suspects a set-up.
programme.desc-more: At Peyton Harbour, a customs check turns into a drama when a heavy-duty driver runs away, overturning Gary Mallon, the foreman, in his unbridled race. Gary succumbs shortly after his injuries, and Inspector Vera Stanhope discovers that the truck was carrying a cargo of stolen heroin. Convinced that it is a set-up, Vera plunges into a complex investigation. The situation is getting worse when a new element upsets the investigations: Gary's ex-wife alerts the police about the disturbing disappearance of their 13-year-old son. Research is intensifying, but it is becoming even more complicated when the national agency against organized crime tries to seize the case, adding a dimension of rivalry and political pressure to an already explosive case.

programme.title: Miquelon, facing the ocean
programme.desc: Threatened by the rise of water, the village of Miquelon and its 600 inhabitants must be relocated out of danger, a great first in France.
programme.desc-more: Miquelon Island, off Canada, is threatened by rising waters due to climate change. This 600-population municipality could see its homes submerged by 2100, according to one of the IPCC scenarios. Faced with this danger, the mayor and local authorities took a new decision in France, to move the village completely to relocate it a few kilometres further, sheltered from the rise of the waters. This project, a major first in the national territory, makes Miquelon a veritable laboratory for climate studies, where the inhabitants become despite them the first French climate refugees

programme.title: The horizon of the possible
programme.sub-title: Living the handicap in Saint-Pierre and Miquelon
programme.desc: The Living Together association was founded in the late 1970s and has become a central player in the support of people with disabilities in Saint-Pierre and Miquelon.
programme.desc-more: In Saint-Pierre and Miquelon, about 60 people live in a disability. The proximity between the inhabitants promotes acceptance of the difference. Families, professionals and associations have developed solutions for each to live and grow with their own people over the decades. Since the creation of the association Vivre Together in the late 1970s, local support gradually became structured around educational support, vocational integration and accommodation, from childhood to adulthood. Meeting with those who make this solidarity live on a daily basis, carried by a rare positive energy.

programme.title: Ouragan Hugo, the wind test
programme.desc: Hurricane Hugo, which devastated Guadeloupe in September 1989, has led to a change in construction practices and preventive measures.
programme.desc-more: On the night of 16-17 September 1989, Hurricane Hugo struck Guadeloupe. The archipelago is ravaged by extreme violence and a raging sea, causing one of the most devastating natural disasters in its recent history. In the morning, the population discovers a landscape of desolation. While solidarity is being organized, reconstruction raises an essential question: how can we better protect Guadeloupe from cyclones? Hugo, by his destructive force, is also the catalyst for crucial reforms to strengthen the resilience of French territories to natural disasters, paving the way for a change in construction practices and preventive measures.

programme.title: TV without filter, 30 years of impertinence
programme.desc: Unpredictable, sometimes embarrassing, sometimes hilarious, but always revealing: impertinence arises where television, by its very nature, seeks to master everything. Yet television is never as alive as it is when it agrees to be a little shook. This film traces the evolution of this freedom of expression that goes through the story of the small screen, and questions the implicit rules of the set.
programme.desc-more: Unpredictable, sometimes embarrassing, sometimes hilarious, but always revealing: impertinence arises where television, by its very nature, seeks to master everything. Yet television is never as alive as it is when it agrees to be a little shook. Through carefully chosen archives and testimonies, this documentary traces the evolution of this freedom of expression that crosses the history of the small screen, and questions the implicit rules of the set. Between freedom and constraints, challenges of images and editorial imperatives, television has a complex relationship with this insolence that it fears, but which it also knows how to use to create cult sequences.

programme.title: Verdun: 300 days, 300 nights
programme.desc: "The Furnace"1916. For 300 days and 300 nights, more than a million French converge in Verdun, a strategic bulwark to fight German troops.
programme.desc-more: 1916. For 300 days and 300 nights, more than one million French from all regions of France and colonies converge in Verdun, a strategic bulwark to fight German troops occupying part of the country. For the first time, in the same momentum, France of the "small countries" is fighting to save the entire nation. Verdun is much more than a military battle, it is both a place and a founding moment inscribed in the memory of all families, where a new feeling was born, that of belonging to the Republic. Rare and unpublished testimonies of soldiers and civilians from the rear revive this battle.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: "The Temporal capsule"Anatole Latile, a schoolboy dissipated but resourceful, spends all his energy getting into trouble.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: "Mothers in Tournai"A Belgian inspector and a French police officer investigate in Tournai, in the middle of the boatmen, after the discovery of an arm tattooed with a bee, under the Pont des Trous.
programme.desc-more: The peaceful waters of the Scheldt deliver a sinister message under the bridge of the Trous in Tournai: a cut arm wearing the tattoo of a bee, royal emblem inherited from Childeric I. Belgian inspector Mathilde takes over the case with the support of Vincent, a French police officer specially mandated. Both investigators gradually trace the trail of this enigmatic symbol deeply rooted in the history of the city. Their investigations plunge them into the particular atmosphere of the river's shores and lead them into the very closed world of the batelière community.

programme.sub-title: Murders at the Pointe du Raz
programme.desc: "Mothers at the Pointe du Raz"The body of an old woman is found stranded on the beach, at the foot of the Pointe du Raz. The affair revives an old Breton legend still alive in the region.
programme.desc-more: In this eighth season of "Mouttres à...", viewers are invited to dive into the heart of French regions, each offering its own picturesque setting and unique traditions. Each episode reveals a captivating police investigation, where murders are inextricably linked to local legends, ancestral customs or elements of historical heritage. Investigators must navigate through centuries-old stories and buried mysteries to detect the truth. This season highlights emblematic destinations such as the Cathar Country, with its medieval castles, and the city of Toulouse, rich in culture and history. Other places such as Cayenne, Cognac, Granville, Albi and Pont-l'Évêque also bring their own intriguing atmosphere, enriching each survey with a cultural depth. The characters, whether they are investigators or witnesses, find themselves immersed in stories where the past and present intertwine, offering a spectacle that is both entertaining and immersive.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: François Schaar (Daniel Auteuil), a renowned lawyer, finds himself at the heart of a media storm while defending the families of two young girls who have suffered from a notorious child crime. As the trial grows, Francis' personal life begins to crack under the weight of the accusations that emerge. His wife, Astrid (Emmanuele Devos), was forced to face the doubts of their adult daughter, Carole, who asked him to reflect on François' past actions, questioning the integrity of their family. Meanwhile, Raphael, their teenage son, adopts an increasingly erratic behavior, exacerbating tension in the home. As external pressure intensified, François had to navigate between his professional responsibilities and the growing troubles of his family life, while seeking to protect those he loved from the devastating consequences of his engagement in this mediated affair.

programme.title: Vera's investigations
programme.desc: Danny Meadon, a young salesman in a market that is about to be sold, is killed on a country bridge, victim of a driver in the middle of the night. Inspector Vera Stanhope quickly directed her investigation to Tony Meadon, the father of the deceased, who had already been marked by the recent death of his wife. The investigation is taking an unexpected turn with Joe Ashworth's arrival, promoted to detective. Initially mandated to evaluate the unit under new guidelines, he decided to return to Vera's team, allowing him to look after his father in a nursing home.
programme.desc-more: In the wild moors of Northumberland, swept by icy winds and bathed in raw light, crimes never remain buried for long. It is here that Vera Stanhope (Brenda Blethyn), chief inspector with a rough temperament as the surrounding landscapes, conducts her investigations with a relentless intuition and caustic humour that destabilizes her colleagues as well as the suspects. Dressed in her eternal worn coat, with a headband in shape, she embodies a force of nature, indifferent to conventions, obsessed with one thing: the truth. With him, Joe Ashworth (David Leon), his dedicated assistant, acts as a spiritual son – a delicate balance between his ideal youth and the experienced cynicism of his mentor. Everything changes when a 15-year-old, Luke Armstrong, is found dead in his bathtub, his face frozen in an expression of terror, strangled by a lace. But what should look like an ordinary family drama turns into a macabre riddle: the assassin has laid fresh flowers on the surface of the water, such as a funeral offer or a sinister signature. For Vera, this too much theatrical detail feels the calculation. Who could have done such a cold and methodical act? A relative? A stranger? Or worse, someone who's just getting started? As the investigation sinks into the unfavorable secrets of the small community, Vera and Joe discover that Luke, apparently a high school student without history, hid troubled bonds – family lies, school tensions, perhaps even dangerous relationships. Each testimony raises new questions, each alibi cracks. Then a second murder occurs, even more meticulously staged. The doubt is no longer allowed: a serial killer is walking around the county, and his ritual seems to obey a logic that only a twisted mind could understand. Between the heavy silences of suspects, the unsaid of a region where everyone knows each other and the false-likes of well-organized respectability, Vera must unravel the skewer of a case where nothing seems to be the same. But the more it digs, the closer the danger gets. Because this killer isn't just hitting – He watches, he anticipates, and he likes to play with those who track him. How far will Vera have to go to get rid of her game before a new victim falls? And what does this series of murders reveal about the buried demons in this lost corner of England, where appearances are often the best of camouflages?

programme.desc: At the foot of the pine tower in Montpellier, an inanimate man wakes up, near a handwritten paper. Quickly, it collapses again, this time stiff dead. Meanwhile, the commander Léa Soler confides to her mother that she is afraid to meet Paul, who has not given any news since she replied "yes" to her marriage proposal. Arriving at the bottom of the tower, Léa learns that the corpse is that of a 35-year-old Montpellieran, historian specialist of Nostradamus. The famous paper is a vellum, parchment of the Middle Ages containing an old French text. For his part, Captain Paul Marchal found a cell phone window, suggesting that the researcher had fallen from the top of the tower.

programme.title: Skyfall
programme.desc: In a world where secret agents are increasingly in danger, James Bond (Daniel Craig) finds himself facing a formidable opponent in "Skyfall". As he began to pursue a hard drive containing the identities of undercover agents, his mission led him to Istanbul. Unfortunately, an accidental injury caused by his teammate left him for death, forcing him to disappear from traffic. This failure caused a fiery failure, and Mr (Judi Dench) was forced to leave MI6. Shortly thereafter, a tragic event upset the MI6 headquarters when a bomb destroyed M's office, marking the beginning of a new era of chaos for the British secret services. In this way, Bond, although still at a disadvantage, is resurfaced in London. Before he can investigate this devastating attack, he must go through a series of tests to prove his worth, testing not only his bravery, but also his loyalty to the organization he serves. As he advances in this spiral of danger and betrayal, Bond realizes that real threats can come from inside and from outside, paving the way for explosive confrontation.

programme.title: Telethon, everything for life
programme.desc: In the 1980s, determined parents refused to accept the announced death of their children, who had a neuromuscular disease unknown to all, myopathy. Without money, without a network, without scientific legitimacy, these families are guided by their determination alone. They went to the United States to convince star Jerry Lewis to lend their name to them, then forced the doors of French television to impose a crazy bet: a 28-hour television marathon to raise awareness of their children's illness. On 4 and 5 December 1987, France as a whole mobilized, village by village, and collected nearly 30 million euros in record time.

programme.title: Absent, in the heart of Piche
programme.desc: Revealed in the show Drag Race France, Piche, the bearded drag queen, marked the minds at the opening ceremony of the 2024 Olympic Games. In March 2025, this queer icon displays complete for his concert at L'Élysée-Montmartre in Paris. While the audience is eagerly waiting for his entry on stage, Piche is reloading behind the scenes with his mother and twin brother. This documentary traces her journey, from her early childhood in her gypsy community in Arles to today, and highlights the challenges and obstacles she has had to face.

programme.title: An odyssey
programme.desc: In a scenography mixing sound and light, the musical culture of the Overseas Territories reveals itself on stage in all its generosity and plurality. Guyanese artist Sisley Loubet invites artists of several generations on stage, with various influences to trace the history, traditions and heritage of ultramarine culture through music and dance on the occasion of the first edition of the "La 1ère à Marseille" festival. With the participation of Roger Raspail, Yann Villageois, Jean-Philippe Grivalliers, Gildas Lutin, Jocelyne Béroar, DJ Killerz, Sya and many others.

programme.title: Let yourself be told
programme.desc: The Renaissance, a real artistic and cultural explosion from Italy, allows France to discover the great Leonardo da Vinci, and to acquire magnificent castles. At that time, the knight King Francis 1 wanted to adorn France with all the splendors and the wars of religion deeply divided the country. From the Loire Valley to Paris, which is an important capital, this journey through time allows you to contemplate spectacular achievements of the time such as the Leonardo da Vinci castle, the Queen's Hotel or the Samaritan Pomp.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: Injured, Lan Jun must rest. But the teenager disobeys to date Kai. At the same time, La Tigresse finds an Eclat who makes her invulnerable.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: A mysterious vigilante, who remotely controls electrical equipment connected thanks to his hacker skills, attacks all the wealthy among London's animals.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, an exceptional-looking Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and fearless companion, are attacking mysteries that even Scotland Yard has not been able to solve. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to plunge into delicate business, mixing secrets, betrayals and puzzles. Each episode sees them explore emblematic places and interview colorful characters, ranging from local traders to mysterious street dwellers. With a mixture of intelligence and instinct, Clever uses his sense of sharp observation to detect often neglected clues, while Bro, as a driving force, brings a touch of boldness to their investigations. Together, they form an unlikely but effective duo, sailing through the meandering of London's crime. Their quest for truth leads them to discover surprising revelations, questioning everything they thought they knew about their neighbourhood.

programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, a pig named Clever, with a keen sense of observation, and her brother Bro, a little impulsive, are embarking on captivating investigations. programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Oscar and Malika meet Jin, a ninja who asks them to pretend to be his apprentices. In fact, to become a ninja master, he must present at least one apprentice this morning to the great master of his clan. Curious to see a real secret dojo and a ninja clan, the children accept. But the simple presentation turns into a fight against the great master's apprentice to prove their worth
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole and Jason are doing everything possible to recover a very rare Startruc figure, confiscated by the director, using Louis Magimax's magic tricks.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: The farmer is charging Bitzer to put a new haystack in the face, but the hungry sheep have hidden themselves inside and are transformed into mobile balls.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Chico, a pink flamingo, crashes at the feet of Belfort and Lupin, thinking he came to Africa. The two heroes will try to help him find his way back.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the "Belfort & Lupin" series, the story begins unexpectedly when a pink flamingo named Chico, disoriented and exhausted, crashes at the feet of our two heroes, Belfort and Lupin. Convinced of having arrived in Africa, Chico quickly realized that he was far from his destination. The two protagonists, always ready to help those in need, decide to embark on a rock adventure to help the flamboyant bird find its way back. As they travel, they meet a gallery of colorful characters and find themselves confronted with comedic and unexpected situations. Challenges are accumulating, testing their ingenuity and friendship. As the tracks multiply, Belfort and Lupin will have to navigate through misunderstandings and misunderstandings, proving that mutual aid and solidarity are essential, even in the most disconcerting moments.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.sub-title: From the menagerie to the rififi
programme.desc: The change of the lama Serge's enclosures creates a real tsunami in the household because Madame Rosa does not support her new neighbour.
programme.desc-more: At La Ménagerie, a local zoo, the change of the enclosures of the lama Serge (Alexandre Nguyen) provokes a real agitation. Indeed, Madame Rosa (Barbara Tissier), a passionate and devoted careful woman, cannot bear the presence of this new neighbour with an unpredictable character. Serge, with his mischievous temperament and his tendency to sow disorder, disturbs the well-ordered daily life of the household, where every animal and every employee has their place. The tension between Rosa and Serge, exacerbated by the mockery of other animals, is rising, while the zoo director, Mr. Bouvier (Hugo Brunswick), is trying to find a solution to calm the situation. Over the days, conflicts are increasing, leading to nasty and unforeseen situations. Between rivalries, emerging friendships and the challenge of living together, this episode promises a humorous exploration of inter-animal and human relations, where everyone will have to learn to accept differences.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco is followed by a mysterious yellow wax character: Lola and Eugene immediately think that it is linked to Molusco's secret and that he is in danger...
programme.desc-more: In a world where strange and everyday life is at hand, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of living a normal life like any eleven-year-old. In search of acceptance, he navigates between his aquatic origins and his desire for integration into human society. His adventures lead him into rough and sometimes perilous situations, as he tries to make friends and discover the joys of childhood, such as sport, games and school. However, his hybrid nature often complicates his task, as he must juggle with prejudice and mockery of his comrades. Through his journeys, Musculo will learn valuable lessons about friendship, self-acceptance and the courage to live fully, despite differences. Each episode explores the unique challenges it faces while offering a touching and humorous look at the quest for identity and belonging.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: A small, half-hust, half-human boy, Molusco can communicate with whales and has a talking shell. Yet his only wish is to lead a normal life.
programme.desc-more: In a world where normality seems out of reach, Musculo, a half-hustler, half-human boy, is struggling with his unique identity. At only eleven years old, he dreams of living like other children, playing football, making friends and living adventures without being constantly judged for his difference. As he navigates between the joys and challenges of childhood, Musculo faces hilarious and touching situations that highlight his desire for acceptance. His interactions with his peers, parents and mentors reveal the complexities of his existence, oscillating between the desire to belong and the pride of his origins. Through his adventures, Musculo learns that true acceptance begins with self-love. While he struggles to find his place in a world that does not always understand his singularity, he discovers that difference can also be a force.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Travis, Inspector McFlare's loyal lieutenant, came to find Clever to tell him of his doubts about the strange behavior of his leader.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, a pig named Clever from India, with a keen sense of observation, and her brother Bro, a little too impulsive, are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve old and complex cases, the two hairy compera are attacking mysteries that have long escaped human investigators. Their first case leads them into the world of mysterious disappearances of pets, where they discover a clandestine network of traffickers. With their ingenuity and sense of camaraderie, Clever and Bro immerse themselves in a thrilling investigation, questioning the inhabitants of the neighborhood and deciphering clues left behind. Their boldness and determination will lead them to surprising revelations that may well change the perception that humans have of these small creatures, while proving to them that team spirit can overcome the greatest obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: The Earth is being invaded. Back on Earth, Oscar, Malika and Prudence must prevent aliens from opening an intergalactic portal through which their army will land.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Heiva, at the heart of Polynesian traditions
programme.desc: Every year, Polynesia lives at the pace of a captivating festival, the oldest in Tahiti, which has been fascinating for more than a century: the Heiva.
programme.desc-more: Still little known in Hexagon, Heiva is a cultural manifestation that blends traditional Tahitian songs and dances. A true social event in Polynesia, this festival of songs and dances is considered the most important cultural event of the year and strongly mobilizes all the groups that sign up for it because it requires thousands of hours of preparation to transmit artistic and traditional times of the history of Polynesia. Evening forbidden for a time in the early nineteenth century, today it regained all its splendor.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: During an electrical failure in the Lexington neighbourhood, where the electronics stopped operating, Clever investigates the scene of a flight.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India with exceptional insight, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive, are embarking on fascinating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to attack cases that even Scotland Yard detectives struggle to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex mystery involving a series of unexplained disappearances and clues lost in the alleys of the city. While Clever uses his keen sense of observation to decipher the puzzles, Bro often gets carried away by his enthusiasm, which leads them into unforeseen and sometimes perilous situations. Together, they must navigate through a world of intrigues and secrets, while cultivating their brotherly bond and their love for adventure. The two brothers will discover that the key to solving this mystery may be their ability to combine their unique talents.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: After having met a shaman, Oscar and Malika travel in an astral dimension where they are transformed into totem animals.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: All eggs were requisitioned for Easter, so there is no more one for the king's meal. Belfort and Lupin try to preserve a swan egg from cooks.
programme.desc-more: In the majestic setting of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, the intrepid duo of Belfort, a faithful dog of Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, was illustrated by his heroic actions. In the lush gardens of the royal residence, these two unlikely friends devote themselves to protecting their fur-and-fine companions, whether they are from the Royal Household or the surrounding wilderness. Each episode leads them into thrilling adventures, where their friendship and courage are tested. Whether it's to rescue an injured bird or to find a lost cat, Belfort and Lupin are showing remarkable team spirit. Through unexpected challenges, they discover not only the joys of mutual aid, but also the dangers that lie ahead in this enchanting and perilous world. Their incessant quest to save the most vulnerable leads them to experience moments rich in emotions, thus forging an unwavering link between these two creatures, emblematic of loyalty and bravery.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Belfort and Lupin help Madame Rosa, the elephant, prepare a grand and improvised celebration to celebrate her 100th anniversary with all the animals of the Household.
programme.desc-more: While the Court of Humans left the fascist of Versailles to take refuge in the soothing setting of Fontainebleau, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) found himself immersed in an ocean of despair. In the King's room, he mourns his forgetfulness, feeling abandoned and invisible in a courtyard where prestige and power reign as masters. As the festivities were full at Fontainebleau, he wondered about his role and place in this world where appearances predominate. Meanwhile, political intrigues and court rivalries threaten to upset the fragile balance between the nobles. programme.desc: Molusco vexes Arthur without wanting to and feels super bad. To give his fellow science fiction fan a smile, he disguises himself as an alien.

Feeling guilty and eager to repair his mistake, Molusco concocts a bold plan to give the smile back to his fellow scientist-fiction. He decided to dress up as an alien and began making spectacular appearances in front of Arthur's window, hoping to entertain and surprise him. The latter, amazed by the presence of his new alien friend, sees his worries fade. This crazy adventure highlights the importance of friendship and creativity, while offering a touch of humour and emotion through Molusco's misadventures.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: After seeing a documentary about molluscs and seeing the disgust of his classmates, Molusco thinks that no one will ever like him as he is.
programme.desc-more: In the "Supermollusk" episode of the "Molusco" series, Molusco, a young mollusk with a tender heart, finds himself confronted with a destabilizing reality after viewing a documentary on molluscs. To his surprise, he realized that his classmates felt a deep disgust for him and his nature. Feeling rejected and misunderstood, Molusco, interpreted by Matthew Forbes, is taken from a impulse of despair and loneliness. To remedy this sense of isolation, he makes the bold decision to disguise himself as a superhero, hoping to conquer the affection and admiration of his peers. This choice drives him into a series of adventures where he will have to prove not only his worth, but also understand that self-acceptance is paramount. On the way, he meets various characters, including his friends who help him discover the strength of friendship and the importance of being self-reliant, even in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco accompanies Coco for a visit to the museum. But back home, Molusco discovers that Coco stole a painting depicting a shell Saint Jaques: he fell in love...
programme.desc-more: During a museum trip, Molusco accompanies his friend Coco, whose enthusiasm for art is palpable. In exploring the various works, Coco is particularly captivated by a painting depicting a Saint-Jacques shell, symbol of beauty and delicacy that deeply affect him. However, their visit takes an unexpected turn when, back home, Molusco discovers with astonishment that Coco has stolen this work of art. This impulsive flight is not only an act of malice, but the sign of an emerging and obsessive love for this unique piece. As Molusco tries to understand his friend's motivations, he finds himself drawn into a whirlwind of moral emotions and dilemmas. The situation prompts them to reflect on the value of art, friendship and the consequences of their actions, while revealing the depth of their connection.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: The Queen is here to solicit Clever for an ultra-confidential mission. The night before, her secret agent warned her of imminent danger before mysteriously disappearing.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unusual pets, Clever, a pig from India in the sense of exceptional observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive in character, are embarking on captivating investigations. Their peaceful daily life quickly turns into a series of thrilling adventures as they tackle mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Thanks to Clever's sharp intelligence and Bro's audacity, the two partners are at the heart of complex business, where every detail counts. From the disappearance of precious objects to puzzles that challenge logic, their determination leads them to foil clever plans. But their quest for truth also exposes them to unexpected dangers, testing their brotherly bond. In this episode, Clever and Bro's humor and ingenuity illuminate dark affairs, revealing that even the smallest of us can make a difference.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Oscar is so stressed by today's math control that he didn't sleep last night. As a result, he falls asleep on the way and no way to wake him up.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: A troupe of Russian swans arrive in Versailles to give a large water ballet. The choreographer panics: fountains do not work.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the majestic gardens of the Palace of Versailles, in the seventeenth century, a singular friendship was established between Belfort, a loyal and affectionate dog, and Lupin, a daring and curious wolf. Together, these two heteroclites embark on thrilling adventures that test their courage and ingenuity. Each episode sees them facing unforeseen challenges, whether it is to rescue a bird trapped in the meshes of a net or to protect the animals of the Royal Household from the dangers of the outside world. Their quest for justice and protection leads them through the lush alleys and hidden secrets of the gardens, where they meet other fascinating characters. With a good dose of humour and emotion, Belfort and Lupin remind us that friendship transcends barriers, and that even the most unlikely allies can make a difference in desperate situations.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Molière's troupe is in Versailles to give a performance. Among them are Poc, a dog that looks like Belfort like two drops of water.
programme.desc-more: Molière's troupe met in Versailles for a long-awaited performance, while the effervescence of the court was mixed with the rumours of nobility. Among the actors, a dog named Poc, with a surprisingly similar physical appearance to that of Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen), joins the adventure, inciting curiosity and fun. As the rehearsals progress, tensions are growing among the troops, each seeking to shine on stage while navigating in the court's political intrigues. Belfort, with its lively spirit and charm, tries to keep the harmony within the group, while juggling with its own ambitions. However, rivalries are formed, threatening not only the performance, but also the friendships that unite actors. Through quiproquos and twists, this day in Versailles promises to be memorable, with Poc as a true actor in this human comedy.

programme.desc: Salty, a cat from the Royal Guard, is paralyzed by a mysterious knight with supernatural powers. Clever and Bro must discover the identity of this knight and lift the spell.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's impulsive and adventurous brother, are engaged in investigations that go beyond imagination. Together, they start a series of mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Their first challenge is to bring them into a complex enigma involving a daring art flight, where invaluable works have disappeared without leaving any trace. Thanks to their lively mind and ability to sneak into unexpected places, the two brothers discovered a well-organized criminal network, using clever techniques to escape justice. While they are thwarting the plans of their opponents, Clever and Bro will also have to overcome their own differences to make the truth come out. Their friendship and determination will be tested in this thrilling adventure, where each clue counts and where danger is around every corner.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: The Earth is being invaded. Back on Earth, Oscar, Malika and Prudence must prevent aliens from opening an intergalactic portal through which their army will land.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Sidonia must fill in the adventure book of the stuffed girl in her class. Anatole is determined to help him, and he has lots of original ideas. But it's not counting on Ange Mafiolo.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: After being locked up outside the sheepfold, can the herd survive the camping with Shaun or will it join the suitable and reliable tent of Bitzer?
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Belfort notes that her mother has a strange behavior: she is more severe and distant than usual, and refuses to let her children approach her.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, two unexpected companions, Belfort and Lupin, are engaged in a series of thrilling adventures. Belfort, a faithful Louis XIV dog, and Lupin, a bold wolf, form an inseparable duo, joining forces to protect the hair and feather residents of the Royal Household and the surrounding wildlife. Each episode leads them into perilous situations where their friendship and ingenuity are tested. Meetings with colourful characters, spectacular rescues and unexpected discoveries will mark their journey. Together, they will face challenges, overcome traps and navigate through the intrigues of the royal court, while learning to overcome their differences. In this series, friendship and loyalty intertwine with moments of humour and emotion, offering a unique look at animal life at the Sun King's court.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: After an uncontrolled slide in the castle, Lupin found himself locked in the cabinet at the clock. Belfort wants to deliver his friend.
programme.desc-more: After an unexpected slide in the corridors of the majestic Versailles castle, Lupin (Alexandre Nguyen) finds himself trapped in the mysterious clock cabinet. This cabinet, both fascinating and terrifying, is subjected to a complex mechanism that the royal watchmaker dates back every day at nightfall. Alarmed by this situation, Belfort, Lupin's faithful friend, is concerned about the disastrous consequences if humans discover the presence of his companion in the castle. To save Lupin before the watchmaker's arrival, Belfort drew up a bold plan. Knowing by heart the workings of the daily life of Versailles, he formed a team of intrepid animals: Ariane, Gazette, Artus, Marcus, and even Madame Rosa. Together, they engage in a perilous mission, while avoiding crossing Bazire, the royal dog, who continues to pursue Belfort to remind him of his obligations. The adventure is full of twists and dangers.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco spends his time at Bruno's, new in the neighborhood, and Rafik feels left out. Molusco's gonna find out Bruno's not an ordinary boy.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Mousco", Molusco, a young curious and endearing character, discovers a new friend in the person of Bruno, a little boy recently arrived in the neighborhood. In search of adventures and camaraderie, Molusco spent all his time with Bruno, gradually neglecting his former friend Rafik, who felt increasingly isolated. While Molusco is excited about this new friendship, he does not know that Bruno hides an amazing secret: in reality, he is a gastronomic chef passionate about oysters, having taken the appearance of a child to explore the world of children. At the same time, Molusco, eager to appear as muscular as Ozzy, is embarking on a weight building program, but his efforts seem to be in vain. This episode illustrates with humour and tenderness the dynamics of friendship, jealousy and misunderstandings that may arise in the quest for acceptance and recognition.

programme.title: Molusco

programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Mousco", Molusco, a clumsy but endearing character, finds himself in a delicate situation after accidentally breaking Coco's television. In an attempt to repair his mistake, he replaces the defective screen with a goldfish, thinking that this pet will bring a little joy to his friend. However, he soon realized that this gesture had unexpected consequences. The fish, named Poissonou, seems to quickly win Coco's heart, causing Molusco to feel jealous and anxious. As he observes with despair the growing complicity between Coco and his new aquatic friend, Molusco must reflect on his own feelings and the value of their friendship. This emotional conflict leads to questions about his place in Coco's life and what it really means to be a friend.
