programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: To look as muscular as Ozzy, Molusco starts to muscle up, in vain. He finally has an idea of genius: he has pearls in his entire body.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fantastic universe, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of living an ordinary life as an eleven-year-old. Despite his physical characteristics that distinguish him from other children, Musculo aspires to integrate and enjoy the simple pleasures of childhood, such as playing football or spending time with his friends. However, his singular appearance attracts the sometimes mocking attention of his comrades, which makes him feel excluded and misunderstood. As the episodes progress, Musculo faces various challenges that test his courage and determination. He discovers the importance of friendship and self-acceptance, while sailing through the trials of preadolescence. Accompanied by his friends, he will live a life of loufrosque and touching adventures that will allow him to get closer to his dream of a normal life, while celebrating his difference and learning to accept himself as he is.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco accidentally breaks Coco's precious TV and replaces it with a goldfish. But Molusco regrets his gesture, the fish being too bulky.
programme.desc-more: After an unexpected fall at school, Molusco, a young fearless hero, finds himself in the hospital to perform radios. To his surprise, he discovers that he has no skeleton, a disturbing fact that plunges him into anxiety. In search of answers, he searches a doctor's office and puts his hand on a skeleton he decides to swallow, thinking of solving his problem. However, he does not suspect that this skeleton is that of a monkey, and the situation takes an unexpected turn when it is confused with the missing link of human evolution. As Molusco tries to navigate this new disorder, he also has to face the consequences of his unpredictable act, causing a series of hilarious and disconcerting events. Surrounded by friends and enemies, he will have to prove his worth while discovering the surprising truths about himself and his identity.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Tommy the gutted cat got bitten by a strange bat. His friend Red doesn't believe his eyes: Tommy has become a vampire!
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, two fearsome investigators, Clever, a pig from India with an exceptional flair for observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive and reckless, are attacking mysteries that escape even the experts of Scotland Yard. While the city has been in the grip of unresolved cases for years, Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of deduction to decipher clues that no one else sees, while Bro does not hesitate to plunge head first into action, bringing a touch of unpredictability to their investigations. Together, they explore cases as varied as mysterious disappearances, bold robberies and buried secrets, while encountering formidable opponents. As they journey, the two brothers discover not only the complexity of the crimes they try to solve, but also the strength of their brotherly bond in a world where danger is at every corner of the street.

Their complicity and determination will lead them to surprising revelations, proving that even the smallest can make a great difference in the quest for justice.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: By racing to school, Oscar and Malika are pushing an old witch who turns them into elderly people to punish them.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.desc: Okoo-koo - Season 5: even closer to children, even more inspiring! For his fifth season, Okoo-koo continues his mission: to awaken curiosity, encourage creativity and accompany children in their discovery of the world through fun, positive and inspiring content. programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Mom and Bluey play at Mom's School when Mom teaches Bluey how to manage her dissipated children and become a better mother.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Carmen, the Matador
programme.desc: In Martinique of the 1900s, Carmen, a proud and unsuspecting Creole woman, claimed her freedom against Don José, a military man from the island's bourgeoisie. The fatal passion of the two lovers is tied from the distillery to the final drama, which takes place in the middle of the carnival. Their love tragedy makes the social and identity tensions of the territory resonate...

programme.title: Flight, three voices from overseas
programme.desc: Cross portraits of Axelle Saint-Cirel, Livia Louis-Joseph Dogué and Luan Pommier, three lyrical singers from Outre-mer in the midst of the ascent.
programme.desc-more: The ascent of three lyrical singers - Axelle Saint-Cirel, Luan Pommier and Livia Louis-Joseph Dogué - reveals three singular trajectories which, each in its own way, push the codes and open the doors of the opera. Mezzo-soprano with a deep stamp, Axelle Saint-Cirel, winner of the fifth edition of the Voice of the Overseas 2023 contest, bears in her the legacy of Guadeloupe. Lyric singer, pianist and composer, Luan Pommier, prize at the 2020 Voix des Outre-Mer competition, is moving on a path where virtuosity and sensitivity meet. Winner of the 2019 Young Talent Award from the Voice of the Overseas Competition, the Martiniquia soprano Livia Louis-Joseph Dogué is a rising figure of her generation.

programme.title: A Caledonian at the Opera
programme.desc: Originally from New Caledonia, Marie Canehmez took part in the final of the 5th edition of the Voix des Outres-Mer competition at Opéra Bastille on 4 February 2023.
programme.desc-more: The documentary follows Marie Canehmez, an opera lover from her early age. On February 4, 2023, she participated in the Opéra Bastille in the final of the 5th edition of the Voix des Outres-mer competition. She is among ten other candidates from Outre Mer. Self-taught, she started singing at the Nouméa Conservatory. After taking the master class of countertenor Fabrice di Falco to prepare her voice at best, she tries her luck at Opéra Bastille. She will be right, because she will emerge from this unique experience.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: After a victorious campaign, Macbeth and Banquo, the army leaders of the Monarch Duncan, met three witches. The latter predict that Macbeth will become Count and then become sacred King. The ambition continued to inhabit him, a feeling fed by his wife Lady Macbeth who urged him to assassinate the king to seize the throne.

programme.title: We need to make a world
programme.desc: Between stories of resilience, unknown traditions and struggles for equality, Karl Sanchez, better known as Drag queen Nicky Doll, explores the human and cultural richness of each country. As the meetings progressed, he was welcomed by the locals, shared their daily lives, tasted local specialities, discovered singular practices and tried out new experiences. Light and deeply human, the series looks at the world in a quirky and positive way and carries a message of hope and tolerance. In South Africa, Nicky Doll explores a country that turns its wounds into collective power. From art to activism, from nature to drag, diversity is an act of resistance and reconciliation.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Great detectives!
programme.desc: Netflix merges two episodes into one. (26/09/19)
programme.desc-more: In a small Australian city, a group of four pre-teens with a keen sense of justice and insatiable curiosity unite to found their own detective agency. Composed of the intelligent and determined Abby (Abby Bergman), the brilliant Aston (Aston Droomer), the russy Jamil (Jamil Smyth-Secka) and the creative Anna (Anna Cooke), this group of friends embarks on a series of captivating investigations that lead them to solve mysteries around their school and neighbourhood. Each episode confronts them with various puzzles, ranging from the disappearance of personal objects to disturbing rumours that disturb the peace of their establishment. As they strive to thwart clever ploys and discover the truth, young detectives must also navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and school rivalries. With an unwavering team spirit, they face unexpected obstacles, testing their investigative skills and their ability to remain united against adversity. "Super detectives!" plunges spectators into a thrilling universe where every investigation is a full-fledged adventure, filled with suspense and humour. Young heroes learn that solving mysteries is not only a matter of intelligence, but also of courage and solidarity.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. These revelations lead her to the location of the next meeting of The Cause, a secret organization led by an evil Knight whose intentions are obscure and threatening. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: In order to enjoy a prototype of the Startruc robot that only comes out in a month, Anatole and Jason are being locked in the search galleries.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.desc: When the farmer's tractor is stuck in the field, Shaun tries to clear it but only creates more problems.
programme.desc-more: In a rural corner of England, Shaun, a mischievous and clever sheep, stands out from his congeners, who are often too naive to understand his bold plans. The peaceful life on the farm takes an unexpected turn when Shaun, in search of a little excitement, decides to escape the daily routine. With the help of his friends, a group of clumsy but devoted sheep, he set up a series of ingenious schemes to thwart the rules of the farm. Their first adventure leads them to a getaway in the nearby city, where they find themselves facing unexpected challenges and uncomprehensive humans. Each new situation testes their ingenuity and friendship, while Shaun must navigate between humour and misadventures. In this quest full of surprises, Shaun proves that even a simple sheep can become a hero, while bringing a touch of madness to the farm life.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Rosa was put in her pen, accused of eating the peas of the vegetable garden, which were intended for Louis XIV's royal dinner.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the enchanting gardens of the Palace of Versailles, in the seventeenth century, there is an unusual friendship between Belfort, a noble loyal dog, and Lupin, a bold wolf with a tender heart. Together, these two intrepid companions form an inseparable duo, ready to do anything to protect their friends with hairs and feathers. Whether it is by helping the residents of the Royal Household or by helping wild animals, their courage and ingenuity are boundless. In this thrilling episode, they find themselves confronted with a series of mysteries and perils, testing their unwavering link. Between unbridled races through the green alleys and unexpected encounters with other residents of the court, Belfort and Lupin demonstrate that love and friendship transcend all barriers. Every new adventure they discover the true value of courage and loyalty in a world where danger is around every corner.

Despite his singular appearance, he navigates through the daily challenges of school life and social interactions, while trying to conceal his true nature. Musculo faces mockery and misunderstanding from his comrades, but he clings to his dream of an ordinary existence. Accompanied by his friends, he embarked on a series of rock adventures, ranging from discovering his own extraordinary abilities to fighting obstacles that seem insurmountable. In this episode, he will also have to face up to some crazy and unexpected situations that will prompt him to redefine what it means to be "normal". In seeking to integrate, Musculo will discover that self-acceptance is perhaps the key to a successful life.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and baffled world, Molusco, an endearing character, finds himself in a delicate situation with his friend Coco. Both eager to please Lola for Mother's Day, they set out on a quest to collect money to buy a memorable gift. Their search leads them to a Mexican wrestling tournament, an event as unpredictable as it is exciting. In this arena where sweat and rivalry reign, Molusco has to face formidable opponents, each with his own style of combat and eccentric personality. As he engages in this intense competition, Molusco discovers not only the strength of friendship and determination necessary to overcome obstacles, but also the values of loyalty and sacrifice. This tournament will become a real event of courage, where each catch is a step towards the perfect gift for Lola, while revealing unexpected facets of himself.

programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's impulsive and adventurous brother, are engaged in investigations that go beyond imagination. Together, they start a series of mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Their first challenge is to bring them into a complex enigma involving a daring art flight, where invaluable works have disappeared without leaving any trace. Thanks to their lively mind and ability to sneak into unexpected places, the two brothers discovered a well-organized criminal network, using clever techniques to escape justice. While they are thwarting the plans of their opponents, Clever and Bro will also have to overcome their own differences to make the truth come out. Their friendship and determination will be tested in this thrilling adventure, where each clue counts and where danger is around every corner.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: As they arrive at the museum before everyone else, Oscar and Malika come to help the Young girl with the pearl, straight out of Vermeer's famous painting.
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Arts transition
programme.sub-title: From Offenbach to Verdi, variation around Paris
programme.desc: A concert recorded in 2014 at the Musée d'Orsay in Paris. The musical program was entirely dedicated to the city of Paris and was performed by the Orchestre Philharmonique de Radio France, directed by Mikko Franck, the Choir and the Master's degree in Radio-France, and by prestigious soloists and dancers of French Cancan. Like the Ville-Lumière, this show is romantic and festive, thanks to the most beautiful airs of the classical repertoire and the great popular songs inspired by it: waltzes, arias, songs, cancans and gypsy tunes, succeed each other and celebrate Paris, thanks to the works of Trenet, Offenbach, Waldteufel, Scotto, Massenet, Puccini, Lehar, Gounod, Gershwin and Verdi.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon at Olympia: The Things of Life - Cinema II
programme.desc: Surfing on the huge wave of success that was won by her first album dedicated to the most mythical symphonies of the seventh art, the illustrious violinist continues her exploration with a second opus that pays tribute to the most famous French composers of film music. The concert featured Francis Lai with "Love Story", Maurice Jarre with "Lawrence d'Saudi", Michel Legrand with "L'Affaire Thomas Crown", Alexandre Desplats with "The Shape of Water", and Georges Delerue with "Le Dernier Métro" and "Rich and Famous".

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: "The new Jade" While all the Jades of the past are appreciated for their qualities, Jade 8 is called "Special" by Malik Melki. Vexée, she's looking to re-enact her image.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Invincible Opponent" When Inspector McFlare meets his agent, Pigeon Paxton, who is about to reveal important information to him, they are both attacked.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen mind and remarkable observational capacity, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive and bold, are embarking on police investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve thorny business, the two fur brothers take charge, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact. Their first case plunges them into an intriguing mystery: a series of inexplicable disappearances of precious toys in the neighbourhood. With their sense of deference, Clever and Bro question unlikely witnesses, explore dark alleys and use clever schemes to dislodge the culprits. As they investigate, they discover an unsuspecting criminal network, testing their intelligence and courage. Each investigation brings them a little closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that lie ahead.

programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a sharp observation, and Bro's somewhat impulsive brother, are embarking on captivating police investigations. Despite their small size, both animals manage to decipher mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Their first case takes them into a series of jewelry robberies that left the police perplexed. Clever uses his lively mind to observe the details that no one else notices, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to enter into risky situations to get clues. In parallel, they are confronted with formidable opponents, cunning criminals who are determined to protect their secrets. As they investigate, the two brothers discover a complex criminal network that threatens to plunge all Lexington into chaos. Their friendship and ingenuity will be tested as they engage in this thrilling quest to restore justice.

programme.title: Okoo-koo
programme.desc: Okoo-koo is the reception and entertainment program with a pedagogy of a group of young animators: Manon, Julia, Karim and Jason.
programme.desc-more: Okoo-koo - Season 5: even closer to children, even more inspiring! For his fifth season, Okoo-koo continues his mission: to awaken curiosity, encourage creativity and accompany children in their discovery of the world through fun, positive and inspiring content. This year, the show is getting even closer to its audience with \" Okoo, it's at home \", a new weekly sequence that gives the children the floor. Karim will meet them all over France to discover their passions, talents and initiatives, or will host them directly on the stage to share their universes. A section that places children at the heart of the program and values their creativity, personality and commitment.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: "The mood regulator"A crazy inventor causes strange behaviors in the city of Oscar and Malika. They need to find a solution to restore control of emotions.
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Tonight, the castle park is preparing to host a spectacular fireworks fire in honor of the king, attracting the curiosity of the city's inhabitants. Artus (Alexandre Nguyen) and Marcus (Hugo Brunswick), two inseparable friends, decided to attend the preparations for this festive event. As they explore the behind the scenes of the organization, they discover a vibrant world of colours and secrets. The two young men find themselves immersed in an electric atmosphere, where the pyrotechnicians work to create heavenly wonders. However, as they conduct their playful investigation, they dig up underlying tensions and unexpected rivalries between the members of the preparation team. As the long-awaited moment approaches, Artus and Marcus realize that this fireworks could reveal more than mere bright flashes, and that much more important issues are hidden behind this royal celebration.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: At the heart of a Castle where tales come to life, Charles Perrault evokes the history of the Little Red Chaperon. However, a mysterious wolf, lost in the surrounding groves, draws the attention of the Guard, who is pursuing it. Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen), initially paralyzed by fear, saw his apprehension turn into determination thanks to Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), who persuaded him to help this animal in distress. For Lupin, this encounter with a wolf of his kind, named Remus, is of particular importance. As the two companions engage in a mission of exfiltration, Remus gradually settles in Lupin's heart, appearing as a fascinating father figure. But Lupin needs a crucial question: should he abandon Belfort to join a pack and live among his fellow men? The fear of losing his friend and the threat to their quest exacerbate Belfort's concern.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: "Postcard"Lan Jun sends a postcard to Kai, who is in boarding school. But the map contains a Teleportation Eclat, and Kai is in a blink of an eye at Ban Tang.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, an ordinary young woman, discovers that she is destined to put on Jade's armor, a symbol of courage and power. The armor, once worn by the famous heroine Jade, is the key to fighting an evil force that threatens to invade his kingdom. While Lan Jun struggles to accept her destiny, she also faces her own doubts and fears. In parallel, an ancient prophecy resurfaces, revealing secrets about his family past that bind his destiny to that of armor. programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, an exceptional-looking Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and fearless companion, are attacking mysteries that even Scotland Yard has not been able to solve. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to plunge into delicate business, mixing secrets, betrayals and puzzles. Each episode sees them explore emblematic places and interview colorful characters, ranging from local traders to mysterious street dwellers. With a mixture of intelligence and instinct, Clever uses his sense of sharp observation to detect often neglected clues, while Bro, as a driving force, brings a touch of boldness to their investigations. Together, they form an unlikely but effective duo, sailing through the meandering of London's crime. Their quest for truth leads them to discover surprising revelations, questioning everything they thought they knew about their neighbourhood.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: "Magic sneakers"This morning, Oscar and Malika will be meeting at the school cross stadium. Oscar forgot his sneakers, so he put on a pair of abandoned shoes.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Okoo-koo
programme.desc: Okoo-koo is the reception and entertainment program with a pedagogy of a group of young animators: Manon, Julia, Karim and Jason.
programme.desc-more: Okoo-koo - Season 5: even closer to children, even more inspiring! For his fifth season, Okoo-koo continues his mission: to awaken curiosity, encourage creativity and accompany children in their discovery of the world through fun, positive and inspiring content. This year, the show is getting even closer to its audience with \" Okoo, it's at home \", a new weekly sequence that gives the children the floor. Karim will meet them all over France to discover their passions, talents and initiatives, or will host them directly on the stage to share their universes. A section that places children at the heart of the program and values their creativity, personality and commitment.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: "The ride" Mama helps Bluey and Bingo find some fun games ideas for car fun while Dad tries to stay in front of a convoy of gray nomads to avoid camping next to the toilet.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The attack on the giant ant"A series of abductions among cats in the Marylebone neighborhood worries the London animal sovereign. A rescuer tells him about the event.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Lexington neighbourhood of London, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India in the sense of sharp observation, and Bro, his impulsive and daring brother, are embarking on police investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. While the city is immersed in a series of troubling mysteries, the two animals find themselves confronted with complex cases, ranging from mysterious disappearances to puzzles that seem to be rooted in local folklore. Clever, with his analytical mind, deciphers clues that no one else notices, while Bro, with his overflowing energy, does not hesitate to engage in perilous situations to get answers. Together, they navigate through captivating intrigues and colorful characters, proving that even the smallest detectives can make a big difference in solving mysteries that haunt their community.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: «La Gorgone»Oscar and Malika will arrive again and again late at school in these fifty-two new adventures rocking... and yet truthful!
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: "Bubbles for Marjane"Anatole manufactures a special use to send a heart-shaped bubble to Marjane. The Mafiolos steal the object before Jason can use it.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.desc-more: In a context of fascist and mystery at the court of Louis XIV, an unfortunate incident occurred when young Ariane (Nathalie Homs) found herself to lace the royal billiard carpet, a masterpiece of craftsmanship. She panicked about the consequences of her act, and turned to her two accomplices, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), masters in the art of trickery and concealment. Together, they must develop a clever plan to mask this blunder before the game begins, where nobles and courtiers expect a demonstration of talent. Between daring ploys and nasty situations, the trio is launching a race against the clock, juggling the intrigues of the court and the expectations of the guests. As tensions rise, loyalty and ingenuity will be tested in a universe where every false step could have fatal repercussions.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: "Third arm"While Molusco finds himself in danger, a third arm pushes him on his head, to save him. Molusco is delighted, but soon to disappoint.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and baffled universe, Molusco, an endearing and clumsy character, finds himself facing an unexpected danger that threatens his existence. To save him, a third arm appears from his head, a phenomenon as surprising as it is surprising. Initially, Molusco was delighted with this new ability, thinking that it would give him unprecedented strength and agility. However, he quickly realizes that this extra arm has a clean will and starts overprotecting it excessively. This arm, with a strong and intrusive personality, makes decisions in its place, disrupting the balance of its daily life and social interactions. While Molusco tries to regain his autonomy and manage this unusual situation, he also faces unexpected challenges, thus revealing truths about himself and the sense of friendship and freedom.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: "Infernal turning"The adventures of Musculo, a little half-hust, half-human boy, who aspires to only one thing: to be able to lead the normal life of an eleven-year-old.
programme.desc-more: In a world where imagination and reality are at the same time together, Musculo, a young boy with a double nature, half-hust, half-human, dreams of living an ordinary existence at the age of eleven. He was removed from the simple pleasures of childhood because of his unique condition, and struggled to integrate among his comrades. Through his adventures, Musculo faces unexpected challenges, whether to enrol in school, participate in children's games or simply make friends. His quest for acceptance led him to explore his identity, while discovering the joys and sorrows of childhood. As the episodes progress, he meets with colorful characters who help him navigate the complexities of his atypical life. Between humour and tenderness, Musculo learns that true normality lies in the acceptance of oneself and the celebration of its differences.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: "The pool"It's summer, it's hot and Molusco and Rafik decide to dig a pool in their garden to become the kings of summer. But things are not theirs.
programme.desc-more: In the middle of the summer, as the overwhelming heat invades their neighbourhood, Molusco (Marc Bretonnière) and Rafik (Matthew Forbes) are fuelling an ambitious dream: to dig a pool in their garden to become the true kings of the summer season. Enthusiastic and motivated, they attack their project with an overflowing energy, determined to create a space of relaxation and pleasure. However, their ambition quickly turned to disaster. By increasing their efforts to make their pool irresistible, they find themselves consuming astronomical water, thus undermining the city's reserves. The situation degenerates as the inhabitants begin to feel the effects of their recklessness. Between whooping and misadventures, Molusco and Rafik will have to face the consequences of their careless act, while trying to save their summer and repair the damage caused.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Master of Lightning" During an electrical failure in the Lexington neighbourhood, where electronic devices ceased to function, Clever investigates the scene of a flight.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India with exceptional insight, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive, are embarking on fascinating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to attack cases that even Scotland Yard detectives struggle to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex mystery involving a series of unexplained disappearances and clues lost in the alleys of the city. While Clever uses his keen sense of observation to decipher the puzzles, Bro often gets carried away by his enthusiasm, which leads them into unforeseen and sometimes perilous situations. Together, they must navigate through a world of intrigues and secrets, while cultivating their brotherly bond and their love for adventure. The two brothers will discover that the key to solving this mystery may be their ability to combine their unique talents.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: "The Gingerbread Man" Oscar and Malika cross the path of a gingerbread man in the midst of adolescence crisis, who chews Oscar's business and disappears in a gloomy house.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: It's Ban Tang's party day. The Yes are planning to go together to the festival and Lan Jun hopes to meet Kai. Which is not Liam's taste.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.desc: Travis, Inspector McFlare's loyal lieutenant, came to find Clever to tell him of his doubts about the strange behavior of his leader.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, a pig named Clever from India, with a keen sense of observation, and her brother Bro, a little too impulsive, are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve old and complex cases, the two hairy compera are attacking mysteries that have long escaped human investigators. Their first case leads them into the world of mysterious disappearances of pets, where they discover a clandestine network of traffickers. programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: A Tiki, sacred statue in Polynesian culture, has just been offered to the city of Oscar and Malika. But suddenly, the statue comes alive and threatens to devastate the city! With the help of Teimana, the young guardian of Tiki, our heroes try to ease the anger of the uprooted statue of her native land.
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Mylène discovers that Anatole borrowed her clothes for a role-playing game on pirates. She's gonna have to take the tests for Jason to get them back.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: Bitzer is embarrassed when his father makes a surprise visit and finds the farm yard in a mess. Shaun and the flock then set off into a large storage.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Mr Lully and his musicians are in the middle of a rehearsal when Ariane suddenly loses control and throws herself on the cushion where Gazette was sitting.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant musical setting, Mr. Lully, a passionate conductor, leads an intense rehearsal with his musicians. As harmony reigns, the atmosphere changes abruptly when one of the musicians, Ariane, experiences an unexpected rise of anger. In the midst of tumultuous emotions, she threw herself on the cushion where Gazette, another member of the band, sat, thus disturbing the session and immerse the entire orchestra in chaos. Tensions rise as musicians try to understand the reasons for this emotional explosion. Mr Lully is facing a dilemma: how to manage this crisis without compromising the performance to come? Throughout the episode, the relationships between the characters are revealed, revealing hidden rivalries and buried secrets. This unexpected confrontation will test not only the group's cohesion, but also the individual aspirations of each member of the orchestra.

programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "ASKIP", Simone's life (Nassima Benchicou) takes an unexpected turn as she faces a form of beginning of school year that does not take into account the reality of her recomposed family. With two mothers, she finds herself confronted with a system that struggles to adapt to her situation. Meanwhile, Robin (Guillaume Auvert) struggles with his own uncertainties. Without his friend Clovis, he feared that Liliou (Emilia Blayer) would confuse his friendly intentions with an attempt to drag, which prompted him to seek a rapprochement with Stella (Agnès Miguras). At the same time, Leo (Gabriel Caballero), Iris, Stella and Mei are beginning to notice irritating ways in their friends, revealing the little obsessions that drive their daily lives. This episode explores the themes of family diversity, friendship and the challenges of communication among adolescents.

programme.title: ASKIP
programme.desc: The day of the school year, sham. He may be a star on the networks, in Truffaut, he is treated like a lambda student. Mahé discovers that boarding school is like a prison. It inadvertently causes a clash between Bilal and Dorian. If Aslan is not a good student, he has decided to become the teachers' favourite...
programme.desc-more: It is the day of the school year at Truffaut, and Sami (Guillaume Auvert), although famous on social networks, discovers with disillusionment that he is only one pupil among many others. Digital glory does not protect him from the realities of school. Meanwhile, Mahé (Emilia Blayer) realized that life at the boarding school was more like a prison than a learning place, which led him to provoke without any desire a confrontation between Bilal (Gabriel Caballero) and Dorian (Agnès Miguras), two comrades whose underlying tensions were emerging. Aslan (Nassima Benchicou), although he struggled to shine academically, decided to play the card of favouritism by making himself indispensable to the teachers. The complex interactions between these young adults highlight identity struggles, rivalries and aspirations, while they navigate in an environment where social pressure is pervasive.

programme.title: ASKIP
programme.sub-title: The day of the 15 minutes of reading
programme.desc: Today, Couret launches the 15 hour reading at the college. Sami is planning to find a way out of it. Meanwhile, a rumor that a ladyly idyll between Stella and Robin is circulating in college. Overwhelmed, Jonnesse put in place badges with the names of the students to learn them more easily. But his system quickly turns against him...
programme.desc-more: Today, at the college, Professor Couret introduces a new initiative: the 15 hour reading, an opportunity for students to dive into literature. However, Sami, a resourceful student, always seeking escape, is putting in place a plan to avoid this obligation. Meanwhile, an intriguing rumor begins to circulate in the corridors, suggesting that a romance could be formed between Stella and Robin, inciting curiosity and jealousy among comrades. At the same time, Jonnesse, the principal, tries to manage the situation by introducing a system of name badges to better know his students. Unfortunately, this system, supposed to facilitate interaction, is rapidly turning into a disaster, causing a series of hilarious quiproquos and misunderstandings that only exacerbate the chaos in the environment. As tensions rise and secrets accumulate, everyone will have to navigate through the challenges of adolescence and interpersonal relationships in college.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: The day before the class photos, Molusco found himself not attractive: he landed on the heads of the globe fishes who made him a super original hairstyle. Except that the fish are poisonous and intoxicate Molusco, who suddenly suffers from an excess of confidence in him.
programme.desc-more: In a world where absurd people are living alongside everyday life, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of a normal existence, similar to that of any eleven-year-old child. As he navigates between his marine origins and his desire for integration, he faces unique challenges. His attempts to blend into the life of a schoolgirl are often hampered by his physical peculiarities and strange behaviors inherited from his dual nature. Accompanied by his friends, who are trying to help him adapt, Musculo discovers the joys and sorrows of childhood, while learning to accept his singularity. The crazy situations and misunderstandings are linked, highlighting the themes of identity and self-acceptance. With a touch of humour and tenderness, this episode explores the obstacles that Musculo must overcome in order to realize his dream of an ordinary child's life, while revealing the richness of his unique personality.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco became addicted to a program on survival in hostile environments. He then took Coco and Rafik on a field expedition. But he quickly discovers that he's not the adventurer he thought he was...
programme.desc-more: In a world where normality is a distant dream, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, aspires to lead the life of an eleven-year-old child. Evolved in a colorful and staggered universe, he faces the daily challenges of childhood while juggling with his hybrid nature. His adventures lead him to be friends with colourful characters, such as his faithful companion, a small sarcastic crab, and his neighbor, a girl full of life who ignores all his peculiarities. Together, they are engaged in fantastic quests, ranging from searching for a submarine treasure to participating in children's games competitions. However, Musculo also has to face the prejudices and misunderstandings of others, who see in him a curiosity rather than a comrade. Through his adventures, he discovers the value of friendship and the importance of accepting his true identity.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: The adventures of Musculo, a little half-hust, half-human boy, who only aspires to one thing: to be able to lead the normal life of an eleven-year-old.
programme.desc-more: In a world where absurd and magic are associated, Musculo, a half-hustler, half-human boy, dreams of leading an ordinary existence like all children of his age. At only eleven years old, he struggles with the challenges of an atypical adolescence, navigating between his extraordinary abilities and his desire for integration. As he tries to integrate with his entourage, Musculo has to face some nasty and often confusing situations, exacerbated by his unique condition. His friends, who accept him as he is, encourage him to embrace his differences, but Musculo still aspires to a life without labels. This inner conflict leads him into a series of adventures where he will have to learn to balance his extraordinary origins with his common aspirations. On the way, he discovers the value of friendship, self-acceptance and the strength of identity, while facing the challenges that his status imposes on him.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco uses his powers to save a baby, but telling the truth could put his secret in danger. So Rafik is the hero and he becomes a star. Except he quickly gets a taste for fame...
programme.desc-more: In a world where the imagination is mixed up with reality, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, ardently aspires to lead an ordinary child's life at the age of eleven. Although he has marine features that make him unique, he often feels in a gap with his comrades. His days are filled with challenges, oscillating between the joys of childhood and the difficulties associated with his singular condition. Between his attempts to blend into society and his interactions with his friends, Musculo gradually discovers the simple pleasures of childhood, such as playing at the park or participating in school games. However, his quest for acceptance is hampered by nasty situations and misunderstandings that reveal the prejudices of others. On the way, he learns that true strength lies not only in appearance, but also in self-acceptance and the ability to bond with friendship despite differences.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Athena, the bitch of a scientist, comes to consult Clever and Bro, because she and her master were attacked by the spectre of an old associate.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unlikely brothers are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, find themselves involved in mysterious things that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Their first investigation plunges them into an unexplained network of disappearances that shakes the local community. By looking at every detail, Clever uses his intelligence and ability to notice clues that humans might neglect, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to engage physically in defending their quest for truth. Together, they must navigate a complex world where appearances are deceptive and where each character hides a secret. As they sink into these mysteries, their brotherly bond will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about their own past.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: The Queen is here to solicit Clever for an ultra-confidential mission. The night before, her secret agent warned her of imminent danger before mysteriously disappearing.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unusual pets, Clever, a pig from India in the sense of exceptional observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive in character, are embarking on captivating investigations. Their peaceful daily life quickly turns into a series of thrilling adventures as they tackle mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Thanks to Clever's sharp intelligence and Bro's audacity, the two partners are at the heart of complex business, where every detail counts. From the disappearance of precious objects to puzzles that challenge logic, their determination leads them to foil clever plans. But their quest for truth also exposes them to unexpected dangers, testing their brotherly bond. In this episode, Clever and Bro's humor and ingenuity illuminate dark affairs, revealing that even the smallest of us can make a difference.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: A huge animal attacked Cosmo's booth during the night. Oscar and Malika are conducting the investigation and finding out that this is a young rogue.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Okoo-koo
programme.desc: Okoo-koo is the reception and entertainment program with a pedagogy of a group of young animators: Manon, Julia, Karim and Jason.
programme.desc-more: Okoo-koo - Season 5: even closer to children, even more inspiring! For his fifth season, Okoo-koo continues his mission: to awaken curiosity, encourage creativity and accompany children in their discovery of the world through fun, positive and inspiring content. This year, the show is getting even closer to its audience with \" Okoo, it's at home \", a new weekly sequence that gives the children the floor. Karim will meet them all over France to discover their passions, talents and initiatives, or will host them directly on the stage to share their universes. A section that places children at the heart of the program and values their creativity, personality and commitment.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey keeps missing his word! But seeing how much Bingo trusts their mom, she grasps the scope of promises and the importance of keeping her word.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, an exceptional-looking Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and fearless companion, are attacking mysteries that even Scotland Yard has not been able to solve. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to plunge into delicate business, mixing secrets, betrayals and puzzles. Each episode sees them explore emblematic places and interview colorful characters, ranging from local traders to mysterious street dwellers. With a mixture of intelligence and instinct, Clever uses his sense of sharp observation to detect often neglected clues, while Bro, as a driving force, brings a touch of boldness to their investigations. Together, they form an unlikely but effective duo, sailing through the meandering of London's crime. Their quest for truth leads them to discover surprising revelations, questioning everything they thought they knew about their neighbourhood.

programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two inseparable companions, Clever, a pig from India with exceptional insight, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive, are embarking on fascinating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity pushes them to attack cases that even Scotland Yard detectives struggle to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex mystery involving a series of unexplained disappearances and clues lost in the alleys of the city. While Clever uses his keen sense of observation to decipher the puzzles, Bro often gets carried away by his enthusiasm, which leads them into unforeseen and sometimes perilous situations. Together, they must navigate through a world of intrigues and secrets, while cultivating their brotherly bond and their love for adventure. The two brothers will discover that the key to solving this mystery may be their ability to combine their unique talents.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the seventeenth century, two unlikely companions, Belfort, a faithful dog of King Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, formed an inseparable team. Their friendship leads them to extraordinary adventures, where their courage and ingenuity are tested. Together, they travel the green alleys of the royal residence, launching rescue missions to rescue animals in distress, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the surrounding forests. Their quest leads them through intriguing mysteries and unexpected encounters, while highlighting the richness of animal life at that time. In a fascinating historical setting, Belfort and Lupin discover not only the importance of friendship and loyalty, but also the challenges of protecting those who have no voice. Each episode brings them a little closer to the soul of Versailles and its secrets.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)
programme.desc: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the lively city of Belfort, the atmosphere warms up when the rosary of the King, an eccentric artist, begins to create a flamboyant hat decorated with ostrich feathers. This capricious ambition arouses the concern of two ladies of the high society, Madame Du Bec (Nathalie Homs) and Madame De Buc (Barbara Tissier), who see this as a danger to their status and reputation. Fearing that this new trend would destabilize the classical elegance of their circle, they decided to do everything possible to sabotage the chapelier's project. In a frantic race against the clock, the two women develop schemes to counter the designer's plans, leading them to a parade of colourful characters, including the faithful assistant of the chapelier (Guillaume Beaujolais) and a young apprentice (Hugo Brunswick) who wanted to prove his worth. Tensions rise as each one confronts each other in a ballet of intrigues and quiproquos, revealing the hidden undersides of the high society.
programme.desc-more: Belfort & Lupin (2023)

programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy, a smart, strong bear, reigns over a corner of the Canadian forest where a lovely family of mischievous lemmings give him a twist.
programme.desc-more: In the vast and wild Canadian forest, Grizzy, an imposing and cunning brown bear, enjoys a comfortable existence in the forest guard cabin, which he considers his kingdom. When he appropriates the delights of this isolated retreat, he encounters a horde of mischievous and fearless lemmings, small mammals who, although often clumsy, do not retreat in front of anything to counteract Grizzy's plans. These lemmings, with their limited intelligence but their unwavering determination, engage in a series of hilarious confrontations with the bear, competing for the domination of the hut and the treasures it contains. Misadventures are going on as Grizzy faces unexpected challenges, clever traps and nasty situations, while trying to preserve his quiet lifestyle. The struggle between the bear and the lemmings gives rise to moments of burlesque comedy, making each episode a unique and entertaining adventure.
