programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: In Canada's vast nature, Grizzy, an imposing bear, enjoys the tranquillity of its territory, a cottage isolated in the middle of the forest. His peaceful life was quickly disrupted by a mischievous group of lemmings, determined to challenge his authority and to appropriate the resources he considered his. These little creatures, always in search of adventures, do not retreat in front of anything to thwart Grizzy's plans, transforming every day into a battle of trick and trick. Their hilarious and often chaotic attempts put to the test the patience of the bear, who must use all his strength and intelligence to try to keep control of his territory. Between comical misunderstandings and fierce rivalries, Grizzy must navigate a world where survival is not only a matter of strength, but also of strategy and resourcefulness in the face of these unexpected opponents.

His peaceful life was quickly disrupted by a mischievous group of lemmings, determined to challenge his authority and to appropriate the resources he considered his. These little creatures, always in search of adventures, do not retreat in front of anything to thwart Grizzy's plans, transforming every day into a battle of trick and trick. Their hilarious and often chaotic attempts put to the test the patience of the bear, who must use all his strength and intelligence to try to keep control of his territory. Between comical misunderstandings and fierce rivalries, Grizzy must navigate a world where survival is not only a matter of strength, but also of strategy and resourcefulness in the face of these unexpected opponents.
programme.desc-more: In the vast and wild Canadian forest, Grizzy, an imposing and cunning brown bear, enjoys a comfortable existence in the forest guard cabin, which he considers his kingdom. When he appropriates the delights of this isolated retreat, he encounters a horde of mischievous and fearless lemmings, small mammals who, although often clumsy, do not retreat in front of anything to counteract Grizzy's plans. These lemmings, with their limited intelligence but their unwavering determination, engage in a series of hilarious confrontations with the bear, competing for the domination of the hut and the treasures it contains. Misadventures are going on as Grizzy faces unexpected challenges, clever traps and nasty situations, while trying to preserve his quiet lifestyle. The struggle between the bear and the lemmings gives rise to moments of burlesque comedy, making each episode a unique and entertaining adventure.

programme.title: The sky of Nantes
programme.desc: Christophe Honoré conjures the ghosts of his maternal family in an old cinema to reveal his film, which traces their history, or at least what he holds of it. Faced with this difficult audience, the filmmaker tries to narrate the events that marked and built his family but is constantly interrupted by the interventions and invectives of these spectators so particular. Very quickly, the session turns to the rule of law, the angers, the unpacking and confessions squeaking, interspersed with moments of tenderness and love.

programme.title: Musical crossing at the Hotel de la Marine
programme.desc: This performance, presented in the prestigious framework of the Court of the Intendant at the Hotel de la Marine, brings together a string quartet and three lyrical singers around a program dedicated to the great works of the classical repertoire. Covered by generations of Talents Adami Classic, this evening highlights the remarkable voices of Michèle Bréant (soprano), Flore Royer (mezzo-soprano) and Alexandre Baldo (baritone bass), accompanied by an exceptional string quartet: Stéphanie-Marie Degand and Iris Scialom on violin, Marie Ducroux on viola and Christian-Pierre La Marca on cello. Together, they will perform masterpieces by Mozart, Borodine and Léo Delibes, while also drawing on an older repertoire, with works by Henry Purcell and Marin Marais.

programme.title: Great detectives!
programme.desc: Netflix merges two episodes into one. (26/09/19)
programme.desc-more: In a small Australian city, a group of four pre-teens with a keen sense of justice and insatiable curiosity unite to found their own detective agency. Composed of the intelligent and determined Abby (Abby Bergman), the brilliant Aston (Aston Droomer), the russy Jamil (Jamil Smyth-Secka) and the creative Anna (Anna Cooke), this group of friends embarks on a series of captivating investigations that lead them to solve mysteries around their school and neighbourhood. Each episode confronts them with various puzzles, ranging from the disappearance of personal objects to disturbing rumours that disturb the peace of their establishment. As they strive to thwart clever ploys and discover the truth, young detectives must also navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and school rivalries. With an unwavering team spirit, they face unexpected obstacles, testing their investigative skills and their ability to remain united against adversity. "Super detectives!" plunges spectators into a thrilling universe where every investigation is a full-fledged adventure, filled with suspense and humour. Young heroes learn that solving mysteries is not only a matter of intelligence, but also of courage and solidarity.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's somewhat impulsive brother, are engaged in captivating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity has led them to solve mysteries that even Scotland Yard has been struggling to clear for years. In this thrilling episode, the two animals discover a series of strange disappearances that seem to be linked to a disturbing urban legend: the Gorgon of Regent's Park, a mythical creature that, according to rumours, is hidden in the shadows of London's gardens. As they navigate through the secrets of their neighbourhood, Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of analysis, while Bro uses his audacity to interrogate the inhabitants and decipher clues. Together, they will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and prove that even the smallest can dig up great truths in a city where appearances are often misleading.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: Shaun escapes by a "portal" inside Shirley's wool to escape a boring Bitzer, but he emerges in a chaotic version of the farm without him.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, a unique bond was established between Belfort, Louis XIV's favorite dog, and Lupin, a daring wolf. Together, they form an unexpected duo, uniting their forces to protect their fellow animals, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the vast surrounding areas. Their friendship leads them into thrilling adventures, oscillating between humour and emotion. While the kingdom is plagued by political intrigues and conspiracy, Belfort and Lupin often find themselves at the heart of delicate situations. They must overcome the traps set by the jealous courtiers and solve mysteries surrounding the disappearance of animals. Through fascinating discoveries and bold rescues, this heteroclite couple learns to overcome their differences, proving that friendship transcends the barriers between species. Their achievements are a celebration of loyalty and courage in a world full of greatness and danger.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: As a great equestrian show prepares for the Grand Ecuries of Versailles, the noble Bucephale horse, well known for its presence, is facing a personal crisis: a mysterious legache that threatens not only his health, but also his future in the prestigious stables. Convinced that he will be driven out and relegated to oblivion in a meadow, Bucephalus is invaded by anguish and despair. Faced with this delicate situation, the two protagonists, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), are committed to a determined mission to save their equine friend. With the complicity of an empathic veterinarian (Nathalie Homs) and other unexpected allies, they explore unusual remedies and unconventional methods to give Bucephale hope. As the carousel date approaches, friendship and solidarity will be tested, but Belfort and Lupin's determination could make all the difference.

programme.sub-title: The Day of the Mystery Room
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "ASKIP", Malo and Iris discover a mysterious sign announcing the opening of a new room. Intrigued, they give free rein to their overflowing imagination, concocting fantastic scenarios around this enigmatic room. However, adults in their surroundings, visibly disconcerted, fail to answer their many questions, leaving the two friends in a blur. Meanwhile, Timéo, who admires his uncle Tanzmann deeply, feels the need to share this pride with his comrades. However, he realized that his uncle preferred to keep their bond secret, which plunged him into an emotional dilemma. At the same time, Sidney is fighting against her sense of exclusion, exacerbated by the fact that she does not have a mobile phone. To feel less isolated, she is developing a bold plan to confiscate her friends' phones, hoping to create a stronger link with them. The tensions and dynamics between these young protagonists reveal universal problems of adolescence, between secrecy, belonging and the quest for identity.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a world where the boundary between human and animal is blurred, Musculo, a young half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of a normal existence. At only eleven years old, he aspires to live the daily adventures of every child of his age, but his unique appearance and extraordinary abilities complicate his life. Between the mockery of his comrades and the expectations of his family, Musculo struggles with his identity and desire to belong. As he sails in the maze of childhood, he discovers unexpected friendships and rivalries that push him to surpass himself. In this episode, Musculo faces a major challenge: to prove that he can be like others, while learning to accept his differences. His quest for acceptance and identity led him to a series of luscious adventures, where he would have to use his unique talents to overcome the obstacles that stand in his way.

programme.title: Molusco

programme.desc: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In the foggy streets of London, Clever, a pig of remarkable intelligence, is dedicated to an unusual mission: to solve the mysteries that affect pets and their owners. With a sharp mind and an unparalleled sense of observation, Clever joins a diverse team of accomplices, including four-legged friends and people passionate about justice. Each investigation plunges him into a secret world where treason, riddles and surprising revelations are mixed. From the disappearance of a precious cat to the strange behavior of a watchdog, each case puts to the test its ingenuity and determination. By sailing through mysterious London, Clever discovers that the truth is often more complex than it seems. programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Charlie Chaplin, the freedom genius
programme.desc: For over a century, everyone knows and loves Charlie Chaplin. A burlesque genius, Chaplin put his talent at the service of an ideal of justice and freedom. His best scenario was that of his own destiny, which is part of the political and artistic history of the twentieth century. Chaplin actor and author, director and producer, composer and choreographer, whose financial independence will be the key to his artistic freedom and his humanist commitment.

programme.title: A Frenchman named Gabin
programme.desc: Jean Gabin remains the most emblematic French actor of the last century. From the Third to the Fifth Republic, the Popular Front at the end of the Thirty Glories, the artist has embodied in cinema France of cities and fields, that of factories and cafes, ports and suburbs, through a comprehensive and varied filmography, rich in masterpieces such as "La Bête humaine", "Le Quai des mismes", "La Grande Illusion", "La Traversée de Paris" or "Un ape en hiver". Between 1935 and 1940, Gabin was featured in twelve films, ten of which became classics of French cinema, under the leadership of Jean Grémillon, Marcel Carné, Jean Renoir and Julien Duvivier. This documentary outlines a portrait of the actor and man, Jean Alexis Moncorgé.

programme.title: The Treasures of Shu's Kingdom
programme.desc: A team of archaeologists, historians and scientists have uncovered a city that has been forgotten for millennia in southwestern China. They try to lift the veil on this great civilization until then unknown, upsetting the history of antiquity. Thousands of objects, bronze, jade and gold relics, dating back more than three thousand years, are back in the light. The site is a testimony to a sophisticated civilization with advanced metallurgy, complex urban planning and a rich belief system centered on the cult of the sun. The history of this fascinating international scientific inquiry offers a renewed reading of the origins of ancient China.

programme.title: Alexandria's Lighthouse: the latest secrets
programme.desc: In the sea off Alexandria, under several meters of water, lies the remains of one of the seven wonders of the ancient world: the legendary lighthouse of Alexandria. For nearly 30 years, archaeologist Isabelle Hairy and her team have been exploring thousands of blocks to reconstruct the history of this extraordinary monument. Today, an exceptional operation is being prepared. The most monumental remains of the lighthouse, some of which weigh several dozen tons, will be re-assembled and digitized. Thanks to new technologies enriched by AI, the archaeologist will be able to establish a virtual replica of the lighthouse and show the genius of its architects.

programme.title: Thalassa, extreme adventures
programme.desc: On November 1, 2026, the 13th edition of the mythical Route du Rhum will start from Saint-Malo to Pointe-à-Pitre. On this occasion, Diego Buñuel takes viewers at the heart of the most extreme challenges. Skippers, naval architects, high-level engineers, they share the same obsession: to go faster and faster on the oceans, at the sole strength of the wind. Diego meets Charles Caudrelier, one of the best French navigators, winner of the previous Route du Rhum. He also discovered the trimaran Ultim Gitana and followed the team of engineers who designed the SP80, a prototype of sailboat capable of reaching 150km/h.

programme.title: The 5 lives of the Earth
programme.desc: 252 million years ago, during the permian period, our planet experienced mass extinction that caused most of its species to disappear. Yet the Earth was full of life and sheltered a rich fauna and flora. The cause of this disaster is a rise of magma that has released a gas destroying almost all life forms in its passage. However, with an environment in constant evolution, life has finally returned to Earth. Today, scientists are sounding alarms and taking stock of the lessons humanity can learn from this event for its own future.

This adventure highlights the importance of not judging on appearances and discovering the true nature of those around us, even those who seem to be enemies.

programme.title: A house, an artist
programme.sub-title: André Malraux, the secrets of a giant
programme.desc: André Malraux, a committed writer, first and most famous of the ministers of culture, knew how to put art into action as a person. Yet this historical figure of the Thirty Glorys hides a secret man, who never let anything appear, nor his intimacy, nor the dark hours he had passed through in the early 1960s. In 1945, after the resistance and the fighting, André Malraux, 44, dropped down his arms and rented the first and second floors of a large villa in Boulogne-Billancourt. As a new man, the famous pre-war novelist, author of "The Hope" and Goncourt Prize with "The Human Condition", begins a new period of creation.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: François Pêcheux takes us to the banks of the Mananbolo River, which was named after a Malagasy princess. The journey begins with the discovery of a muscled custom meringued. It consists of fighting each other to bring down the other. Surrounded by the indigenous people, he travels by boat and discovers on his way the remains of the Malagasy people. Between encounters and mythical places, he discovers friendly characters. We discover caves once home to ancient populations, a very artisanal rum that is torn away at gold prices in the cities. Not to mention the crocodile and crab hunt.

programme.title: Winning return for the kitchen of old
programme.desc: Once put in the old grimoires, the recipes of old make a frantic return today on social networks, in bookstores and in starred restaurants. This phenomenon, which combines nostalgia, a quest for meaning, conviviality and eco-responsible approach, demonstrates a deep need to reconnect with our roots but also with "good eating". Constance has made her 86-year-old Mamou a social media star by filming her preparing her family recipes. Some restaurateurs, like Jean Sévénes, surf on their childhood memories. Elsewhere, others do not hesitate to rehabilitate the offal or to put the soup in fashion.

These two opinion specialists decipher the aspirations, fears and hopes of French and French people during this historic presidential campaign. programme.title: The tragedy of contaminated blood
programme.sub-title: Two communities, from dream to nightmare
programme.desc: Between 1980 and 1985, thousands of people were infected in France with the AIDS virus through transfusions and blood products: hemophiliacs, transfused, and their spouses and children. Physicians, senior officials and ministers had to answer to the courts. One formula remained in all memories: "responsible but not guilty". But how could a transfusion system based on voluntary donation and solidarity become the vector of such a disaster?

programme.title: Malraux, the poetry of action
programme.desc: André Malraux, as ambivalent as he was exciting, has never stopped, both in his lifetime and after his death, unleashing passions. Fifty years after his disappearance, the "real" journey of this self-taught who has made up a destiny is traced. His itinerary is anything but straight. An attempt to steal statues in Cambodia will create a conscience and political commitment. A major anti-fascist fight in the inter-war period succeeds after 1945 a firm commitment to the Buttist alongside De Gaulle. But his commitment is not limited to action. The writer is never far away, for whom words are there to transcend reality and who wants to be the memorialist of his time.

programme.title: Alexandria's Lighthouse: the latest secrets
programme.desc: Thanks to AI and the unprecedented underwater excavations, a team of archaeologists was able to reconstruct in 3D the famous lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the seven wonders of the world.
programme.desc-more: In the sea off Alexandria, under several meters of water, lies the remains of one of the seven wonders of the ancient world: the legendary lighthouse of Alexandria. For nearly 30 years, archaeologist Isabelle Hairy and her team have been exploring thousands of blocks to reconstruct the history of this extraordinary monument. Today, an exceptional operation is being prepared. The most monumental remains of the lighthouse, some of which weigh several dozen tons, will be re-assembled and digitized. Thanks to new technologies enriched by AI, the archaeologist will be able to establish a virtual replica of the lighthouse and show the genius of its architects.

programme.desc-more: On November 1, 2026, the 13th edition of the mythical Route du Rhum will start from Saint-Malo to Pointe-à-Pitre. Skippers, naval architects, high-level engineers, they share the same obsession: to go faster and faster on the oceans, at the sole strength of the wind. programme.title: The 5 lives of the Earth
programme.desc: 252 million years ago, huge volcanic eruptions caused nearly 90% of species to disappear from the Earth and the oceans.
programme.desc-more: 252 million years ago, during the permian period, our planet experienced mass extinction that caused most of its species to disappear. Yet the Earth was full of life and sheltered a rich fauna and flora. The cause of this disaster is a rise of magma that has released a gas destroying almost all life forms in its passage. However, with an environment in constant evolution, life has finally returned to Earth. Today, scientists are sounding alarms and taking stock of the lessons humanity can learn from this event for its own future.

With unexpected reversals of situation and moments of tension, this episode highlights the strength of friendship and resilience to adversity. Heroes will have to show courage and creativity to thwart the wicked's plans, proving that even in the most desperate situations, hope and solidarity can triumph.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.sub-title: Opale coast, between winds and tides

programme.title: A house, an artist
programme.sub-title: André Malraux, the secrets of a giant
programme.desc: In 1945, André Malraux, 44, rented the first and second floors of a large villa in Boulogne-Billancourt, where he began a new period of creation.
programme.desc-more: André Malraux, a committed writer, first and most famous of the ministers of culture, knew how to put art into action as a person. Yet this historical figure of the Thirty Glorys hides a secret man, who never let anything appear, nor his intimacy, nor the dark hours he had passed through in the early 1960s. In 1945, after the resistance and the fighting, André Malraux, 44, dropped down his arms and rented the first and second floors of a large villa in Boulogne-Billancourt. As a new man, the famous pre-war novelist, author of "The Hope" and Goncourt Prize with "The Human Condition", begins a new period of creation.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: François Pécheux embarks on the Manambolo River, west of Madagascar, for a journey full of surprises and unforgettable encounters.
programme.desc-more: François Pêcheux takes us to the banks of the Mananbolo River, which was named after a Malagasy princess. The journey begins with the discovery of a muscled custom meringued. It consists of fighting each other to bring down the other. Surrounded by the indigenous people, he travels by boat and discovers on his way the remains of the Malagasy people. Between encounters and mythical places, he discovers friendly characters. We discover caves once home to ancient populations, a very artisanal rum that is torn away at gold prices in the cities. Not to mention the crocodile and crab hunt.

programme.title: Winning return for the kitchen of old
programme.desc: Family cuisine, simmered dishes and the comforting side of Proust made a remarkable return to the table of great chefs and amateur cooks.
programme.desc-more: Once put in the old grimoires, the recipes of old make a frantic return today on social networks, in bookstores and in starred restaurants. This phenomenon, which combines nostalgia, a quest for meaning, conviviality and eco-responsible approach, demonstrates a deep need to reconnect with our roots but also with "good eating". Constance has made her 86-year-old Mamou a social media star by filming her preparing her family recipes. Some restaurateurs, like Jean Sévénes, surf on their childhood memories. Elsewhere, others do not hesitate to rehabilitate the offal or to put the soup in fashion.

programme.title: The tragedy of contaminated blood
programme.sub-title: Two communities, from dream to nightmare
programme.desc: Between 1980 and 1985, thousands of people were infected in France with the AIDS virus through transfusions and blood products: hemophiliacs, transfused, and their spouses and children. Physicians, senior officials and ministers had to answer to the courts. One formula remained in all memories: "responsible but not guilty". But how could a transfusion system based on voluntary donation and solidarity become the vector of such a disaster?

programme.title: The tragedy of contaminated blood
programme.sub-title: Young doctors face an unknown virus
programme.desc: In the 1980s, the medicine that thought it was the victorious of epidemics was faced with an unknown virus, that of AIDS.

programme.title: The tragedy of contaminated blood
programme.desc: In a transfusion system delivered to itself, how can we stop contamination? It was not until July 1985 that donor testing became systematic.

programme.title: Malraux, the poetry of action
programme.desc: Fifty years after his death, a return to André Malraux's unusual journey, a fascinating figure who marked and wrote the legend of the twentieth century.
programme.desc-more: André Malraux, as ambivalent as he was exciting, has never stopped, both in his lifetime and after his death, unleashing passions. Fifty years after his disappearance, the "real" journey of this self-taught who has made up a destiny is traced. His itinerary is anything but straight. An attempt to steal statues in Cambodia will create a conscience and political commitment. A major anti-fascist fight in the inter-war period succeeds after 1945 a firm commitment to the Buttist alongside De Gaulle. But his commitment is not limited to action. The writer is never far away, for whom words are there to transcend reality and who wants to be the memorialist of his time.

programme.title: The 5 lives of the Earth
programme.desc: 800 million years ago, after an episode of extreme glaciation, the Earth experienced an evolutionary leap and saw the emergence of complex life forms.
programme.desc-more: Recent geological analyses have proved the theory that the Earth was, 800 million years ago, completely covered with ice. This period has shaped our planet and is responsible for the world as we know it. Nearly a billion years ago, the Earth was composed of only one immense land mass. This vast, sterile expanse of life was only home to its oceans. A complex phenomenon will then lead to a total recovery of the planet by ice. It is the rapid melting that follows that will lead to the appearance of the first forms of life.

programme.title: Catherine Leroy, a French woman in the Vietnam War
programme.desc: At 21, without experience, young photographer Catherine Leroy left alone to cover the Vietnam War. His photographs are of a staggering depth.
programme.desc-more: Catherine Leroy was one of the few women photographers who covered the Vietnam War between 1966 and 1968. At 21, she had no experience, and decided to leave everything to go as close to the hostilities as possible. His photos, of a staggering proximity, tell of a war seen by a fearless young woman who, alone among soldiers of her age, was able to capture the reality of combat with force and humanity. While Vietnam was its first land, it continued its work on other fronts until the 1990s. Catherine Leroy imposed her look before being forgotten.

However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

She shares her life with her little brother George, who is still armed with her teddy dinosaur, as well as with their parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig. Together, they engage in a multitude of daily adventures that lead them to explore their surroundings, whether they are on park trips, farm visits or beach trips. Peppa's friends, such as Suzy Sheep and Pedro Pony, often join their games, adding a touch of friendship and camaraderie to their experiences. programme.title: Thalassa, extreme adventures
programme.desc: The great reporter Diego Buñuel travels to Namibia's coast to participate in a sea lion rescue mission and meet desert lions.
programme.desc-more: Over two thousand kilometres from Namibia to South Africa, the gigantic dunes of the Namib Desert, the oldest desert in the world, flow into the Atlantic Ocean. On this coast, sea lions are victims of marine pollution from plastic waste and fisheries. All these terrible traps in which they end up obstructing and strangling. Diego Buñuel is involved in a rescue operation with Naude Dreyer, a protector of the oceans. In the north of the country, the great reporter meets with desert lions in the company of biologist Philip Stander.

programme.title: Luxury, a French Power
programme.desc: The major French luxury and haute couture companies have built the most powerful and viral system of influence of our time.
programme.desc-more: On the global geopolitical scale, a Dior bag, a Chanel dress or a Hermès square seem to be derisory in front of oil barrels or arms contracts. Yet French haute couture built the most powerful and viral system of influence of our time. For 20 years, French haute couture houses have become world empires with LVMH and Kering. In financial difficulties, these groups must win the battle of image and "like" by organizing extraordinary parades. In the era of Instagram, a brand is able to spend half a million euros during Fashion Week to have the biggest stars in the front row of its show.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.sub-title: Iceland, an island of fire and ice
programme.desc: Iceland, lost in the cold waters of the Atlantic just a few kilometres from the polar circle, is a country of volcanoes and glaciers. Sophie Jovillard discovers the complex relationship between fire and ice, so characteristic of the island, and how the inhabitants adapt to this ever-changing land.
programme.desc-more: Sophie Jovillard flies to Iceland, an island country famous for its volcanoes, geysers and lava fields, in the middle of its ice-covered decor. In this climate-disruption context, half of the country's glaciers are threatened with extinction by the end of the century. Sophie Jovillard is going to meet Icelanders who love nature and want to protect their ecosystem. She also seeks to understand how the islanders adapt to the constant volcanic threat or how the country has become a champion of parity.

programme.title: Jamy's World
programme.desc: The 45,000 historical monuments in France are threatened by climate change. Jamy Gourmaud is going to meet those who are watching over this heritage.
programme.desc-more: This is an unknown consequence of climate change: the jewels of French heritage are also being undermined. Crude, which eats up the foundations, heat waves that break the stone, dryness that cracks the ramparts, storms that attack the coast: the weather attacks, stone after stone, on this precious heritage. There is an urgent need to protect our heritage, as our 45,000 historic monuments help make France the world's first tourist destination. From the Loire castles to the Versailles castle, from the If castle to the Strasbourg cathedral, Jamy Gourmaud meets architects, curators and artisans who every day watch over this threatened heritage.

programme.sub-title: Heating: how to reduce the bill?
programme.desc: Jamy Gourmaud provides an update on the different heating modes of the housing, presenting their operation, advantages and disadvantages.
programme.desc-more: With the rise in gas and electricity prices, one in five French households is considering changing their heating methods, to spend less, but also to protect the planet, as radiators contribute significantly to global warming. But between oil, gas, electricity or wood stoves, how to choose? Jamy Gourmaud is going to meet these French who are taking the step. The moderator and journalist reviews the energy, financial and environmental advantages and disadvantages of each of these heating modes, not to mention the isolation of the housing.

programme.title: Kibbutz Revadim, the utopian pioneers' utopia
programme.desc: The Israeli kibbutz, who were the models of community life at the time of their creation, have moved away from their original egalitarian and revolutionary principles.
programme.desc-more: The Israeli kibbutz, like Revadim built in 1947, have long embodied a model of community life and collective work on earth for progressive circles around the world. Young idealists were attracted to this by the promise of building a modern utopia from the beginning of the 20th century. These men and women built a way of life based on pooling resources among community members, settling and cultivating land at the heart of a growing Zionist project. If the model has materialized, it raises deep questions about its historical foundations and implications.

programme.title: Yesili
programme.sub-title: I saw the lion, the Fox and the weasel.
programme.desc: The mice managed to escape the neighbor's cat. What better way to get over his emotions than a little story?
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the "Yetili" series, the mice, maliciously cunning, manage to escape the claws of the neighbor's cat, a creature dreaded for his ruthless hunting. This unexpected flight leads them into a journey full of twists and turns, where they discover a world far wider and more dangerous than their simple domestic environment. In search of comfort after this trial, they gather around a comforting story, a way to heal their tumultuous emotions. As the stories go through, mice realize the importance of friendship and courage in the face of adversity. The bonds are growing stronger and each one finds a way to confront his fears, while remembering the lessons of the past. This episode highlights the strength of narrative as a tool for resilience, and explores the themes of survival, self-help and self-discovery in a united community.

programme.desc-more: Simon and Gaspard, two young cousins, spend the night with their grandparents, Papi and Grandma. As night sets in, Gaspard, a little afraid of the darkness, asks Simon for help to overcome his fear. To reassure him, Simon takes him near the window, where they see a disturbing silhouette: a strange creature with eight red eyes that sneaks into the darkness. Their scared screams attract Grandma, who runs to understand what's happening. Although Simon is convinced that monsters do not exist, he decides to prove to Gaspard that there is nothing to fear. Together, they go out in the garden with Grandma to explore. Along the way, they meet glittering fireflies, a curious mouse, and even a perched owl. However, anxiety comes back when they see the mysterious creature again. Finally, they discover that what terrified them was nothing but a family of bats, revealing that fear can often be overstated.

Bears, represented as a loving and protective family, see their daily lives disturbed by the unexpected arrival of the fearless little girl, Gold Buckle. programme.title: Chauvet, voyage to the origins
programme.desc: The Chauvet Cave offers a fabulous dive in time, but it is also a fragile natural monument that science is trying to preserve today.
programme.desc-more: In France, in the heart of the gorges of the Ardèche, is a cave formed 6 million years ago by nature and to the unusual history. In 1994, a team of amateur speleologists discovered its walls covered with the oldest drawings ever discovered. Closed to the public to protect it, the cave hosts a first scientific mission in 1998. The interdisciplinary team led by the prehistorian Jean Clottes then embarks on a long scientific and human adventure in order to discover all the secrets of this place.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.desc: How did the island of Saint-Martin and the archipelago of Guadeloupe preserve their lush nature? How did it become an asset for both territories? Sabine Quindou begins her journey aboard a 12 metre sailboat manned by the guadeloupée skipper Rodolphe Sepho.
programme.desc-more: Sabine Quindou travels to the heart of the French Antilles for a journey to discover the archipelago of Guadeloupe and the island of Saint Martin. His adventure began on the sailboat of the guadeloupéen skipper Rodolphe Sepho in the direction of the land. Once they arrive, they start a hike into the tropical forest with a swim under a waterfall. Sabine also discovers a historic distillery, an exceptional mangrove, the horse ride in the water and the island of Saint-Martin that the French and Dutch have shared for nearly 400 years.

programme.title: Mechanics of journalism
programme.desc: Journalist Virginie Vilar tells, step by step, the mechanics of her investigations that caused Nicolas Hulot's fall in November 2021.
programme.desc-more: " I withdraw from public life for good," said Nicolas Hulot, on November 24, 2021, the day before the Virginie Vilar investigation was released in "Special Envoy" on the former minister. The journalist managed to obtain testimony from several women accusing him of sexual assault or rape. It is the spectacular fall of one of the French favourite personalities, icon of ecology. Virginie Vilar tells, step by step, the mechanics of her investigations that lasted four years. Nicolas Hulot, for his part, has always denied these accusations. He was never convicted. In the eyes of justice, he is presumed innocent.

programme.title: Mechanics of journalism
programme.desc: Laetitia Cherel, a journalist at Radio France, investigated the charges of assault and rape on a minor against Abbé Pierre.
programme.desc-more: On 17 July 2024, Emmaus published the testimonies of seven women accusing Abbé Pierre of assaults, including rape on a minor. Many more will follow. Seventeen years after his death, the one who was considered a "saint", symbol of the fight against poverty suddenly appears under a whole other face. Laetitia Cherel, a journalist at the Investigation Unit of Radio France, then launched a long investigation that would lead her to the Holy See. Within the Church as well as the Emmaus movement, some had long known all or part of the actions of Abbé Pierre. But what exactly did we know, at what time, and why did these reports not lead to the priest falling earlier?

programme.desc: From Monday to Thursday, "C tonight" gives the floor to researchers, artists and intellectuals from all walks of life. The program is built around a political or social subject that has made the news of the day. This debate allows us to deepen our reflection on this event with the aim of enlightening the complexity of the world.
programme.desc-more: With French people more concerned than ever about the repercussions of the various political, health, social, economic, energy and war crises in Ukraine and the Middle East, intellectuals, artists and protagonists at the centre of the news come to bring their expertise to a debate. programme.desc: "Super Rabbit"This morning Simon is disguised as a superhero, and he plays to chase imaginary bad guys. Nobody should ever tell himself to call him Simon! programme.desc-more: In a colorful and lively world, Simon, a little mischievous rabbit with a wide toothed distance, navigates through the daily challenges of life with an overflowing curiosity. With a lively imagination, Simon does not step back to explore his environment, whether by playing with friends or discovering creative solutions to seemingly simple problems. Each episode of his adventure confronts him with situations that teach him valuable lessons about friendship, sharing and courage. With his companions, he learns to overcome the little fears of childhood, while cultivating his joyful and endearing personality. Simon thus becomes a model for his comrades, proving that even the youngest can face delicate situations with humour and determination. Through his experiences, he demonstrates that growing up means meeting challenges, but also enjoying the moments of joy and friendship that make everyday life look better.

programme.desc: "The forces of volcanoes"If volcanoes are weapons of mass destruction, without these underground forces there would be no atmosphere, oceans, land surface, or life on earth.
programme.desc-more: The Earth is home to a rich diversity of life thanks to the alliance of four powerful forces: volcanoes, the Sun, the sky and the sea currents. Volcanoes are essential to the fragile balance of nature. There are about 1,500 active volcanoes on Earth, including the Kilauea in Hawaii. In the mouth of this smoking monster, molten rock rises from the earth's bowels and lava flows spring from the cracks of the earth's crust. The lava flow is devastating everything in its passage.

In this country where three out of ten children are forced to work, mining the minerals hidden in its basements could soon change the situation.

programme.title: The 5 lives of the Earth
programme.desc: "Air"In the beginning, the Earth was a sterile and burning rock. Water has allowed the first forms of life to appear that produced oxygen.
programme.desc-more: 4.5 billion years ago, during the Haddean era, our planet was a rock and magma hell, hostile to any form of life. The experts study rocks containing an atmosphere that contains the keys to the evolution of our planet. It is the arrival of water droplets on Earth that will cause a violent flood and change it forever. The result is "Great Oxygenation", the accumulation of oxygen in our atmosphere that will make the ozone appear and make our planet a place conducive to the development of life.

programme.title: Farm products: to drink and eat?
programme.desc: From markets to supermarkets, from mountain farms to mega-farms, from artisans to industrialists, research behind the scenes of the production of "farmers" products.
programme.desc-more: Farm products represent 4 billion euros in turnover each year in France. Farmers' and producer's co-operative markets are growing, and even large areas offer wide ranges of farm products in their shelves. In the consumer imagination, these products oppose industrial agriculture and are based on all the virtues. The reality is more contrasted. Apart from a few very well-structured sectors, the regulation that defines the farmer label is vague and not binding. To be entitled to it, we must produce and transform on the farm, defined as a single geographical entity.

programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little mischievous slut who shares her daily life with her family in a colorful and playful world. Surrounded by her little brother George, Mom Pig and Papa Pig, she explores the world around her with curiosity and enthusiasm. Both children embark on daily adventures, whether they jump into mud puddles, visit the zoo or play with their friends. Through fun and sometimes nasty situations, Peppa and George discover the simple joys of life, learning to express their emotions and develop their vocabulary. The themes of friendship, family and learning are at the heart of each episode, offering young spectators valuable lessons while entertaining them. The series, which won a BAFTA Award in 2005 for its quality of animation, continues to captivate children from all over the world with its endearing characters and fantasy stories.

programme.title: Vegetable oils: a boiling market
programme.desc: Between deceptive and industrial labels that are played by buyers' confidence, the world of vegetable oils is full of traps for consumers.
programme.desc-more: From sunflower, olive or truffle, vegetable oils are essential to our diet, but the search for profitability often undermines their quality. In France, the most affordable sunflower oil market has increased in recent years. In Argentina, one of the largest producers of sunflower oil, the use of a chemical solvent is problematic. In Provence, Bernard Foron has been a olive oil producer for 17 years. Its product, called PDO, is not representative of the majority of olive oils consumed by the French.

programme.title: Catherine Leroy, a French woman in the Vietnam War
programme.desc: At 21, without experience, young photographer Catherine Leroy left alone to cover the Vietnam War. His photographs are of a staggering depth.
programme.desc-more: Catherine Leroy was one of the few women photographers who covered the Vietnam War between 1966 and 1968. At 21, she had no experience, and decided to leave everything to go as close to the hostilities as possible. His photos, of a staggering proximity, tell of a war seen by a fearless young woman who, alone among soldiers of her age, was able to capture the reality of combat with force and humanity. While Vietnam was its first land, it continued its work on other fronts until the 1990s. Catherine Leroy imposed her look before being forgotten.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.desc: Georgia, a country of cocagne hidden between the mountain ranges of the large and small Caucasus, has made a place between the Russian giant and the East. The generosity and hospitality of the inhabitants are not a legend, as Jerome Pitorin will be able to verify. European, Slavic, Turkish or Persian: multiple influences contribute to the country's culture. Between the capital Tbilisi and the countryside, Jerome goes to meet Georgians by crossing the winding roads of a country in the midst of reconstruction.
programme.desc-more: Georgia is a country in the Caucasus, on the Black Sea, whose many influences from Asia and Europe have shaped the culture and character of its inhabitants. Walking along winding roads between the capital Tbilisi and the country villages, Jérôme Pitorin goes to meet them. He is warmly welcomed by this people who reveal to him the story of the pearl of the Caucasus. Topics: Georgia, a land full of contrasts • the country of cultural excellence • The Black Sea, the Caucasus Riviera • Telepherics, dizzy attention • Strong as a Georgian • Svanetia, the myth of the Golden Fleece.

programme.title: Mysteries of the solar system
programme.desc: "The Ice Worlds" Professor Brian Cox explores the frozen worlds of the solar system. He analyses a dwarf planet where mountains of solid ice float on the surface.
programme.desc-more: At the edge of the solar system, ice is presented in unsuspected forms. Europe, one of the moons orbiting Jupiter, is home to a titanium ocean under a layer of frozen water 10 to 25 kilometres thick. On Pluto, the dwarf planet, mountains of frozen water float in the atmosphere. Saturn's rings are composed of a myriad of crystals made of ice. Finally, the Uranus coat contains dense, warm and black ice: the Superionic ice. Ice, this solid and sparkling element, shapes entire moons and planets and could allow the formation of an alien life.

programme.title: Mysteries of the solar system
programme.desc: "The Worlds of Darkness" Professor Brian Cox explores the hidden domains of the solar system, between and beyond the planets, where countless worlds are plunged into darkness.
programme.desc-more: Nestled in the darkness between stars and beyond the planets, hidden worlds, out of reach of the most powerful telescopes, still hold many secrets. To discover these secret areas, one must probe the mysteries of the asteroid belt: a myriad of rocky bodies between Mars and Jupiter and visit the Kuiper belt, a vast frozen world several billion kilometres wide, so dark and so remote that it was discovered only in 1992. In 2018, 10 billion kilometers from the Kuiper belt, the dwarf planet FarFarOut was detected. So the question remains: how far does the solar system extend?

programme.title: The 5 lives of the Earth
programme.desc: A story of the appearance of humans on Earth, beginning with the dramatic impact of a meteorite on our planet 66 million years ago. The dinosaurs, then undisputed masters of the continents, are totally eradicated, like most other living species. In this dark and cooled world, mammals adapt and develop. They then move towards primates and then towards the first humans. The latter then appropriate their environment as any species before them, for better or worse.

programme.title: Migraine: the end of the puzzle?
programme.desc: Eleven million French people suffer from migraine, one of the most poorly understood and minimized diseases. Behind this common word is a fearsome neurological condition, capable of displacing those who suffer from it for hours, days, sometimes a lifetime. Today, the management of migraine is at the heart of a medical revolution that also raises many questions.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey are tired of being ordered. They therefore call upon the giant Tina, their invisible friend, to show their parents who commands. They can now do what they want, until Mom and Dad rebel.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In a circus game, Bluey is named trackmaster, along with his friends. But Hercules prefers to play the bike game. Fortunately, Bluey finds a solution that pleases everyone.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, always ready to explore the world around her. With his little brother George (Lily Snowden-Fine), they are living thrilling and fun adventures alongside their parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig (Richard Ridings). Peppa loves jumping into mud puddles, an activity that gives him immense joy and symbolizes his mischievous spirit. Each episode takes them into a variety of situations, whether on a farm trip, a day at the beach, or even a simple visit to friends. Through these moments of play and discovery, Peppa and George learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and sharing. programme.title: Bluey Minisodes
programme.desc: Mom's trying to get Robot Bingo to wash her teeth by giving her very precise instructions.
programme.desc-more: In a warm family setting, Mom (Melanie Zanetti) strives to ensure that Robot Bingo (David McCormack), a robot with a childish look, adopts good hygiene habits. While the little robot seems reluctant to wash its teeth, Mom uses playful methods and precise instructions to capture her attention. She offers interactive games and imaginative scenarios, transforming this routine into a captivating adventure. The humorous dialogues and the nasty situations make learning fun and engaging. As Mom tries to convince Robot Bingo of the importance of this daily task, she shows patience and inventiveness, illustrating the challenges of education and parenting. This mini-episode addresses with tenderness and humour the themes of learning and responsibility, while highlighting the dynamics between a mother and her child, even if it is a robot.

programme.title: On the road to Madison
programme.desc: When their mother died, Michael Johnson and his sister Caroline found themselves in the farm where they spent their childhood. They learn that the deceased, Francesca, has demanded that her ashes be spread from the top of Roseman Bridge. A weird thing that the reading of Francesca's diary will explain...
programme.desc-more: Following the death of their mother, Francesca, Michael Johnson (Clint Eastwood) and his sister Carolyn found themselves in the family home, where childhood memories flowed. By searching their mother's affairs, they discover an unexpected will that challenges everything they thought they knew about her legacy. In parallel, they fall on a series of letters and an intimate diary that reveal a secret and passionate love story. This story took them to summer 1965, when Francesca, a housewife living in Iowa, found herself alone at home while her husband and children attended an agricultural fair. It was then that she crossed Robert Kincaid's path (Meryl Streep), a wandering photographer looking for landscapes to immortalize. Their bystander encounter turns into an intense bond, upsetting their existence and pushing them to question their choices of life.

programme.desc: A dive into the magical epic of fantasy, a genre that has enorced the world for more than a century, from Tolkien's novels to the legendary "Harry Potter" saga, from the "Game of Thrones" tsunami to "The Wheel of Time" or to the video game "Zelda". Designed as an immersive journey to spectacular images, this film takes viewers into a parallel world, born in response to the crises of history.

programme.title: The bookstore
programme.sub-title: Share of noon, by Paul Claudel
programme.desc: Because reading is and will remain one of the best ways to escape, François Busnel invites viewers to enter "La P'tite Librairie". On shelves there are novels, essays, great classics or comic books. In short, books to eat without moderation to make the mind travel from its couch. François Busnel proposes every day to discover or rediscover a French or foreign work: novel, essay, great classic or comic strip. In short, this is a good opportunity to get to the page.

programme.title: Malraux, the poetry of action
programme.desc: André Malraux, as ambivalent as he was exciting, has never stopped, both in his lifetime and after his death, unleashing passions. Fifty years after his disappearance, the "real" journey of this self-taught who has made up a destiny is traced. His itinerary is anything but straight. An attempt to steal statues in Cambodia will create a conscience and political commitment. A major anti-fascist fight in the inter-war period succeeds after 1945 a firm commitment to the Buttist alongside De Gaulle. But his commitment is not limited to action. The writer is never far away, for whom words are there to transcend reality and who wants to be the memorialist of his time.

programme.title: Your Turn (C à vous)
programme.desc: Culture, politics, economy... In a Parisian loft, Anne-Elisabeth Lemoine and her group of columnists discuss and exchange around the most diverse news, live. The presenter is surrounded by Patrick Cohen, Pierre Lescure, Aurélie Casse alternately with Emilie Tran Nguyen, Mohamed Bouhafsi, Lorrain Sénéchal and Bertrand Chameroy. During the show, where they receive several guests, each presents a chronicle. During the first part of the program, a chef cooks a dish that they then taste in C to you, the continuation, the second part of the program.

programme.title: C to you next

programme.title: The future of the Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: Under the surface of the Coral Sea, off the Australian Queensland, stands the world's largest coral reef, the Great Barrier. Every year, the arrival of spring in this underwater environment generates the magnificent and fragile reproduction of coral. More than 60,000 sea turtles are heading to Raine Island to make it the largest spawning site in the world. Processes as magical as they are threatened by global warming. This documentary offers us an immersive journey into the frenzy of the beginning of life, accompanied by enlightening explanations from local marine explorers and curators.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, who lives fun adventures with her family and friends. Always ready to explore the world around him, Peppa (John Sparkes) and his little brother George discover the joy of small things, whether by jumping in mud puddles or playing imagination games. Their daily lives are rhythmic with simple but rewarding activities, such as going to the park, visiting friends or learning new words and concepts. Peppa's parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig, also play an essential role, bringing life lessons while having fun. Through the wild situations and charming interactions with other characters, such as Suzy Sheep and Danny Dog, the series offers a fun exploration of friendship, family and discovery, captivating young viewers with its stories full of warmth and humour.
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, always ready to explore the world around her. With his little brother George (Lily Snowden-Fine), they are living thrilling and fun adventures alongside their parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig (Richard Ridings). Peppa loves jumping into mud puddles, an activity that gives him immense joy and symbolizes his mischievous spirit. Each episode takes them into a variety of situations, whether on a farm trip, a day at the beach, or even a simple visit to friends. Through these moments of play and discovery, Peppa and George learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and sharing. Colourful characters, such as their friend Suzy Sheep (Morwenna Banks) and the teacher, add a touch of magic to their daily lives, making each episode both educational and entertaining.

Each short film highlights valuable life lessons, while celebrating brotherly love and family ties, in a setting where creativity and friendship are in the spotlight.

programme.title: Farm products: to drink and eat?
programme.desc: Farm products represent 4 billion euros in turnover each year in France. Farmers' and producer's co-operative markets are growing, and even large areas offer wide ranges of farm products in their shelves. In the consumer imagination, these products oppose industrial agriculture and are based on all the virtues. The reality is more contrasted. Apart from a few very well-structured sectors, the regulation that defines the farmer label is vague and not binding. To be entitled to it, we must produce and transform on the farm, defined as a single geographical entity.

programme.title: Small animals, big adventures
programme.desc: In Taiwan, a pangolin covered with scales must cross forests and plantations to find a female before the end of the love season. In Brazil, a couple of tamarind-lion struggles to feed their twins in a fragmented forest, between scarcity, rivalries and predators. These two stories reveal the impact of monocultures and the strength of alliances to survive in nature.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.desc: Known for the beauty of its coasts and turquoise waters, Sardinia also draws a large part of its identity from its land and traditions. Behind the postcard landscapes lies a wild and mysterious island, where the steep mountains follow the immense dunes and forgotten villages. Sophie Jovillard is off the beaten track, discovering a more intimate, secret and unsuspecting Sardinia. From ancestral songs to shepherd secrets, from celebrating villages to lands where almost no water is grown, Sophie discovers an island that looks like no other.

programme.sub-title: Overseas: the defense of the blue world

programme.title: Maico : Marie-Claude Vaillant-Couturier, the revolt
programme.desc: Back to one of the greatest heroines of the 20th century: Marie-Claude Vaillant-Couturier tells through archives his journey as a French emblematic figure of the Second World War. Initially seduced by Stalin's speeches, she quickly became a communist activist and incorporated as a photographer's reporter the newspaper She is committed to the Resistance and faces Hitlerian ideologies. Arrested and then deported, she will give a decisive testimony at the Nuremberg trial.

programme.title: The 5 lives of the Earth
programme.desc: Recent geological analyses have proved the theory that the Earth was, 800 million years ago, completely covered with ice. This period has shaped our planet and is responsible for the world as we know it. Nearly a billion years ago, the Earth was composed of only one immense land mass. This vast, sterile expanse of life was only home to its oceans. A complex phenomenon will then lead to a total recovery of the planet by ice. It is the rapid melting that follows that will lead to the appearance of the first forms of life.

programme.title: Winning return for the kitchen of old
programme.desc: Once put in the old grimoires, the recipes of old make a frantic return today on social networks, in bookstores and in starred restaurants. This phenomenon, which combines nostalgia, a quest for meaning, conviviality and eco-responsible approach, demonstrates a deep need to reconnect with our roots but also with "good eating". Constance has made her 86-year-old Mamou a social media star by filming her preparing her family recipes. Some restaurateurs, like Jean Sévénes, surf on their childhood memories. Elsewhere, others do not hesitate to rehabilitate the offal or to put the soup in fashion.

programme.title: The 100 places you need to see
programme.desc: Discover the nuggets of Flanders, from Lille to the highest ground in Europe, including Roubaix, Bailleul, Malo-les-Bains, the Aodomarian marsh, Arras and Caudry, lovers of Flanders serve as guides in these magical places. Like Marie, who shares her good deals in Lille and Roubaix where the art deco pool became a museum in 1994. In Arras, where 52 Flemish facades were classified, Anne, a former journalist, discovered the galleries dug under the city to house thousands of soldiers during the 14-18 war...

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", Simon and his friend Gaspard find themselves confronted with a dilemma: to listen to the wise advice of Grandma Wolf, their grandmother, or to follow their own instincts. Despite her experience and wisdom, Mamie Wolf (the actress's voice), tries to pass on important life lessons, but the two young boys, full of determination and carelessness, choose to ignore her recommendations. Professor Wolf, also reluctant to pay attention to his own mother's warnings, finds himself in a difficult situation that prompts him to reconsider his attitude. Through comedic situations and unexpected twists, this episode highlights the importance of transmitting family values and listening to previous generations. As the consequences of their choices come to light, Simon and Gaspard will eventually face reality and recognize that sometimes the advice of elders is much more valuable than they think.
programme.desc-more: Simon Superlapin (2016)
programme.desc: Simon Superlapin (2016)

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: In Simon Superlapin's colorful and playful world, Gaspard, a young creative, with a lot of imagination, put his heart into making a monumental sand cake, which he considers his masterpiece. Proud of his work, he hastened to show it to his friends Lou and Simon, hoping to share with them the joy of his realization. However, as they return to the sandbox, a big surprise awaits them: the cake was destroyed in an unexpected accident. Devastated by this loss, Gaspard has to face disillusionment and sadness. But with the help of Lou and Simon, he discovers that true magic lies not only in creation, but also in friendship and solidarity. Together, they decide to embark on a new adventure to rebuild the cake, learning on the way valuable lessons about teamwork and resilience.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: In a sunny afternoon, Simon and Gaspard, two young adventurers inseparable, find themselves in the kitchen looking for sweets. Their curiosity prompts them to explore the closets, where they discover a box filled with appetizing cakes. In no time, they settle down at the table to taste these delicious treats, savoring each bite with delight. However, the joyful atmosphere changes when their grandfather, a man with a tender heart but a little distracted, enters the kitchen, attracted by the sweet smell. To his surprise, he realizes that there are no more cakes left. The two friends, taken with remorse, exchange conspiracies but decide to remain silent on their little gourmet getaway. While their grandfather is wondering about this mystery, Simon and Gaspard will have to navigate between guilt and friendship, while learning a valuable lesson about honesty and sharing.

programme.desc: In the Bordelais, the art of living is cultivated daily. At the heart of the vineyards, villages and landscapes that make the region's identity, Célyne Fuselier discovers a territory where the taste of good bread, great tablées and simple pleasures draw a certain idea of happiness to the French. As she travels, the host meets those who make this land live generous and perpetuate her taste for sharing. Between know-how, traditions and moments of celebration, she discovers a sweetness of life that seduces visitors from all over the world and where each stage is an invitation to enjoy the moment.

This journey leads viewers from the mildness of Geneva to the wild landscapes of the Greater Cariçaie, to the discovery of agricultural traditions, to the peaks of the Vaudese Alps. Each stage reveals a facet of this unique relationship between the inhabitants and nature. Between mountain enthusiasts at Mount Pèlerin and forest guardians, this journey highlights women and men who shape, protect and celebrate their environment.
