programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: For almost a month, fifty cameras went to Poissy's maternity home to film the daily lives of medical personnel and their patients.
programme.desc-more: Women's expectations of childbirth are as high as future mothers themselves. Some want to control everything, others hope that this moment is as short as possible or that everything will be carried out according to their convictions, even if it is suffering. So midwives and doctors must listen to their desires, even when they are rather unusual. But birth sometimes escapes all predictions and the health care teams, such as the parturients and their entourage, are forced to recover from it during the events.

programme.title: Top Info
programme.desc: Discover TOP INFO, the new daily JT designed for young adults. Each edition will open up to three highlights of the current situation, before continuing with a substantive subject, embodied by young journalists, to deepen a theme. Once a week, this sequence will focus on combating misinformation and media education.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: If Nathan is pleased that Clay is going home, he does not know how to tell him that the results of the intervention force him to give up his sports career.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.title: Welcome home
programme.desc: It is time to discover during this great finale that Olivier and Sophie, Sandrine and Bruno, Sophie and Thomas as well as Magalie and Lionel will be the guests of the week.
programme.desc-more: The most famous guest house competition offers many surprises! Discover exceptional areas, moments of sharing and conviviality... but also competition and sharp criticism, prepare yourself for twists at each stage! Where the houses have charm and the guests of character: Every week, four couples open the doors of their guest house and receive themselves in turn to judge each other! From the reception to the quality of services, to the inspection of the house and its exteriors, to the quality/price ratio... everything will be checked and noted without concession. At the end of the week, only one duo will win the coveted title of "Best Guest House" and leave with the sum of €3,000.

programme.title: The Villa of Broken Hearts
programme.desc: Nacca tells Soso he's lost. Marine finished her coaching upset with a letter from her mother, which encouraged her to believe in love again.
programme.desc-more: A group of anonymous men and women or who have already participated in reality TV shows in the past is housed in a superb villa with the aim of solving their problems related to their love life. To help them, the seduction coach Lucie Mariotti offers them a galant appointment with suitors from outside. The expert is also present at individual coaching sessions to try to learn more about the failures of their sentimental past and help them identify the nature of the brakes to their love happiness.

programme.title: Visitors to America
programme.desc: The adventures of the knight and his faithful squire, always lost in the meanderings of time, continue in the 21st century, in the United States.
programme.desc-more: In the war of Cent Ans, Thibault de Malfète (Jean Reno), Duke of Anjou and Orléans, arrived in England, accompanied by his faithful squire, André Le Pâté (Christian Keyboarder), to celebrate his marriage with an English princess. But the Duke ingurgates a bewitched potion and he assassinates his fiancée, Princess Rosalind (Christina Applegate). His faithful servant, André Le Pâté, just saved him from a certain death. When a magician offers Thibault to come back some time before the crime to repair the misfortune, he agrees to go back in time. But the magician forgets an ingredient and sends the two men in the year 2000 to Chicago.

programme.title: Visitors: The Revolution
programme.desc: Thinking of returning home, Count Godefroy de Montmirail and Jacquouille la Fripuille, his squire, found themselves in the middle of the French Revolution.
programme.desc-more: Locked in the corridors of time, Godefroy de Montmirail (Jean Reno) and his faithful servant Jacquouille (Christian Keyboarder) are projected in an era of profound political and social upheavals: the French Revolution... More specifically, La Téreur, a period of great dangers during which the descendants of Jacquouille La Fripouille, the convinced revolutionaries, confiscate the castle and all the property of the descendants of Godefroy de Montmirail, arrogant aristocrats on the run whose life is only held by a thread.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: Family XXL and shouting in the shovel, don't panic, Super Nanny is coming!
programme.desc: Together for 16 years, Marilyne and Jimmy have been a large family with their seven children: Solanne, 15, Lola, 12, Malone, 11, Illan, 8, Nino, 6, Lizie, 4, and Charly, 1 year. But behind this XXL tribe, the daily life is explosive: shouts, disputes and tensions are rumbling the day. Solanne, the eldest, took on the role of second mom, while Lola and Malone isolated themselves, the latter spending hours in front of the screens. Nino and Lizie, on the other hand, multiply the nonsense and provocations. Overwhelmed, Marilyne tries to impose a strict organization before leaving for work, leaving Jimmy in retreat. Family balance threatens to collapse. Super Nanny intervenes to try to recreate the bond and soothe this family with breath.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: Five kids, two teenagers, one mommy: Super Nanny comes to order.
programme.desc: Jessica, 40, is the manager of an escape game and raises her five children on her own, every other week: Rone, 13, Ava, 11, Lev, 9, and the twins Taëlle and Liora, 7 years old. Rone, the senior HPI diagnosed, is as brilliant as he is unmanageable, especially because of his phone addiction and his constantly boiling mind. Ava suffers from the attention paid to her brother and struggles to express his emotions. The disputes between brothers and sisters are increasing, putting Jessica's authority to a great test. In the face of this explosive situation, Super Nanny intervenes to try to restore order, calm tensions and give Jessica the keys to her authority.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: Our 4 children are in conflict, help us!
programme.desc: Laëtitia, 35, and Julien, 38, call on Super Nanny. Indeed, at the head of a fraterie of four children constantly in conflict, the parents are on the verge of a nervous crisis. Super Nanny therefore goes to the Var to, at first, observe the habits and daily life of the little family, then draw up a plan to help the little family communicate otherwise than by shouting. The task will not be easy, as children have a strong character.

programme.desc: On the morning of April 14, 2019, in Avignon, Marie-Pascale Sidolle mysteriously disappears. The last time this caregiver was seen by the video surveillance cameras, she was in her car, in the parking lot of her workplace, the Avignon hospital. On January 25, 2021, a hunter found bones in the garrigue, 15 km away. These are the remains of Marie-Pascale. What happened to him? Who did this helper without a story? Who took the caregiver? *A snail murderer*

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: Close-up on a particular investigation: two criminal cases took place 30 years apart and are a priori unrelated. The investigators, however, are able to discover the common thread of these two crimes: a 78-year-old woman with a strong character, accused of having eliminated her rival in love, who, however, continues to claim her innocence. programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: In France, one in twenty newborns has a mother over 40 years of age. The pregnancies of these women, which are more risky than others, are particularly monitored.
programme.desc-more: Alexandra decided to have a child at 44 years of age, requiring a major follow-up of her pregnancy and a scheduled delivery in Caesarean section. If she awaits the happy event with serenity, her companion José questions her parenthood in her 40s. Astrid, however, is waiting for her second little boy, but is concerned about the weight of her baby, which has exceeded her term by a few days. Finally, Ana is about to give birth to her son after having had a lot of difficulty accepting and managing the miscarriage of her previous pregnancy.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Florian is very involved in taking care of the birth of her third child; Carlos, on the other hand, approached the birth of his companion lightly.
programme.desc-more: Yolène, 28, and Florian, 26, are waiting for their third child. For the first two, the couple had used in vitro fertilization. As for Anilia, she is pregnant for the second time. Although the father left, the thirty-year-old remained positive. She decides to give birth with her best friend, who works as a child care assistant at the hospital in Poissy. For their part, 26-year-old Marta and 27-year-old Carlos will welcome their first baby. Carlos is very relaxed, ready for all eventualities and approaches this delivery with great lightness.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: A few days from Halloween, Brooke and Julian are receiving an unexpected visit. Clay and Quinn, on the other hand, have difficulty adapting to normal life.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.desc: A group of anonymous men and women or who have already participated in reality TV shows in the past is housed in a superb villa with the aim of solving their problems related to their love life. programme.title: Emergency Calls
programme.sub-title: Northern bullies and thieves, no respite for night brigade
programme.desc: In Douai, in the North, 420 police officers are faced with often complicated missions, especially after dark. When the night comes, the offenders seem to be jostling. Many drivers are hoping to go unnoticed. Some drive without a license, others drive with nearly two grams of alcohol per litre of blood.
programme.desc-more: In Douai, in the North, 420 police officers are faced with often complicated missions, especially after dark. When the night came, the offenders seemed to be jostling and the police saw it in all colours. Many drivers are hoping to go unnoticed. Some drive without a licence, like almost 800,000 French, others drive with nearly two grams of alcohol per litre of blood, four times the limit allowed. In Douai, the Belgian border is only a few kilometers away. Interventions sometimes turn into chases, with police officers having to act before offenders cross it. The inhabitants can also count on the flair of the law enforcement agencies.

programme.title: Emergency Calls
programme.sub-title: Commandos : Chock Selection for elite soldiers
programme.desc: 27 young people, including two women, aged 21-35, dream of becoming commando instructors and joining the army elite. All are already experienced soldiers, but only a handful will achieve its goal. For three weeks, trials are taking place in a true course of the fighter.
programme.desc-more: 27 young people, including two women, aged 21 to 35, dream of becoming commando instructor and joining the army elite. To achieve this, they must surpass themselves in ruthless trials. All are already experienced soldiers, but only a handful will achieve its goal. For three weeks, trials, day and night, in the forest as in the water, are taking place in a true journey of the fighter where no weakness is tolerated. Candidates must hold, at all costs. The aim is to plunge these commandos apprentice instructors into a state of extreme fatigue to test their physical abilities, resistance and ability to push their limits.

programme.sub-title: Mulhouse: The elite PSIG gendarmes on alert!

programme.title: Emergency Calls
programme.sub-title: Speed, alcohol, accidents: when Montauban police officers hunt down drivers
programme.desc: The Tarn-et-Garonne is France's 6th deadliest department. About 20 gendarmes from the Montauban Motorised Platoon are on the front line to intercept the drivers. They patrol the A20 motorway, which is crisscrossed every day by 70,000 motorists, but also on the rural departments.
programme.desc-more: Montauban is a town with 250,000 inhabitants, located not far from Toulouse, in the Occitanie region. It is a sunny city that smells good in the Southwest. However, behind this image is a less cheerful reality: the Tarn-et-Garonne is the 6th deadliest department in France in terms of road accidents. A team followed the PMO gendarmes, the motorised platoon of Montauban. These 20 specialists are on the front line to intercept the drivers. Overspeed, drivers without a licence or drunkenness, the patrol does not tolerate any deviations to carry out its mission.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: In February 1982, Amandine, the first test baby, was born in Clamart, a miracle made possible by Professors René Frydman and Jacques Testart.
programme.desc-more: In February 1982, the first test baby was born at the maternity hospital of Antoine-Béclère de Clamart, Hauts-de-Seine, thanks in particular to Professors René Frydman and Jacques Testart. A step forward that now allows one in thirty children to be born in France thanks to a medically assisted reproductive technique. Many doctors have since taken over the torch of these two Professors, including Michael Grynberg. He is a specialist in reproductive medicine and manages several hundred births every year.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: In France, if one in five women prefers to give up an anaesthesia under peridural conditions during childbirth, the others would not give up on it for anything in the world.
programme.desc-more: For every mother who arrives at maternity with contractions, the questions of the nursing staff are always the same: can you assess the pain on a scale of 1 to 10 and would you like a peridural? In France, one in five women prefers to give birth naturally. The other four, for their part, were anxious to benefit from the peridural so as not to suffer as their mothers at one time. It is an anesthesia that is supposed to alleviate the sometimes terrible pains of the world.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: A month in the maternity halls of the hospital centre of Poissy-Saint-Germain, the most important in Ile-de-France, where every year 4,500 babies are born.
programme.desc-more: After the success of the first season, the maternity clinic of the inter-municipal hospital in Poissy-Saint-Germain, where a baby comes into the world every two hours, returns to the maternity ward. For almost a month, fifty cameras filmed 24 hours a day the privacy of families, as well as the daily lives of maternity workers. Coralie, 17, and single, Sophie, who is about to give birth to triplets, Stéphane super "coach" who (re) falls in love with his wife, Daouda very stressed because his wife has to undergo a caesarean... so many intense and sensitive situations.

programme.title: The Hobbit: Smaug's Desolation
programme.desc: With dwarfs, a hobby confronts a thousand dangers and a dragon holding a treasure. He takes over a power ring held by a strange creature.
programme.desc-more: Bilbon Sacquet (Martin Freeman), the discreet but courageous hobby, continues his perilous quest alongside Thorin Écu-de-Chêne (Richard Armitage) and his company of Dwarfs determined to take over their lost kingdom, Erebor, from the claws of the dragon Smaugh. Their journey leads them through hostile lands, where every forest, river and mountain contains deadly dangers, but also unexpected allies. After having barely escaped the trolls of the mountains, the group sinks into the dark depths of the Mirkwood Forest, a cursed place where black magic corrupted until the sunlight. Trees similar to spectra, deceptive illusions and creatures tamped in the shadows transform this crossing into a test of endurance and trickiness. Yet, this is just a taste of the horrors that await them: giant spiders, thirsty with flesh, stretch their mortal webs, while the Elves of the Black Forest, led by Prince Legolas (Orlando Bloom) and Captain Tauriel (Evangeline Lilly), capture them, taking them as intruders. If Legolas, guided by a mixture of mistrust and curiosity, hesitates to let them go, Tauriel, whose sense of justice transcends the borders of his people, sees in them a glimmer of hope in a world that is becoming increasingly darker. Freed from a daring escape, Bilbon and the Dwarfs find themselves propelled towards the shores of Lake Town, a prosperous human city built on stilts, where the reception is as uncertain as the deep waters surrounding it. Meanwhile, a much greater threat is emerging: Smaught (voice of Benedict Cumberbatch), the golden dragon with piercing eyes and implacable trick, watches over his treasure in the bowels of the Solitary Mountain, still unaware that intruders dare to defy his reign.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: In La Réunion, on 29 July 2016, Julita Bénard and her companion Claudia were victims of an assault at the abyss of L'Etang-Salé, not far from the city of Saint-Pierre. Claudia's doing well, but Julita's disappearing. There are many leads, but the investigation of the gendarmes reveals a totally unexpected scenario.
programme.desc-more: On 29 July 2016, Julita Bénard and her companion Claudia were attacked on Réunion Island, in the gulf of Étang-Salé. Claudia gets out, but the attacker leaves no trace of Julita. The investigators then begin a long-term work and there are many tracks followed, at the end of which the truth will appear, as terrifying as it is surprising. Back to the case and its outcome, with the intervention of many witnesses, including the father and aunt of the disappeared, but also many other relatives and professionals.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.title: Fifty shades of Grey
programme.desc: In Seattle, the life of Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson), a shy and clumsy literature student, turns when she meets Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan), a charismatic and mysterious businessman. She was asked to interview Christian for an article in her student newspaper, and was immediately captivated by her seductive appearance and disconcerting assurance. As they begin to associate, their intense connection quickly takes an unexpected turn. Christian, who is in the grip of his own inner demons, reveals to Anastasia his inclination for unconventional sexual practices. He suggested that she sign a contract setting out the rules of a relationship that was much more complex than she had imagined. Disturbed between his attraction for this enigmatic man and his own limits, Anastasia finds herself immersed in a world of passion, pain and self-discovery, questioning his values and desires.

programme.title: Gabby and the Magic House
programme.desc: The fairy festival opens its doors: places for attractions, games, beards for Dad and a new friend who dreams of winning a flowery competition!
programme.desc-more: Gabby is a sparkling and imaginative little girl, passionate about cooking, manual activities and time spent with her friends. Her life takes on an extraordinary turn when she discovers that her dollhouse is more than just a toy: it is a real portal to a magical world where everything becomes possible. Every time she plays with her dolls, Gabby finds herself immersed in fascinating adventures, filled with enchanting characters and challenges. Accompanied by her faithful friends, she explores colorful kingdoms, solves creative puzzles and learns valuable lessons about friendship, creativity and determination. Thanks to his magical home, Gabby discovers that the power of imagination can transform reality and that every day is a new opportunity to learn and grow. With a mixture of humour and tenderness, this series invites young spectators to believe in their dreams and to give free rein to their creativity.

programme.title: Rainbow High
programme.desc: When Violet creates the perfect purple shade for her sparkling ray, she remembers the years she painted at Junior High and created the perfect purple.
programme.desc-more: The arrival of new students at Rainbow High High is disrupting the delicate balance of social relations within the school. While old friendships are being tested, tensions are mounting between emerging groups of young designers and designers. The new arrivals, with their flamboyant personality and undeniable talent, arouse both admiration and jealousy among the students already in place. Each of them brings a unique touch to the dynamics of the high school, intensifying the competition to stand out in an environment where glamour and creativity are the key words. The protagonists will have to navigate through the intrigues, betrayals and unexpected alliances to find their place in this world where appearance counts as much as talent. Between fashion, friendship and rivalry, Rainbow High explores the challenges of adolescence and the quest for identity in a vibrant and artistic community.

programme.title: Pirate Academy

programme.desc-more: On the sunny beach of the Pirates Academy, young adventurers known as Planctons are engaged in a hard workout. As they explore the dunes, they fall by chance on an old necklace, the vestige of the legendary pirate La Perlouze. According to local mythology, this jewel confers power of invincibility to the one who manages to master it. Intrigued by this discovery, Planktons are embarking on a quest to discover the mysteries surrounding La Perlouze and its necklace. However, their enthusiasm is rapidly darkened by strange events that are beginning to occur around them. Shadows of the past resurface, threatening their safety and that of the Academy. Between rivalries, friendships and the weight of a legend, young pirates will have to show courage and ingenuity to overcome the dangers that lie ahead, while discovering the true nature of the power they covet.

programme.title: Ice Age 2
programme.desc: The day the glacier that protects their valley threatens to break under the influence of warming, prehistoric animals must make their baluchon and flee.
programme.desc-more: While the Earth, still shaped by the ice of prehistory, is undergoing the first subjugations of a changing climate, a lush valley is home to a community of animals as disparate as they are attached. But this tranquillity is threatened: an imposing ice dam, the last bulwark against the raging waves of the ocean, begins to crack under the effect of an inexorable trigger. For Manny the mammoth, lonely and full of shit, this news sounds like a drink. Persuaded to be the last survivor of his kind, he rubbed his destiny in the company of his inseparable competitors: Sid, the lazy, loquacious and clumsy, whose farfetched ideas often defy logic, and Diego, the sword-ted tiger with a troubled past, drawn between his predatory instincts and his nascent friendship for this unlikely duo. As panic spreads into the valley and thousands of animals set out to secure land, the trio embarks on a journey of tangles. Their route soon crossed that of Ellie, a mammoth female as playful as eccentric, convinced against all evidence of belonging to the family of opossums. His overflowing energy and certainty his confusing sess is shaking Manny's convictions, who sees her as an unexpected hope... But also a mystery to be clarified. Why does this strange creature, surrounded by a band of equally extravagant opossum brothers, ignore its true nature? Meanwhile, well above them, Scrat the sword-destroyed squirrel continues its eternal quest for the perfect acorn, unwittingly triggering cascade disasters that could well precipitate the end of the glacial world.

programme.title: Ice Age 3: The Time of the dinosaurs
programme.desc: Two mammoths, a tiger and a squirrel go out looking for their friend, a lazy one, kidnapped by a tyrannosaur. They discover a world under the ice.
programme.desc-more: At the dawn of a new ice age, as the frozen landscapes of prehistory begin to cover themselves with a thin layer of green, warning of changes, the most unlikely pack of friends of all time is facing much more personal upheavals. Manny, the mammoth bulged in his heart, and Ellie, his playful and life-filled companion, are about to live one of the most terrifying adventures of their existence: becoming parents. Between excitement and anguish, Manny, still as protective, wonders if he will be up to the level, while Ellie, more serene, tries to reassure him. Yet the imminent arrival of a small mammoth is not the only source of tension within the group. Diego, the well-dipped sword-ted tiger, also feels the wind of change. The idea of a family life, with its responsibilities and compromises, makes him flee on all hands. For him, freedom and adventure go first and foremost, and he announces his departure, leaving behind friends as surprised as they are attribed. But it is Sid, the exuberant and clumsy lazy man, who will trigger a chain of events as unexpected as crazy. As he crawls into the ice, he falls on three giant eggs, abandoned and on the brink. Without hesitation, he adopted them, convinced of his intention to become the best of fathers. When the eggs hatch, revealing three lovely dinosaur babies, Sid is in the angels. But her joy is short-lived: a tyrannosaur mother furious and determined to regain her offspring disembark, sowing panic.

programme.title: Asterix in the Bretons
programme.desc: In the year 50 B.C., the Roman Empire, led by the formidable Julius Caesar, conquered almost all of Brittany, with the exception of a single Gallic village that fiercely resists the invader. Threatened by the loss of their independence, the Bretons, tired and desperate, sent Jolictorix, their leader, to ask for help from his cousin Asterix, an indomitable Gaul known for his exploits. Asterix, accompanied by his inseparable friend Obelix, prepares to go to the rescue of the Bretons. With the help of Druid Panoramix, they concoct the famous magic potion, the source of their superhuman strength. Their journey leads them to Londinium, where an unexpected detour confronts them with formidable challenges. Unfortunately, in the heart of the city, the precious potion is stolen, placing our heroes in a race against the clock to find it. This journey, full of pitfalls, will reveal the team spirit and determination of Asterix and Obelix in front of the Roman invader.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Angus MacGyver, a handyman, is teaming up with experts in their respective fields and is able to solve sensitive and dangerous investigations. When a biochemical weapon disappears, Mac, also a member of a secret government organization, and his partners immediately try to find it. Later, she was a former friend of Mac's, CIA agent, who no longer gave news: her last mission to Venezuela might have been fatal to her. The fine team then travels to Moscow, where two Russian agents help them disable a nuclear warhead. A more muscular and action-packed version of the famous series of the 1980s-1990s.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Within the secret Phoenix society, an organization acting in the shadows to protect the interests of the US government, Angus "Mac" MacGyver (Lucas Till) uses his intelligence and ingenuity to get out of the most perilous situations. In the second season, he was under the supervision of Matty Webber (Meredith Eaton), former superior of Jack Dalton (George Eads) to the CIA, who entrusted him with increasingly complex missions. At the same time, Wilt (Justin Hires) was sent to espionage training, learning to navigate the dangerous world of intelligence. While MacGyver and his team, composed of Riley Davis (Tristin Mays) and Jack Dalton, face various threats, two iconic figures from the original series are emerging, adding a touch of nostalgia and tension to their adventures. Between international intrigues and technological challenges, MacGyver struggles to save lives while testing his unique skills.

programme.title: Gabby and the Magic House
programme.desc: The fairy festival opens its doors: it is open to attractions, games, beards to Dad and a new friend who dreams of winning a flowery competition!
programme.desc-more: Gabby is a sparkling and imaginative little girl, passionate about cooking, manual activities and time spent with her friends. Her life takes on an extraordinary turn when she discovers that her dollhouse is more than just a toy: it is a real portal to a magical world where everything becomes possible. Every time she plays with her dolls, Gabby finds herself immersed in fascinating adventures, filled with enchanting characters and challenges. Accompanied by her faithful friends, she explores colorful kingdoms, solves creative puzzles and learns valuable lessons about friendship, creativity and determination. Thanks to his magical home, Gabby discovers that the power of imagination can transform reality and that every day is a new opportunity to learn and grow. With a mixture of humour and tenderness, this series invites young spectators to believe in their dreams and to give free rein to their creativity.

programme.title: Rainbow High
programme.desc: It's Kira's birthday, and the girls jump from gate to gate to a wonderful snow-covered country to celebrate her special day.
programme.desc-more: The arrival of new students at Rainbow High High is disrupting the delicate balance of social relations within the school. While old friendships are being tested, tensions are mounting between emerging groups of young designers and designers. The new arrivals, with their flamboyant personality and undeniable talent, arouse both admiration and jealousy among the students already in place. Each of them brings a unique touch to the dynamics of the high school, intensifying the competition to stand out in an environment where glamour and creativity are the key words. The protagonists will have to navigate through the intrigues, betrayals and unexpected alliances to find their place in this world where appearance counts as much as talent. Between fashion, friendship and rivalry, Rainbow High explores the challenges of adolescence and the quest for identity in a vibrant and artistic community.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: The students of the Pirate Academy wake up one morning in a disconcerting environment: all adults have mysteriously disappeared. In this unexpected situation, young pirates, nicknamed Planktons, find themselves facing a major challenge. Convinced that they can prove their value and ability to function as a self-contained crew, they decide to organize themselves and take charge of things. Quickly, tensions are emerging within the group, each trying to claim its role and authority. Alliances are formed and disbanded as they strive to create a society based on cooperation and mutual trust. In this adventure, children will not only have to overcome their differences, but also face challenges that will test their team spirit. Between rivalry and camaraderie, they will learn what it really means to be a crew, while discovering the stakes of responsibility and solidarity.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: In the colorful world of "Pirate Academy", Finn, a young pirate aspirant, deeply admires Marc the Bouc, a legendary character known for his daring exploits on the seas. However, the disturbing discovery that his hero never washed him into an identity crisis. Decided to imitate this unsanitary example to prove his commitment to piracy, Finn began to abandon his own hygiene, to the great despair of his classmates. His fellow students, shocked by this new attitude, try to convince him of the dangers of this path, but Finn remains obstinate, convinced that he must prove himself by adopting the way of life of his idol. This unexpected choice leads to a series of comic situations and confrontations, where Finn will eventually have to navigate between his admiration for Marc and the realities of being a true pirate, while discovering the importance of personal identity and hygiene in his adventure.

programme.title: Boy, Girl, etc.
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 1 of the series Boy, Girl, etc.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and baffled universe, Boy and Girl, two young humans, share their daily lives with a bunch of eccentric anthropomorphic animals: Dog, a loyal and farce dog, Cat, a mischievous and cunning feline, and Mouse, a curious and intrepid little mouse. Together, they live under the same roof in a joyful bazaar, where the crazy situations and misadventures are linked. Every day, Boy and Girl discover the joys and challenges of a community life, learning to navigate through small arguments and moments of camaraderie. Their atypical family, although different from traditional norms, teaches them essential values such as friendship, solidarity and acceptance of differences. As the episodes progress, this unlikely sibling strengthens, proving that love and understanding can overcome all barriers, even those that seem the strangest.

programme.title: Jamie has tentacles.
programme.sub-title: Falfatrox has the cards in hand
programme.desc: Jamie, the son of the king of planet Blurb, found refuge on Earth to escape the Blarbs launched after him. The Walsh family is gathering the boy, who has all the difficulties of the world in concealing his powers.
programme.desc-more: Chassed by the Vloks, an alien race avid with flesh, Jamie, the prince of planet Blarb, is forced to flee to Earth to escape a tragic fate. He arrived on our planet and found refuge with Mr. and Mrs. Walsh, a caring couple who offered him shelter. In this new world, Jamie has a special connection with their son, Nerdy (Gabriel Bismuth-Beloved), a shy and introverted teenager whose life is mainly held behind the doors of his room. Despite his extraordinary powers, Jamie must sail with caution, concealing his abilities to avoid attracting the attention of the Vloks. Under constant threat from Lieutenant Contact, a ruthless robot, and Sergeant Gratchett, a mutant cow determined to capture him, Jamie and Nerdy unite to face these perils, learning the value of friendship and courage in a world where every moment can be fatal.

programme.title: A soul mate for Christmas
programme.desc: As the end of the year approaches, as the glittering lights and the magic of Christmas envelop the world, two lonely souls, separated by an ocean, prepare to experience an unexpected experience. Molly Cooper (Laura Vandervoort), an independent farmer from Connecticut, leads a simple and warm life surrounded by its animals and snow-covered landscapes that make its region charming. On the other side of the Atlantic, Patrick Kensington (Rainbow Sun Francks), a refined and busy man, lives in a stylish London apartment, where the bustling pace of the city leaves him little time to enjoy the sweetness of the holidays. To escape the routine and discover a new way to celebrate Christmas, Molly and Patrick decided to temporarily exchange their homes. What was initially only a simple practical arrangement quickly turns into a correspondence full of complicity. Through their exchanges of emails and messages, a sincere and deep connection is established between them. Despite the distance, they share their traditions, dreams and hopes, gradually discovering that they have much more in common than they would have imagined. As Christmas day approaches, they finally agree to meet in person in Molly's snow-covered farm. But between the unexpected of the journey, the secret expectations and the doubts that may arise at the idea of moving from virtual to real, this encounter promises to be as exciting as it is incertaine. Will the preparations for the holidays, the reunions with the relatives and the small happiness of the daily life reinforce this nascent alchemy, or will the differences between their two worlds prove more difficult to overcome than they had believed? In an atmosphere where Christmas magic blends with the most tender emotions, Molly and Patrick may discover that the most beautiful gift is not under the tree, but in the unexpected encounter of two hearts ready to open up to love...

programme.title: A five star Christmas
programme.desc: A few days away from Christmas, as the streets of New York sparkle under the garlands and the effervescence of the festivals invade the city, Rachel, a dedicated and discreet assistant, is about to go on a business trip that promises to be like all the others. For years, she has worked alongside Adrian, her charismatic and ambitious boss, a man whose smile makes her blush and whose stealthy eyes feed her most secret dreams. In silent love, Rachel never dared to cross the line between the professional and the intimate, preferring to settle for small gestures – a coffee placed on her desk, a word of encouragement slipped into a file – while hoping that one day, perhaps, he will notice how she feels. But this time, everything is going to change. A monstrous snowstorm struck the area, paralyzing the transportation and forcing Rachel and Adrian to take refuge in a luxury, isolated hotel, a haven of warmth and light in the middle of a snowy landscape. Only guests of the establishment, they find themselves immersed in an out-of-time atmosphere, where office rules no longer apply. Between the decorated fir trees, the crackling fireplace fires and the dinners with improvised candles, the alchemy that has always united them takes on a new dimension. Conversations, first professional, gradually slide towards more personal confessions. Adrian, usually so distant, seems to finally see Rachel differently. And Rachel, free from her inhibitions, dares finally let her feelings appear.

programme.desc: Jamie's getting a distress call from a space-disappeared ship. He must go to the spot and take Nerdy with him.
programme.desc-more: Chassed by the Vloks, an alien race avid with flesh, Jamie, the prince of planet Blarb, is forced to flee to Earth to escape a tragic fate. He arrived on our planet and found refuge with Mr. and Mrs. Walsh, a caring couple who offered him shelter. In this new world, Jamie has a special connection with their son, Nerdy (Gabriel Bismuth-Beloved), a shy and introverted teenager whose life is mainly held behind the doors of his room. Despite his extraordinary powers, Jamie must sail with caution, concealing his abilities to avoid attracting the attention of the Vloks. Under constant threat from Lieutenant Contact, a ruthless robot, and Sergeant Gratchett, a mutant cow determined to capture him, Jamie and Nerdy unite to face these perils, learning the value of friendship and courage in a world where every moment can be fatal.

programme.title: Ice Age 3: The Time of the dinosaurs
programme.desc: Manny and Ellie are waiting for their first child. Diego decides to leave them, because family life is not very suitable for him. Sid discovers three large eggs he decides to adopt. From these eggs three dinosaur babies come out. Their mother is looking for them, but Sid refuses to abandon them. However, when a tyrannosaur attacks them, he follows the mother and the little ones in an unknown world...
programme.desc-more: At the dawn of a new ice age, as the frozen landscapes of prehistory begin to cover themselves with a thin layer of green, warning of changes, the most unlikely pack of friends of all time is facing much more personal upheavals. Manny, the mammoth bulged in his heart, and Ellie, his playful and life-filled companion, are about to live one of the most terrifying adventures of their existence: becoming parents. Between excitement and anguish, Manny, still as protective, wonders if he will be up to the level, while Ellie, more serene, tries to reassure him. Yet the imminent arrival of a small mammoth is not the only source of tension within the group. Diego, the well-dipped sword-ted tiger, also feels the wind of change. The idea of a family life, with its responsibilities and compromises, makes him flee on all hands. For him, freedom and adventure go first and foremost, and he announces his departure, leaving behind friends as surprised as they are attribed. But it is Sid, the exuberant and clumsy lazy man, who will trigger a chain of events as unexpected as crazy. As he crawls into the ice, he falls on three giant eggs, abandoned and on the brink. Without hesitation, he adopted them, convinced of his intention to become the best of fathers. When the eggs hatch, revealing three lovely dinosaur babies, Sid is in the angels. But her joy is short-lived: a tyrannosaur mother furious and determined to regain her offspring disembark, sowing panic.

programme.title: Ice Age 4: The drift of continents
programme.desc: Because of a planetary cataclysm caused by Scrat and his irrepressible desire for acorn, Manny, Sid and Diego find themselves trapped in an odyssey around the world. On an iceberg that serves as a boat, they try to join their respective families. But the seas are far from safe...
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant prehistoric world of colours and life, the Scrat squirrel (voice of Chris Wedge) is embarking on a desperate quest to catch a glans. However, his obsession caused a monumental cataclysm, causing the separation of continents and upsetting the balance of the planet. At the heart of this chaos, the mammouth Manny (voice of Ray Romano) finds himself isolated on a piece of drifting ice, far from his family, his wife Ellie (voice of Queen Latifah) and their daughter Pêche (voice of Keke Palmer). Manny, accompanied by his faithful friends – the Diego-sabre tiger (voice of Denis Leary) and the clumsy lazy Sid (voice of John Leguizamo), as well as his grandmother – must navigate through turbulent waters and face unprecedented challenges. Their journey led them to cross the road of a band of formidable pirates, led by the terrifying Captain Gutt (voice of Peter Dinklage). In a confrontation between courage and trickery, the group will have to unite its forces to overcome the dangers and regain their path to safety. The stakes have never been so high, and friendship will be tested in this thrilling adventure full of humour and emotion.

programme.title: The great saga of cult cartoons
programme.desc: For over a hundred years, cartoons have made people laugh, dream and shiver. A dive into these animated worlds with cult extracts, unforgettable generics and testimonies of personalities. Memories, crazy laughs and nostalgia guaranteed.

programme.title: The success story of cult comics
programme.desc: Dive into the universe of comic books and manga that have shaped the imagination of several generations. While France is today the world's second largest manga consumer, the program reveals the secrets, anecdotes and amazing stories hidden behind mythical works such as Asterix, Tintin, Smurfs, One Piece or Dragon Ball. Through the memories of such personalities as Olivier Minne, Magloire, Amandine Petit, or specialists as pop culture journalist Marie Palot, authors Jérôme Alquié or Diane Truc, the documentary mixes archives, playful battles and cross-testimony. A cocktail of humor, nostalgia and discoveries to celebrate comic and manga culture in a resolutely pop and positive atmosphere. © Gulli

programme.title: Ice Age 2
programme.desc: Life is much more enjoyable in the valley since temperatures warmed up. Sid organized a holiday colony: Manny the mammoth and Diego the tiger are not the last to mock him. In the heart of his heart, and although he does not touch anyone, Manny is unhappy: he thinks he is the last mammoth on Earth when he would have liked to be able to found a family. But soon, heat forces, the glacier threatens to break and engulf the valley. To survive, this little world is on the road to a safer place. On the way, Manny, Diego and Sid meet Elijah and his two brothers, Opposums...

programme.title: Ice Age 3: The time of dinosaurs
programme.desc: When Sid the lazy finds three big eggs in a cave, he decides to adopt them. Trouble begins when the young prove to be dinosaurs. When the tyrannosaur mom comes to get her children, she takes Sid with her. Manny and Ellie are waiting for their first baby mammouth. How will the father, already stressed, understand paternity in this unsecured context? With Diego, the sword-tooth tiger, and Scrat, the squirrel, they then go looking for their friend. They discover under the ice a lush jungle where dinosaurs live. They meet Buck, a snoop who hunts the most terrible dinosaurs: Rudy...

programme.title: The success story of cult comics
programme.desc: Dive into the universe of comic books and manga that have shaped the imagination of several generations. While France is today the world's second largest manga consumer, the program reveals the secrets, anecdotes and amazing stories hidden behind mythical works such as Asterix, Tintin, Smurfs, One Piece or Dragon Ball. Through the memories of such personalities as Olivier Minne, Magloire, Amandine Petit, or specialists as pop culture journalist Marie Palot, authors Jérôme Alquié or Diane Truc, the documentary mixes archives, playful battles and cross-testimony. A cocktail of humor, nostalgia and discoveries to celebrate comic and manga culture in a resolutely pop and positive atmosphere. © Gulli

programme.title: Lightning at the Christmas Market
programme.desc: A young woman returns to her hometown to resurrect the Christmas market from her childhood. A prince who came incognito offers him his help.
programme.desc-more: In a small snowy town where the lights of the garlands glitter like stars fallen from the sky, Cassie, an ambitious and Cartesian young woman, returns after years of absence to revive the Christmas market of her childhood, a magical place where memories of her past mingle with cinnamon and fir fragrances. Despite a brilliant career in the event, Cassie, accustomed to urban challenges and high-end projects, is unrecognized by the unexpected and the over-yearly charm of this village where time seems to be stopped. His goal? Turn this market into an unmissable event, while honouring the memory of her grandmother, who was once the soul of her. But his well-oiled plan quickly comes up against the unexpected arrival of Nicolas, a enigmatic and charismatic man, who spontaneously proposes to help him organize the festivities. Initially annoyed by his casual approach and his casual humour, Cassie sees him as an obstacle to his legendary efficiency. Yet, behind his simple manners and his appearance as a barouder is a well-kept secret: Nicolas is none other than a prince, weary of the suffocating protocols of the court, who chose to simmer incognito in local life to discover the authenticity of a popular festival, far from the appartments and fireworks of his world. As preparations are in full swing – between wooden chalets to decorate, concerts to organize and culinary specialties to be highlighted – Cassie and Nicolas are still linked by increasing complicity. The sparks of their first disputes gradually give way to more tender exchanges, where shared laughter and improvised confidence create an unexpected alchemy. Yet their collaboration is not without challenges: the expectations of the inhabitants, the logistical unforeseen and, above all, the unsaid ones that weigh on Nicolas threaten to make everything change.

programme.title: The flavors of Christmas
programme.desc: A renowned chef devastated by a disastrous article decides to return to his family for Christmas. A travel writer helps her to reconnect with her roots.
programme.desc-more: Grace Cooke, star chef and pioneer of gastro-scientific cuisine, reigns over the stoves of the largest restaurants with surgical precision and bold creativity. Yet behind this perfect shell is a exhausted woman, in doubt. When a stinging article by an influential critic demolishes his last menu, calling his kitchen "cold and soulless", Grace feels the floor slipping under his feet. For the first time, she questions everything: What if, despite the stars and praises, she had lost what really mattered? Injured and disoriented, she fled the bustle of Parisian cuisines to her hometown, a small snow-covered village where childhood memories and the smell of hot bread remind her of a time when cooking was synonymous with sharing and love. It is there, between the familiar walls of her childhood home and the winter landscapes that sooth her soul, that she crosses the road of Asher St. James, a traveler writer with casual charm and free spirit. He, too, sought meaning, placed his suitcases in the village to write a novel inspired by local stories. An unexpected alchemy is created between them. He, with his poetic words and his new look at the world, helps to reconnect to his roots; She, with her culinary knowledge and perfectionism, reveals a new way of seeing life. Together, they explore the Christmas markets, Grace's forgotten recipes, and the simple little happiness that had disappeared from her busy life. Yet, as Grace rediscovers the joy of cooking with her heart, a dilemma arises: can she really turn her back on her career to regain this lost authenticity? As Christmas parties approach, tensions rise. Her family, proud but worried, pushes her to take over the reins of her professional life, while Asher, drawn between her desire to stay and her need for freedom, must make a choice. Between the world's expectations and the desires of her soul, Grace will have to find her way – a path that may not resemble any other.

programme.desc-more: Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson (Shemar Moore), Lieutenant of the Special Weapons And Tactics (S.W.A.T.) in Los Angeles, commanded an elite police intervention unit. Hondo, who moved into the difficult neighbourhoods where he grew up, often finds himself in an internal conflict between the loyalty he owes to his community and the loyalty he feels to his colleagues. programme.desc: Cassie is a young woman with a brilliant career that succeeds. programme.title: The flavors of Christmas
programme.desc: A renowned chef devastated by a disastrous article decides to return to his family for Christmas. A travel writer helps her to reconnect with her roots.
programme.desc-more: Grace Cooke, star chef and pioneer of gastro-scientific cuisine, reigns over the stoves of the largest restaurants with surgical precision and bold creativity. Yet behind this perfect shell is a exhausted woman, in doubt. When a stinging article by an influential critic demolishes his last menu, calling his kitchen "cold and soulless", Grace feels the floor slipping under his feet. For the first time, she questions everything: What if, despite the stars and praises, she had lost what really mattered? Injured and disoriented, she fled the bustle of Parisian cuisines to her hometown, a small snow-covered village where childhood memories and the smell of hot bread remind her of a time when cooking was synonymous with sharing and love. It is there, between the familiar walls of her childhood home and the winter landscapes that sooth her soul, that she crosses the road of Asher St. James, a traveler writer with casual charm and free spirit. He, too, sought meaning, placed his suitcases in the village to write a novel inspired by local stories. An unexpected alchemy is created between them. He, with his poetic words and his new look at the world, helps to reconnect to his roots; She, with her culinary knowledge and perfectionism, reveals a new way of seeing life. Together, they explore the Christmas markets, Grace's forgotten recipes, and the simple little happiness that had disappeared from her busy life. Yet, as Grace rediscovers the joy of cooking with her heart, a dilemma arises: can she really turn her back on her career to regain this lost authenticity? As Christmas parties approach, tensions rise. Her family, proud but worried, pushes her to take over the reins of her professional life, while Asher, drawn between her desire to stay and her need for freedom, must make a choice. Between the world's expectations and the desires of her soul, Grace will have to find her way – a path that may not resemble any other.

programme.title: Christmas in Pemberley
programme.desc: As Christmas approaches, a event organizer goes to a picturesque little town where she approaches the owner of a charming estate.
programme.desc-more: As Christmas approaches, New York's effervescence is replaced by the snowy sweetness of a picturesque little town, where the traditions and magic of the season mix together to create a enchanting atmosphere. Elizabeth Bennet (Jessica Lowndes), a dynamic and passionate event organizer, is entrusted with a delicate mission: orchestrating a festival that will bring life to this warm community. But when she arrived, she discovered that the place she had imagined for this celebration, the majestic estate of Pemberley, was about to change hands. Indeed, William Darcy (Michael Rady), his billionaire owner, as mysterious as he is charismatic, decided to sell this historic home, thus endangering the preparations for the festival. Determined to turn this challenge into an opportunity, Elizabeth, with her contagious energy and creative spirit, tries to convince William to give her a chance. Despite his initial reluctance and apparent coldness, he eventually accepted, provided that everything was organized according to his strict rules. But while Elizabeth is trying to transform Pemberley into a fairytale place, she faces unexpected obstacles, both logistical and emotional. Between the tensions related to the organization of the event and the secrets surrounding William, a complex relationship gradually became established between them.

programme.title: The secret life of the Pharaohs
programme.sub-title: Toutankhamon, the Pharaoh with the fabulous treasure
programme.desc: The life and work of Tutankhamon's ancestors, Queen Hatchepsout, the sublime Nefertiti or Akhenaton, some of the most fascinating characters of all antiquity.
programme.desc-more: On 26 November 1922, near Luxor, Egyptologist Howard Carter discovered Tutankhamon's grave, one of the last descendants of a family that had led Egypt for eight generations. Under the aegis of this eighteenth dynasty, the Egyptian kingdom became the richest and most powerful in the world. This series is interested in the life and work of Tutankhamon's ancestors, Queen Hatchepsout, the sublime Nefertiti, and the enigmatic Akhenaton, some of the most fascinating characters of all antiquity.

This series is interested in the life and work of Tutankhamon's ancestors, Queen Hatchepsout, the sublime Nefertiti, and the enigmatic Akhenaton, some of the most fascinating characters of all antiquity.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In September 1998, Michèle Gillet was found dead on the terrace of her house. The investigators quickly identified the ideal culprit: a certain Pascal Labarre, a painter in building. The young man is sentenced to 20 years in prison. In 2003, after a reverse, twisted investigation, he was acquitted.
programme.desc-more: On 1 September 1998, the 46-year-old Michèle Gillet's body was discovered on the terrace of his house in Isle, a small town in Dordogne. His skull is broken and his neck bears a strangulation mark. Next to the corpse, a bucket is filled with blood. The investigations focus on the victim's entourage, and in particular Pascal Labarre, a 33-year-old building painter. Placed in custody in January 1999, he confesses to be Michèle's lover that he killed in an act of madness. He was incarcerated and then declared his innocence.

programme.desc: In 2021, in the Nièce de Marie-France Pisier, Camille Kouchner accused his father-in-law of having raped his brother. In 2011 Marie-France Pisier died in unclear conditions.
programme.desc-more: Daughter of the politician Bernard Kouchner and niece of actress Marie-France Pisier, Camille Kouchner published in 2021 "La Familia Grande". She accuses her father-in-law, political scientist Olivier Duhamel, of sexually assaulting her twin brother, Victor, who was then a teenager. This revelation causes a real earthquake in the media world. A few years earlier, Marie-France Pisier, despite all the obstacles, tried to denounce these facts. She was found dead in her pool in 2011 in unclear conditions.

programme.title: Nausicaá, the aquarium of all challenges
programme.desc: In Nausicaá, Europe's largest aquarium, women and men are working to support a fragile ecosystem and care for over 58 000 marine animals.
programme.desc-more: In Boulogne-sur-Mer, facing the English Channel, Nausicaá is the largest aquarium in Europe. Its 20-metre-long, five-metre-high bay window offers a stunning view of a reconstituted ocean. But behind this prowess of engineering, women and men are working tirelessly to support this fragile ecosystem and to care for more than 58,000 marine animals. Along with technical teams, caretakers and veterinarians, discover the behind the scenes of this giant of the seas, where every technological challenge is put at the service of a single ambition: to discover the oceans to better protect them.

programme.title: The strength of the oceans
programme.desc: Experts are tracking hurricanes threatening the West Indies. Their aim is to better predict these severe cyclones intensified by global warming.
programme.desc-more: Every year, the French Antilles fear the arrival of devastating cyclones. Faced with these phenomena, many specialists are mobilizing. Pilots crossing the eye of the cyclone to the drone-equipped oceanographers, all track these storms to Miami. Their aim is to anticipate precisely the place and strength of the impact, a crucial challenge because the climate is warming.

programme.desc: Under its quiet air, the Manche hides a superpowering marine mechanics. Giant tides, strong currents and formidable storms shape the landscape.

programme.title: Bonifacio Falaise: Inevitable Erosion?
programme.desc: In Bonifacio, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of the erosion phenomenon that weakens the cliffs and anticipate the next collapses.
programme.desc-more: Perched on its limestone cliffs more than 80 meters above the Mediterranean, Bonifacio has been fascinated since the 12th century. Behind this picture of postcard is a real threat. The cliffs, subjected to the constant assaults of the sea and weakened by rainwater infiltrations, are gradually eroding. In 2022, the danger rose by a step: several houses were targeted by prefectural orders because of the risk of collapse. On the spot, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of this phenomenon and to anticipate future collapses. Through their research, the city, originally conceived as a stunning fortress, reveals its extreme fragility. How far could erosion endanger Bonifacio's future?

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: Castles, villages, opera or lighthouses, there are places in France that seem to be cursed. Popular beliefs or legends, coincidences or scientific puzzles?
programme.desc-more: The bad spell seems to be hounding at some places in France. In Tévennec, Brittany, for example, a lighthouse would have been the scene of sordid events, while in the Black Perigord, a troglodytic house would have been haunted by a machiavelic and bloody character who had lived there in the past. In the Cevennes, an area, "the triangle of the Burle", holds the French record of air disasters. programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: Danny and Martin escort a political prisoner, witness in a crucial case. But they're ambushing and Martin's injured in the shooting.
programme.desc-more: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.

programme.title: 2012: Ice Age
programme.desc: A volcanic eruption in Iceland threatens North America with a new ice age. The Hart family is fighting to escape this terrible threat.
programme.desc-more: In Iceland, a cataclysmic volcanic eruption triggers a series of events threatening humanity. A thick cloud of ashes extends across the globe, causing radical climate change and plunges North America and the rest of the world into a new ice age. The fall of temperatures is brutal, transforming familiar landscapes into an ice desert. In this apocalyptic context, the Hart family finds itself at the heart of chaos, struggling for their survival in the face of extreme conditions and invisible threats. Meanwhile, a team of scientists, determined to reverse the course of events, is mobilizing to find a solution to this unprecedented climate crisis. As time is running out and the extinction of humanity seems imminent, Harts and scientists must join forces to face the ice storm that threatens to swallow everything.

programme.title: Hostage Game
programme.desc: An ex-Navy finds himself in the heart of a hostage-taking with his daughter and stepfather. Despite his post-traumatic disorders, he must protect them.
programme.desc-more: In a world of ubiquitous tension, Hostage Game plunges spectators into the troubled universe of Kyle Snowden (Tyrese Gibson), a former navy whose traumas of the past haunt him. As he tries to rebuild his life after a difficult separation with his wife, he finds himself taking over the custody of his young daughter, Angel. Their daily lives take a dramatic turn when they find themselves held hostage in a grocery store, alongside Sam (John Malkovich), Kyle's stepfather and an influential member of Congress. Their abductor, driven by a desire for revenge, targets Sam for personal reasons, holding him responsible for the arrest of his father, currently incarcerated. In this crisis situation, Kyle must draw on his military skills and protective instincts to save his daughter and face his inner demons. As hours pass, tensions intensify, and every decision could have fatal consequences. Between the struggle for survival and that of his family, Kyle must navigate through a real game of cat and mouse, where the slightest false step could be tragic. The outcome of this confrontation will depend not only on his physical abilities, but also on his emotional resilience to a ruthless opponent.

programme.title: Bonifacio Falaise: Inevitable Erosion?
programme.desc: Perched on its limestone cliffs more than 80 meters above the Mediterranean, Bonifacio has been fascinated since the 12th century. Behind this picture of postcard is a real threat. The cliffs, subjected to the constant assaults of the sea and weakened by rainwater infiltrations, are gradually eroding. In 2022, the danger rose by a step: several houses were targeted by prefectural orders because of the risk of collapse. On the spot, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of this phenomenon and to anticipate future collapses. Through their research, the city, originally conceived as a stunning fortress, reveals its extreme fragility. How far could erosion endanger Bonifacio's future?

programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: 2012: Ice Age
programme.desc: In Iceland, a cataclysmic volcanic eruption triggers a series of events threatening humanity. A thick cloud of ashes extends across the globe, causing radical climate change and plunges North America and the rest of the world into a new ice age. The fall of temperatures is brutal, transforming familiar landscapes into an ice desert. In this apocalyptic context, the Hart family finds itself at the heart of chaos, struggling for their survival in the face of extreme conditions and invisible threats. Meanwhile, a team of scientists, determined to reverse the course of events, is mobilizing to find a solution to this unprecedented climate crisis. As time is running out and the extinction of humanity seems imminent, Harts and scientists must join forces to face the ice storm that threatens to swallow everything.

programme.title: Hostage Game
programme.desc: In a world of ubiquitous tension, Hostage Game plunges spectators into the troubled universe of Kyle Snowden (Tyrese Gibson), a former navy whose traumas of the past haunt him. As he tries to rebuild his life after a difficult separation with his wife, he finds himself taking over the custody of his young daughter, Angel. Their daily lives take a dramatic turn when they find themselves held hostage in a grocery store, alongside Sam (John Malkovich), Kyle's stepfather and an influential member of Congress. Their abductor, driven by a desire for revenge, targets Sam for personal reasons, holding him responsible for the arrest of his father, currently incarcerated. In this crisis situation, Kyle must draw on his military skills and protective instincts to save his daughter and face his inner demons. As hours pass, tensions intensify, and every decision could have fatal consequences. Between the struggle for survival and that of his family, Kyle must navigate through a real game of cat and mouse, where the slightest false step could be tragic. The outcome of this confrontation will depend not only on his physical abilities, but also on his emotional resilience to a ruthless opponent.

programme.desc: Anne breaks up with Jack while Danny starts an affair with Elena. It was then that the former husband of the latter, Carlos Aguilar, began to make talk about him. In this season, it's Jack's turn to be investigated, after being abducted by a psychopath who does not hesitate to torture him. The writers give a real thickness to the character of Elena, whose daily life becomes a hell.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: Anne breaks up with Jack while Danny starts an affair with Elena. It was then that the former husband of the latter, Carlos Aguilar, began to make talk about him. He is willing to do anything to get custody of their daughter, including taking the child away. In this season, it's Jack's turn to be investigated, after being abducted by a psychopath who does not hesitate to torture him. While the team is overwhelmed, especially because of a man who turns out to be a real serial kidnapper, Carlos is redoing his own and threatening the very life of his ex-wife. The writers give a real thickness to the character of Elena, whose daily life becomes a hell.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Eyjafjallajökull
programme.desc: Valérie and Alain, a divorced couple who have not been able to get along for a long time, find themselves forced to join forces on a plane trip to Greece, where they must attend their daughter's wedding. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when the eruption of the Icelandic volcano Eyjafjallajökull causes a change of destination, forcing their flight to land thousands of kilometres from their original goal. Now stuck together, Valérie and Alain have to drive over 2,000 kilometres to reach the wedding venue. Their journey is expected to be tumultuous, marked by tensions and disputes, as they are confronted with their common past and their accumulated grudges. The road quickly becomes a real verbal battlefield, where insults and humiliations are coming along, revealing the still sharp wounds of their separation. Throughout this journey, the two former spouses will have to navigate through their confrontational emotions and discover whether, despite their differences, there is a glimmer of hope for reconciliation.

programme.title: Jean-Philippe
programme.desc: Fabrice (Fabrice Luchini), a disillusioned quadrennial, stifled in the dull decor of her pavilionary suburbs, between a wife whose routine has blunted dreams and a teenage girl in the midst of revolt. The only flash in his morose daily life is his unconditional adoration of Johnny Hallyday, a timeless icon whose tubes are rhythmic and soften his disillusionment. Posters, records and loop concerts are his last escape, his only reason to get up every morning. But when a watered evening turns into a nightmare after a neighbor overtakes the assemblé to silence him, Fabrice wakes up in a parallel world where his idol never existed. More than I love you, more than L'Envie, nothing. Just a sidereal void, a rewritten popular culture, and an obsessive question: how to live when what made you vibrate disappeared? Decided to restore the order of things, Fabrice embarked on a quest as crazy as it was impossible: to find Jean-Philippe Smet, the man who should have become Johnny, and make him the legend he deserved. But the reality is cruel: the real Smet is only a modest bowling manager, far from the spotlights and crowds of them. Worse, he seems to be content with this unglorious existence, indifferent to the destiny of glory that Fabrice destines him. Between scepticism and polite amusingness, Jean-Philippe resists the grandiose plans of his most determined " fan". Yet, despite the failures, the doors closing and the unbelieving gaze, Fabrice persists, convinced that Smet's raw talent only demands to explode.

programme.title: The Oceans Force
programme.desc: Currents, giant waves, cyclones, underwater volcanoes: thanks to 3D reconstructions and images generated by IA, this series reveals the colossal forces that animate the French seas. She goes to meet scientists and sailors who try to understand them and to understand them.

programme.title: Bonifacio Falaise: Inevitable Erosion?
programme.desc: Perched on its limestone cliffs more than 80 meters above the Mediterranean, Bonifacio has been fascinated since the 12th century. Behind this picture of postcard is a real threat. The cliffs, subjected to the constant assaults of the sea and weakened by rainwater infiltrations, are gradually eroding. In 2022, the danger rose by a step: several houses were targeted by prefectural orders because of the risk of collapse. On the spot, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of this phenomenon and to anticipate future collapses. Through their research, the city, originally conceived as a stunning fortress, reveals its extreme fragility. How far could erosion endanger Bonifacio's future?

programme.title: Cherbourg: The submarine factory
programme.desc: The Redoutable, the first French nuclear submarine. It is the starting point for an unusual industrial and geopolitical adventure: that of the Cherbourg arsenal. Through unpublished archives and testimonies of workers, engineers and sailors of the time, exploration behind the scenes of a top secret construction site, emblematic of the French nuclear power. Beyond the technological feat, the Cherbourg naval base also has a social history, that of a territory shaped by the defence industry, between worker pride, collective memory and contemporary issues.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
