programme.title: 2012: Ice Age
programme.desc: In Iceland, a cataclysmic volcanic eruption triggers a series of events threatening humanity. A thick cloud of ashes extends across the globe, causing radical climate change and plunges North America and the rest of the world into a new ice age. The fall of temperatures is brutal, transforming familiar landscapes into an ice desert. In this apocalyptic context, the Hart family finds itself at the heart of chaos, struggling for their survival in the face of extreme conditions and invisible threats. Meanwhile, a team of scientists, determined to reverse the course of events, is mobilizing to find a solution to this unprecedented climate crisis. As time is running out and the extinction of humanity seems imminent, Harts and scientists must join forces to face the ice storm that threatens to swallow everything.

programme.title: New York, Criminal Section
programme.desc: In this fifth season of "New York, Criminal Section", Inspectors Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio) and Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe) welcome two new officers, Veteran Mike Logan (Chris Not) and Inspector Carolyn Barek (Annabella Sciorra). Although the two investigators' duos never cross, each one is confronted with complex and intriguing cases. Goren and Eames find themselves facing a grieving patriarch (Malcolm McDowell), whose grief hides dark secrets, while Logan and Barek have to navigate the tumults of a charismatic adoptive mother (Whoopi Goldberg), whose protégés seem to have drifted to crime. This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.
programme.desc-more: New York City, Criminal Section is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the US judicial system, highlighting a team of elite investigators from the New York Criminal Police. In this vibrant and life-filled metropolis, violent crimes often leave no room for error, and it is the responsibility of these investigators to resolve the darkest cases. Their mission: to track down murderers by looking not only at physical evidence, but also at the psychological distress that drives an individual to commit such atrocities. Each episode follows the investigators, led by Detective Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio). Accompanied by her partner, Detective Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe), this dynamic duo explores the meandering of the criminal mind, relying on innovative psychological methods to apprehend suspects. The episodes often highlight disturbing records, where each murder tells a different story, revealing the motivations and traumas behind the crime. However, at the dawn of every new investigation, investigators must navigate through a network of lies, secrets and manipulation, each case testing not only their professional skills, but also their moral values.

programme.title: Little secrets between neighbours
programme.desc: Each episode tells an incredible story of neighbours: neighbourhood conflicts, forbidden love, secrets, jealousies... We frequent them every day. We exchange with them polishes in the building yard or over the hedge. We can imagine their intimacy by looking at them out the window. The lives of our neighbors seem perfectly normal... But appearances are deceptive and behind their walls, often hide incredible stories... And you, do you really know your neighbors?

programme.title: The Hobbit: an unexpected journey
programme.desc: A Hobbit, a magician and thirteen dwarfs embark on a great expedition to recover a treasure guarded by a dragon in the heart of a mountain.
programme.desc-more: In the green hills of the County, where life is flowing peacefully at the rhythm of hearty meals and smoking pipes, Bilbon Sacquet (Martin Freeman) runs for quiet days away from the tumults of the outside world. This discreet and casanial hobby, attaching to his love of simple little things, still ignores that his destiny will change the day an unexpected visitor knocks at his door. Gandalf the Grey, a magician as mysterious as unpredictable, offers Bilbon an adventure that will take him far beyond the boundaries of his comfortable burrow. Without really understanding how, Bilbon found himself in a perilous quest alongside thirteen dwarfs led by the charismatic and determined Thorin Écu-de-Chêne. Their goal? Recapture the lost kingdom of Yerebor, once prosperous, but today under the control of the dragon Smaugh, a creature as fearsome as it is greedy. For these dwarves, this expedition is much more than just a quest for treasures: it is a matter of honour, revenge and restoration of their lineage. But the road to the Solitary Mountain is sore. Between the wild land of Middle Earth, populated by trolls, d'orques and much older creatures, and the insidious dangers of fragile alliances, each stage puts to the test the courage and trick of Bilbon. Despite his initial reluctance, he discovered unsuspecting resources in him, while learning to navigate in a world where magic, betrayals and epic battles shaped the destiny of peoples.

programme.title: - I'm going to get out of here immediately.
programme.desc: José Fernandez (Ary Abittan), an air and border police officer, spent most of his life managing the transfer of undocumented people to their countries of origin. He works closely with his partner, Guy Berthier (Cyril Lecomte), an impenitent seducer capable of turning every moment into an opportunity to flirt. The rare moments when José is not in transit, his personal life is marked by increasing tensions with his wife, Maria, whose jealousy is exacerbated threatens to separate them. She wishes to keep her away from her son-in-law, who admires José deeply. As their relationship fluctuates, an unexpected turn turns out to him when his superior offers him a final crucial transfer before his future mutation. This mission will confront him with heartbreaking choices, questioning not only his professional commitment, but also his personal values and family relations. José will have to navigate between his duties as a police officer and his role as a father, in a context where every decision counts.

programme.title: Wasabi
programme.desc: Hubert Fiévet (Jean Reno) plays a separate cop. Solitaire, full of stuff, but endowed with a large heart under his appearance as a brute, he does not hesitate to use speedy methods to bring order to rule. Yet his explosive temperament played him a bad turn when, after having corrected the prefect's son a little too vigorously, he found himself forced to take a forced vacation. A punishment that falls badly for this policeman who is used to action and allergic to inaction. As he gets ready to rub his boredom in a Parisian apartment, a phone call will change everything. A notary informs about news as unexpected as it is upsetting: Miko, the woman he loved passionately twenty years earlier before she mysteriously disappeared, has just died in Japan in troubled circumstances. Named as the only heir, Hubert had no choice but to jump into the first plane to Tokyo, determined to understand what could have happened to the love of his youth. On the spot, he was welcomed by his former team-mate Maurice, now settled in the land of the rising sun. But what he discovers is beyond what he could have imagined.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who made his daughter laugh
programme.desc: "He who made his daughter laugh" By singing a song to his daughter, Ross discovers that he can make her laugh, but also that he can sleep on her: he dares not tell Rachel about it.
programme.desc-more: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

programme.title: Little secrets between neighbours
programme.desc: Each episode tells an incredible story of neighbours: neighbourhood conflicts, forbidden love, secrets, jealousies... We meet them every day. But appearances are deceptive and behind their walls, often hide incredible stories... And you, do you really know your neighbors?

programme.title: The Magi Kings
programme.desc: In the ancient East, under a shooting star announcing the birth of a king, three wise and venerable men, Melchior (Didier Bourdon), Gaspard (Pascal Légitimes) and Balthazar (Didier Bourdon), traveled through the deserts and mountains to Bethlehem. With gold, incense and myrrh, these Magi kings, as determined as they are naive, follow the heavenly light with unwavering faith. Their mission is clear: to pay homage to the Child Jesus, whose coming must change the course of history. But as they prepare to accomplish their destiny, a strange and inexplicable phenomenon propels them through the centuries, catapulting them into a world they cannot understand. When they open their eyes, it is in the Paris of the 21st century that they find themselves, in the midst of horns, neon and an indifferent crowd in a hurry to go about its occupations. Disoriented, but always driven by their sacred quest, the three men try to adapt to this modern world where no one believes in their history. Their eccentric appearance, their old-fashioned outfits and their mysterious discourses on a star and a divine newborn are worth being taken for marginals, even illuminated ones. Yet, despite the mockery and general misunderstoodness, Melchior, Gaspard and Balthazar refused to give up. They are convinced that the Child Jesus is hiding somewhere in this tentacular city, and they intend to find him.

programme.title: The Hobbit: Smaug's Desolation
programme.desc: Bilbon Sacquet (Martin Freeman), the discreet but courageous hobby, continues his perilous quest alongside Thorin Écu-de-Chêne (Richard Armitage) and his company of Dwarfs determined to take over their lost kingdom, Erebor, from the claws of the dragon Smaugh. Their journey leads them through hostile lands, where every forest, river and mountain contains deadly dangers, but also unexpected allies. After having barely escaped the trolls of the mountains, the group sinks into the dark depths of the Mirkwood Forest, a cursed place where black magic corrupted until the sunlight. Trees similar to spectra, deceptive illusions and creatures tamped in the shadows transform this crossing into a test of endurance and trickiness. Yet, this is just a taste of the horrors that await them: giant spiders, thirsty with flesh, stretch their mortal webs, while the Elves of the Black Forest, led by Prince Legolas (Orlando Bloom) and Captain Tauriel (Evangeline Lilly), capture them, taking them as intruders. If Legolas, guided by a mixture of mistrust and curiosity, hesitates to let them go, Tauriel, whose sense of justice transcends the borders of his people, sees in them a glimmer of hope in a world that is becoming increasingly darker. Freed from a daring escape, Bilbon and the Dwarfs find themselves propelled towards the shores of Lake Town, a prosperous human city built on stilts, where the reception is as uncertain as the deep waters surrounding it. Meanwhile, a much greater threat is emerging: Smaught (voice of Benedict Cumberbatch), the golden dragon with piercing eyes and implacable trick, watches over his treasure in the bowels of the Solitary Mountain, still unaware that intruders dare to defy his reign.

programme.title: Team explores
programme.desc: Revealed to Valenciennes, then to FC Bruges, Jean-Pierre Papin and one of the most emblematic French attackers of the 80s-90s.
programme.desc-more: In high-level sport, sharing the same name, and the same sport, does not always guarantee perfect harmony. Behind the stories of family success are also rivalries or jealousies. This documentary explores the sometimes complex relationships between brothers and sisters at the highest level. Figures that have become famous in the sports world, such as the Félix brothers and Alexis Lebrun, table tennis champions, and the Tony brothers and Patrice Estanguet in canoeing, as well as the Perchist champion Renaud Lavillenie and his brother Valentin, who shines in the same discipline.

programme.title: Two superflics
programme.desc: In Miami, Matt (Terence Hill) and Wilbur (Bud Spencer), two small crooks seeking recognition, try to enter the world of crime by being hired by a local malfrat. However, their ambition quickly led to a fight that eventually united them as friends and accomplices. Hoping to make a name, they decide to make a hold-up. However, Wilbur's unsightlyness creates a series of nasty and unforeseen situations that complicate their plan. To the surprise of the two men, they found themselves forcibly enlisted in a police training course, where they learned the basics of the profession, but in their unconventional way. Matt and Wilbur were eventually sent to the field, becoming police officers for the least atypical. During their mission, they met Susy Lee (Laura Gemser), an Asian young woman whose brother had recently been murdered. Motivated by a mixture of curiosity and desire to do justice, the two friends will try to solve this mysterious murder while navigating through the mess of the criminal world and the absurdities of their new existence as police officers.

programme.title: The Rookie: Los Angeles Cop
programme.desc: After the Armstrong case broke, John Nolan was blamed and his training period extended for a month. This sanction is accompanied by a visit to a disciplinary commission and may well ruin his chances of becoming an inspector or joining a specialized unit. Promote investigator, Lopez prefers to keep her pregnancy quiet, fearing that she will be treated differently if she knows. Shortened by the pandemic, this third season is the shortest of the series with only 14 episodes.
programme.desc-more: Recently divorced and faced with a major turning point in his life, John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), a man aged 40 years, finds himself somewhat lost after his son left for university. On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: After Julie's death, Charles was looking for a home for the three orphans. Unfortunately, he can't put them together...
programme.desc-more: In the small town of Walnut Grove, Julie Sanderson's tragic death left a void in the community and especially in the heart of Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon). Shortly after the funeral, Charles was approached by potential adoptive parents, who wished to welcome John, Carl and Alicia, three orphaned young people who lived temporarily with Grace (Charlotte Stewart) and Mr. Edwards (Karl Swenson). In the face of this delicate situation, Charles must navigate between his own emotions of loss and the responsibility to find a loving home for these children in search of stability. Tensions are rising as the candidates for adoption are examined, each with its own motivations. Meanwhile, children, lost and disembodied, have to face their new reality, learning to open up to the idea of a new family. This touching narrative addresses themes of mourning, hope and the power of family ties, even in the darkest moments.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: The Ingalls are happy to leave Walnut Grove for a trip, until the Oleson family joins them...
programme.desc-more: Miss Beadle's students, who are passionate about nature, are responsible for a school project on different types of foliage. Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson) and her sister Laura (Melissa Gilbert), eager to learn, rejoice at the idea of going camping with family to explore the surrounding flora. With the help of their parents, Charles (Michael Landon) and Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), they prepare their excursion, eager to discover the beauty of the Midwest landscapes. The Oleson, the family often disagreed with the Ingalls, decided to join this adventure, bringing a particular dynamic to this journey. As they explore, tensions between the two families are revealed, but also unexpected moments of comradeship. This excursion is transformed into a real life lesson, where children learn not only about nature, but also about the importance of friendship and solidarity in the face of the challenges of everyday life.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: The whole village is celebrating the inauguration of the new church. Caroline, injured, prefers to stay home to make pies.
programme.desc-more: In the small village of Walnut Grove, the atmosphere is at the feast as the inhabitants prepare to celebrate the inauguration of the new church, symbol of unity and renewal. However, Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), injured in the leg, decided not to join the festivities and preferred to stay alone at home. Over the hours, the pain she feels becomes more intense, plunged into a state of vulnerability. While her children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), as well as their father Charles (Michael Landon), are involved in the preparations for the celebration, Caroline struggles against her dark thoughts and isolation. His memories and reflections on family life, love and faith are beginning to emerge, illustrating the emotional challenges of physical suffering. This moment of personal crisis becomes a revealing ordeal, both for her and for those around her.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In order to buy a gift from Reverend Alden, Laura and Mary invest the school's funds in products they hope to sell.
programme.desc-more: As the birthday of Reverend Alden (Richard Bull) approaches, the children of Walnut Grove's catechism are mobilizing to offer him a special gift: a new Bible. Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), who was named treasurer of the group, was given the responsibility of buying this symbolic object. However, as she begins to raise the funds, she realizes with despair that the amount raised is largely insufficient to cover the cost of the gift. In search of solutions, Mary received advice from her sister Laura (Melissa Gilbert), who suggested a bold idea: using school funds, originally intended for the purchase of medicines, to finance the purchase of the Bible. This decision, though intentional, raises moral dilemmas and tensions within the community. Mary will have to navigate between her good intentions and the unforeseen consequences of her choice, while preserving the spirit of solidarity that unites the inhabitants of Walnut Grove.

118 stakeholders are called upon to intervene in a research laboratory that has been burned and presents a biological risk.
programme.desc-more: Members of the Los Angeles Emergency Response Unit 118 are confronted with chaotic situations and scenarios worthy of action films. This season begins with an unusual incident: a traffic accident results in the release of millions of bees, immerse the city in a real frenzy. Firefighters, first aid workers and other stakeholders must demonstrate cold blood and expertise to deal with this environmental disaster while ensuring the safety of citizens. At the heart of this dynamic, the team must also learn to navigate the organizational transition following the retirement of Captain Bobby Nash. This change brought the new captain, Gerrard, to the fore, whose tyrannical leadership style tested the cohesion and team spirit of the unit 118. Tensions are rising as each member adapts to this new hierarchy while continuing to carry out their crucial work. In parallel to these professional challenges, Bobby finds himself juggling his real responsibilities with his role as technical advisor on the stage of the drama series "Hotshots". This series, which offers a fictional look at the challenges of everyday life in a fire station, will highlight the realities of emergency response.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: McGarrett and the 5-0 agents are captured on Lanai Island and face a certain death as they track a dangerous enemy.
programme.desc-more: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: By working on the murder of one of the last survivors of the USS Arizona, McGarrett learns about the important role his grandfather played in Pearl Harbor.
programme.desc-more: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.

programme.title: A Christmas in Scotland
programme.desc: A young woman goes to Scotland to look for an old sanctuary which she hopes will revive her department in the university where she teaches.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the Scottish Highlands, where snowy landscapes and Celtic legends blend under a winter sky, Lucy, a passionate but difficult archaeology professor, arrives with a crucial mission. Threatened to lose her post at the university, she must definitely find the ruins of a sanctuary dedicated to Beira, the mythical queen of winter, whose discovery could save her career. Her investigation leads her to an isolated manor, as majestic as it is enigmatic, held with an iron hand by Edina McAvoy, a woman of a well-dimmed character, convinced that the place is haunted by the ghost of her late husband. Between strange noises, slamming doors and painful memories, the atmosphere is charged with a mysterious melancholy, as if the past refused to erase. To explore the archaeological sites scattered throughout the region, Lucy turns to Duncan, the son of Edina, a charismatic but tormented man. Owner of a difficult whisky distillery, he gave up his dreams to take over the family business, but struggled to find a balance between tradition and modernity. Despite his initial reluctance, he agreed to guide Lucy through the icy moors and ancestral forests, where each stone could give a clue about the lost sanctuary. Between improvised excavations, evenings at the corner of the fire and shared confidences, an unexpected complicity arises between them, shaking their certainty. Yet their quest is confronted with unforeseen obstacles: hostile weather conditions, local rumours about a curse linked to Beira, and above all, the family tensions that are re-emerging. Edina, distrustful of this stranger who interferes in their lives, sees this collaboration with a bad eye. And when Lucy discovers that the sanctuary could be linked to a legend far darker than expected, she realizes that her research is putting in jeopardy much more than her career. Between ancient mysteries, emerging passions and heartbreaking choices, this Christmas in Scotland could well become the most unforgettable of their lives... But at what cost? In this enchanting winter tale, where history and present intertwine, a question persists: will they manage to reconcile their dreams with the ghosts of the past?

118 is involved in a festival on the Renaissance, then in offices where a boss was poisoned. Chimney and Maddy are looking for a new home.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

programme.title: A family for rent
programme.desc: A man who is introverted and lonely but easy offers a young single mother in need to rent her family against the redemption of her debts.
programme.desc-more: In a bitter-sweet comedy, the universe of "A family for rent" presents Paul-André (Benoît Poelvoorde), a man of forty years old, both rich and desperately alone. Although fortunate, he has a deep boredom and lack of human connection in his life. It is then that he comes to realize that what he really misses is a family, a real one, that would bring meaning to his monotonous existence. On the other hand, Violette (Virginie Efira), a four-year-old mother, finds herself in an inextricable situation: threatened with expulsion and desperate, she fears losing custody of her two children, which exacerbates her vulnerability. In this context, Paul-André and Violette will cross their paths unexpectedly. In search of a solution to find a semblance of normality, they engage in a singular pact: Paul-André will "love" a family to discover the affection and responsibilities to which he aspires, while Violette finds in him valuable support to overcome his trials. However, their arrangement, although initially pragmatic, slowly transforms into an emotional journey where laughter and tears, friendship and disillusionment mix. As their lives interlace, each of them will have to face his own demons while rediscovering what truly means to love and be loved.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: In the fifth century, King Arthur reigned over Kaamelott and actively sought the Grail. But his divine quest is slowed down by the incompetence of his knights.
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: A treasure in your home
programme.desc: What if a treasure hides in your attic? In each episode, a private individual opens his or her doors, convinced to own a nugget: rare stamps, family jewels, old vase or forgotten old instrument. programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: The Ingalls are happy to leave Walnut Grove for a trip, until the Oleson family joins them...
programme.desc-more: Miss Beadle's students, who are passionate about nature, are responsible for a school project on different types of foliage. Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson) and her sister Laura (Melissa Gilbert), eager to learn, rejoice at the idea of going camping with family to explore the surrounding flora. With the help of their parents, Charles (Michael Landon) and Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), they prepare their excursion, eager to discover the beauty of the Midwest landscapes. The Oleson, the family often disagreed with the Ingalls, decided to join this adventure, bringing a particular dynamic to this journey. As they explore, tensions between the two families are revealed, but also unexpected moments of comradeship. This excursion is transformed into a real life lesson, where children learn not only about nature, but also about the importance of friendship and solidarity in the face of the challenges of everyday life.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: The whole village is celebrating the inauguration of the new church. Caroline, injured, prefers to stay home to make pies.
programme.desc-more: In the small village of Walnut Grove, the atmosphere is at the feast as the inhabitants prepare to celebrate the inauguration of the new church, symbol of unity and renewal. However, Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle), injured in the leg, decided not to join the festivities and preferred to stay alone at home. Over the hours, the pain she feels becomes more intense, plunged into a state of vulnerability. While her children, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), as well as their father Charles (Michael Landon), are involved in the preparations for the celebration, Caroline struggles against her dark thoughts and isolation. His memories and reflections on family life, love and faith are beginning to emerge, illustrating the emotional challenges of physical suffering. This moment of personal crisis becomes a revealing ordeal, both for her and for those around her.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In order to buy a gift from Reverend Alden, Laura and Mary invest the school's funds in products they hope to sell.
programme.desc-more: As the birthday of Reverend Alden (Richard Bull) approaches, the children of Walnut Grove's catechism are mobilizing to offer him a special gift: a new Bible. Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), who was named treasurer of the group, was given the responsibility of buying this symbolic object. However, as she begins to raise the funds, she realizes with despair that the amount raised is largely insufficient to cover the cost of the gift. In search of solutions, Mary received advice from her sister Laura (Melissa Gilbert), who suggested a bold idea: using school funds, originally intended for the purchase of medicines, to finance the purchase of the Bible. This decision, though intentional, raises moral dilemmas and tensions within the community. Mary will have to navigate between her good intentions and the unforeseen consequences of her choice, while preserving the spirit of solidarity that unites the inhabitants of Walnut Grove.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Since his marriage to widow Snider, Isaiah Edwards has been happy and constantly seeking to please his wife and John Jr, his adopted son.
programme.desc-more: Isaiah and Grace Edwards are happy to welcome their new adoptive family life, hoping to build strong ties with their children. However, tensions arose between Isaiah and his adopted son, John, a brilliant but unsophisticated young boy. While Isaiah, a seasoned farmer, tries to pass on his agricultural know-how to John, he realizes that their visions of life are in disagreement. Isaiah's passion for hunting and farm work is not unheeded by John, who prefers to dive into his books. To celebrate John's birthday, Isaiah decided to offer a rifle, thinking that this gesture could create a link between them. However, this unexpected gift raises questions about each other's expectations and dreams, highlighting the challenges of a family seeking harmony. The search for mutual understanding is transformed into a journey of moving and rich in teachings.

After Bobby's death, LAFD and LAPD bear the burden of mourning. Back in Los Angeles Eddie feels guilty for not being there.
programme.desc-more: Members of the Los Angeles Emergency Response Unit 118 are confronted with chaotic situations and scenarios worthy of action films. This season begins with an unusual incident: a traffic accident results in the release of millions of bees, immerse the city in a real frenzy. Firefighters, first aid workers and other stakeholders must demonstrate cold blood and expertise to deal with this environmental disaster while ensuring the safety of citizens. At the heart of this dynamic, the team must also learn to navigate the organizational transition following the retirement of Captain Bobby Nash. This change brought the new captain, Gerrard, to the fore, whose tyrannical leadership style tested the cohesion and team spirit of the unit 118. Tensions are rising as each member adapts to this new hierarchy while continuing to carry out their crucial work. In parallel to these professional challenges, Bobby finds himself juggling his real responsibilities with his role as technical advisor on the stage of the drama series "Hotshots". This series, which offers a fictional look at the challenges of everyday life in a fire station, will highlight the realities of emergency response.

programme.sub-title: The Marvelous World of the Rich
programme.desc: The 118 team will honor Bobby Nash's sacrifice by dedicating the barracks to him. The team must go into intervention to save a billionaire whose life is in danger.
programme.desc-more: After Bobby's death, barracks 118 must be rebuilt. Athena is conducting a dangerous investigation into a criminal network that fails to cost her life, before she is finally promoted to an inspector. She and Hen are also involved in a totally new mission in space. Buck, for his part, is looking for meaning in his life by taking under his wing the young Theo, while Eddie survives a stabbing attack and finds his son Christopher. Between mourning and renewal, the team is learning to be a reality.

As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Isaiah and Grace Edwards are happy to welcome their new adoptive family life, hoping to build strong ties with their children. However, tensions arose between Isaiah and his adopted son, John, a brilliant but unsophisticated young boy. While Isaiah, a seasoned farmer, tries to pass on his agricultural know-how to John, he realizes that their visions of life are in disagreement. Isaiah's passion for hunting and farm work is not unheeded by John, who prefers to dive into his books. To celebrate John's birthday, Isaiah decided to offer a rifle, thinking that this gesture could create a link between them. However, this unexpected gift raises questions about each other's expectations and dreams, highlighting the challenges of a family seeking harmony. The search for mutual understanding is transformed into a journey of moving and rich in teachings.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In a small town in the Midwest, Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) lives a beautiful love story with Jason, a young dreamer with scientific aspirations. Together, they share moments of carelessness and wonder, but their relationship is quickly put to the test by the invasion of Nellie Oleson (Alison Arngrim), Laura's notorious rival. Always ready to sow the trouble, Nellie decides to use a machine to record the human voice that her mother just offered her. With Machiavellian skill, she spread Laura's declaration of love throughout the city, causing a real tumult. As Laura's peaceful life becomes a public spectacle, she must navigate between her feelings for Jason and the humiliations inflicted by Nellie. This whirlwind of emotions and rivalry highlights the themes of adolescent love, friendship and the consequences of acts, while at the same time providing a look at the dynamics of relationships in a welded community.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In the episode "The pride of the village", Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) prepares to accompany her daughter Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson) to a mathematics competition in Minneapolis, where Mary will have the honour of representing Walnut Grove. This opportunity is an opportunity for Mary to shine and prove her skills, but the pressure of competition is heavy on her shoulders. During their absence, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) found herself alone at home, responsible for taking care of her father Charles (Michael Landon) and her little sister Carrie (Sidney Greenbush). Laura must juggle family responsibilities with her own concerns, which turns out to be a real challenge. As Mary is a city star, Laura faces unexpected trials that test her courage and determination. This episode explores the themes of responsibility, ambition and family ties, while highlighting the dynamics between members of the Ingalls family.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Carl (Sidney Greenbush) are curious children, captivated by the fascinating stories of the trains they heard at school. Their adventurous minds prompted them to convince Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) and Mr. Edwards (Victor French) to take them on an excursion to the station, where they finally hoped to see these locomotives in action. Once there, the excitement rises as the children move away to play on a parked car, filled with carelessness and wonder. However, their joy quickly turns into terror when the car unwinds unexpectedly and begins to degrade the slope at full speed. As a train approaches at a high speed, Mary, Laura and Carl must show courage and ingenuity to try to control the situation and avoid a disaster. This unexpected journey testifies their friendship and sense of responsibility, transforming a dream day into a race against time.

After Bobby's death, barracks 118 must be rebuilt. Athena is conducting a dangerous investigation into a criminal network that fails to cost her life, before she is finally promoted to an inspector. She and Hen are also involved in a totally new mission in space. Buck, for his part, is looking for meaning in his life by taking under his wing the young Theo, while Eddie survives a stabbing attack and finds his son Christopher. Between mourning and renewal, the team is learning to be a reality.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: On the other side of the periph'
programme.desc: One morning, near an old underground tripot in the city of Bobigny, the tranquility is disturbed by the discovery of the lifeless body of Jean-Éric Chaligny's wife, known as the most influential boss in France. This tragedy quickly plunges the police into a complex investigation, where two actors of radically different backgrounds find themselves forced to collaborate. On the one hand, Ousmane Diakhité (Omar Sy), a police officer from the financial section based in Bobigny, who seeks the truth while navigating the meandering of local crime. On the other hand, François Monge (Laurent Lafitte), captain of the Paris criminal police, used to prestigious affairs in the capital. This heteroclite duo is embarking on an investigation that leads them from the dark-hearted suburbs of the Parisian employers' union. As they discover, they must overcome their prejudices and differences to solve this mystery that threatens to reveal hidden secrets on both sides of the device.

programme.title: The Rookie: Los Angeles Cop
programme.desc: After the Armstrong case broke, John Nolan was blamed and his training period extended for a month. This sanction is accompanied by a visit to a disciplinary commission and may well ruin his chances of becoming an inspector or joining a specialized unit. Promote investigator, Lopez prefers to keep her pregnancy quiet, fearing that she will be treated differently if she knows. Shortened by the pandemic, this third season is the shortest of the series with only 14 episodes.
programme.desc-more: Recently divorced and faced with a major turning point in his life, John Nolan (Nathan Fillion), a man aged 40 years, finds himself somewhat lost after his son left for university. On an ordinary day, he became a witness to a bank robbery where he barely escaped death. This traumatic event leads him to a profound introspection on his life choices and the path he wishes to take. Driven by a strong desire to change his life, John decided to leave his old life behind and settle in Los Angeles to fulfill his dream of becoming a policeman. As a new LAPD member, he must navigate in a complex environment where danger and stress are pervasive. At the earliest age of recruits, he found himself under the wing of Talia Bishop (Alyssa Diaz), his educational determination, who would have to help him overcome the specific challenges associated with his unique situation. Between training events, police intrigues and the need to prove its worth to younger colleagues, John Nolan will have to show courage and resilience while finding his place in a constantly changing world.

programme.title: Christmas Letters
programme.desc: Noah Harrington, a developer, is arriving in the small town of Oak Creek with the intention of replacing a post office abandoned by a modern office complex. His arrival is not seen with a very good eye. On the spot, he must work with Tessa, a city historian and protector, and try to find the right compromise. Noah and Tessa bring out old "Letters to Santa Claus" and soon they will come closer...

programme.title: Norbert, ex officio clerk
programme.sub-title: Céline, chicken sequestration / Anthony, mashed usurpation
programme.desc: Céline loves to mix sweet and salty for the greatest misfortune of her friends. His favorite recipe is chicken... with strawberry syrup! Anthony, for his part, is convinced to pay a fine tribute to his grandmother by making a family dish: the famous marguerite. But every time, he doesn't follow the recipe. Anthony mixes cold industrial mashed tuna with canned tuna and a mayonnaise jar. The whole is decorated with eggs. Chief Norbert Tarayre will teach them how to make dishes.

programme.title: The Tournesol case
programme.desc: Professor Tournesol, a leading scientist, has just developed a revolutionary invention: an ultrasonic weapon capable of destroying glass objects. Although initially conceived as a research project, this weapon has alarming destructive potential if it is perfected to target other materials. Only Professor Bretzel, his former colleague, has the knowledge to activate this machine. Tintin, accompanied by his faithful dog Milou, Captain Haddock and Professor Tournesol, set out to find Bretzel and warn him of the dangers of invention. However, they quickly discover that Bretzel was abducted by syldave agents. Shortly thereafter, Professor Tournesol's turn was to be kidnapped. Tintin and his friends then raced against the clock to find the missing scientists, thwart the malicious plans of the kidnappers and prevent this technology from falling into bad hands, while facing the obstacles that stand in their way.

programme.title: A treasure in your home
programme.desc: What if a treasure hides in your attic? In each episode, a private individual opens his or her doors, convinced to own a nugget: rare stamps, family jewels, old vase or forgotten old instrument. He entrusts us with the estimate he makes and what he dreams of accomplishing with that sum. Then visit a auctioneer, whose expert verdict sometimes contains cruel disillusionments... or beautiful surprises !!

In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Lara Croft : Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie), heiress of a colossal fortune and a line of fearless archaeologists, lives surrounded by priceless treasures, including a mysterious clock with unfathomable powers. This precious artifact, transmitted by his father, the famous archaeologist Lord Richard Croft (Jon Voight), contains a much greater secret than anything she could have imagined. Years earlier, his father had revealed to him the existence of the Illuminati, a secret and powerful organization, obsessed with the quest for this legendary clock. According to ancient accounts, this object would allow to control the gates of Time and Space, offering absolute power to the one who can use it. Lara discovers that, 5,000 years earlier, this clock had already played a decisive role in the victory of the first Illuminati over their enemies. But the mystery thickens when it learns that a rare astronomical phenomenon occurs every 5,000 years, aligning three planets to form a sacred triangle, making the clock operational. As the Illuminati, who are still active and more determined than ever, are approaching their goal, Lara is embarking on a frantic race across the globe. Between ancient ruins, mortal traps and ruthless enemies, it must decipher the riddles of the past to prevent this organization from achieving its dark purposes. With its sharp intelligence, legendary agility and boundless audacity, Lara Croft faces ever more perilous challenges. Each clue discovered brings it closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that threaten to rock everything.

programme.title: Magnitude 10.5: the apocalypse
programme.desc: In the United States, an unprecedented seismic cataclysm is being prepared when the brutal rapprochement of tectonic plates plunges the country into chaos. In a few hours, devastating earthquakes, tsunamis and floods ravage the coast, destroying entire cities and endangering the lives of millions of citizens. As the population is panicked, scientists, who had anticipated such a disaster in several millennia, find themselves deprived of the urgency of the situation. Seismologist Samantha Hill (Kim Delaney), accompanied by her father, is entrusted with the heavy task of finding a solution to save the country. In parallel, the president, incarnate by Beau Bridges, must navigate through political crises and decisions crucial to maintaining order and security. In this struggle against the clock, family ties and heartbreaking choices will be tested while the apocalypse threatens to take everything over.
programme.desc-more: Following a devastating earthquake that has already ravaged iconic cities such as Seattle, San Francisco and Los Angeles, the President of the United States is appealing to the contingency plan developed by Roy Nolan, an expert who died during the disaster. As the nation recovers from this tragedy, the situation becomes even more worrying when a former extinct volcano in Sun Valley, Idaho, begins an eruption. This natural phenomenon is accompanied by seismic tremors felt as far as Utah, triggering a wave of panic and uncertainty among the population. Infrastructure is beginning to yield: a highway is collapsing, and motorists are abandoning their vehicles, committing themselves to a desperate flight. As each minute becomes crucial, the protagonists face a chain disaster that threatens not only their survival, but also the future of several cities, while the hour is ticking and chaos is intensifying. In this apocalyptic context, courage and ingenuity will be tested.

programme.title: Magnitude 10.5: the apocalypse
programme.desc: In a climate of seismic tension, scientists detect the formation of a threatening geological fault in the Great Lakes region. This natural phenomenon, which is rapidly changing towards the Gulf of Mexico, could lead to a catastrophic split of the United States into two continents, with disastrous repercussions on the population and the environment. At the heart of this crisis, Samantha Hill (Kim Delaney), an expert in seismology, alerts President Hollister (Beau Bridges) about the imminent dangers, including the proximity of two of the country's largest nuclear reactors on the fault path. In response, the president ordered the evacuation of the entire West Coast, anticipating a devastating earthquake. Samantha proposes a radical solution: an underground atomic explosion, the last attempt to stem the chain of shaking. As panic sets in, time is running out and every decision could be fatal to millions of lives.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In the episode "The pride of the village", Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) prepares to accompany her daughter Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson) to a mathematics competition in Minneapolis, where Mary will have the honour of representing Walnut Grove. This opportunity is an opportunity for Mary to shine and prove her skills, but the pressure of competition is heavy on her shoulders. During their absence, Laura (Melissa Gilbert) found herself alone at home, responsible for taking care of her father Charles (Michael Landon) and her little sister Carrie (Sidney Greenbush). Laura must juggle family responsibilities with her own concerns, which turns out to be a real challenge. As Mary is a city star, Laura faces unexpected trials that test her courage and determination. This episode explores the themes of responsibility, ambition and family ties, while highlighting the dynamics between members of the Ingalls family.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Carl (Sidney Greenbush) are curious children, captivated by the fascinating stories of the trains they heard at school. Their adventurous minds prompted them to convince Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) and Mr. Edwards (Victor French) to take them on an excursion to the station, where they finally hoped to see these locomotives in action. Once there, the excitement rises as the children move away to play on a parked car, filled with carelessness and wonder. However, their joy quickly turns into terror when the car unwinds unexpectedly and begins to degrade the slope at full speed. As a train approaches at a high speed, Mary, Laura and Carl must show courage and ingenuity to try to control the situation and avoid a disaster. This unexpected journey testifies their friendship and sense of responsibility, transforming a dream day into a race against time.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: As the financial crisis is hitting the region hard, farmers face unprecedented challenges. Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) and his friend Mr. Edwards, aware of the seriousness of the situation, accept a dangerous job: to transport an explosive product that could change the deal for their families. To carry out this mission, they join forces with Hill and Murphy, two trusted men, but the road they have to take is stumbling blocks and dangers. The picturesque landscapes of the prairie hide unexpected threats, making their journey all the more distressing. At every turn, they must show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles ahead. At the same time, tensions are rising among farmers, as they struggle to preserve their land and dignity in the face of adversity. This journey becomes a real test of their determination and friendship.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In a small village in the Midwest, the atmosphere at school is upset by the arrival of a new master, Mr. Applewood, who replaces Miss Beadle, the beloved school mistress. This change is not well experienced by the students, especially Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert), who quickly finds himself in the teacher's viewfinder. Applewood seems to have a attachment to her, unjustly accusing her of all the incidents that occur in her class, creating an atmosphere of tension and misunderstanding. Laura, usually full of life and curiosity, feels persecuted and unjustly treated. Her friends, including Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson) and twins Carrie and Grace (Lindsay and Sidney Greenbush), are trying to support her, but the situation is becoming more and more complicated. As pressure rises, Laura must find a way to defend her honour and restore justice to her class, while learning valuable lessons about resilience and friendship.

After Bobby's death, barracks 118 must be rebuilt. Athena is conducting a dangerous investigation into a criminal network that fails to cost her life, before she is finally promoted to an inspector. She and Hen are also involved in a totally new mission in space. Buck, for his part, is looking for meaning in his life by taking under his wing the young Theo, while Eddie survives a stabbing attack and finds his son Christopher. Between mourning and renewal, the team is learning to be a reality.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Dream pools
programme.desc: In Sologne, the dream pools often take the form of lagoons, offering a natural and relaxing atmosphere. These pools are distinguished by their irregular shape, soft beaches and coatings that mimic sand or rocks, creating a haven of peace inspired by natural lagoons. The team will have to surpass itself in order to meet the client's expectations. Between small unforeseen events and the nature of the land this site is far from being restless.

programme.title: Dream pools
programme.sub-title: Spectacular lagoon renovation in the south
programme.desc: HGTV and Lanei Chapman travel the country to present some of the most unique, memorable and creative paradise gardens. Armed with a parasol, a glass and a towel Chapman visits breathtaking pools and gets advice to maintain a luxury oasis in his garden. This time, head to the southern United States to discover a spectacular pool that simulates a lagoon. For the coup the pond and its amenities need to be renovated. This is an opportunity for the team to make its ingenuity speak.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: For many French people who are thirsty for freedom and adventure, the nomadic journey is a dream solution. They therefore look at the latest trends in the sector. With a price of around €60,000 for a new vehicle, the happy owners of these equipped vans and other motorhomes give to heart joy in order to take full advantage of their investment. Sales exceeded 100,000 such vehicles in 2023 and 1.5 million French people threw themselves into the water. For smaller exchanges, the rental is also growing.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Zoom on Aurélie and Erwan who, for six months, have been travelling Europe in a motorhome with their children. After the south of the continent, they stop in Germany to attend their very first Grand Prix motorcycle with family. Marie and Jo, both in the city and on stage, have been travelling the roads of France for two years, between concerts and large spaces. Erwan and Aline, on the other hand, chose to leave 18 months around the world in a truck, with their daughter. Their adventure begins in Brittany, between local specialities and spectacular landscapes.

programme.title: That's France!
programme.desc: Through different topics and several headings, "C'est c'est c'est c'est c'il la France!" promotes living together and highlights the diversity of France. Surrounded by his columnists, Julie Mamou-Mani, alias "Mamuz", Anthony Babkine and Nadège Mongerard, alias "Nadège 100 Gêne", Yasmine Oughlis promotes living together and orchestra, with the good mood that characterizes it, this program that focuses on highlighting the social, economic and cultural issues of French society. To follow, moments of escape, lively debates and constructive information, while keeping a positive perspective.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Perpignan, a city of 120,000 inhabitants located between the Pyrenean mountains and the Mediterranean Sea. A haven of peace at first glance, but in reality the city is facing a constantly growing crime. To stop this phenomenon, 160 municipal police officers are looking after 24/7, equipped like their colleagues in the National Police. The officers face missions as varied as they are risky, from urban riots to escape offences, domestic violence or urban rodeos.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Two hours away from Paris, in the Orne department, Normandy, car is sometimes the only means of transport for the 280,000 inhabitants. With its advantages and disadvantages, but also those who do not respect the rules. Alcohol, narcotics or dangerous vehicles, to bring order to the bitumen, 150 Norman gendarmes are on the verge of war. Military personnel who monitor the department's strategic axes, looking for drivers and public hazards. Bad encounters on the road that are added to the scourge of accidents. For several weeks, a team followed these soldiers on the Orne roads. Where their patience is sometimes put to a hard test.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Every summer, the population of Royan is multiplied by six, attracting hundreds of thousands of holidaymakers who come to enjoy the beaches. But behind this postcard, the city's fifty-five policemen face a reality under high tension. For two months, focus on the moving daily life of Sandra and Olivier, faced with refusals to comply, accidents and runaway drivers.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Mary sent Sheldon to the catechism after discovering him playing Donjons & Dragons, but he wanted to study different religions.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

programme.title: My dream pool
programme.desc: The team of experts meets two families. The first one has a swimming pool built with spa, the second one wants a connected swimming pool.
programme.desc-more: Two families want to buy a swimming pool. Marie Josée and Mamar bought an old bastide near Antibes which they completely renovated. The little missing touch, a pool. The second family lives in the Yvelines, at the gates of Paris. The couple works a lot and has little time to get together with their family. It is for this reason that they decided to build a magnificent swimming pool equipped with a spa, jets of water and a sunbathing beach! A swimming pool that makes the whole family dream!

programme.title: Dream pools
programme.desc: In France, there are 3.5 million private swimming pools. In this expanding sector, inventiveness is essential. Head to the Sologne to follow the construction of a lagoon pool.
programme.desc-more: In Sologne, the dream pools often take the form of lagoons, offering a natural and relaxing atmosphere. These pools are distinguished by their irregular shape, soft beaches and coatings that mimic sand or rocks, creating a haven of peace inspired by natural lagoons. The team will have to surpass itself in order to meet the client's expectations. Between small unforeseen events and the nature of the land this site is far from being restless.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As usual, friends decide to spend their time playing video games, which is not very good for their companions, who have other projects.
programme.desc-more: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.
