programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard is in space, but nevertheless keeps in touch with his mother and wife. Raj, the only single in the troupe, feels abandoned.
programme.desc-more: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Inside Burger King: Behind the Scenes of a Fast Food Giant
programme.desc: An immersion in the workings of the success that has become indispensable to Burger King, American sign who signed a return noticed in France in 2012.
programme.desc-more: In a few years, Burger King has become a major player in fast food in France. The American brand, born in Miami in 1954, has long disappeared and has signed a return that was noticed in 2012. Since then, its development has been accelerating. Bold advertising campaigns, your staggered pace, technological innovations, ambitious investments: the strategy is clear and taken care of. Franchised and employees evoke the backstage of a growing network. With more than 600 restaurants and nearly 50 new openings each year, the brand continues its conquest of the territory. An immersion in the wheels of a success that has become inevitable.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon's life, accustomed to experimental success, takes a new direction after a disappointing failure at the scientific fair.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon disassembles the refrigerator to stop a buzzing nerve. Then he writes a road map for repairs...
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Dream pools
programme.desc: In France, there are 3.5 million private swimming pools. In this expanding sector, inventiveness is essential. Head to the Sologne to follow the construction of a lagoon pool.
programme.desc-more: In Sologne, the dream pools often take the form of lagoons, offering a natural and relaxing atmosphere. These pools are distinguished by their irregular shape, soft beaches and coatings that mimic sand or rocks, creating a haven of peace inspired by natural lagoons. The team will have to surpass itself in order to meet the client's expectations. Between small unforeseen events and the nature of the land this site is far from being restless.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard's mission in space is advanced, which poses problems for the organization of marriage. Amy uses psychology to get closer to Sheldon...
programme.desc-more: As the group dynamics evolve within the group of friends, the female presence is increasing around Leonard (Johnny Galecki), Sheldon (Jim Parsons), Howard (Simon Helberg) and Raj (Kunal Nayyar). The relationship between Penny (Kaley Cuoco) and Leonard gets more complicated after Penny shared one night with Raj, while Leonard is going through a difficult breakup with Priya. This tumultuous emotional context raises questions about the possibility of a reconciliation between Leonard and Penny. Amy (Mayim Bialik) is eager to advance her platonic relationship with Sheldon, seeking to push him to explore a more intimate connection, which exacerbates Sheldon's associative traits. At the same time, Howard is preparing for a major turning point in his life, with the wedding on the horizon and expedition projects to the international space station. This fifth season promises many twists and hilarious tensions within this iconic group.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard is in space, but nevertheless keeps in touch with his mother and wife. Raj, the only single in the troupe, feels abandoned.
programme.desc-more: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Gaëlle and Franck leave in a van, Fanny and Laëtitia travel in a renovated motorhome, and Eric and Zabou take the road south on their old truck.
programme.desc-more: For many French people who are thirsty for freedom and adventure, the nomadic journey is a dream solution. They therefore look at the latest trends in the sector. With a price of around €60,000 for a new vehicle, the happy owners of these equipped vans and other motorhomes give to heart joy in order to take full advantage of their investment. Sales exceeded 100,000 such vehicles in 2023 and 1.5 million French people threw themselves into the water. For smaller exchanges, the rental is also growing.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Close-up on Aurélie and Erwan, Marie and Jo, or Erwan and Aline, who chose to travel the roads of France, Europe or the world on their motorhome.

Their adventure begins in Brittany, between local specialities and spectacular landscapes.

programme.title: That's France!
programme.desc: Through different topics and several headings, "C'est c'est c'est c'est c'il la France!" promotes living together and highlights the diversity of France. Surrounded by his columnists, Julie Mamou-Mani, alias "Mamuz", Anthony Babkine and Nadège Mongerard, alias "Nadège 100 Gêne", Yasmine Oughlis promotes living together and orchestra, with the good mood that characterizes it, this program that focuses on highlighting the social, economic and cultural issues of French society. To follow, moments of escape, lively debates and constructive information, while keeping a positive perspective.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Between urban riots, escape offences, domestic violence and urban rodeos, the missions of the police officers in Perpignan are varied, and often risky.
programme.desc-more: Perpignan, a city of 120,000 inhabitants located between the Pyrenean mountains and the Mediterranean Sea. A haven of peace at first glance, but in reality the city is facing a constantly growing crime. To stop this phenomenon, 160 municipal police officers are looking after 24/7, equipped like their colleagues in the National Police. The officers face missions as varied as they are risky, from urban riots to escape offences, domestic violence or urban rodeos.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Alcohol, narcotics or dangerous vehicles, to bring order to the bitumen, 150 gendarmes of the Orne department are on the foot of war.
programme.desc-more: Two hours away from Paris, in the Orne department, Normandy, car is sometimes the only means of transport for the 280,000 inhabitants. With its advantages and disadvantages, but also those who do not respect the rules. Alcohol, narcotics or dangerous vehicles, to bring order to the bitumen, 150 Norman gendarmes are on the verge of war. Military personnel who monitor the department's strategic axes, looking for drivers and public hazards. Bad encounters on the road that are added to the scourge of accidents. For several weeks, a team followed these soldiers on the Orne roads. Where their patience is sometimes put to a hard test.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Alex, Sheldon's assistant, is trying to seduce Leonard. The latter appreciates the situation. Finding out the case, Sheldon is trying to settle it.
programme.desc-more: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Lucifer
programme.desc: A drug dealer was shot, and Chloe is in charge of the investigation. She is soon joined by Lucifer, now accompanied by her new partner Eve.
programme.desc-more: Because he's bored in hell, Lucifer leaves everything, quits and opens a nightclub in Los Angeles. He puts his deep knowledge of human turpitudes at the service of the local police, of which he becomes a valued consultant. Detective Chloe Decker assists him in his criminal investigations, while an angel, Amenadiel, tries to convince him to go underground and entrusts his soul states to a therapist, Linda. This adaptation of a comic book plays on the codes of the fantastic and the policeman, without omitting the register of seduction.

programme.title: Zone 51: The secret base that intrigues the planet
programme.desc: Decryption of the secrets surrounding Zone 51, in the wilderness of Nevada, northwest of Las Vegas, which has been fuelling theories for decades.
programme.desc-more: Flying saucers recovered by the American government, an extraterrestrial body analyzed in the greatest secret: Zone 51, in the middle of Nevada desert, northwest of Las Vegas, has been feeding theories for decades. "Independence Day" and "X-Files" have helped make it famous around the world. For nearly sixty years, the authorities refused to officially recognize its existence until the CIA did so in 2013. This documentary decrypts the declassified archives, collects the words of the whistleblowers and updates the latest developments.

At university, Sheldon hires an assistant, which reveals the jealousy that was sleeping in Amy. She's gonna do everything she can to break the ice. The band is mobilizing to help Raj find love. A few family secrets will be revealed in season 6. But a new career perspective will still pose the threat of separation. The record for the series, which is now reaching 20 million viewers in the United States.
programme.desc-more: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: The wrath of the Titans
programme.desc: Ten years after triumphing over the fearsome Kraken and saving the city of Argos, Perseus (Sam Worthington) turned his back on his divine heritage. Living as a humble fisherman, he tries to escape the shadow of his past, while raising his son alone. But the gods did not forget its existence. While the balance of power on the Olympic wave, Hades (Ralph Fiennes), thirsty for domination, orchestrate a bold blow: he captures Zeus (Liam Neeson), the king of the gods, and locks him in the depths of the Hells. Deprived of its protection, the world of mortals finds itself at the mercy of chaos, and the signs of divine anger are multiplying. The oceans are unleashing, the earth is shaking, and the legendary creatures, freed from their chains, are sowing terror. For Perseus, the retirement time is over. Forced to take up arms, he must face not only Hades forces, but also his own demons.

programme.title: Fringe
programme.desc: Olivia and its double alternative, nicknamed False-Livia, are at the centre of a narrative arc and conduct investigations in each of the universes where they are located. In every world, the constraints and differences are becoming increasingly apparent, as well as the plans of the Minister of Defence, Walter Bishop's alter ego. A strange war machine is also at the heart of the story. Fringe's third season is clearly focused on a tone close to science fiction. Blue or red credits indicate the world of action.

programme.title: The anger of the Titans
programme.desc: Ten years after his incredible victory against the monstrous Kraken, the heroic Perseus, half-god and son of Zeus, lives in a peaceful fishing village. He raised his 10-year-old son, Helus, alone. But his father was captured by Ares and Hades. The latter decided to betray him to make a covenant with Kronos. The Titans' strength is growing considerably. Perseus must face his destiny by embarking on a difficult quest that will lead him to Hell. With the help of the warrior queen Andromède, the fallen god Hephaistos and Agénor, he will do everything possible to liberate Zeus, overthrow the Titans and save humanity...

programme.title: The Titans' Shock

To survive, he will have to accept his destiny and divine nature...

programme.title: At the heart of customs: Spain - Season 1
programme.desc: A suspicious package alerts the Barcelona customs surveillance brigade. A vehicle that arrives at the port of Tarifa to embark to Tangier arouses suspicions of agents. At Madrid Barajas Airport, a concerned mother's call mobilizes the civil guard.

programme.title: At the heart of customs: Spain - Season 1
programme.desc: The opening of a container containing two high-end vehicles reveals the owner's fraudulent intentions. The Strait of Gibraltar is the scene of a migrant rescue operation. A couple who claim to want to offer their relatives the same products packed in various packagings is accused of intentional concealment.

programme.title: At the heart of customs: Spain - Season 1
programme.desc: In Algeciras, a truck from Morocco seems to have undergone recent modifications. At Madrid airport, a suitcase attracts attention.

programme.title: At the heart of customs: Spain - Season 1
programme.desc: A night-time aerial search in Gibraltar waters can end fatally for the agents involved. A passenger with curious behavior lands at Madrid airport.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: Professor Tupperman died. Leonard, Sheldon and Barry jump on this terrible opportunity and try to get their tenure in the university. But the task is not simple. Everyone flatters the committee members, including Ms. Davis... Soon, boys see girls also enter the competition.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: Sheldon is upset by the cancellation of her favorite TV series and tries in vain to get her back on the air. He writes to the channel for answers to questions he asks and who he believes has not received answers. Amy tries to teach her how to overcome the stress that wins her. Sheldon pretends to be cured but he's nothing.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: Sheldon discovers that Professor Proton of his youth is alive. He wants to invite him and send him an e-mail. At the Raj cafeteria, Howard is asked to watch his dog for the weekend. Sheldon is coming in to announce that Professor Proton will come home. Howard wonders how Sheldon got him to come.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: While Amy, Penny and Bernadette are heading to the airport for a trip to Las Vegas, the boys are at Leonard and Sheldon's and are preparing to play the game "Dongeons and Dragons". Raj receives a message from Lucy that she is free to go out and goes to meet her. He's glad they can date. The game goes on without him.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 6
programme.desc: With all his friends, Raj tells about the time he spent with Lucy. Howard joins them and says he may have found her a job. He learned that Stephen Hawking is an experimental physicist and recommended Leonard. Later Raj spoke with Lucy about Leonard's request to meet her and asked if they could all date one day.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory - Season 7
programme.desc: Leonard is still on the expedition and is in a telephone conversation with Sheldon. Then Raj, Sheldon and Howard have breakfast. Raj's heart is broken for losing Lucy. Howard tries to cheer him up and suggests that he attend the reception evening of the new postdoctoral fellows to meet him.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My life is hell - Season 1
programme.desc: Violence, insults, broken dialogue: focus on neighbours who rot their lives. These conflicts have always existed, but since the health crisis and the rise of telework, complaints related to the neighbourhood have increased by 60%, according to the General Housing Confederation (GHC). Between physical and verbal violence, some disputes eventually settle with a mediator. Others go to court.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My life is hell - Season 1
programme.desc: In the countryside, or in the city, no one escapes from his neighbours. But for some, cohabitation is turning into a merciless war. How can we end these clashes between neighbours? If some choose the path of conciliation, others choose to bring their case to court or to the town hall to settle their conflicts.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell - Season 4
programme.desc: In Nice, 72-year-old Marie-Hélène and 74-year-old Benoît thought they would enjoy their retirement peacefully. But the installation of padel fields a few meters from their garden is changing their daily lives. In Haute-Goulaine, 60-year-old Anissa, her house has deteriorated since the construction of the neighbouring building. For four years, she has been conducting a judicial fight that has exhausted her, and has not yet been resolved.

programme.title: Night programmes
programme.desc: Every week, David Chaignon and his team go on the ground to meet passionate people, both in France and abroad. It offers a travelling program that sheds light on the latest cynégetic and fisheries, is interested in techniques in vogue, the regulations in force, new materials...

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this new season of the iconic series, the members of the geek band are at a decisive turning point in their lives. Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) returns from a trip and discovers significant changes in the daily lives of his friends. Penny (Kaley Cuoco), after leaving her job as a waitress, now devotes herself to her career as an actress and brings her ties to Leonard, going so far as to make an unexpected marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) continues his quest for love and ends up meeting Emily, a fascinating dermatologist, who may well upset her life. The intrigues become more complex as Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) and Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik) navigate their relationship while facing personal challenges. This season promises to plunge even deeper into the dynamics of friendship and love within this brilliant and engaging group, while maintaining the staggered humour that made the series' success.

programme.title: Inside McDo : a year in the #1 restaurant in France
programme.desc: It is one of the most well-known companies in the world and is present on all continents. With more than 2 million meals served a day, France is now the second largest global market for "McDonald's", just after the United States. This conquest of the country champion of gastronomy is not without intrigue the implantation of what is emblematic of junk food. Besides, competitors like "Burger King" or the "KFC" fried chicken king are also present alongside the American giant.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper, a science genius, is perceived as inadequate in society by his university colleagues. At the age of 9, his parents decided, after a mature reflection, to send him to high school because of his exceptional intelligence. However, from the first day of school, Sheldon put herself on the back of his comrades and teachers. This series highlights Sheldon's early years, with Iain Armitage in the lead role and Jim Parsons in voice over.

programme.title: My dream pool
programme.desc: A show dedicated to the construction of swimming pools. Discover the family that revolutionizes the pool market in France. In each episode Diffazur, the family business, shows you the innovative concepts and the most beautiful swimming pools in the world that make us dream.

programme.title: Dream pools
programme.desc: France has 3.5 million private swimming pools. With an average of 150,000 construction demands per year managed by 1300 specialized companies, the country ranks first and second at the world level, just behind the United States. To meet this high demand, Piscinists are innovating and pushing technological creations and challenges further. The documentary series shows the crazy projects of these exceptional piscinists who push back ingenuity and know-how.

programme.title: I'll go sleep at your place.

Then he joined Narva, in northeastern Estonia. The city is separated from Russia by a river. In Madona, Latvia, Antoine drinks "medical" salt water. The globe-squatter ends his journey to Vilnius, the capital of Lithuania, where he discovers the Republic of Uzupis.

programme.title: I'll go sleep at your place.

There he learns that plainclothes policemen will follow him for his safety. Indeed, Libya is only 70 km away and terrorist groups are not to be excluded. The globe squatter then finished his journey to Oran.

programme.title: I'll go sleep at your place.

programme.title: Fishing XXL

Many fish inhabit the wild waters that make up it, but one particular case attracts the adventurer's attention. It is the Pirara, one of the largest fishes in Amazonia, a species of freshwater catfish. Capable of tearing everything out of his way, he has incredible strength, and imposes fear on any fisherman. But it takes more to discourage Cyril, who goes to his discovery with the aim of fishing him.

programme.title: Fishing XXL

His journey leads him from the Florida Rivers to the British Columbia Mountains, where he meets with victims and consults with experts. The adventure culminates when Cyril confronts a giant sturgeon in a torrent, testing his fishing skills.

programme.title: Fishing XXL
programme.desc: Cyril tries to capture a giant catfish with bare hands in the troubled waters of Oklahoma. This ancestral fishing technique, inherited from the Amerindians, is extremely dangerous. By diving into the dens of these imposing fishes, Cyril also faces other aquatic threats: snake turtles, poisonous snakes and beavers. An adventure that tests his courage in a hostile environment.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Pain and pain, life to death
programme.desc: On 22 May 2006, police found the mutilated and naked body of 20-year-old William Modolo, who was murdered with stones. A few weeks earlier, he had met Jean-Pierre Planqueel and his friends, a group of five people, whom they thought they had become his friends. Bad in his skin, especially because of his overweight, William Modolo trusted them, but unfortunately for him, these five individuals abused him sexually and punished him in any way, a real atrocity, before ending with him under blows.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Thierry Saman, the concierge who knew too much
programme.desc: Thierry Saman was officially a concierge in the 13th arrondissement of Paris. Actually, man was a lot more than that. He led several lives. A guardian of the day, Thierry Saman had been involved in the big banditry for years, notably in several robberies on drug dealers. From his lodge, without his "collaborators" knowing it, he was playing the role of a police indicator. On 15 January 2003, Thierry Saman was murdered. His murderers, Eric Steger and El Hadi Ghariani, were tried in January 2014.

programme.desc: Concierge in a building in Place Souham, in the 13th arrondissement of Paris, Thierry Saman disappears without leaving any traces. The man had had some trouble with the justice system in the 1990s, but he had been "car-free" ever since. The police find out he was playing the role of a criminal...
programme.desc-more: Thierry Saman was officially a concierge in the 13th arrondissement of Paris. Actually, man was a lot more than that. He led several lives. A guardian of the day, Thierry Saman had been involved in the big banditry for years, notably in several robberies on drug dealers. From his lodge, without his "collaborators" knowing it, he was playing the role of a police indicator. On 15 January 2003, Thierry Saman was murdered. His murderers, Eric Steger and El Hadi Ghariani, were tried in January 2014.

programme.desc-more: In October 2012, Denize Soares, a 43-year-old Brazilian, was tried by the Isère Assize Court for the murder of Sébastien Brun, his companion from 2000 to 2004. programme.title: Titanic: The Secrets of Science
programme.desc: Thanks to a state-of-the-art technique, a digital 3D replica of the Titanic is created, allowing an immersive analysis of the unprecedented wreckage.
programme.desc-more: Under the Atlantic, at 3800 metres deep, the Titanic wreck delivers its last secrets thanks to two submarine robots, Romeo and Juliet, which captured 715,000 images and millions of laser measurements. After two years of work, this data created a life-size 3D digital twin of the ship, offering a new scientific approach to the 1912 sinking.

programme.title: Titanic: The 10 Hidden Faces of Myth
programme.desc: In 1912, the Titanic, a ship known as insubmersible, struck an iceberg and dark in the Atlantic. A look back at one of the greatest dramas in maritime history.
programme.desc-more: In April 1912, the famous Titanic, the largest ship ever built, left Southampton for its inaugural crossing. Considered a real wonder of engineering, it is considered insubmersible. Yet, four days later, it struck an iceberg and dark in the cold waters of the North Atlantic. Nearly 1,500 people perish, for lack of sufficient lifeboats. Thanks to archival images and three-dimensional reconstructions, this documentary reveals the unknown stories that lie behind one of the greatest dramas in maritime history.

programme.title: Titanic: Anatomy of a Giant
programme.desc: More than a hundred years after the sinking of the Titanic, this film recaptures the genesis of the most mythical ship of all time. Never had such a ship been imagined.
programme.desc-more: The Titanic itself is a engineering concentrate due to its unparalleled dimensions, its double hull in riveted steel plates, its waterproof compartments, its hydraulic system and its revolutionary propulsion. It is the result of three years of work and the commitment of more than 15,000 men working day and night. Of course, unfortunately famous for its sinking 110 years ago now, the Titanic has a history as legendary as it is unknown. It is the history of its construction that is highlighted in this documentary.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: John and Alex are in bad faith, they're fighting, they're getting provoked. They're arrogant, selfish, greedy and jealous. But first, they love each other!
programme.desc-more: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.desc-more: Journalist Frédérique Lantieri looks back at the Mohamed Faleh case, a killer who was cracking his victims' skull with an axe. In 1999, a man, Max, was attacked under the same circumstances, but he survived his attack... telling that he saw "the devil" jump on him. Through his testimony, the investigators linked to three similar cases that had taken place a few years earlier. They discover the profile of a killer passionate about gambling and women. The criminal investigation police will take more than 20 years to close this case, which has covered the chronicle.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On 8 November 1999, Brigitte Muller, a 42-year-old documentaryist, married and mother of two, committed suicide in the basement of the marital home, with a revolver of 357 Magnum, in Ingwiller, Lower Rhine. Her husband, Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic doctor and ballistics specialist, is a suspected time. But the investigation was finally closed in February 2000. It will take fourteen years, dozens of expert opinions and three trials to finally give a judicial outcome to the Muller mystery.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On February 23, 2017, Pascal and Brigitte Troadec, along with their adult children, Sébastien and Charlotte disappeared from their home in the Loire-Atlantique region of Orvault. Some blood marks are found in their homes. A mystery that immediately mobilizes the police and the press, because it is not without recalling the Dupont case of Ligonnés whose crime scene is only a few kilometers away. However, the case will be resolved quickly with the arrest of Hubert Caussin, Pascal Troadecn's brother-in-law, and will prove to be the one of a delusion of persecution, which turned into a drama.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Didier Tallineau, the man with both faces
programme.desc: In July 1999, Carole's body, a nurse student, was found on a country road in Châteaubriant. After a party with friends in a bar, she had stayed alone with the manager, Didier Tallineau, to help her tidy up. Suspected, this father of the family gives different versions before recognizing Carole's murder. He also ended up confessing to the one, ten years earlier, in Vendée, of Catherine, his girlfriend of the time. He was then sentenced to 30 years in prison with a 20-year security sentence. But after four and a half years in prison, he was released under the Law on the Rights of the Sick.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: With the testimony of the investigation's relatives, the leader is going back to Jennifer Charron's murder. On Sunday 29 April 2007 in the morning, a mushroom picker discovers the body of this 21-year-old waitress on a concrete slab in a clearing in Saint-Sulpice-de-Royan, Charente-Maritime. She's carbonized from the bust to the face, with her hands still attached to her back. According to forensic doctors, Jennifer Charron died of a brain hemorrhage, after being beaten several times with bare hands but also with a stone.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: In 1990, Rodica Negroiu, a Romanian-born caregiver, aroused suspicions from the police when one of her patients was found dead. Investigators find that the old man, a wealthy man, had been poisoned. They also update the strange disappearances of her first two husbands. After seven years of investigation, the Aide-Career trial began in June 1999 in Nancy. She was deprived of her French nationality and was sentenced to 20 years ' imprisonment.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: In 2003 in the Ardennes, a young woman, Laurence, filed a complaint against her companion, Jean-Luc Blanche, who abused her 9-year-old daughter. The man denies but has already been convicted of three rapes. Released under judicial control during the investigation, he returned to Laurence to hit her and then fled. During his run, which led him to Calvados, then to the Eure, Drôme, Côte-d'Or and the Paris region, he abducted and raped five women before being arrested. He was tried in 2006 in Charleville-Mézières and was sentenced to life imprisonment.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Douliery was indicted in February 2002 for the disappearance of his partner Dominique Ortiz, and was dismissed for lack of evidence. Five years later, Douliery appeared again in court. He is accused of murdering Jean-Pierre Faure, the husband of his mistress Béatrice Frustieri, who, in 2005, had also disappeared. During this trial, Béatrice Frustieri will also accuse him of the murder of Dominique.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Jonathann Daval, the betrayal of the ideal son-in-law
programme.desc: On October 28, 2017, in Gray-la-Ville, Haute-Saône, Alexia Daval, did not return from his jogging. Two days later, his body was found partly calcined and hidden under branches in a nearby commune. When she was announced her death, her husband Jonathann Daval would fight with her parents-in-law before confessing to the murder of his wife and then retracting. On 21 November 2020, he was finally convicted of murder and sentenced to 25 years' imprisonment after an investigation and trial with multiple twists.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: Patrice Uzan was heavily convicted of two crimes. L-un in Saint-Witz in January 2011, near Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle, for the double murder of a couple of pensioners, with a sentence of life imprisonment, with 20 years of security And the other, in April 2011, in Paris for the murder of a jeweller during a robbery, with 30 years in prison. All the victims were shot three times in the head, with the same weapon, which allowed the two cases to be reconciled and tried separately.

programme.title: Ciné & Chill
programme.desc: Presented by Canelle Sab, Ciné & Chill offers a modern and uncomplexed look at cinema. Every week, the journalist delivers a review in a few minutes, incarnated, accessible and rhythmic from a film to the poster, with a writing thought for new uses and social media codes. In addition, a review of the essential news of the cinema goes back to the releases, announcements and events that make pop culture news. Ciné & Chill is also a hybrid and conversational event, which is also based on Brut's networks, designed to speak to both enthusiasts and new generations.

programme.title: Seven Sisters
programme.desc: In 2073, the Earth choked under the weight of its own overpopulation. Resources are running out, megacities are spreading infinitely, and desperate governments are imposing radical measures to control population. Among them, the Single Child Act, applied without mercy by the Office of Birth Allowance (BAN), a powerful institution headed by a hand of iron by Nicolette Cayman (Glenn Close). In this world where every birth is planned, registered and strictly limited, breaking the rule is equivalent to a crime against the state. The violators disappear. "Illegal" children are being hunted. And those who dare to hide them risk everything – including their lives. It is in this climate of silent terror that Terrence Settman (Willem Dafoe) makes a decision that will seal the fate of his family. When an unexpected medical event gives birth to seven identical girls, he refuses to deliver them to the NDB. Instead, he drew up a bold plan: each of the sisters would bear the same name, Karen Settman, but only one specific day of the week, corresponding to his secret name (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday...). Located inside their apartment in high security, the seven young women grow up in ignorance of their own multiple existence, sharing a unique life through the stories of their "days". For the outside world, Karen Settman is just one person – a model employee, discreet, without history.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Michel Providetet and Monique Olivier, the evil alliance
programme.desc: Between 1987 and 2003, Monique Olivier "rabat" for her husband, Michel Provenret, seven young girls aged 12 to 21, who he rapes and kills in the Ardennes. In 2003, an eighth victim escaped. The information provided by the girl allows the law enforcement to trace the evil couple back. Arrested, Michel Provenret confesses nine crimes, but he is suspected of having committed others in Belgium. After his trial in Charleville-Mézières in 2008, the couple was sentenced to life incompressible, the heaviest of the penalties provided for in the Criminal Code.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Guy Georges, the Eastern Parisian killer
programme.desc: This is a case that immediately mobilizes the police and the press, both the disappearance, on 23 February 2017, of Pascal, Brigitte, Sébastien and Charlotte Troadec, has a taste of already seen in the Nantes region. This case was one of a delusion of persecution, which turned into a drama. Four members of the same family died because of a ruminated rancidity until the obsession.
programme.desc-more: In the fall of 1997, a killer spreads terror in the capital. Two young women living near the Bastille are raped and slaughtered at home. The man now known as the Eastern Parisian killer is making headlines and escaping the police. In 1998, at the laboratory of molecular biology in Nantes, where the pre-legged genetic fingerprints are stored in criminal investigations, Dr. Olivier Pascal compares the DNA sequences with the fingerprint of the Parisian Eastern killer. He found a concordance with the DNA of a certain Guy Georges, prelevé in 1995.

After a trial full of twists and turns, he was sentenced to life imprisonment.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: In March 2002, Jean-Raymond Blatti, accountant of a small company in the suburbs of Geneva, was found dead in his office. His skull was stoned. On her belly, two words ("dirty rapist") are written in indelible ink. The police are looking at all the leads before bringing this murder closer to the attack, a few months earlier, of Henri Kosa, the former accountant of the Swiss company. He was also hit in the head. Part of his brain is destroyed. The investigators are interested in the third accountant, Denis Lemasson. What they find is freezing.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On the night of July 16-17, 2000, Richard Alessandri, manager of a supermarket, was murdered at his home in Pernes-les-Fontaines, Vaucluse. His wife, Edwige, told the police that they had been the victims of a burglary that went wrong. Yet the evidence and testimony of their son suggest that Edwige Alessandri killed her husband. The woman has always been crying out for innocence. His defence and his support committee will not be enough to convince justice. She is convicted three times of this crime.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: In 2006, Jean-Luc Blanche, a multi-recidivist, was sentenced to life imprisonment for rapes he committed in the summer of 2003. A month before the facts, Blanche was accused of sexual touching by a child, and arrested. A judge released him under judicial supervision: back on this case.
programme.desc-more: On 5 April 1992, Sylviane Kaas was found dead at her home. Her husband, André, and their children are making the grim discovery as they return from the cinema. There is every indication that André is guilty, particularly in view of his behaviour following his wife's death. André was finally sentenced and sentenced to three years in prison. He was dismissed in 1996 and was dismissed in 2004. Meanwhile, the investigation was resumed by prosecutor Joseph Schmidt, but the murderer is still running.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: It all starts with two bodies found at the foot of the highest cliff in France, Cap Canaille. Two lovers are turning the ball in the accused's box. programme.desc-more: In 1993, in Languedoc-Rousillon, Albert Foulcher was arrested for the murder of André Meffray, a retired insurer. Foulcher, who has always denied, remains in prison for three years before being released on parole in 1996. But three days before his trial in 2000, he disappeared. The police had no news of him for nearly a year, until he returned to kill the husband of one of his mistresses, as well as two gendarmes, and then another insurer. He was hunted by the Raid's men and killed himself in January 2001.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Aurelien Pioger, death in the vineyards
programme.desc: In January 2011, a couple of retired people were found dead in their pavilion. In April 2011, a jeweller was shot dead during a robbery. The Gendarmerie is investigating the first case. The PJ is working on the other, not knowing that both cases are bound by the same operating procedure. All the victims were shot with the same weapon.
programme.desc-more: On October 19, 2008, in Saint-Lambert-du-Lattay, Maine-et-Loire, a gamekeeper found a body, hanged on the beam of an agricultural appentis. It is the one of Aurélien Pioger, a 28-year-old young man who had just finished the harvest season. While suicide is first mentioned, there are a number of anomalies, as well as traces of beatings on his face, which intrigue the gendarmes. Soon, the investigation is moving towards the hypothesis of a disguised murder. Indeed, Aurélien was the victim of a very violent "collective punishment" on the part of some other harvesters.

programme.title: Ciné & Chill
programme.desc: Presented by Canelle Sab, Ciné & Chill offers a modern and uncomplexed look at cinema. Every week, the journalist delivers a review in a few minutes, incarnated, accessible and rhythmic from a film to the poster, with a writing thought for new uses and social media codes. In addition, a review of the essential news of the cinema goes back to the releases, announcements and events that make pop culture news. Ciné & Chill is also a hybrid and conversational event, which is also based on Brut's networks, designed to speak to both enthusiasts and new generations.

programme.title: Podium
programme.desc: Dive into the crazy and touching world of Bernard Frédéric (Benoît Poelvoorde), a man whose life revolves around an obsession: to perfectly embody the mythical singer Claude François. He is a professional sosy, and he chains the galas and provincial scenes, mic in hand and glitter in the suit, before the sometimes amused eyes, often exasperated by his entourage. But when Véro (Julie Depardieu) , his wife tired of this nomadic and eccentric existence, throws him an unrelenting ultimatum – family life or Cloclo – Bernard resolves to put on his heel boots and white tuxedo to put on a much duller suit-dress. Direction the bank, where he tries to blend in the mould of a lambda frame, suffocating day after day under the weight of routine and numbers. Everything changes when Couscous (Jean-Paul Rouve), his accomplice always as crazy as he is faithful, arrives with a new explosive: a Night of the Sames is organized on television, with at the key a national visibility and, who knows, a consecration for the best imitator of Cloclo.

programme.title: Seven Sisters
programme.desc: While the government is pursuing a single child policy, seven sisters, each of whom has a day of the week as their first name, are being hunted.
programme.desc-more: In 2073, the Earth choked under the weight of its own overpopulation. Resources are running out, megacities are spreading infinitely, and desperate governments are imposing radical measures to control population. Among them, the Single Child Act, applied without mercy by the Office of Birth Allowance (BAN), a powerful institution headed by a hand of iron by Nicolette Cayman (Glenn Close). In this world where every birth is planned, registered and strictly limited, breaking the rule is equivalent to a crime against the state. The violators disappear. "Illegal" children are being hunted. And those who dare to hide them risk everything – including their lives. It is in this climate of silent terror that Terrence Settman (Willem Dafoe) makes a decision that will seal the fate of his family. When an unexpected medical event gives birth to seven identical girls, he refuses to deliver them to the NDB. Instead, he drew up a bold plan: each of the sisters would bear the same name, Karen Settman, but only one specific day of the week, corresponding to his secret name (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday...). Located inside their apartment in high security, the seven young women grow up in ignorance of their own multiple existence, sharing a unique life through the stories of their "days". For the outside world, Karen Settman is just one person – a model employee, discreet, without history.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Edgar Boulai: the missing of Vaux-le-Pénil
programme.desc: On September 23, 1996, the bodies of Donald, his companion Stephanie and their two children were found buried at the bottom of their garden in Vaux-le-Pénil, near Melun. It was almost a year ago for the day that the family had disappeared. The perpetrator of the crime: Edgar Boulai, who, for twelve months, settled on the ground of his victims.
programme.desc-more: In 1996, the bodies of Donald Davila, of Stephanie, his companion, and their two young children buried in the garden of their house in Vaux-le-Pénil, near Melun were found. Their disappearance was reported a year earlier by Gilberte, Stephanie's mother. She alerted the police, the courts, the press, in vain. Edgar Boulai, who knew them, settled on their ground saying they would not return. But Gilberte never wanted to believe it. All the family's things are there: cars, orange card, medicines for children. When Boulai finally sold the cars, Gilberte filed a complaint for theft. The investigation finally led to the arrest and conviction of the latter to life imprisonment in 2000.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Jean-Baptiste Rambla: A crime for inheritance
programme.desc: In 1974, Marie-Dolorès, the sister of Jean-Baptiste Rambla, then 6 years old, was killed by Christian Ranucci, one of the last condemned to death in France. In 2004, in Marseilles, Jean-Baptiste Rambla killed his boss, Corinne Beidl, and after ten years in prison, he murdered Cintia Lunimbu in Toulouse.
programme.desc-more: The story of Jean-Baptiste Rambla is that of a man marked by crime. Witness of his sister's abduction when he was six years old, he said he was haunted by this tragic event and used it as proof for his own package. He committed his first murder in July 2004 in Marseilles, his victim was his boss: Corinne Beidl, the motive remains obscure. Sentenced to 18 years in prison, he was released on condition, but ended up recidivating in July 2017 in Toulouse, when he brutally killed Cintia Lunimbu, an unknown woman who had the misfortune to cross her path.

programme.title: Ikea's crazy story
programme.desc: Ikea is the story of a Swedish-coloured brand, which has become the world leader in furniture and decoration. Ikea furniture, design, cheap and impronçable names, are everywhere. Created in 1943 by 17-year-old Swedishman Ingvar Kamprad, the brand is first and foremost a small mail-order company, but it takes him only 30 years to become a huge multinational.

programme.title: The crazy story of Coca-Cola
programme.desc: More than a drink, Coca-Cola has become a global symbol of conviviality and shared moments. His fulgurant rise is based on a visionary marketing: the secret of the recipe locked in a safe in Atlanta, the red and jovial Santa Claus popularized in his pubs, cult campaigns and a pioneer product placement in the cinema, notably in Spielberg's E.T. Even today, Coca-Cola must defend its image against criticisms of sugar and the environment. How does the giant manage to remain a leader despite the controversy? Close-up on the crazy epic of Coca-Cola, from cocaine to the most iconic soda on the planet.

programme.title: The crazy story of McDonald's
programme.desc: McDonald, is a fast food giant that everyone knows and has served more than 400 billion burgers since 1948. This crazy success was born in a simple California drive-in run by the McDonald brothers, who invented the concept of fast food. Ray Kroc, a visionary of business, is conquered by the idea and thanks to franchises, the brand conquers America and the world. Big Mac, Happy Meal, O-Fish Net are key to the brand's success. Back on the epic of a brand that has changed our way of consuming.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, the team of the Unsolved Business Section, led by Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), is committed to reopening long forgotten investigations, confronting the ghosts of the past. The season opens with a tragic case: a massacre in a large area in 1995, where a possible third accomplice emerges, questioning the version of events. In another episode, the death of a policeman, suspected of corruption in 1968, revives investigations into a troubled past. The discovery of a teenager's remains in a garbage dumpster raises questions about the young man's identity and the circumstances of his disappearance. Each case is intertwined with poignant cultural references, such as the Columbine shooting and controversial doctor Jack Kevorkian. With a rich soundtrack, mixing artists like Bob Dylan and Coldplay, this Cold Case season plunges the spectator into an emotional exploration of the consequences of unsolved crimes.
programme.desc-more: Within Philadelphia police, Lieutenant John Stillman (John Finn), but also Inspectors Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), Scotty Valens (Danny Pino), Nick Vera (Jeremy Ratchford), Will Jeffries (Thom Barry) and Kat Miller (Thoms Trade) were part of a special brigade investigating past cases, which were closed at the time despite the fact that they were not resolved. The team will then interview witnesses, whose lives have changed significantly since the murder, try to find new clues and use new technologies that can provide some answers.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Carter agreed to take a cure to treat his drug addiction. Abby, who herself struggles with her addiction to alcohol, tries to support him. The unexpected arrival of her mother, who suffers from bipolar disorders, does not favour the balance of the young woman. Kerry, for his part, is deeply troubled by Kim Legaspi, a beautiful psychiatrist who does not make a mystery of her homosexuality. A dense season, exploring the complexity and subtlety of the characters, including Kerry Weaver, which reveals unexpected depths.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

Unfortunately, a snowstorm soon forced his plane to land in a lost corner of Montana. Shortly afterwards, she was forced to share a Bed & Breakfast room with a perfect stranger, sitting next to her during the flight. Between the two young people, obviously very different, the relationships are electric. When the owners arrive at the gîte, they take them for a couple.

programme.title: Megan's dream Christmas
programme.desc: Megan, a young writer-director specializing in Christmas movies, is tyrannical. She leads a life of hell to her collaborators, who she intends to have worked on during New Year's Eve. His private life, moreover, is far from enviable since Megan frequents Eric, a selfish and superficial boy. Soon, after an umpteenth anger, she accidentally assailed herself. When Megan wakes up, she realizes she was thrown into a snowball. In this alternative reality, the director is married and mother of two children.

programme.title: Megan's dream Christmas
programme.desc: Megan, who wakes up in a parallel life where she is married to Ted, her youthful love with which she has two beautiful children, Mia and Teddy, believes first of all in a joke from her team...

programme.title: Second hand: the trades of the occasion
programme.desc: Vincent crossed France to visit Belgian neighbours. The Normand is familiar with this route since he frequently travels overseas. He goes back to looking for vintage objects from which he hopes to gain some benefits during his brocante. The treasure hunt continues in the Pink City for Charlene and Romain, charged with emptying a house. In Orange, Nadine is conducting investigations to try to determine the selling prices of several items brought by increasingly numerous customers of items of which she has no idea of the value.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Francis Evrard, the kidnapping of Enis
programme.desc: Between 1962 and 2007, Francis Evrard, a repeat pedophile, was convicted eight times, almost every time for rape or touching minors under the age of 15. After each of his prison trips, he never spent more than four months before he again assaulted a young boy. On 15 August 2007, he abducted and raped the little Enis in Roubaix. This case showed the effectiveness of the "abduction alert" mechanism, but above all triggered a national controversy and ultimately inspired the 2008 law establishing security detention for criminals at high risk of recidivism.

programme.title: XXL trucks: the queens of the wheel
programme.desc: Sabine fights against fog and traffic difficulties at the Col du Tourmalet before charging 290 barriers to Pau, for his last mission linked to the Tour de France féminine. Clotilde must deliver its cargo before 2 p.m., then reach Beatrice in Nogaro. Anaïs and Myriam carry mechanical parts, but traffic jams on the RCEA slow their journey. For its part, Amélie uses narrow roads to reach her client and unload. In Nogaro, Béatrice and Clotilde discover behind the scenes the French championship of racing truck.

programme.title: XXL trucks: the queens of the wheel
programme.desc: Frédérique continued his journey with an exceptional convoy and had to cross Nantes before 7:15 a.m. Despite the rain that makes her carrier slippery, she arrives at destination in time. At the port of Ghent, Anaïs and Myriam encounter difficulties in parking and delaying unloading. Estelle delivers her cargo before returning to search for concrete walls. Lexie, for his part, continues to learn mechanics from Jennifer, with the ambition to become a race driver. In Nogaro, Amélie, Anaïs, Myriam, Clotilde and Sabine, they have an exceptional experience: they board race trucks.

programme.title: XXL trucks: the queens of the wheel
programme.desc: In general, the female gender is not associated with the trucking profession. But the "Trucker Babes" are here to hurt this prejudice. They are robust, bright in spirit and with many horses under their seats, they do not let themselves be counted.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Castle and Beckett finally decided to get married. At the same time, the young woman joined the FBI, and she's starting to work in Washington. During this sixth season, when we follow the wedding preparations, Castle is poisoned by a mysterious toxin. He's trying to get back on the team while Beckett's fired from the FBI. Meanwhile, Alexis has a new boyfriend, Pi, a boy who doesn't like Castle. In the twelfth episode, Castle found his father, whose news he had had since Alexis was abducted in Paris (season 5).
programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Beckett's relationship with Castle is taking on a new twist: they spent one night together. As a first step, they obviously try to hide their relationship from their colleagues as well as Matha and Alexis. In the first episode of this fifth season, Beckett and Castle finally discover the name of the man who commissioned Beckett's mother's murder. This is William Bracken (Jack Coleman), a senator. This character becomes recurring in the series, creating a conflict with Beckett. Finally, in a double episode, Alexis was kidnapped and then Castle met his father, a former spy. The season ends with Castle's marriage proposal, and the FBI's offer to Beckett.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: Between 1984 and 1992, Francis Heaulme committed at least nine murders throughout France, regardless of whether he was a man, woman or child. He's probably the perpetrator of other crimes. Thanks to a method similar to that of the FBI, the house marshal Jean-François Abgrall was able to stop and reconstruct the path of the murderer.

programme.title: SNCF: The secrets of XXL logistics
programme.desc: Every day in France, almost 15,000 trains run 28 000 kilometres of lines. Thousands of officers coordinate traffic, ensure safety and anticipate incidents so that trains leave and arrive on time. At Lyon station, where nearly 250 TGVs travel daily on the Paris-Lyon-Mediterranean axis, the supervisory teams manage departures and delays in real time. Help desk experts help drivers facing a failure remotely. A team also followed the maintenance of the trainsets in the technicalentres, where some TGVs are completely renovated, as well as the preparation of schedules, almost two years in advance.

programme.title: Amazon, the secrets of a XXL logistics
programme.desc: The e-commerce revolution is accelerating. Three in four French people have ordered over the Internet in the last 12 months. Undisputed leader of the sector, Amazon ships billions of parcels every year around the world. Behind this performance: millions of references, competitive prices and above all an out-of-standard logistics machine, driven by artificial intelligence.

programme.title: Inside Ikea: Behind the scenes of the Swedish giant
programme.desc: In the furniture, Ikea has established itself as a landmark of everyday life. Behind the arrow path and the furniture in kit hides a perfectly runned mechanics. Set up rooms, restaurant in the heart of the store, adjoining warehouse: everything is thought out to guide, inspire and simplify the purchase. In Nantes, one of the most popular sites in the country, teams coordinate daily deliveries, online orders, re-assortment of shelves and service of thousands of meals. Logistics, sales, catering, second life of products: dive into the scenes of the daily operation of a giant that has become indispensable.

programme.title: Ikea's crazy story
programme.desc: Ikea is the story of a Swedish-coloured brand, which has become the world leader in furniture and decoration. Ikea furniture, design, cheap and impronçable names, are everywhere. Created in 1943 by 17-year-old Swedishman Ingvar Kamprad, the brand is first and foremost a small mail-order company, but it takes him only 30 years to become a huge multinational.

programme.title: Podium
programme.desc: Dive into the crazy and touching world of Bernard Frédéric (Benoît Poelvoorde), a man whose life revolves around an obsession: to perfectly embody the mythical singer Claude François. He is a professional sosy, and he chains the galas and provincial scenes, mic in hand and glitter in the suit, before the sometimes amused eyes, often exasperated by his entourage. But when Véro (Julie Depardieu) , his wife tired of this nomadic and eccentric existence, throws him an unrelenting ultimatum – family life or Cloclo – Bernard resolves to put on his heel boots and white tuxedo to put on a much duller suit-dress. Direction the bank, where he tries to blend in the mould of a lambda frame, suffocating day after day under the weight of routine and numbers. Everything changes when Couscous (Jean-Paul Rouve), his accomplice always as crazy as he is faithful, arrives with a new explosive: a Night of the Sames is organized on television, with at the key a national visibility and, who knows, a consecration for the best imitator of Cloclo.

programme.title: Seven Sisters
programme.desc: In 2073, the Earth choked under the weight of its own overpopulation. Resources are running out, megacities are spreading infinitely, and desperate governments are imposing radical measures to control population. Among them, the Single Child Act, applied without mercy by the Bureau d'Allocation des Naissancies (BAN), a powerful institution led by a hand of iron by Nicolette Cayman (Glenn Close). In this world where every birth is planned, registered and strictly limited, breaking the rule is equivalent to a crime against the state. The violators disappear. "Illegal" children are being hunted. And those who dare to hide them risk everything – including their lives. It is in this climate of silent terror that Terrence Settman (Willem Dafoe) makes a decision that will seal the fate of his family. When an unexpected medical event gives birth to seven identical girls, he refuses to deliver them to the NDB. Instead, he drew up a bold plan: each of the sisters would bear the same name, Karen Settman, but only one specific day of the week, corresponding to his secret name (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday...). The seven young women, who are locked inside their apartment in high security, grow up in ignorance of their own multiple existence, sharing a unique life through the stories of their "days". For the outside world, Karen Settman is just one person – a model employee, discreet, without history.

programme.title: The resistant
programme.desc: Around one in three women worldwide have experienced domestic or sexual violence, as a result of being a woman. But everywhere, far from the spotlight, resistanceers circumvent oppression, refuse the limits imposed on them, and imagine concrete solutions to save lives. From India to Afghanistan, from Africa to Iran, to the United States, France and Ukraine, author Sarah Barukh, herself a former victim of domestic violence, is going to meet them. Each is a "visage of the possible", the face of a feminism that gives hope, that gathers, protects and frees. This film highlights a real system of repair, agile and solidary, which moves the lines. Because in the face of this "global pandemic", as the UN has expressed it, global solutions are needed.

programme.title: Snow
programme.desc: Dive into the snowy and hostile landscapes of the Alps, where silence stifles secrets like snow stifles the tracks. Here, the cold is not just a question of weather: it is insinuated in souls, freezes consciousness and reveals the fractures of a society where appearance often hides the infamous. In the middle of this storm, Captain Thomas Delhaye (Frédéric Diefenthal), an experienced cop but weakened by progressive deafness that isolates a little more each day. When two notables of the region, respected and untouchable figures, are found murdered in macabre and strangely familiar conditions, Delhaye feels her blood iced. The killer's methods recall with disturbing precision those of Hugo Czarlewski, a charismatic and manipulative psychopath who had terrorized Savoy seven years earlier. Officially, Czarlewski is serving a life sentence... But the coincidences are too many to be accidental. To break the mystery, Delhaye takes a new risk: to have Juliette Hémon (Murielle Huet des Aunay), the ex-companion of Czarlewski, temporarily released, sentenced to twenty years in prison for complicity and homicide. A woman broken by her past, Juliette may have the keys to the riddle, but her collaboration is a dangerous bet. Between lies, unsaid and ambiguous loyalties, the border quickly blurs: who manipulates who? Are recent murders the work of an imitator, a forgotten accomplice... Or the sign that a repressed nightmare is coming back?

programme.title: The Joan of Arc case

The carrier - the series
programme.desc: Frank was hired to lead the son of an anti-mafia judge, shot dead in front of the child, from Berlin to Rome to testify against his murderer.
programme.desc-more: Frank Martin (Chris Vance), the famous "carrier", is back with a new associate, Caterina Boldieu. In this season full of twists, their first mission takes them into a perilous world, where they must escort the son of an Italian anti-mafia judge. The latter must testify at the trial of a notorious murderer, and the safety of the young man is paramount. As Frank strives to protect him, an American song star also seeks his services, putting him in the face of a formidable competition. Quickly, he realizes that other carriers compete with him, each one ready to do anything to take over. In parallel with his risky missions, Frank cannot help but look for the woman he loves, who disappeared under mysterious circumstances. This combination of protection, betrayal and personal research makes this series a veritable whirlwind of action and emotion, where loyalty and danger are associated at every moment.
