programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: A man was shot dead after posting a video showing a woman who had been declared missing: Sherlock and Holmes immediately took the case in hand.
programme.desc-more: While Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are continuing their investigations in New York, their collaboration is being tested by unexpected reunions. Joan crosses the path of Shinwell Johnson, a former patient whose tumultuous journey leads him to seek his help. Determined to help her, she finds herself immersed in a complex world of loyalties and difficult choices. At the same time, Holmes faces an unexpected return from Kitty Winter, her former partner, who gives her a crucial warning about an imminent threat. In this climate of tension, Captain Gregson (Aidan Quinn) seeks to have the contributions of the two detectives recognized, adding a political dimension to their efforts. This fifth season, which celebrates the 100 episodes, further deepens the dynamics between Holmes and Watson, while exploring themes of redemption, danger and the impact of past choices.

Her father, concerned about her well-being, hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had become her mentor, to help her stay on the right path and avoid a relapse. As an unexpected partner, Joan finds herself navigating the complex universe of criminal investigations alongside Sherlock. Together, they solve thorny business using Holmes' sharp intuition and deducing talent, often confronted with puzzles that test their skills. The dynamics between the duo, with the feminization of Watson's character, bring a new dimension to this modern adaptation of Conan Doyle's works. The challenges they face reveal not only mysteries, but also the personal struggles and human relations that unite them.

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: Danny Dolinski, a hired killer from the old school, must train a young wolf on the field, but their mission is not going to happen as planned.
programme.desc-more: We are diving into the tumultuous life of Danny Dolinski, a seasoned hit man who represents the old school. At the height of his career, Danny realizes that the time to hang up is approaching and that it is time to retire. However, his employers imposed a final job on him: to train a young killer aspirant, Wihlborg, who embodied the values and attitude of a new generation, that of the Z. Wihlborg generation, with its tempered character and determination, did not hesitate to question Danny's traditional methods. This passage of witness between the two men, with so different routes, is bound to be strewn with obstacles. Together, they fly to Northern Ireland, where they must carry out a delicate mission. On the spot, the duo will discover that the challenges lie not only in the success of their contract, but also in their ability to understand and accept the divergence of their philosophies of life and profession. While the Irish environment, both picturesque and full of history, is the backdrop to their adventure, tension rises between Danny's pragmatic and methodical approach and Wihlborg's bold and modern style. This contrast quickly turns into a game of power and ego, where each man has to face his own demons and realities of the profession, while trying to carry out their joint mission.

programme.desc: In an apocalyptic world invaded by zombies, a small group of military and a scientist are trying to escape the dead and find a cure.
programme.desc-more: After a disaster that ravaged the planet and transformed the majority of the population into living dead, a handful of survivors gathered in a fortified shelter. Among them, Zoé, a brilliant medical student, collaborates with scientists to understand the origin of the scourge. While the military in the camp advocates the use of force to eliminate any threat, Zoe still believes in a scientific solution to stop the virus and save what remains of humanity.

programme.title: Dead Rising : Endgame
programme.desc: In the quarantine area east of Mission City, investigative journalist Chase Carter is to arrest a secret government plot.
programme.desc-more: In the city of East Mission, where the pandemic has turned the population into zombie hordes, the government has erected a quarantine wall to contain the epidemic and protect the rest of the world. Chase Carter (Jesse Metcalfe), a fearless investigative journalist, decided to enter this containment area to conduct a thorough investigation. Convinced that the brutal methods adopted by the authorities to eradicate the dead risk the death of innocent civilians, he sought to denounce that imminent catastrophe. In addition to his investigation into systematic violence, Chase is personally concerned: his colleague and friend, Jordan Blair (Marie Avgeropoulos), disappeared without leaving any trace. As he navigates through an unpredictable landscape populated by deadly dangers, he discovers disturbing truths and conspiracy that go beyond what he had imagined. To save the innocent, find Jordan and expose the truth, Chase will have to brave deadly clashes with zombies while facing government forces determined to protect their secrets, even at the cost of a bloodbath.

programme.title: The carrier - the series
programme.desc: Ferrara McIntyre, a popstar on a European tour, asks Frank to drive and protect her. Indeed, the young woman is threatened with death.
programme.desc-more: Frank Martin (Chris Vance), the famous "carrier", is back with a new associate, Caterina Boldieu. In this season full of twists, their first mission takes them into a perilous world, where they must escort the son of an Italian anti-mafia judge. The latter must testify at the trial of a notorious murderer, and the safety of the young man is paramount. As Frank strives to protect him, an American song star also seeks his services, putting him in the face of a formidable competition. Quickly, he realizes that other carriers compete with him, each one ready to do anything to take over. In parallel with his risky missions, Frank cannot help but look for the woman he loves, who disappeared under mysterious circumstances. This combination of protection, betrayal and personal research makes this series a veritable whirlwind of action and emotion, where loyalty and danger are associated at every moment.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: While a man is found dead, tied to a menhir, the police officers who investigate will bring out the buried traumas of Belle-Ile.
programme.desc-more: On a captivating journey through France, "Mothers to..." plunges spectators into the heart of regions rich in history and culture, where every murder revealed is intimately linked to a local legend or a landmark event. Each episode highlights a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, whose skills are not always limited to those of the law enforcement agencies. These characters, sometimes from a variety of backgrounds, mix their talents and perspectives to solve complex puzzles that shake local communities. As investigations, tensions and affinities develop, adding a romantic and human dimension to their investigations. Between police intrigues and cultural discoveries, this series will seduce polar lovers while immersing them in the French heritage, making each murder a mystery to be deciphered, and a story to tell.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: A commissioner investigates the death of a man, found hanged in a hangar. The murder seems to be a tragic event in the 1980s.
programme.desc-more: In this fourth season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque and varied landscapes of France become the scene of captivating police investigations, where every murder is intimately linked to local legends and traditions. Follow the adventures of a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, who launch in exciting investigations in Grasse, in the heart of the world of perfumers, where scents and secrets mix. In Strasbourg, they explore the wine world, where wine passion sometimes hides deadly rivalries. programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock learns that despite his intervention to give him a second chance, Shinwell continues to play the mole for the police in his former gang.
programme.desc-more: While Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are continuing their investigations in New York, their collaboration is being tested by unexpected reunions. Joan crosses the path of Shinwell Johnson, a former patient whose tumultuous journey leads him to seek his help. Determined to help her, she finds herself immersed in a complex world of loyalties and difficult choices. At the same time, Holmes faces an unexpected return from Kitty Winter, her former partner, who gives her a crucial warning about an imminent threat. In this climate of tension, Captain Gregson (Aidan Quinn) seeks to have the contributions of the two detectives recognized, adding a political dimension to their efforts. This fifth season, which celebrates the 100 episodes, further deepens the dynamics between Holmes and Watson, while exploring themes of redemption, danger and the impact of past choices.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock and Watson are investigating a ritual murder. The killer wanted to turn his victim into a mummy, a perfect replica of a famous artifact.
programme.desc-more: In New York, Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), an exceptionally brilliant but arrogant detective, is trying to reintegrate into the world of investigation after a difficult period of detoxification. Her father, concerned about her well-being, hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had become her mentor, to help her stay on the right path and avoid a relapse. As an unexpected partner, Joan finds herself navigating the complex universe of criminal investigations alongside Sherlock. Together, they solve thorny business using Holmes' sharp intuition and deducing talent, often confronted with puzzles that test their skills. The dynamics between the duo, with the feminization of Watson's character, bring a new dimension to this modern adaptation of Conan Doyle's works. The challenges they face reveal not only mysteries, but also the personal struggles and human relations that unite them.

programme.title: Elementary

programme.desc-more: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), the famous genius detective, faces a new challenge as he emerges from a period of detoxification. His willingness to resume service is complicated by his arrogance and unconventional methods. To help her navigate this delicate phase of her life, her father hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had taken a radical turn in her career. Joan, initially reluctant, is forced to follow Sherlock in his investigations, while juggling with his own demons and the pressure of a complex criminal world. Together, they form an unexpected duo, where Sherlock's relentless logic confronts Joan's intuition and sensitivity. As they resolve mysterious affairs in New York, their relationship evolves, mixing tension, respect and a touch of friendship, while revealing each other's flaws and wounds.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In Sarlat-la-Canedas, the son of a Confit producer was murdered during a ritual recalling the historical events of the 17th century In order to investigate, the commander Claire Dalmas of the Bordeaux research section is obliged to return to her childhood town, which she has been fleeing for 20 years from working with gendarmerie captain Eric Pavin, with whom she was in contact and whose news she had no more. Between rurality, history and craziness, the duo will have to show ingenuity and patience to solve a case that is definitely not Claire's taste,
programme.desc-more: Murders to... is a captivating police series that plunges viewers into the enigmatic universe of criminal investigations in the heart of French regions. Each episode takes us to a distinct place, rich in history and local legends, where the past resurfaces in a often tragic and bloody way. In every investigation, horrific crimes seem to resonate with historical events, legends or myths rooted in the collective memory of the inhabitants. The series examines how these ancient narratives can influence the present, while buried secrets resurface, leading the protagonists into a real nightmare. The series follows a group of determined investigators, ready to elucidate these dark mysteries. Their expertise, accompanied by an analytical and human approach, prompts them to interview not only suspects, but also witnesses and residents, always in search of hidden truths. In addition to their investigative skills, they must navigate through tense interpersonal dynamics and the emotional impact of crimes on the community. Investigators also face moral dilemmas, wondering how far they are prepared to go to unearth the truth.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: While Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are continuing their investigations in New York, their collaboration is being tested by unexpected reunions. Joan crosses the path of Shinwell Johnson, a former patient whose tumultuous journey leads him to seek his help. Determined to help her, she finds herself immersed in a complex world of loyalties and difficult choices. At the same time, Holmes faces an unexpected return from Kitty Winter, her former partner, who gives her a crucial warning about an imminent threat. In this climate of tension, Captain Gregson (Aidan Quinn) seeks to have the contributions of the two detectives recognized, adding a political dimension to their efforts. This fifth season, which celebrates the 100 episodes, further deepens the dynamics between Holmes and Watson, while exploring themes of redemption, danger and the impact of past choices.
programme.desc-more: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are called upon to investigate a shocking double murder when the bodies sifted with two twins are found in a New York apartment. The brothers, one of whom had been adopted, had recently regained their family ties through a website. As they dive into the details of this complex affair, Sherlock and Joan discover a network of family scams and secrets that could explain the tragedy. In parallel with this investigation, Sherlock offers his father, a man with whom he has a tense relationship, to assist him in his affairs, hoping to convince him to leave New York. This dynamic father-son adds a layer of personal tension to the plot, while Sherlock navigates between his professional obligations and family conflicts, revealing the challenges behind his sharp intellect.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: In New York, Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), an exceptionally brilliant but arrogant detective, is trying to reintegrate into the world of investigation after a difficult period of detoxification. Her father, concerned about her well-being, hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had become her mentor, to help her stay on the right path and avoid a relapse. As an unexpected partner, Joan finds herself navigating the complex universe of criminal investigations alongside Sherlock. Together, they solve thorny business using Holmes' sharp intuition and deducing talent, often confronted with puzzles that test their skills. The dynamics between the duo, with the feminization of Watson's character, bring a new dimension to this modern adaptation of Conan Doyle's works. The challenges they face reveal not only mysteries, but also the personal struggles and human relations that unite them.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), the famous genius detective, faces a new challenge as he emerges from a period of detoxification. His willingness to resume service is complicated by his arrogance and unconventional methods. To help her navigate this delicate phase of her life, her father hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had taken a radical turn in her career. Joan, initially reluctant, is forced to follow Sherlock in his investigations, while juggling with his own demons and the pressure of a complex criminal world. Together, they form an unexpected duo, where Sherlock's relentless logic confronts Joan's intuition and sensitivity. As they resolve mysterious affairs in New York, their relationship evolves, mixing tension, respect and a touch of friendship, while revealing each other's flaws and wounds.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Five victims fall under the bullets of a sniper who is ambushed, methodical and ruthless. The evidence, overwhelming, quickly identified a former military officer, James Barr, as the perpetrator of the murders. Arrested and imprisoned, he refuses any collaboration with the police... until he scratches a enigmatic message on a piece of paper: "Find Jack Reacher". Thus, Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise), a former military police officer as mysterious as he is intransigent, whose reputation as a lonely vigilante precedes every step. Without a fixed home or attachment, Reacher lives on the margins of the rules, guided by an inflexible moral code and a formidable ability to untie the most complex sons of criminal affairs. When he arrives in the small town still in shock, his objective is clear: to understand why his name was invoked by a man accused of a massacre. But the more it digs, the thicker the shades. The testimonies contradict each other, the evidence seems too perfect, and a fabric of obscure interests is emerging around the case, involving powerful figures ready to do anything to stifle the truth.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: A decade after Jason Bourne (Matt Damon) disappeared from the CIA radars, leaving behind his turbulent past as a murderer. After spending ten years fleeing his old life and the demons accompanying him, Bourne strives to regain peace and understand the mysteries of his identity. However, his former mentor, Robert Dewey, director of the CIA, cannot help but consider him a residual threat and, eager to bring him back to order, hires Heather Lee, a hacker and counter-insurgency specialist, to find Bourne. As information on Bourne's past began to emerge, he found himself trained in a real game of cat and mouse, with CIA agents on his tracks determined to neutralize him. Tension rises as those who have formed it still consider it one of their most dangerous creations, while Bourne begins to make disturbing discoveries about the hidden truths that link his past to secret CIA operations.

programme.title: The Big Heads

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In this fourth season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque and varied landscapes of France become the scene of captivating police investigations, where every murder is intimately linked to local legends and traditions. Follow the adventures of a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, who launch in exciting investigations in Grasse, in the heart of the world of perfumers, where scents and secrets mix. In Strasbourg, they explore the wine world, where wine passion sometimes hides deadly rivalries. Other investigations lead them to Dunkirk, where the mysteries of the northern coasts are revealed, and Martinique, on the sides of the majestic Pelee Mountain, where local culture and ancestral beliefs reveal disturbing truths. Each episode offers a mixture of suspense, regional culture and human drama, enriching intrigue with authentic elements.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In this new season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque landscapes of France become the scene of captivating criminal mysteries, where every investigation is intimately linked to the cultural heritage and local traditions. The protagonists, Fauve Hautot and Aurelien Wiik, find themselves immersed in the heart of sordid business that reveal the buried secrets of their region. Every murder is anchored in a legend or a building full of history, thus revealing the dark facets of French heritage. The spectators follow these experienced investigators as they navigate between folklore and criminal investigation, digging up sometimes disturbing truths. The appearances of iconic figures such as Line Renaud, Samuel Labarthe, Francis Huster and Olivier Marchal add dramatic depth to the intrigues, enriching the story of their talent and charisma. This season promises a fascinating exploration of local mysteries, between dramatic tensions and unexpected revelations.

programme.desc-more: Murders to... is a captivating police series that plunges viewers into the enigmatic universe of criminal investigations in the heart of French regions. Each episode takes us to a distinct place, rich in history and local legends, where the past resurfaces in a often tragic and bloody way. In every investigation, horrific crimes seem to resonate with historical events, legends or myths rooted in the collective memory of the inhabitants. The series examines how these ancient narratives can influence the present, while buried secrets resurface, leading the protagonists into a real nightmare. The series follows a group of determined investigators, ready to elucidate these dark mysteries. Their expertise, accompanied by an analytical and human approach, prompts them to interview not only suspects, but also witnesses and residents, always in search of hidden truths. In addition to their investigative skills, they must navigate through tense interpersonal dynamics and the emotional impact of crimes on the community. Investigators also face moral dilemmas, wondering how far they are prepared to go to unearth the truth.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: While Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are continuing their investigations in New York, their collaboration is being tested by unexpected reunions. Joan crosses the path of Shinwell Johnson, a former patient whose tumultuous journey leads him to seek his help. Determined to help her, she finds herself immersed in a complex world of loyalties and difficult choices. At the same time, Holmes faces an unexpected return from Kitty Winter, her former partner, who gives her a crucial warning about an imminent threat. In this climate of tension, Captain Gregson (Aidan Quinn) seeks to have the contributions of the two detectives recognized, adding a political dimension to their efforts. This fifth season, which celebrates the 100 episodes, further deepens the dynamics between Holmes and Watson, while exploring themes of redemption, danger and the impact of past choices.
programme.desc-more: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are called upon to investigate a shocking double murder when the bodies sifted with two twins are found in a New York apartment. The brothers, one of whom had been adopted, had recently regained their family ties through a website. As they dive into the details of this complex affair, Sherlock and Joan discover a network of family scams and secrets that could explain the tragedy. In parallel with this investigation, Sherlock offers his father, a man with whom he has a tense relationship, to assist him in his affairs, hoping to convince him to leave New York. This dynamic father-son adds a layer of personal tension to the plot, while Sherlock navigates between his professional obligations and family conflicts, revealing the challenges behind his sharp intellect.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: In New York, Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), an exceptionally brilliant but arrogant detective, is trying to reintegrate into the world of investigation after a difficult period of detoxification. Her father, concerned about her well-being, hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had become her mentor, to help her stay on the right path and avoid a relapse. As an unexpected partner, Joan finds herself navigating the complex universe of criminal investigations alongside Sherlock. Together, they solve thorny business using Holmes' sharp intuition and deducing talent, often confronted with puzzles that test their skills. The dynamics between the duo, with the feminization of Watson's character, bring a new dimension to this modern adaptation of Conan Doyle's works. The challenges they face reveal not only mysteries, but also the personal struggles and human relations that unite them.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: In New York, Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), an exceptionally brilliant but arrogant detective, is trying to reintegrate into the world of investigation after a difficult period of detoxification. Her father, concerned about her well-being, hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had become her mentor, to help her stay on the right path and avoid a relapse. As an unexpected partner, Joan finds herself navigating the complex universe of criminal investigations alongside Sherlock. Together, they solve thorny business using Holmes' sharp intuition and deducing talent, often confronted with puzzles that test their skills. The dynamics between the duo, with the feminization of Watson's character, bring a new dimension to this modern adaptation of Conan Doyle's works. The challenges they face reveal not only mysteries, but also the personal struggles and human relations that unite them.

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: Depressive teachers, stressed parents and school children in the moon try to survive the horrors and joys of daily life in school. Relationships intertwine for the best and often for the worst!
programme.desc-more: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: A policeman, infiltrated into a criminal organization, is murdered during an ambush by two mysterious killers. Terzani and Rex are investigating.
programme.desc-more: In a world where crime reigns in control, a police officer (Francesco Arca) infiltrates a notorious criminal organization, determined to collect crucial information to dismantle this network. As he is immersed, he gains the confidence of the members, while juggling with the constant danger surrounding him. As he approaches his goal, his identity is compromised and he becomes the target of an ambush orchestrated by two mysterious killers. These murderers, with obscure motives, prove to be dreaded figures in the middle. The policeman, aware that every movement can cost him his life, desperately tries to escape. Tension rises as he navigates between loyalty and betrayal, while seeking to protect his loved ones from the consequences of his investigation. In this game of cat and mouse, the line between good and evil blurs, allowing for an explosive outcome.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: A man, a senior official in a post office, was murdered at his home. Terzani and Rex first question the victim's ex-wife.
programme.desc-more: In a quiet neighbourhood, the life of a senior post office official takes a tragic turn when he is found murdered at home. Inspector Terzani and his faithful companion Rex, a German shepherd with an exceptional flair, are embarking on a complex investigation that plunges them into the vic's privacy. By questioning the man's ex-wife, the investigators discover a woman tormented by separation and bitterness, who could hide unaccustomed secrets. While Terzani and Rex search the evidence left at the crime scene, they meet with colleagues from the victim and family members, each with their own underlying motivations and tensions. The atmosphere is becoming more and more intense as revelations accumulate, and the team must navigate between lies and truths to expose the culprit, while facing unexpected emotional challenges.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: A man, recognized as a master in seduction and organizing courses to help shy men overcome their difficulties, is stabbed.
programme.desc-more: Antonio Tassinari, nicknamed Excel, is a charismatic man and expert in seduction, recognized for his innovative methods that help shy men overcome their relationship complexes. His life took a tragic turn when he was found stabbed in his apartment, leaving behind a series of questions. Rex, the exceptional detective dog with flair, and his faithful partner Terzani, are embarking on a complex investigation to discover the circumstances of his death. As they investigate, they meet a range of characters, ranging from former Excel students, who have benefited from his courses, to rivals jealous of his success. Each testimony reveals a hidden facet of man, while secrets of his past resurface. Rex and Terzani must unravel the true of the false in a world where seduction can prove fatal, while navigating in the intrigues and passions that surround the life of Excel.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Blew by the premature death of his wife, Andreas Mitterer learns that he will have a new partner, who is none other than a dog, named Rex.
programme.desc-more: Andreas Mitterer, police commissioner in Merano, finds himself deeply saddened after the tragic loss of his wife. As he struggles to overcome his grief and find meaning in his life, he receives unexpected news: a new teammate will join his team. To his surprise, he is a police dog named Rex, renowned for his outstanding detection skills. Despite his initial scepticism, Andreas began to establish a connection with Rex, which turned out to be more than just a pet. Together, they must navigate a series of criminal cases that shake the region, while learning to work in tandem. As Andreas gradually recovers from his grief, Rex becomes a precious ally, helping him rediscover hope and joy in living through their thrilling investigations and their nascent friendship.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: The key witness of a major trial is found dead. Lupo and Bernard understand that this whole affair plunges them into a detestable conspiracy.

Fortunately, Cutter is watching the grain and altercations are not uncommon in McCoy's office. After 20 seasons, "New York Judicial Police" drew his reverence, leaving behind her a rosary of spin-off and adaptations abroad, including "Paris, criminal investigations" with Vincent Pérez.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: Created by a secret organization in the Cold War in the Soviet Union, a team of four superheroes faces many challenges.
programme.desc-more: In the 1940s, in the midst of the Cold War, the Soviet Union set up an ambitious genetic engineering program led by Professor Viktor Dobronravov. This secret project aims to create superhuman beings by performing bold experiments on human and animal subjects. While the professor is working to develop extraordinary abilities in his subjects, his rival, Dr August Kuratov, is working on the Patriot project, which involves the creation of a universal teleguiding device, Module 1. However, a tragic incident occurs during an experiment, causing an explosion that turns Kuratov into a powerful mutant. With disproportionate powers and a thirst for revenge, he escapes control, threatening the already fragile balance of the country. The authorities, aware of the danger of Kuratov, decided to intervene and to bring together a team of former experimental subjects to arrest him, resulting in an explosive confrontation between the dark creatures and the forces of law and order.

programme.title: xXx : Reactivated
programme.desc: With his team of warriors, an extreme sports specialist must take over an aircraft, which controls military satellites, stolen by the criminals.
programme.desc-more: As he recruited new agents from a lively New York restaurant, Agent Augustus Gibbons (Samuel L. Jackson) suddenly fell into chaos when a satellite crashed nearby. This cataclysmic event marks the beginning of a series of attacks orchestrated by a gang of daring thieves who succeed in infiltrating CIA premises. Their goal: to take over Pandora's box, a high-tech device capable of controlling all military satellites. In the face of this threat, Jane Marke (Toni Collette), the agency's director, decides to appeal to Xander Cage (Vin Diesel), a former Gibbons recruit, who now lives a quiet life in the Dominican Republic. Forced to return to the front of the stage, Xander embarked on a perilous mission to get Pandora's box back. He will be assisted by a diverse team of experts, including the formidable Serena Unger (Deepika Padukone) and the elite fighter Xiang (Donnie Yen), who must join forces to counter the plans of the thieves and avoid a global catastrophe.

programme.title: Kickboxer
programme.desc: An American karateka, who trains intensively, seeks revenge for his brother, who was terrified in a very unloyal fight in Thailand.
programme.desc-more: A Thai boxing champion, Eric is seriously injured by treachery in a fight. His younger brother, Kurt, decided to avenge him. He went to the old Xian Chow to learn martial arts. Mylee, the master's niece, falls in deep love with him. But the young man only thinks of his revenge and the fight that will oppose him to the winner of his brother. At the same time, the underworld is trying to fix the game.

programme.title: Mercury Code
programme.desc: A child with autism manages to decode the CIA's protection system, immediately drawing the attention of a few ill-intentioned killers.
programme.desc-more: In the ruthless world of secret services, where every mistake can cost a career – or a life –, Art Jeffries (Bruce Willis), a senior FBI agent, has had better days. After a failure during a delicate operation, he was relegated to minor missions, far from the important business. But when a case as mysterious as it is urgent lands on his desk, Jeffries understands that it may be his last chance to make up for it. His new mission: to protect Simon, a young autistic boy whose parents have just been murdered in troubled circumstances. What seems at first glance a simple case of witness protection quickly takes a much darker turn. Simon, despite his handicap which the outer world cup, has an exceptional cognitive capacity. Without knowing it, he decrypted an ultra-secret code, information so sensitive that it now attracts the worst predators. Unscrupulous killers, willing to do anything to eliminate the child and anyone who dares to get in their way. Jeffries then found himself plunged into a race against time, hunted by invisible but omnipresent enemies, whose resources and determination seemed boundless. To complicate things, Simon, overwhelmed by a hostile environment and stimuli that he cannot control, struggle to communicate, making Jeffries' task all the more arduous.

The murder weapon belongs to Daniel Griffon, a friend of the girl's. The young man was very unstable and convinced that his father, John Griffin, who had disappeared in a car accident, had been murdered.
programme.desc-more: Inspector Lewis (2006)
programme.desc: Inspector Lewis (2006)

programme.title: Inspector Lewis
programme.desc: Detective Lewis and Sergeant Hataway are being called to a crime scene. Dean Greely's body was discovered near a barge. At that time, this former student from Oxford University was part of the sons of the resurrection, a secret circle of pleasures of life. He had in his possession the list of the other members of the circle: Theodore Platt, Harry Bundrick and Sefton Linn. The three men seem to be hiding information from the police. A few days later Linn was murdered. Lewis finds out he was a victim of blackmail.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: While the big finance and dirty politicians cases are still on the agenda for Lupo and Bernard, the two police officers also regularly find themselves in the New York lowlands: a polygamous sect, clandestine street fighting, an illegal adoption route, the Russian mafia and a serial killer who is elusive: these are the cases the team is facing this year. As the next season, this 19th season is one of the few to stage an unchanged distribution: an opportunity to change the relationships between the characters and to deepen exciting legal controversies.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.title: xXx : Reactivated
programme.desc: As he recruited new agents from a lively New York restaurant, Agent Augustus Gibbons (Samuel L. Jackson) suddenly fell into chaos when a satellite crashed nearby. This cataclysmic event marks the beginning of a series of attacks orchestrated by a gang of daring thieves who succeed in infiltrating CIA premises. Their goal: to take over Pandora's box, a high-tech device capable of controlling all military satellites. In the face of this threat, Jane Marke (Toni Collette), the agency's director, decides to appeal to Xander Cage (Vin Diesel), a former Gibbons recruit, who now lives a quiet life in the Dominican Republic. Forced to return to the front of the stage, Xander embarked on a perilous mission to get Pandora's box back. He will be assisted by a diverse team of experts, including the formidable Serena Unger (Deepika Padukone) and the elite fighter Xiang (Donnie Yen), who must join forces to counter the plans of the thieves and avoid a global catastrophe.

programme.title: Kickboxer
programme.desc: A Thai boxing champion, Eric is seriously injured by treachery in a fight. His younger brother, Kurt, decided to avenge him. He went to the old Xian Chow to learn martial arts. Mylee, the master's niece, falls in deep love with him. But the young man only thinks of his revenge and the fight that will oppose him to the winner of his brother. At the same time, the underworld is trying to fix the game.

programme.title: Mercury Code
programme.desc: In the ruthless world of secret services, where every mistake can cost a career – or a life –, Art Jeffries (Bruce Willis), a senior FBI agent, has had better days. After a failure during a delicate operation, he was relegated to minor missions, far from the important business. But when a case as mysterious as it is urgent lands on his desk, Jeffries understands that it may be his last chance to make up for it. His new mission: to protect Simon, a young autistic boy whose parents have just been murdered in troubled circumstances. What seems at first glance a simple case of witness protection quickly takes a much darker turn. Simon, despite his handicap which the outer world cup, has an exceptional cognitive capacity. Without knowing it, he decrypted an ultra-secret code, information so sensitive that it now attracts the worst predators. Unscrupulous killers, willing to do anything to eliminate the child and anyone who dares to get in their way. Jeffries then found himself plunged into a race against time, hunted by invisible but omnipresent enemies, whose resources and determination seemed boundless. To complicate things, Simon, overwhelmed by a hostile environment and stimuli that he cannot control, struggle to communicate, making Jeffries' task all the more arduous.

programme.title: Sphere
programme.desc: Norman, a psychologist, joins a group of scientists on a platform at sea. Under close surveillance of a secret service agent, he finds there Beth Halperin, his former companion, a biochemist, Harry Adams, a mathematician, and Ted Fielding, a young astrophysicist. Their mission, to study an immense ship that military personnel found, failed by three thousand meters of bottom.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In the heart of the "Magicland" amusement park, Terzani, Rex and Monterosso are about to enjoy a relaxing day, far from the hassle of their profession. However, the party turns into a drama when a dancer, star of one of the shows, is found murdered in disturbing circumstances. The police are rapidly plunged into a world of rivalries and jealousy, exploring tensions between dancers and stuntmen, each having its own reasons to want to see the other fail. As the investigation progresses, attention is turned to Massimo Forghieri, the park's director, whose sluggish affairs, including amphetamine trafficking, raise many questions. Yet, the mystery becomes thick when elements of the past resurface, revealing a series of tragic events that left indelible scars. The protagonists quickly realize that the truth, much more complex than it seems, may well involve long-sought secrets and unexpected links between victims and suspects.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In a world where crime reigns in control, a police officer (Francesco Arca) infiltrates a notorious criminal organization, determined to collect crucial information to dismantle this network. As he is immersed, he gains the confidence of the members, while juggling with the constant danger surrounding him. As he approaches his goal, his identity is compromised and he becomes the target of an ambush orchestrated by two mysterious killers. These murderers, with obscure motives, prove to be dreaded figures in the middle. The policeman, aware that every movement can cost him his life, desperately tries to escape. Tension rises as he navigates between loyalty and betrayal, while seeking to protect his loved ones from the consequences of his investigation. In this game of cat and mouse, the line between good and evil blurs, allowing for an explosive outcome.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In a quiet neighbourhood, the life of a senior post office official takes a tragic turn when he is found murdered at home. Inspector Terzani and his faithful companion Rex, a German shepherd with an exceptional flair, are embarking on a complex investigation that plunges them into the vic's privacy. By questioning the man's ex-wife, the investigators discover a woman tormented by separation and bitterness, who could hide unaccustomed secrets. While Terzani and Rex search the evidence left at the crime scene, they meet with colleagues from the victim and family members, each with their own underlying motivations and tensions. The atmosphere is becoming more and more intense as revelations accumulate, and the team must navigate between lies and truths to expose the culprit, while facing unexpected emotional challenges.

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.
programme.desc-more: In a school where the ordinary meets the extraordinary, the daily life takes place between laughter and tears. Teachers, like Mr. Moreau (Rayane Bensetti), try to maintain order in a class of schoolboys who are disinclined and dreaming. Outside the classroom, parents, stressed by the demands of education, struggle to give their children the best while facing their own doubts. Students, represented by characters such as Clara (Caroline Anglade) and Hugo (Morgan Bontemps), navigate between tumultuous friendships and first love emodies, while facing the challenges of adolescence. In the corridors and in the canteen, the intrigues are formed and concluded, revealing unexpected alliances and palpable rivalries. Every day at school is a microcosm of the joys and sorrows of life, where each interaction can lead to significant discoveries about oneself and others.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Andreas Mitterer, police commissioner in Merano, finds himself deeply saddened after the tragic loss of his wife. As he struggles to overcome his grief and find meaning in his life, he receives unexpected news: a new teammate will join his team. To his surprise, he is a police dog named Rex, renowned for his outstanding detection skills. Despite his initial scepticism, Andreas began to establish a connection with Rex, which turned out to be more than just a pet. Together, they must navigate a series of criminal cases that shake the region, while learning to work in tandem. As Andreas gradually recovers from his grief, Rex becomes a precious ally, helping him rediscover hope and joy in living through their thrilling investigations and their nascent friendship.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In a new working environment, Terzani and Rex, the famous police duo, are assigned to a police station headed by the rigorous Annamaria Fiori. Soon they find themselves immersed in an intriguing investigation that defies conventions. Indeed, a series of mysterious murders sow terror in the city, and the clues point to an unexpected culprit: a dog. While investigators are trying to break the mystery behind these crimes, they must navigate a network of secrets and lies. Each leads to reluctant witnesses and suspects with obscure motivations, while the apparently aggressive behaviour of the animal raises many questions. Terzani and Rex will have to be insightful and intuitive in order to unravel this disturbing affair, proving once again that appearances can be misleading in the world of crime.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Guido Lorenzo (Francesco Arca), a fast-growing entrepreneur, is caught in a whirlwind of tragic events after a night with a luxury prostitute. The next morning, he discovered with horror that the young woman had been found dead in mysterious circumstances. The investigators, led by Rex's unwavering team, are quickly plunged into a complex investigation. The first clues lead them to a top-down sports club, where appearances are often misleading and secrets well guarded. As the investigators interview the club members, they realize that the victim had links with influential personalities, revealing a network of corruption and debauchery. Tensions are rising as Guido, suspected of having deeper links with crime, must prove his innocence while seeking to understand the truths hidden behind this vicious circle. Each revelation brings them a little closer to the heart of the riddle, where loyalty and betrayal are mixed dangerously.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: As he gets ready to go out to seek food for his faithful companion Rex, Inspector Terzani (Francesco Arca) suddenly finds himself kidnapped by a mysterious kidnapper. Terzani's worrying disappearance soon aroused the concern of Rex, who, faithful to his master, began to search the premises for clues. Noting Terzani's absence and alarmed by the situation, Monterosso (Giovanni Calcagno), a colleague from Terzani, decided to immediately launch the search to find his friend. The investigators quickly discover that the kidnapper, a man named Tarantini, has just served a prison sentence. Tensions are rising as Monterosso and his team try to uncover Tarantini's motivations and identify the places where he might have taken Terzani. In a race against the clock, Rex and Monterosso must unite their forces to save Terzani before it is too late.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: The personal problems of the protagonists interfere with their work. Van Buren announces his health problems to his team while McCoy presents himself to his own estate. Rubirosa confesses her past relationship with a corrupt magistrate. But in the meantime, the crime doesn't stop in New York. The temptation is therefore great to compromise with principles. Fortunately, Cutter is watching the grain and altercations are not uncommon in McCoy's office. After 20 seasons, "New York Judicial Police" drew his reverence, leaving behind her a rosary of spin-off and adaptations abroad, including "Paris, criminal investigations" with Vincent Pérez.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: After Jamie Ross's resignation, who preferred to find a job more compatible with his family life, Abbie Carmichael made her debut at the prosecutor's office. She is a former narcotics officer and is familiar with the mafia and drug dealers that Briscoe and Curtis face daily, even though she sometimes underestimates the threats that the underworld is putting on her loved ones. His conservative ideas, in a manner that is more progressive in Schiff and McCoy's mind, will be tested in a rape case. The introduction of this character allows this 9th season to strongly reflect ideological bipolarity in American society.

Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: After Jamie Ross's resignation, who preferred to find a job more compatible with his family life, Abbie Carmichael made her debut at the prosecutor's office. She is a former narcotics officer and is familiar with the mafia and drug dealers that Briscoe and Curtis face daily, even though she sometimes underestimates the threats that the underworld is putting on her loved ones. His conservative ideas, in a manner that is more progressive in Schiff and McCoy's mind, will be tested in a rape case. The introduction of this character allows this 9th season to strongly reflect ideological bipolarity in American society.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Captain Montgomery died, and Beckett, shot and wounded, underwent a major operation. She's safe and sound, but a priori amnesia because she doesn't remember Castle telling her she's a flame. Her health is improving from day to day and she eventually returns to the service, without immediately feeling able to return to the field. With Castle, she is still retracing her mother's killer, Castle's great dam, who is worried about her. In the fourth season, Lanie and Esposito split up, as did Alexis and his boyfriend, Ashley, while Ryan married his fiancée, Jenny. And Alexis, who grew up, is about to enter college, and is more interested in his father's work with the police.
programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: David, a respected police officer, and his partner Cal, are on a mission to dismantle a network of drug dealers. In an intervention, their plan went wrong when Jean and Violet, a couple of desperate drug addicts, opened fire, seriously wounding David. Cal, determined to save his partner, is pursuing the fugitives who have fled to an isolated farm. This shelter belongs to Eric, a former veteran of the army haunted by his demons. Despite his own internal struggles, Eric agrees to help Cal, aware that the situation is desperate. However, tension rises when the head of the cartel, accompanied by his men, bursts into the farm, taking David as a hostage. Between loyalty, sacrifice and the shadow of the violence that is hovering, Cal and Eric will have to join forces to try to get out of this deadly battlefield and save David before it is too late.

programme.title: Out of Death
programme.desc: Shannon (Lala Kent), a photographer, ventures into an isolated mountainous region to capture the beauty of the landscape. While she immortalizes nature, she is witness to a terrible scene: the murder of a man disarmed by a corrupt policeman. Panic, Shannon understands that she has crucial evidence and that her life is now in danger. The local sheriff, a man with dark intentions, is mobilizing his men to track down the young woman and recover any witness to this crime. In his escape, Shannon crossed the path of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis), a vacation inspector, who, aware of the seriousness of the situation, decided to help him. Together, they must navigate through a network of corruption and violence, while seeking to break the truth. Their struggle for justice will plunge them into a deadly game where every decision can be fatal.

programme.title: The nun
programme.desc: In a private school in Romania, a group of six young women are subjected to the tyranny of a ruthless nun, whose methods of discipline are as cruel as they are worrying. When one of them, who is being abused, finds herself pregnant, the nun, in an act of "purification", decides to torture her to atone for her alleged sin. Her friends, horrified, intervene to try to save their comrade, but the situation quickly becomes chaotic. Shortly afterwards, the nun mysteriously disappeared and the establishment closed its doors, leaving behind a heavy past. Seventeen years later, the return of two of the former students, now adults, is accompanied by the discovery of lifeless bodies, reviving traumatic memories. Accompanied by the daughter of their murdered friend, they return to school to face the demons of their past and the reappearance of this nun avengeess, ready to charge the price of their secrets.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Commissioner Marco Terzani and his faithful German shepherd Rex are investigating a series of criminal cases in Rome. Murders, poisoning, sports scandals, mysterious communities and family rivalries put the team to a tough test. Thanks to his unusual instincts, Rex helps reveal the truth behind increasingly complex investigations. A 16 season that gives Francesco Arca his chance in the role of Commissioner Marco Terzani.
programme.desc-more: In a quiet neighbourhood, the life of a senior post office official takes a tragic turn when he is found murdered at home. Inspector Terzani and his faithful companion Rex, a German shepherd with an exceptional flair, are embarking on a complex investigation that plunges them into the vic's privacy. By questioning the man's ex-wife, the investigators discover a woman tormented by separation and bitterness, who could hide unaccustomed secrets. While Terzani and Rex search the evidence left at the crime scene, they meet with colleagues from the victim and family members, each with their own underlying motivations and tensions. The atmosphere is becoming more and more intense as revelations accumulate, and the team must navigate between lies and truths to expose the culprit, while facing unexpected emotional challenges.

programme.desc-more: Antonio Tassinari, nicknamed Excel, is a charismatic man and expert in seduction, recognized for his innovative methods that help shy men overcome their relationship complexes. His life took a tragic turn when he was found stabbed in his apartment, leaving behind a series of questions. Rex, the exceptional detective dog with flair, and his faithful partner Terzani, are embarking on a complex investigation to discover the circumstances of his death. As they investigate, they meet a range of characters, ranging from former Excel students, who have benefited from his courses, to rivals jealous of his success. Each testimony reveals a hidden facet of man, while secrets of his past resurface. Rex and Terzani must unravel the true of the false in a world where seduction can prove fatal, while navigating in the intrigues and passions that surround the life of Excel.

programme.desc-more: Andreas Mitterer, police commissioner in Merano, finds himself deeply saddened after the tragic loss of his wife. As he struggles to overcome his grief and find meaning in his life, he receives unexpected news: a new teammate will join his team. To his surprise, he is a police dog named Rex, renowned for his outstanding detection skills. Despite his initial scepticism, Andreas began to establish a connection with Rex, which turned out to be more than just a pet. Together, they must navigate a series of criminal cases that shake the region, while learning to work in tandem. As Andreas gradually recovers from his grief, Rex becomes a precious ally, helping him rediscover hope and joy in living through their thrilling investigations and their nascent friendship.

programme.title: Capucine
programme.desc: In a world where conversations are mixed with bursts of laughter and sincere reflections, Capucine (Barbara Bolotner) stands out for her sparkling personality and unique vision of life. With her AirPods well in her ears, she juggles phone calls with tasty anecdotes, revealing the complexities and sweetness of family relationships. Each exchange is an opportunity for Capucine to express her bold point of view, whether it is the dynamics of her own family or the stories she hears around her. Her frankness and impertinent humour make her an ideal confidant, able to transform ordinary moments into memorable memories. Through his reflections, Capucine invites us to explore the subtleties of family life, to laugh at the most cunning situations and to embrace the challenges with lightness and wisdom, while also building authentic ties with those around him.

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: Whether you teach, study or drop your offspring there every morning, the school leaves no one indifferent.
programme.desc-more: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.

Every day at school is a microcosm of the joys and sorrows of life, where each interaction can lead to significant discoveries about oneself and others.

At that time, this former student from Oxford University was part of the sons of the resurrection, a secret circle of pleasures of life. He had in his possession the list of the other members of the circle: Theodore Platt, Harry Bundrick and Sefton Linn. The three men seem to be hiding information from the police. A few days later Linn was murdered. Lewis finds out he was a victim of blackmail.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: While the big finance and dirty politicians cases are still on the agenda for Lupo and Bernard, the two police officers also regularly find themselves in the New York lowlands: a polygamous sect, clandestine street fighting, an illegal adoption route, the Russian mafia and a serial killer who is elusive: these are the cases the team is facing this year. programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: In the oppressive darkness of a tunnel connecting Manhattan to New Jersey, an unexpected catastrophe is emerging. A truck carrying toxic waste explodes, causing a devastating detonation that blocks both tunnel entrances. As chaos and the relief teams are facing a stalemate, hope seems to be getting smaller. Kit Latura (Sylvester Stallone), a former head of the New York Samu, is then faced with a moral and professional dilemma. Witness of the tragedy, he feels the call of duty and decides to brave the dangers in order to try to save the victims trapped inside. In a hostile environment where smoke and panic reign, Latura must navigate through the rubble and failing ventilation systems, while facing its own inner demons. As the minutes pass, the stakes become increasingly critical. Kit Latura faces unforeseen obstacles, both physical and psychological, as he strives to carry out a rescue mission that could change the fate of many innocent people. Tensions are rising, and every second counts in this fierce struggle against the clock and the elements.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: A bookstore is found dead, tortured in his shop. The killer seems to have been looking for an object. Jane first looks at the victim's safe.
programme.desc-more: In Boston, Inspector Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), known for her frankness and determination, is working with Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), a medical examiner with a mysterious past and rigorous analytical methods. Despite their differences in style and personality, these two women form an unlikely but complementary duo, joining forces to resolve complex criminal cases. Jane, with her intuitive approach and sharpened instinct, often has to temper Maura's scientific analyses and sometimes too academic conclusions. Together, they navigate a world where violence and mystery mix, facing twisted suspects and disconcerting puzzles. As the surveys progress, their relationship evolves, revealing not only the challenges of their profession, but also the facets of their personal lives. Between thrilling intrigues and moments of camaraderie, Rizzoli and Isles demonstrate that friendship can arise from the most unexpected situations.

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dead in a disused hangar, the entire Orthodox Jewish community in Strasbourg is in mourning. Is this an anti-Semitic crime?
programme.desc-more: In Strasbourg, a tragic tragedy shakes the Orthodox Jewish community when the lifeless body of a young woman is discovered in a hangar. Inspector Caesar Wagner (Gil Alma) and his team are called upon to investigate this disturbing murder. While the first leads seem to rule out the hypothesis of an anti-Semitic act, the investigation plunges investigators into the meandering of a welded community where tradition and modernity clash. As they investigate, they meet with members of the community, including respected figures and relatives of the victim, who reveal hidden tensions and well-kept secrets. Caesar Wagner must navigate carefully between beliefs and customs, while trying to understand the real motivations behind this crime. In this delicate context, he strives to unravel the sons of a complex intrigue that challenges the very notion of loyalty and justice within a community seeking truth.

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: Marie-Ange Wagner, Mayor of Strasbourg and mother of Caesar, married Christian Haas. As the party is full in a castle, a corpse is found in a cold room.
programme.desc-more: César Wagner (Gil Alma), inspector in Strasbourg, finds himself in a real puzzle when he arrives late at the marriage of his mother, Marie-Ange, the mayor of the city. The ceremony, which takes place in a sumptuous castle, takes a tragic turn when a corpse is discovered in a cold room, plunging the festivities into chaos. The situation is complicated when Caesar and his team have to navigate a network of lies and secrets, as the main suspects are all linked to the organizing company of the event. Victoire Haas, the daughter of the groom Christian Haas (Florent Peyre), turns out to be the director of the company, adding a layer of tension and personal dilemmas to the investigation. In a context of loyalty and betrayal, Caesar must act with discretion to expose the culprit, while preserving the integrity of his family and the honour of his mother.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: In Boston, Inspector Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), known for her frankness and determination, is working with Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), a medical examiner with a mysterious past and rigorous analytical methods. Despite their differences in style and personality, these two women form an unlikely but complementary duo, joining forces to resolve complex criminal cases. Jane, with her intuitive approach and sharpened instinct, often has to temper Maura's scientific analyses and sometimes too academic conclusions. Together, they navigate a world where violence and mystery mix, facing twisted suspects and disconcerting puzzles. As the surveys progress, their relationship evolves, revealing not only the challenges of their profession, but also the facets of their personal lives. Between thrilling intrigues and moments of camaraderie, Rizzoli and Isles demonstrate that friendship can arise from the most unexpected situations.
programme.desc-more: Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), a well-dipped detective, is called to the rescue when the wife of a former teammate entrusts her with a desperate affair: her daughter has just been abducted in a car. The investigation is beginning on a complex family drama, where the girl's younger brother, witness to the abduction, provides crucial details to the investigators. He evokes a woman driving and a man sitting in the back, adding a layer of mystery to this already tragic affair. In parallel, Jane's team, including her friend and forensic doctor Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), is exploring the tense relationship between the victim's parents to avoid personal involvement. As hours pass, anxiety rises, and anxiety turns into horror when a girl's body is found in a nearby forest, rushing investigators into a race against the clock to unmasking the kidnapper.

Lynette Scavo (Felicity Huffman), a former dynamic advertising environment, sacrificed her career to raise her children, but has to face the tumult of a chaotic family life. Bree Van de Kamp (Marcia Cross), a perfectionist and methodical, strives to maintain a control facade, while Gabrielle Solis (Eva Longoria), a capricious and seductive model, struggles with the demands of his flamboyant lifestyle. As friendships strengthen and test each other, each character must navigate through the obstacles imposed by their desires, ambitions and hidden truths, highlighting the complexity of life in the suburbs. This poignant and captivating drama explores the themes of friendship, betrayal and self-search, while plunging the viewer into a universe where everyday life often hides much darker realities. programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: In Strasbourg, a tragic tragedy shakes the Orthodox Jewish community when the lifeless body of a young woman is discovered in a hangar. Inspector Caesar Wagner (Gil Alma) and his team are called upon to investigate this disturbing murder. While the first leads seem to rule out the hypothesis of an anti-Semitic act, the investigation plunges investigators into the meandering of a welded community where tradition and modernity clash. As they investigate, they meet with members of the community, including respected figures and relatives of the victim, who reveal hidden tensions and well-kept secrets. Caesar Wagner must navigate carefully between beliefs and customs, while trying to understand the real motivations behind this crime. In this delicate context, he strives to unravel the sons of a complex intrigue that challenges the very notion of loyalty and justice within a community seeking truth.
programme.desc-more: César Wagner (Gil Alma) is a newly transferred police captain in Strasbourg. This friendly investigator is distinguished by his sharp intelligence and unconventional methods, but he is also afflicted by a tenacious hypocondria that complicates his daily life. Every new incident becomes an opportunity for him to care about his well-being, adding a dose of humor to his already eccentric personality. Despite his constant concerns for his health, Caesar shows impressive analytical capacity and unwavering determination to resolve complex cases that often go beyond conventions. With the help of his colleagues, including the frank and dynamic Olivia Côte (Sarah Barbault), he is committed to elucidate the criminal mysteries that shake the city, while sailing in the turbulences of his own personal life. As the intrigues multiply and tensions increase, Caesar must learn to face not only clever criminals, but also his own fears and flaws.

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: César Wagner (Gil Alma), inspector in Strasbourg, finds himself in a real puzzle when he arrives late at the marriage of his mother, Marie-Ange, the mayor of the city. In a context of loyalty and betrayal, Caesar must act with discretion to expose the culprit, while preserving the integrity of his family and the honour of his mother.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: The police department is hosting a new agent, Nina Holliday. His first investigation is a double murder. A man and his wife were murdered.
programme.desc-more: In Boston, Inspector Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), known for her frankness and determination, is working with Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), a medical examiner with a mysterious past and rigorous analytical methods. Despite their differences in style and personality, these two women form an unlikely but complementary duo, joining forces to resolve complex criminal cases. Jane, with her intuitive approach and sharpened instinct, often has to temper Maura's scientific analyses and sometimes too academic conclusions. Together, they navigate a world where violence and mystery mix, facing twisted suspects and disconcerting puzzles. As the surveys progress, their relationship evolves, revealing not only the challenges of their profession, but also the facets of their personal lives. Between thrilling intrigues and moments of camaraderie, Rizzoli and Isles demonstrate that friendship can arise from the most unexpected situations.

programme.desc: In Strasbourg, a finger is discovered in one of the bottles intended for tasting for the contest of the best beer of a very popular festival.

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.sub-title: All the gold of the Rhine
programme.desc: A young man is found dead, dressed in an authentic SS uniform. This student was doing research on "The Gold of the Rhine", a mythical Nazi treasure.
programme.desc-more: The body of a young man is discovered in the middle of a wasteland. Captain Caesar Wagner, compulsive hypochondriac, and his team find that the deceased, dressed in a real SS officer uniform, was killed with a bullet in his head. Thanks to Flora Salvi, a professor of military history, they learn that the uniform belonged to Nazi officer Wolfgang Hartmann, who founded the SS Ruins section in 1943 in Strasbourg. Thanks to a tattoo on the victim, the victim is identified as a student in history, close to a neo-Nazi circle.
