programme.desc-more: Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), a well-dipped detective, is called to the rescue when the wife of a former teammate entrusts her with a desperate affair: her daughter has just been abducted in a car. The investigation is beginning on a complex family drama, where the girl's younger brother, witness to the abduction, provides crucial details to the investigators. He evokes a woman driving and a man sitting in the back, adding a layer of mystery to this already tragic affair. In parallel, Jane's team, including her friend and forensic doctor Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), is exploring the tense relationship between the victim's parents to avoid personal involvement. As hours pass, anxiety rises, and anxiety turns into horror when a girl's body is found in a nearby forest, rushing investigators into a race against the clock to unmasking the kidnapper.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: In Boston, Inspector Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), known for her frankness and determination, is working with Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), a medical examiner with a mysterious past and rigorous analytical methods. Despite their differences in style and personality, these two women form an unlikely but complementary duo, joining forces to resolve complex criminal cases. Jane, with her intuitive approach and sharpened instinct, often has to temper Maura's scientific analyses and sometimes too academic conclusions. Together, they navigate a world where violence and mystery mix, facing twisted suspects and disconcerting puzzles. As the surveys progress, their relationship evolves, revealing not only the challenges of their profession, but also the facets of their personal lives. Between thrilling intrigues and moments of camaraderie, Rizzoli and Isles demonstrate that friendship can arise from the most unexpected situations.
programme.desc-more: Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), a well-dipped detective, is called to the rescue when the wife of a former teammate entrusts her with a desperate affair: her daughter has just been abducted in a car. The investigation is beginning on a complex family drama, where the girl's younger brother, witness to the abduction, provides crucial details to the investigators. He evokes a woman driving and a man sitting in the back, adding a layer of mystery to this already tragic affair. In parallel, Jane's team, including her friend and forensic doctor Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), is exploring the tense relationship between the victim's parents to avoid personal involvement. As hours pass, anxiety rises, and anxiety turns into horror when a girl's body is found in a nearby forest, rushing investigators into a race against the clock to unmasking the kidnapper.

"The Grand PrixTM of Canada and Monaco are exchanging their place on the calendar (Canada on 24 May, Monaco on 7 June). programme.title: The judge is a woman
programme.desc: While Marquand and Bernier thought they would get hold of Robin Guéret, the adopted brother and murderer of Julia and Clemence, they found him murdered.

programme.title: The judge is a woman
programme.desc: Called to the prosecution, Eric Solanas continues to obstruct Alice's investigation into the murder of Agathe Madera.
programme.desc-more: In a world where justice and truth intertwine, "The judge is a woman" plunges viewers into the heart of a poignant and complex investigation. At the centre of this intrigue, Judge Anne Vignaud (Marine Delterme) teamed up with Commander Marquand (Jean-Michel Tinivelli) to clarify the mystery surrounding the tragic death of Loïc Lardenois, whose body was discovered in a forest, the skull shattered and a weapon in hand. As the investigation progresses, Loïc's couple, Nadège (Medina Diarra), is immersed in a whirlwind of emotions. She still has not overcome the loss of their child, who died at birth, and accuses Dr. Lemaréchal (Guillaume Carcaud) of medical misconduct. This charge becomes a central element of the investigation, questioning the competence of the gynecologist and revealing latent tensions within the medical community. Investigators quickly discover that a break-in took place in the doctor's office on the night of the crime, adding a layer of mystery to this already complex case. As the pieces of the puzzle begin to assemble, pressure rises and unexpected revelations may well upset the fragile balance between justice and revenge. In this game of power and manipulation, the quest for truth is sown with tangles, where each character hides secrets and obscure motivations.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In this new season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque landscapes of France become the scene of captivating criminal mysteries, where every investigation is intimately linked to the cultural heritage and local traditions. The protagonists, Fauve Hautot and Aurelien Wiik, find themselves immersed in the heart of sordid business that reveal the buried secrets of their region. Every murder is anchored in a legend or a building full of history, thus revealing the dark facets of French heritage. The spectators follow these experienced investigators as they navigate between folklore and criminal investigation, digging up sometimes disturbing truths. The appearances of iconic figures such as Line Renaud, Samuel Labarthe, Francis Huster and Olivier Marchal add dramatic depth to the intrigues, enriching the story of their talent and charisma. This season promises a fascinating exploration of local mysteries, between dramatic tensions and unexpected revelations.
programme.desc-more: Murders to... is a captivating police series that plunges viewers into the enigmatic universe of criminal investigations in the heart of French regions. Each episode takes us to a distinct place, rich in history and local legends, where the past resurfaces in a often tragic and bloody way. In every investigation, horrific crimes seem to resonate with historical events, legends or myths rooted in the collective memory of the inhabitants. The series examines how these ancient narratives can influence the present, while buried secrets resurface, leading the protagonists into a real nightmare. The series follows a group of determined investigators, ready to elucidate these dark mysteries. Their expertise, accompanied by an analytical and human approach, prompts them to interview not only suspects, but also witnesses and residents, always in search of hidden truths. In addition to their investigative skills, they must navigate through tense interpersonal dynamics and the emotional impact of crimes on the community. Investigators also face moral dilemmas, wondering how far they are prepared to go to unearth the truth.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In this eighth season of "Mouttres à...", viewers are invited to dive into the heart of French regions, each offering its own picturesque setting and unique traditions. Each episode reveals a captivating police investigation, where murders are inextricably linked to local legends, ancestral customs or elements of historical heritage. Investigators must navigate through centuries-old stories and buried mysteries to detect the truth. This season highlights emblematic destinations such as the Cathar Country, with its medieval castles, and the city of Toulouse, rich in culture and history. Other places such as Cayenne, Cognac, Granville, Albi and Pont-l'Évêque also bring their own intriguing atmosphere, enriching each survey with a cultural depth. The characters, whether they are investigators or witnesses, find themselves immersed in stories where the past and present intertwine, offering a spectacle that is both entertaining and immersive.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In Rocamadour, a place full of spirituality and mystery, a man's body is discovered on the steps of the Penitent's Way, a historical pilgrimage route. The circumstances surrounding his death were disturbing: he was allegedly forced to climb the 216 steps on his knees, a practice of atonement dating back to the Middle Ages. A few days before his retirement, Commander Sophie Lacaze (Clémentine Célarié) was entrusted with this delicate investigation. She is assisted by her successor, Alexandre Delcroix (Grégori Derangère), a young investigator full of promises. Together, they plunge into the secrets of the city and quickly discover that the situation is even more complex: the daughter of the deceased, an eight-year-old girl, was abducted. As they try to solve this macabre mystery, Lacaze and Delcroix must navigate between reluctant witnesses and unexpected revelations, while fighting against the pressure of time to save the girl.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In the picturesque region of Burgundy, the harmony of landscapes is disturbed by shocking murder. Morgane (Cristiana Reali), a talented chef specializing in molecular cooking, is found dead in the forges of Buffon, his body showing signs of extreme violence with nitrogen-damaged lungs. Investigators Mylène Deville (Marie Vincent) and Frédéric Tessier (Franck Sémonin) are embarking on a complex investigation to uncover the mystery of this murder. Alain Malaval (Joseph Malerba), Morgane's companion, a former policeman converted to a cook, quickly became a suspect in Frédéric's eyes, who sought to understand the motives behind this heinous crime. As the evidence accumulates, a new twist occurs with the discovery of a second body in the locks: that of Commissioner Deville, who has been gone for years. The investigation takes an unexpected turn, linking past and present in a quest for truth.

programme.title: Balthazar
programme.desc: When a cow, the fourth of the month in the area, is brutally killed in the village where he grew up, Balthazar is sent to the area by Dr Olivia Vesinet. He joined Captain Costes there. The reunion between the medical examiner and his parents is cold. The next day, Balthazar's best childhood friend Sabrina, who was also the police officer in charge of the investigation, was found murdered in the same macabre staging. Both cases are necessarily linked and Balthazar's past could allow him to arrest the culprit.
programme.desc-more: Raphaël Balthazar (Tomer Sisley) is a forensic physician with an undeniable charisma and a lively mind. A epician in his soul, he sails between his meticulous work as a forensic expert and his passion for life, which is not without surprise to Commander Bach (Hélène de Fougerolles). The latter, pragmatic and strict in terms of procedures, has difficulty in passing the eccentricities of Balthazar. Beyond his charm and humour, Balthazar has a long history: the murder of his wife, whose daily memory he continues to evoke, haunting him in his daily life. As he gets involved in complex criminal cases, he is regularly immersed in investigations that combine science and emotions. By digging up the truths hidden behind each body, Raphael confronts his own demons and the pain of his loss.

programme.title: Balthazar
programme.desc: The prints on the knife, the DNA on the bodies, his lies, all accuses Balthazar of the double murder in his native village. He himself doubted his innocence in view of the confused memories of recent events. He is being held in custody by his colleagues Costes and Delgado. The medical examiner hypothesizes that his psychologist deliberately gave him drugs incompatible with his health, which would explain his hallucinations lately. Balthazar manages to escape from the police station by jumping out the window.

programme.title: Balthazar
programme.desc: As Balthazar (Tomer Sisley) prepares to give a course at the medical school, the situation takes a dramatic turn when a student, William Lacan (Côme Levin), pulls out a weapon and threatens to take the professor hostage. William demands that Balthazar innocent his father, accused of murdering his wife. The forensic doctor, by examining the evidence in the case file, discovered disturbing inconsistencies in the autopsy report, which could call into question the guilt of the man. With the help of his interns, Fatim (Constance Labbé) and Eddy (Yannig Samot), as well as a few students trapped in the Chamber, Balthazar launched a race against the clock to solve the riddle and avoid William being condemned for his desperate act. Meanwhile, the police are preparing to intervene, intensifying pressure on Balthazar to find a solution before it is too late.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: A few days before the retreat, a woman, police commander, is investigating with her successor to try to elucidate the murder of a man.
programme.desc-more: In Rocamadour, a place full of spirituality and mystery, a man's body is discovered on the steps of the Penitent's Way, a historical pilgrimage route. The circumstances surrounding his death were disturbing: he was allegedly forced to climb the 216 steps on his knees, a practice of atonement dating back to the Middle Ages. A few days before his retirement, Commander Sophie Lacaze (Clémentine Célarié) was entrusted with this delicate investigation. She is assisted by her successor, Alexandre Delcroix (Grégori Derangère), a young investigator full of promises. Together, they plunge into the secrets of the city and quickly discover that the situation is even more complex: the daughter of the deceased, an eight-year-old girl, was abducted. As they try to solve this macabre mystery, Lacaze and Delcroix must navigate between reluctant witnesses and unexpected revelations, while fighting against the pressure of time to save the girl.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: When investigating the murder of a young woman, chef côté, a police officer sees an old case reappearing, which affects her personally.
programme.desc-more: In the picturesque region of Burgundy, the harmony of landscapes is disturbed by shocking murder. Morgane (Cristiana Reali), a talented chef specializing in molecular cooking, is found dead in the forges of Buffon, his body showing signs of extreme violence with nitrogen-damaged lungs. Investigators Mylène Deville (Marie Vincent) and Frédéric Tessier (Franck Sémonin) are embarking on a complex investigation to uncover the mystery of this murder. Alain Malaval (Joseph Malerba), Morgane's companion, a former policeman converted to a cook, quickly became a suspect in Frédéric's eyes, who sought to understand the motives behind this heinous crime. As the evidence accumulates, a new twist occurs with the discovery of a second body in the locks: that of Commissioner Deville, who has been gone for years. The investigation takes an unexpected turn, linking past and present in a quest for truth.

programme.desc: A traffic accident is of interest to the team of experts, who are looking at how a vehicle could hit a car almost at a stop.
programme.desc-more: The Miami team of experts is facing a tragedy on the city's sunny roads. After a dramatic collision between two vehicles, a mother, driving with her two children on her 4x4, lost her life in a tragic accident. The second driver, however, quickly disappeared on the scene, leaving behind him a troubling mystery. The investigators, led by Horatio Caine (David Caruso), face a lack of tangible evidence. The only witness, a jogger named Victor, seems to be their only hope for understanding the circumstances of this tragedy. As investigators dig deeper, Jesse Cardoza (Jonathan Togo) discovers that Victor is hiding a secret: he is actually the driver of the other car. This revelation opens the door to a series of moral and ethical questions about truth and responsibility, pushing the team to unravel the true of the false in this tragic affair.

programme.desc-more: In this new season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque landscapes of France become the scene of captivating criminal mysteries, where every investigation is intimately linked to the cultural heritage and local traditions. The protagonists, Fauve Hautot and Aurelien Wiik, find themselves immersed in the heart of sordid business that reveal the buried secrets of their region. Every murder is anchored in a legend or a building full of history, thus revealing the dark facets of French heritage. The spectators follow these experienced investigators as they navigate between folklore and criminal investigation, digging up sometimes disturbing truths. The appearances of iconic figures such as Line Renaud, Samuel Labarthe, Francis Huster and Olivier Marchal add dramatic depth to the intrigues, enriching the story of their talent and charisma. This season promises a fascinating exploration of local mysteries, between dramatic tensions and unexpected revelations.

programme.desc-more: In the historic city of La Rochelle, a mysterious murder shakes local tranquillity: a businessman is found hanged in the Saint-Nicolas tower, with the letter "A" written in blood letters on his forehead. This macabre crime evokes a tragic event that occurred in the seventeenth century when Catholic monks were massacred by Protestants, suggesting a connection between past and present. The investigation was entrusted to Captain Raphaël Weiss (Philippe Caroit), a seasoned investigator, who was under the command of his own daughter, Justine Weiss (Dounia Coesens). Their already tense relationship becomes complicated as Justine discovers buried secrets about her father's life. As they plunge deeper into the affair, they must navigate through a network of lies and unsaid, confronting not only the mystery of murder, but also the demons of their own family past.

At the heart of the plot, a respected businessman is discovered drowned in a fishing port, leaving behind him a mystery that the team must solve. Early investigations reveal even more disturbing cases, such as a camper found dead in a pool and a collector whose body has been drifting into the Garonne for months. While the team, led by the chief detective, is fighting against the watch to unravel these cases, a more insidious threat emerges: a serial killer who seems to have a penchant for the caves. Each episode intensifyes tension, while investigators must navigate between buried secrets and a threat that is approaching, testing their determination and ingenuity.
programme.desc-more: Ghemara's life, wounded by a bullet in the chest, is suspended from a wire. The evidence is accumulated, revealing a parachute that does not open and two bodies sharing one identity, testing the skills of the Research Section (SR). Each new discovery reinforces the pressure on Linski and his team, who must navigate through a maze of clues and false-semblings. In this third season, tensions are rising, and the entry of Claire Linski brings a new breath to a series already appreciated by the public, promising thrilling turns and a high-fly investigation.

At the centre of this intrigue, Judge Anne Vignaud (Marine Delterme) teamed up with Commander Marquand (Jean-Michel Tinivelli) to clarify the mystery surrounding the tragic death of Loïc Lardenois, whose body was discovered in a forest, the skull shattered and a weapon in hand. As the investigation progresses, Loïc's couple, Nadège (Medina Diarra), is immersed in a whirlwind of emotions. She still has not overcome the loss of their child, who died at birth, and accuses Dr. Lemaréchal (Guillaume Carcaud) of medical misconduct. As the pieces of the puzzle begin to assemble, pressure rises and unexpected revelations may well upset the fragile balance between justice and revenge. In this game of power and manipulation, the quest for truth is sown with tangles, where each character hides secrets and obscure motivations.

programme.desc: While in a busy bank, Detective Cyrus Lockwood (William Petersen) suddenly gets plunged into the chaos of a robbery. After panic, the latter are heading to the vault room where they steal only the contents of a specific safe belonging to Sam Braun, a man whose personal knowledge is shared by Catherine Willows (Marg Helgenberger). programme.title: Planet Killers
programme.desc: Fewer than 5,000 tigers still live in the wild in the world. A symbol of power and object of admiration, the magnificent feline is also considered, for its misfortune, a commodity. Transformed into liquors, gums, or pills, supposed to bring health and cure for rheumatism, these tiger-derived products flow illegally into the streets of Hanoi and Beijing and on Facebook. programme.title: Animal Odyssey
programme.sub-title: The journey of the African elephant
programme.desc: There was a time when the elephant was present everywhere on Earth. From Africa 50 million years ago, this conquest of the world is coupled with an extraordinary evolutionary history that saw an animal the size of a dog become the largest terrestrial mammal. How has the latter borne the major climate change that the planet has experienced over time? What benefits has it gained from its large size? What role has the appearance of the trumpet played in its evolution?

programme.title: What do we eat? Ideas for better food tomorrow
programme.desc: The problem of food is increasingly present in the minds of the French, especially because of its impact on the environment. Indeed, a quarter of French CO2 emissions are linked to their diet. The cause is the evolution of our diet patterns over the last fifty years. The food we have now comes from all over the world, is more varied and faster to cook to adapt to our new lifestyles. Thomas Sotto investigates alternatives for a more responsible and environmentally friendly diet without sacrificing pleasure.

programme.title: Trains like the others
programme.desc: From the moment he arrived in Rabat, the political capital, the globe-trotter was seized by a city where life seemed peaceful and gentle. programme.title: Trains like the others
programme.desc: To approach this federal state of South America, great as 16 times France, the globe-trotter chose to leave Rio de Janeiro, in the south. Philippe Gougler travels the Rocinha favela with one of his iconic inhabitants, Coconut. Then he went to Curitiba, capital of Paraná, and met fishermen in Laguna. A little further north, in the mining region, it runs along the Belo Horizonte-Vitória line. Finally, he visits Ouro Preto, in the Minas Gerais, a city classified by UNESCO as a heritage of humanity.

programme.title: Trains like the others
programme.desc: The globe-trotter Philippe Gougler travels to the Gruyères region, in the canton of Fribourg, on a gastronomic train. Then he goes to the heart of a forest, to meet tummo followers, a form of yoga that is almost naked, in the snow. Having taken place in the comfortable "Bernina Express", the barouder is wandering through breathtaking landscapes between Switzerland and Italy. Then Philippe Gougler descends to Saint-Moritz, a resort in the Swiss Alps, with the oldest natural ice bobsleigh track in the world. He then made a stop in the Joux valley, in the south-west of the Jura massif, to meet a watchmaker.

programme.title: In the time of dinosaurs
programme.desc: Recent discoveries show that Mesozoic animals have been much more intelligent and developed than previously believed. The wealth of their life and behaviour, hitherto unsuspectable, is now revealed through modern means of investigation of paleontology and international experts. This documentary follows three emblematic specimens of the last dinosaurs: a young Deinochierus, a mother Mosasaure predatory from the seas and a Troodon living in the Arctic.

programme.title: Operation Okavango
programme.desc: Discovery from Namibia to the banks of Okavango, Botswana. The Skeleton coast is home to sea lion colonies and the Namib Desert is populated by animals such as the white-backed cockroach, the sand viper and the "white lady", a surprising spider.

programme.title: Planet Earth: The Adventure of Life
programme.desc: 250 million years ago, volcanic eruptions led to massive extinction of some species, altering the Earth's ecosystem. These events led to the ascent of mammals, replacing dinosaurs. Reconstitutions describe and understand how these cataclysms shaped Earth's history and evolution, highlighting the resilience of life.

programme.title: Planet Earth: The Adventure of Life
programme.desc: The possibility of life begins when the Earth collids with another protoplanet, of Mars size, shortly after the formation of our solar system.

programme.title: The science of the forces of nature
programme.desc: With global warming, avalanches are growing all around the globe. These phenomena are linked to the composition of snow, which appears to be one of the most important factors in the departure of an avalanche. Many scientists analyse the functioning of these natural disasters in order to understand, predict and limit their impact. They can identify the most at risk territories and implement means to protect and protect the population.

programme.title: The science of the forces of nature
programme.desc: Whether in Iceland, in the island of Reunion, in Indonesia or in South America, the presence of volcanoes constantly forces men to imagine ways to try to tame their fury or predict their eruptions. Despite the progress of warning systems, the latest disasters can be particularly devastating for people living in contact. Why does the planet manifest itself in this way?

programme.title: Plastic, collective suicide?

programme.title: Hydrogen: a false good idea?
programme.desc: In a world that is plagued by the climate crisis and unprecedented energy instability, this investigation addresses a central question: how to decarbonize societies in a fast and sustainable manner? At the heart of this reflection, hydrogen, the most abundant element of the universe, appears to be a promising solution. But behind the discourse of miracle energy, lies the technological, economic and geopolitical limits of a sector that is still far from being truly green. Between grey, green or "natural" hydrogen, the documentary raises the veil on the paradoxes of an energy presented as clean but still largely dependent on the fossil.

programme.title: In the time of dinosaurs
programme.desc: For twenty years, fossil discoveries of new species of dinosaurs have been increasing, upsetting the vision of these giants.
programme.desc-more: Recent discoveries show that Mesozoic animals have been much more intelligent and developed than previously believed. The wealth of their life and behaviour, hitherto unsuspectable, is now revealed through modern means of investigation of paleontology and international experts. This documentary follows three emblematic specimens of the last dinosaurs: a young Deinochierus, a mother Mosasaure predatory from the seas and a Troodon living in the Arctic.

programme.title: The science of the forces of nature
programme.desc: From the Alps to the Himalayas avalanches are increasingly striking as a result of global warming. But how do these phenomena trigger?
programme.desc-more: With global warming, avalanches are growing all around the globe. These phenomena are linked to the composition of snow, which appears to be one of the most important factors in the departure of an avalanche. Many scientists analyse the functioning of these natural disasters in order to understand, predict and limit their impact. They can identify the most at risk territories and implement means to protect and protect the population.

programme.title: Hydrogen: a false good idea?
programme.desc: Between grey, green or "natural" hydrogen, zoom on the paradoxes of an energy presented as clean but still largely dependent on fossil
programme.desc-more: In a world that is plagued by the climate crisis and unprecedented energy instability, this investigation addresses a central question: how to decarbonize societies in a fast and sustainable manner? At the heart of this reflection, hydrogen, the most abundant element of the universe, appears to be a promising solution. But behind the discourse of miracle energy, lies the technological, economic and geopolitical limits of a sector that is still far from being truly green. Between grey, green or "natural" hydrogen, the documentary raises the veil on the paradoxes of an energy presented as clean but still largely dependent on the fossil.

programme.title: Greenland, the thrills of the Earth
programme.desc: A family of navigators is conducting a scientific mission to Greenland. Thanks to the melting of the ice, they study virgin lands to discover a geological mystery.
programme.desc-more: On board the polar sailboat Vagabond, the navigators France and Eric lead a geological mission to Greenland, a land in the midst of a metamorphosis. Global warming frees up ever-observed land, providing a unique opportunity to study the origin of plate tectonics. After three years, the adventure ended with a family return, with their daughters, to their home port of Brest.

The journey continues to Ushuaia, aboard the "small train from the end of the world."

programme.title: Japan, a new wild world
programme.desc: Rare images, shot in Japan, show the adaptation strategies to climate change and human omnipresence developed by wildlife.
programme.desc-more: South tropical climate, north-northern ice and winds... With 7,000 islands for one country, the Japanese archipelago is continental in appearance and hosts a flamboyant biodiversity in its lands. The galloping expansion of metropolises and human activities, however, is making this ancestral balance falter. Two worlds are opposed today: between veneration and contempt for Nature, the stakes are shared. Wild animals adapt to these new living conditions, and act as scouts to change our own behaviors.

programme.title: After the meteorite, the world of survivors
programme.desc: In Colorado, paleontologists discovered fossils that tell how life resumed on Earth after the fall of an asteroid 66 million years ago.
programme.desc-more: Since 2016, in Corral Bluffs, located in the heart of an arid desert in Colorado, USA, a team of American and French paleontologists, led by Tyler Lyson, has opened a time window on the fauna and flora that lived in the million years after the impact of the asteroid that caused the dinosaurs to die 66 million years ago. These specialists try to explore the mystery of the rebirth of animal and plant species after chaos because this place has preserved the best fossil archives to understand what happened after the last extinction of life on Earth.

programme.title: Volcanolands
programme.desc: Long under the supervision of Chile, Argentina, a country with 39 active volcanoes, takes control of its risk management by creating its own modern observatory.
programme.desc-more: Argentina, with 39 active volcanoes, has long delegated surveillance of this threat to its Chilean neighbour. Recently, the country regained control by creating its own observatory, the OAVV, in Buenos Aires. The youngest in the world, it's mission is to build a modern surveillance network on this vast 3700-kilometre-long territory to manage this major risk.

programme.title: Jerusalem: Building the City of God · Global Voices
programme.desc: Jerusalem is a city that has passed through the ages. For more than three millennia, it has been built up in the rhythm of successive civilizations and has lived there. Theatres of a multitude of myths, religious constructions of different periods and religions make it a very special city from an architectural as well as historical point of view. Travel through more than 3,000 years of history and mystery, at the heart of the most iconic constructions of Jerusalem, the city of God, which continues to fascinate.

programme.title: The forgotten city of Ramses II
programme.desc: Beyond Abu Simbel, Egypt owes dozens of temples and hundreds of monumental statues to the most famous of the Pharaohs, Ramses II. But according to the ancient texts, the most dazzling of the builder's achievements was his capital, Pi-Ramses. A forgotten city whose only ancient descriptions allow us to imagine the splendor. Formally identified during the 20th century, the site of the ancient Pi-Ramses is now meticulously searched by archaeologists who gradually lift the veil on the lost city of the most illustrious of the Pharaohs.

programme.title: Salazar, Portugal to leave or double
programme.desc: As the Second World War was in full swing in Portugal, dictator António de Oliveira Salazar was threatened by his regime on all sides. The initial neutrality declared at the beginning of the conflict is no longer sufficient and Spain is planning an imminent invasion. Thanks to a skillful diplomatic game, Salazar managed to contain the Axis and the Allies to save valuable time. When the victory of the Allies became clear, he promised them access to the Azores archipelago, which was strategically important. In exchange, he negotiated the survival of his regime and joined the camp of victors.

programme.title: The art of espionage
programme.desc: A focus on the fascinating evolution of spying techniques over the decades. Beyond James Bond fiction, we discover how intelligence services use cutting-edge gadgets, indecipherable codes like Enigma, deadly poisons and even seduction to accomplish their missions. It is a plunge into the real secret methods of the agents of the shadow.

programme.title: The last few hours...

programme.title: Iraq, destruction of a nation
programme.desc: Persuaded that the great powers would let him, Saddam Hussein invaded Kuwait on 2 August 1990. Americans, British and French agree to punish Iraq, without really seeking a diplomatic solution. The Gulf War, which began in January 1991, was as rapid as it was devastating: Iraqis under a flood of fire saw their infrastructure razed. 100,000 soldiers and at least 60,000 civilians die. The result is a 12-year embargo, which will make the Iraqi people pay the megalomania of its president.

programme.title: Iraq, destruction of a nation
programme.desc: In 2007, in the midst of a civil war, Saddam Hussein's ghost, executed a year earlier for crimes against humanity, was hovering over Iraq. The rais was a dictator, but he had managed to hold the Iraqi people composed of Sunnis, Shiites, and ethnic and religious minorities. The Americans, for their part, are overwhelmed by the violence that is tearing apart the country where Islamist terrorism thrives. With millions of dollars, they finance Sunni tribes to fight Al Qaeda and support the new regime. programme.title: Salazar, Portugal to leave or double
programme.desc: The Second World War plunges Europe into destruction and terror, and Portugal, with Antonio Salazar, is caught in a stride between Churchill and Hitler.
programme.desc-more: As the Second World War was in full swing in Portugal, dictator António de Oliveira Salazar was threatened by his regime on all sides. The initial neutrality declared at the beginning of the conflict is no longer sufficient and Spain is planning an imminent invasion. Thanks to a skillful diplomatic game, Salazar managed to contain the Axis and the Allies to save valuable time. When the victory of the Allies became clear, he promised them access to the Azores archipelago, which was strategically important. In exchange, he negotiated the survival of his regime and joined the camp of victors.

For the king's Catholic entourage, it is a matter of disposing of the leaders of the Protestant faction, who give signs of rebellion. programme.title: Under the threat of the Khmer Rouge, the fall of the French embassy
programme.desc: During three weeks of spring 1975, the French embassy in Phnom Penh, surrounded by the Khmer Rouge, was the refuge of nearly a thousand Cambodians.
programme.desc-more: On 17 April 1975, the Khmer Rouge took control of Phnom Penh, the capital of Cambodia. A thousand five hundred Westerners and frightened Cambodians take refuge in the French Embassy. France is at the heart of a diplomatic crisis, while Pol Pot's troops refuse to leave the Embassy until the refugees have been delivered. Between Phnom Penh and Paris, France must make a choice between its diplomatic interests and its duty to protect refugees. Fifty years later, archives and witnesses told the story of these three weeks of tension.

programme.title: Marcus Klingberg, a pure spy
programme.desc: Polish Jew, a medical student in Warsaw, in 1939, Marcus Klingberg fled the Nazis and the Shoah to join the Soviet Union. Enlisted in the Red Army Medical Service, he became an epidemiologist noticed by the highest authorities. After the war, he emigrated to Israel where he led the clandestine bacteriological weapons programme for 30 years. The Israeli services eventually discovered that Klingberg was carrying out all his research in the USSR. The story of this professor who died in Paris in 2015 remains one of the most mysterious of the cold war.

programme.title: Little spying with friends
programme.desc: The story of Kim Philby, a double agent, and his Cambridge comrades, reveals one of the most effective spying networks. From Washington from the Cold War to contemporary Moscow, from Beirut alleys to Buckingham Palace, this story is complex.

programme.title: Prague in the Service of Moscow: In the Secrets of the Cold War
programme.desc: From the Cold War to the invasion of Ukraine, Moscow has always conducted secret operations against the West. In the days of communism, the Kremlin relied heavily on the secret services of Eastern countries such as Czechoslovakia. Thanks to the opening of the Czech archives, the documentary sheds new light on Prague's role in the service of Moscow for four decades.

programme.title: Children of Blackfoot, children of divorce
programme.desc: The latest generation of Blackfoot is disappearing. Their children, born after independence, find themselves the custodians of a story they have not lived, of a partial or confused narrative, of a heritage that is sometimes heavy to bear. This is the case with Muriel, Nicolas, Mathilde, Raphael, Emilie and Guillaume. The land of their origins no longer exists, it has dissolved in the tragic history of history, the silence of their parents and the disdain of French society. Today, they wonder what they can convey about family history and culture.

But already, rumors of conspiracy are circulating. Former masters of the king, but also men, among the most powerful of the kingdom, or the queen herself, are pointed with a finger. Thanks to the discovery of unpublished documents preserved in the Vatican Secret Archives, this investigation is elevating one of the most opaque mysteries in the history of France. • Debate moderated by Franck Ferrand and Clementine Portier-Kaltenbach.

In the heart of the royal city of Loches, the historian then looks at the mystery of the death of Agnes Sorel, the favorite of Charles VII. In Langeais, he traced the fate of Anne of Brittany who married Charles VIII. Chenonceaux Castle was embellished by the very powerful Diane de Poitiers. Finally, it was in Blois that Catherine de Medici died in 1589.

programme.desc: Michel de Nostre-Dame, said Nostradamus, was considered in his time as a great oracle. This French astrologer and doctor, born in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence in 1503, would have predicted the most important events in our history, from the French Revolution to the rise to power of Napoleon and Hitler. But his enigmatic verses lend themselves to countless interpretations. Historians who are specialists in these mysterious quatrains are taking stock of their latest progress.

programme.title: Churchill's Hidden War
programme.desc: At the beginning of World War II, Winston Churchil ordered the arrest of all Germans, Austrians and Italians residing in the United Kingdom. The new Prime Minister does not want to take the risk of seeing enemy spies at large on his territory.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.desc: Built in 796 by Charlemagne, the Cathedral of Aix-la-Chapelle is a jewel of Byzantine inspiration. Its octagonal dome, made of Roman stones and an innovative mortar, was designed for eternity. Enriched with Gothic choirs over the centuries, this coronation church of the German emperors, the first UNESCO World Heritage site, embodies the birth of a new European empire.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.sub-title: Sainte-Sophie: the challenge of a mega-construction
programme.desc: On the border between Europe and Asia Minor, in Turkey, is one of the most majestic monuments on the planet: St.Sophie of Istanbul. A massive, colossal structure covering a surface of 7540m2! Researchers rely on advanced technologies to discover the mysteries of its construction, sometimes invisible to the naked eye. How were its gigantic dome and interior volume designed? How did she miraculously resist earthquakes? The researchers are trying to reveal the secrets of this mythical monument.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.desc: Built at an altitude of 2430 metres in the Andes Mountains, the Inca city of Machu Picchu remains one of the most enigmatic urban creations in history. While research has long focused on its centre, new technologies now allow scientists to probe the surrounding jungle and the depths of the site to discover its ultimate mysteries.

programme.title: It's a real plot!
programme.sub-title: The coup d'état of 11 September in Chile
programme.desc: On 11 September 1973, the Chilean army overthrowd the socialist government of Salvador Allende, then allied with the Communists. The coup, led by army general Augusto Pinochet, takes place in a context of crisis and strong political, social and economic polarization, with opposition between the executive and the legislative and judicial branches. A terrible crackdown is being carried out on opponents of the new regime.

programme.title: Run away from the Nazis. On the road to the monasteries
programme.desc: In 1945, the end of the war in Europe, the advance of Soviet troops and the liberation of the camps caused unprecedented population movements. Thousands of Nazi criminals will then take advantage of this chaos to flee the continent and thus escape justice. Among them are some of the regime's most sinister figures: Adolf Eichmann, the architect of the "final solution", Franz Stangl, commander of the Sobibor and Treblinka camps, or Klaus Barbie, the "boucher de Lyon". All this was made possible thanks to exfilration networks organized by former Nazis, but also with the help of the Catholic Church. The routes that history will retain under the name of "Rat Road" or "Monastery Road".

programme.title: The Nazis of Nuremberg
programme.desc: 75 years ago, 21 leaders of the Nazi regime of the Third Reich were tried by the Nuremberg court. More than 1,000 digitalized archival documents and footage taken in the courtroom highlight the atmosphere that prevailed during this historic trial. The witnesses followed the stand, accusing the generals, the ministers of death, responsible for the most terrible extermination in modern history.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: In a context of intertwining human tensions and tragedies, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a heroine with a big heart, manages to reason a forerunner who took a class of students hostage, of which her daughter Clara is part. Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status. At the same time, Louis (Bénédicte Delmas) faces charges of murder against Serge, while Tom (Mina Gustin), on the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, is organizing a concert to honour his memory. Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.
programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

programme.title: Party at home
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the series Home Party
programme.desc-more: Because crooks sold the house her father had built, Ji-eun, a young writer woman, contracts with the new owner, an extremely popular actor. She will become her maid and be able to settle in a permanent home. The situation becomes sufficiently compromising for the couple to be forced to enter into a white marriage. A series of love twists that met a great success in Asia and offers as filming frame Korea, in the region of Incheon, but also Shanghai and Thailand.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.sub-title: The Revolt of the Intra-Terrestrials, Part 2
programme.desc: Back to life for the eleventh time as his spaceship crashed, Dr.Déctobre meets Amy Pond, a seven-year-old girl who becomes, at adulthood, his travel companion. Their journey, constantly disturbed by a spatiotemporal fault, leads them to cross the Churchill road, in conjunction with the Daleks, but also the Weeping Angels and other evil creatures, to finally reach the cosmic portal of Pandorica, beyond which is held a terrible monster. A new Doctor, a new environment, new characters and new ways! After the acclimatization of use, a fifth exciting season in which a wind of freshness blows.
programme.desc-more: Amy, Rory and the Doctor, still looking for Melody Pound, came back in their own time. But under the threat of Mels, a childhood friend of Amy and Rory pursued by the police, the team was forced to board the Tardis again. Mels uses his gun and damages the device. In 1938, the Tardis crashed in Berlin in Hitler's office, and was invaded by toxic smoke.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.sub-title: In the hands of the rebels
programme.desc: Ori ships are moving at full speed towards Earth to subordinate the population to their religion. Vala, who gave birth to a little drug powers, Adria, fails to channel the power of the child. The young woman now takes the lead of the Oris. Daniel Jackson thinks that a fabulous weapon, designed by the magician Merlin, could definitely stop the invaders. He's going to Camelot to try to locate her. Meanwhile, Adria has been numbing her mother's feelings. A final season that ends in apotheosis, for a series that comes with "Stargate Atlantis" in 2004, then "Stargate Universe" in 2009 and even in cartoon.
programme.desc-more: In the near future, the long-inactive Stargate program is suddenly revived following an unexpected invasion of an alien commando that storms the Stargate Command (SGC) base on Earth. Under the leadership of Colonel Jonathan O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson), the CGS is awakening from its torpor to deal with this imminent threat. This special service of the American Air Force is designed to explore unexplored worlds through the doors of the stars, mysterious devices allowing you to travel to other planets and dimensions. Together, a heteroclite team of scientists and soldiers, including the brilliant astrophysician Samantha Carter (Amanda Tapping) and the doctor of Team Daniel Jackson (Michael Shanks), embarks on perilous missions. They quickly discover that the universe is full of dangers, including the dreadful Goa的uld, a parasitic race that enslaves countless civilizations. Each trip confronts them with complex moral choices and conflicts of interest, while strengthening the links between team members. Through thrilling adventures, the GSC will have to navigate between fragile alliances and fierce fighting, while seeking to protect the Earth from growing alien threats. The stakes are high, and each mission could change the course of humanity.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Ori ships are moving at full speed towards Earth to subordinate the population to their religion. Vala, who gave birth to a little drug powers, Adria, fails to channel the power of the child. The young woman now takes the lead of the Oris. Daniel Jackson thinks that a fabulous weapon, designed by the magician Merlin, could definitely stop the invaders. He's going to Camelot to try to locate her. Meanwhile, Adria has been numbing her mother's feelings. A final season that ends in apotheosis, for a series that comes with "Stargate Atlantis" in 2004, then "Stargate Universe" in 2009 and even in cartoon.

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.desc: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the supernatural mixes with everyday life, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki) and Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles) find themselves facing an unexpected situation when a mysterious man bursts into their hotel room. This man, Henry Winchester, their grandfather, reveals that he travelled through time to escape Abaddon, a fearsome demon who took possession of a young woman to track him. As the threat grew, the Winchester brothers had to not only protect Henry, but also find a way to send him back to his original era before it was too late. With the help of Castiel (Misha Collins), the fallen angel, and other allies, Sam and Dean plunge into a race against the clock, facing dark demons and forces. The stakes are higher than ever, as they try to defeat Abaddon's Machiavellical plans while preserving their family heritage.

programme.title: The college years
programme.sub-title: At the edge of the abyss
programme.desc: In this episode of the series "Les ans fac", Annette, a dynamic student, finds herself confronted with a delicate situation when her friend Aristide starts to associate with Agnes, a young woman with irresistible charm. Annette, who has always been close to Aristide, experiences growing jealousy in the face of this new relationship, questioning her own friendship and feelings. As she tries to manage her conflicting emotions, she starts a personal inquiry to understand Agnes' true intentions, convinced that he is hiding something behind his smile. Over the days, Annette discovers that appearances can be misleading and that bonds of friendship can be tested by love. This emotional dilemma leads him to reflect on his own desires and the complexity of human relations at university, where each choice can have unexpected consequences.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Les ans fac", Clarisse (Camille Raymond) confides to her best friend Laetitia (Virginie Desarnauts) about the tumults of her love life. It reveals the growing tensions between Justine (Rebecca Hampton) and Anthony Dupray, two characters with contrasting personalities who struggle to conquer Clarisse's heart. As rivalries intensify, Laetitia becomes the privileged witness of secrets and unsaid that may well change the course of their friendship. Emotional issues arise as young adults navigate the complexities of love and friendship on campus. Between betrayals and revelations, each character has to face his own desires and uncertainties. This new episode plunges viewers into a whirlwind of emotions, highlighting the challenges of student life, while exploring the fragile ties that bind these young adults in search of identity.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Alain wants only one thing: revenge for Jeanne and Valentine, who lead the great life thanks to the money they stole from him. He's calling Daniel.
programme.desc-more: In a context of intertwining human tensions and tragedies, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a heroine with a big heart, manages to reason a forerunner who took a class of students hostage, of which her daughter Clara is part. Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status. At the same time, Louis (Bénédicte Delmas) faces charges of murder against Serge, while Tom (Mina Gustin), on the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, is organizing a concert to honour his memory. Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.

programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

programme.desc: In a context of intertwining human tensions and tragedies, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a heroine with a big heart, manages to reason a forerunner who took a class of students hostage, of which her daughter Clara is part. Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status. At the same time, Louis (Bénédicte Delmas) faces charges of murder against Serge, while Tom (Mina Gustin), on the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, is organizing a concert to honour his memory. Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.
programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

programme.desc: The Doctor continues his spatiotemporal journey, surrounded by Amy, his boyfriend Rory and the archaeologist River Song. The crew members of the Tardis are faced with a multitude of new enemies, including the Gangers, clones created by humans, the religious order of Silence and Hitler himself. But a terrible taraudic secret the Doctor's three companions, who cannot reveal to him the nature of it. Steven Moffat, who has been in charge of the series since the start of Russel T. Davies, has been putting his foot on this beautiful sixth season, but perhaps a bit disconcerting for fans.
programme.desc-more: Amy, Rory and the Doctor, still looking for Melody Pound, came back in their own time. But under the threat of Mels, a childhood friend of Amy and Rory pursued by the police, the team was forced to board the Tardis again. Mels uses his gun and damages the device. In 1938, the Tardis crashed in Berlin in Hitler's office, and was invaded by toxic smoke.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: The Doctor makes several journeys through time to neutralize the creature that is lying behind the door of Pandorica. Amy was again in 1996.
programme.desc-more: Back to life for the eleventh time as his spaceship crashed, Dr.Déctobre meets Amy Pond, a seven-year-old girl who becomes, at adulthood, his travel companion. Their journey, constantly disturbed by a spatiotemporal fault, leads them to cross the Churchill road, in conjunction with the Daleks, but also the Weeping Angels and other evil creatures, to finally reach the cosmic portal of Pandorica, beyond which is held a terrible monster. A new Doctor, a new environment, new characters and new ways! After the acclimatization of use, a fifth exciting season in which a wind of freshness blows.

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.sub-title: The amazing adventures of Sam and Dean
programme.desc: Sam and Dean are, in their defence, the guests of honour of a convention bringing together fans of the "Supernatural" saga. The meeting is degenerating.
programme.desc-more: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.

Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.

programme.title: The college years
programme.sub-title: At the edge of the abyss
programme.desc: Annette doesn't like seeing Aristide with Agnes...
programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Les ans fac", Annette, a dynamic student, finds herself confronted with a delicate situation when her friend Aristide starts to associate with Agnes, a young woman with irresistible charm. Annette, who has always been close to Aristide, experiences growing jealousy in the face of this new relationship, questioning her own friendship and feelings. As she tries to manage her conflicting emotions, she starts a personal inquiry to understand Agnes' true intentions, convinced that he is hiding something behind his smile. Over the days, Annette discovers that appearances can be misleading and that bonds of friendship can be tested by love. This emotional dilemma leads him to reflect on his own desires and the complexity of human relations at university, where each choice can have unexpected consequences.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: Clarisse tells Laetitia everything about Justine and Anthony...
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Les ans fac", Clarisse (Camille Raymond) confides to her best friend Laetitia (Virginie Desarnauts) about the tumults of her love life. It reveals the growing tensions between Justine (Rebecca Hampton) and Anthony Dupray, two characters with contrasting personalities who struggle to conquer Clarisse's heart. As rivalries intensify, Laetitia becomes the privileged witness of secrets and unsaid that may well change the course of their friendship. Emotional issues arise as young adults navigate the complexities of love and friendship on campus. Between betrayals and revelations, each character has to face his own desires and uncertainties. This new episode plunges viewers into a whirlwind of emotions, highlighting the challenges of student life, while exploring the fragile ties that bind these young adults in search of identity.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Louis and Alexandra live together, but their relationship is deteriorating. The former husband of the young woman, who beat her, is the victim of an attempted homicide.
programme.desc-more: In a context of intertwining human tensions and tragedies, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a heroine with a big heart, manages to reason a forerunner who took a class of students hostage, of which her daughter Clara is part. Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status. At the same time, Louis (Bénédicte Delmas) faces charges of murder against Serge, while Tom (Mina Gustin), on the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, is organizing a concert to honour his memory. Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.

programme.title: Cut
programme.desc: Eva and Lulu, two sisters who come to La Réunion to investigate the disappearance of their mother, refuse to believe that this is a voluntary flight. A disturbing coincidence, Adil's father, a psychiatrist their mother had known, also arrived on the island. Adil doesn't know he's going to be the target of the newcomers. All of them have a better chance of her happiness breaking into pieces. Despite all this, Adil and Eva end up getting closer. Eva, however, cannot help but beware of this man, who may have played an important role in the disappearance of his mother. A third season, with the arrival of new characters: Lulu (Nadia Richard) and Eva (Sabine Perrault), among others.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Laure managed to reason with a forceful man who took a class of the school that Clara attended hostage. A victim of a heart attack, Alain decides to sell the clinic. Maxime Servais, a well-known surgeon, was appointed to the position of director, while Jeanne returned to be a simple doctor. Louis is accused of trying to assassinate Serge. On the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, Tom organized a concert with his friends and asked his mother to attend. Baptiste discovers Jessica's double life and is dark in drug addiction. Caroline receives her mother's unexpected visit. Jessica's getting a lot of money into her radio show. Romances, breakups and betrayals are always on the rendezvous.
programme.desc-more: Laure returns from Africa to seek care for Zacharia, a 10-year-old orphan. She's got a car accident with Jessica, who's having a miscarriage. Jessica and Baptiste opt for adoption and eventually welcome Zacharie. Laure cancels a trip to Africa to support Jessica, in the midst of depression. The yacht of Yannis Nomikos, David's father, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Yannis learns that he has an incurable disease but asks Lucie not to say anything. Grégory returns to Saint-Tropez after spending ten years in a Colombian prison. Caroline learns that she is pregnant but dare not tell David, who fears fatherhood. A season marked by the return of Frédéric Daban, in the role of Gregory.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Carter agreed to take a cure to treat his drug addiction. Abby, who herself struggles with her addiction to alcohol, tries to support him. The unexpected arrival of her mother, who suffers from bipolar disorders, does not favour the balance of the young woman. Kerry, for his part, is deeply troubled by Kim Legaspi, a beautiful psychiatrist who does not make a mystery of her homosexuality. A dense season, exploring the complexity and subtlety of the characters, including Kerry Weaver, which reveals unexpected depths.

programme.title: Cut
programme.desc: Eva and Lulu, two sisters who come to La Réunion to investigate the disappearance of their mother, refuse to believe that this is a voluntary flight. A disturbing coincidence, Adil's father, a psychiatrist their mother had known, also arrived on the island. Adil doesn't know he's going to be the target of the newcomers. All of them have a better chance of her happiness breaking into pieces. Despite all this, Adil and Eva end up getting closer. Eva, however, cannot help but beware of this man, who may have played an important role in the disappearance of his mother. A third season, with the arrival of new characters: Lulu (Nadia Richard) and Eva (Sabine Perrault), among others.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Laure managed to reason with a forceful man who took a class of the school that Clara attended hostage. A victim of a heart attack, Alain decides to sell the clinic. Maxime Servais, a well-known surgeon, was appointed to the position of director, while Jeanne returned to be a simple doctor. Louis is accused of trying to assassinate Serge. On the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, Tom organized a concert with his friends and asked his mother to attend. Baptiste discovers Jessica's double life and is dark in drug addiction. Caroline receives her mother's unexpected visit. Jessica's getting a lot of money into her radio show. Romances, breakups and betrayals are always on the rendezvous.
programme.desc-more: Laure returns from Africa to seek care for Zacharia, a 10-year-old orphan. She's got a car accident with Jessica, who's having a miscarriage. Jessica and Baptiste opt for adoption and eventually welcome Zacharie. Laure cancels a trip to Africa to support Jessica, in the midst of depression. The yacht of Yannis Nomikos, David's father, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Yannis learns that he has an incurable disease but asks Lucie not to say anything. Grégory returns to Saint-Tropez after spending ten years in a Colombian prison. Caroline learns that she is pregnant but dare not tell David, who fears fatherhood. A season marked by the return of Frédéric Daban, in the role of Gregory.

The yacht of Yannis Nomikos, David's father, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Yannis learns that he has an incurable disease but asks Lucie not to say anything. Grégory returns to Saint-Tropez after spending ten years in a Colombian prison. Caroline learns that she is pregnant but dare not tell David, who fears fatherhood. A season marked by the return of Frédéric Daban, in the role of Gregory.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Carter agreed to take a cure to treat his drug addiction. Abby, who herself struggles with her addiction to alcohol, tries to support him. The unexpected arrival of her mother, who suffers from bipolar disorders, does not favour the balance of the young woman. Kerry, for his part, is deeply troubled by Kim Legaspi, a beautiful psychiatrist who does not make a mystery of her homosexuality. A dense season, exploring the complexity and subtlety of the characters, including Kerry Weaver, which reveals unexpected depths.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Ori ships are moving at full speed towards Earth to subordinate the population to their religion. Vala, who gave birth to a little drug powers, Adria, fails to channel the power of the child. The young woman now takes the lead of the Oris. Daniel Jackson thinks that a fabulous weapon, designed by the magician Merlin, could definitely stop the invaders. He's going to Camelot to try to locate her. Meanwhile, Adria has been numbing her mother's feelings. A final season that ends in apotheosis, for a series that comes with "Stargate Atlantis" in 2004, then "Stargate Universe" in 2009 and even in cartoon.
programme.desc-more: In the near future, the long-inactive Stargate program is suddenly revived following an unexpected invasion of an alien commando that storms the Stargate Command (SGC) base on Earth. Under the leadership of Colonel Jonathan O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson), the CGS is awakening from its torpor to deal with this imminent threat. This special service of the American Air Force is designed to explore unexplored worlds through the doors of the stars, mysterious devices allowing you to travel to other planets and dimensions. Together, a heteroclite team of scientists and soldiers, including the brilliant astrophysician Samantha Carter (Amanda Tapping) and the doctor of Team Daniel Jackson (Michael Shanks), embarks on perilous missions. They quickly discover that the universe is full of dangers, including the dreadful Goa的uld, a parasitic race that enslaves countless civilizations. Each trip confronts them with complex moral choices and conflicts of interest, while strengthening the links between team members. Through thrilling adventures, the GSC will have to navigate between fragile alliances and fierce fighting, while seeking to protect the Earth from growing alien threats. The stakes are high, and each mission could change the course of humanity.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: As Laure prepares to return to Africa, Jessica is going through a phase of depression. Laure then pushes back his departure. With Caroline, she decides to change her friend's ideas by taking her to the bike...
programme.desc-more: In a context of intertwining human tensions and tragedies, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a heroine with a big heart, manages to reason a forerunner who took a class of students hostage, of which her daughter Clara is part. Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status. At the same time, Louis (Bénédicte Delmas) faces charges of murder against Serge, while Tom (Mina Gustin), on the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, is organizing a concert to honour his memory. Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.

programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Les ans fac", Annette, a dynamic student, finds herself confronted with a delicate situation when her friend Aristide starts to associate with Agnes, a young woman with irresistible charm. Annette, who has always been close to Aristide, experiences growing jealousy in the face of this new relationship, questioning her own friendship and feelings. As she tries to manage her conflicting emotions, she starts a personal inquiry to understand Agnes' true intentions, convinced that he is hiding something behind his smile. Over the days, Annette discovers that appearances can be misleading and that bonds of friendship can be tested by love. This emotional dilemma leads him to reflect on his own desires and the complexity of human relations at university, where each choice can have unexpected consequences.

programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status.
