programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Back to life for the eleventh time as his spaceship crashed, Dr.Déctobre meets Amy Pond, a seven-year-old girl who becomes, at adulthood, his travel companion. Their journey, constantly disturbed by a spatiotemporal fault, leads them to cross the Churchill road, in conjunction with the Daleks, but also the Weeping Angels and other evil creatures, to finally reach the cosmic portal of Pandorica, beyond which is held a terrible monster. A new Doctor, a new environment, new characters and new ways! After the acclimatization of use, a fifth exciting season in which a wind of freshness blows.
programme.desc-more: Amy, Rory and the Doctor, still looking for Melody Pound, came back in their own time. But under the threat of Mels, a childhood friend of Amy and Rory pursued by the police, the team was forced to board the Tardis again. Mels uses his gun and damages the device. In 1938, the Tardis crashed in Berlin in Hitler's office, and was invaded by toxic smoke.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Ori ships are moving at full speed towards Earth to subordinate the population to their religion. Vala, who gave birth to a little drug powers, Adria, fails to channel the power of the child. The young woman now takes the lead of the Oris. Daniel Jackson thinks that a fabulous weapon, designed by the magician Merlin, could definitely stop the invaders. He's going to Camelot to try to locate her. Meanwhile, Adria has been numbing her mother's feelings. A final season that ends in apotheosis, for a series that comes with "Stargate Atlantis" in 2004, then "Stargate Universe" in 2009 and even in cartoon.
programme.desc-more: In the near future, the long-inactive Stargate program is suddenly revived following an unexpected invasion of an alien commando that storms the Stargate Command (SGC) base on Earth. Under the leadership of Colonel Jonathan O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson), the CGS is awakening from its torpor to deal with this imminent threat. This special service of the American Air Force is designed to explore unexplored worlds through the doors of the stars, mysterious devices allowing you to travel to other planets and dimensions. Together, a heteroclite team of scientists and soldiers, including the brilliant astrophysician Samantha Carter (Amanda Tapping) and the doctor of Team Daniel Jackson (Michael Shanks), embarks on perilous missions. They quickly discover that the universe is full of dangers, including the dreadful Goa的uld, a parasitic race that enslaves countless civilizations. Each trip confronts them with complex moral choices and conflicts of interest, while strengthening the links between team members. Through thrilling adventures, the GSC will have to navigate between fragile alliances and fierce fighting, while seeking to protect the Earth from growing alien threats. The stakes are high, and each mission could change the course of humanity.

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.desc: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the supernatural mixes with everyday life, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki) and Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles) find themselves facing an unexpected situation when a mysterious man bursts into their hotel room. This man, Henry Winchester, their grandfather, reveals that he travelled through time to escape Abaddon, a fearsome demon who took possession of a young woman to track him. As the threat grew, the Winchester brothers had to not only protect Henry, but also find a way to send him back to his original era before it was too late. With the help of Castiel (Misha Collins), the fallen angel, and other allies, Sam and Dean plunge into a race against the clock, facing dark demons and forces. The stakes are higher than ever, as they try to defeat Abaddon's Machiavellical plans while preserving their family heritage.

programme.desc: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the supernatural mixes with everyday life, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki) and Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles) find themselves facing an unexpected situation when a mysterious man bursts into their hotel room. This man, Henry Winchester, their grandfather, reveals that he travelled through time to escape Abaddon, a fearsome demon who took possession of a young woman to track him. As the threat grew, the Winchester brothers had to not only protect Henry, but also find a way to send him back to his original era before it was too late. With the help of Castiel (Misha Collins), the fallen angel, and other allies, Sam and Dean plunge into a race against the clock, facing dark demons and forces. The stakes are higher than ever, as they try to defeat Abaddon's Machiavellical plans while preserving their family heritage.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Les ans fac", Clarisse (Camille Raymond) confides to her best friend Laetitia (Virginie Desarnauts) about the tumults of her love life. It reveals the growing tensions between Justine (Rebecca Hampton) and Anthony Dupray, two characters with contrasting personalities who struggle to conquer Clarisse's heart. As rivalries intensify, Laetitia becomes the privileged witness of secrets and unsaid that may well change the course of their friendship. Emotional issues arise as young adults navigate the complexities of love and friendship on campus. Between betrayals and revelations, each character has to face his own desires and uncertainties. This new episode plunges viewers into a whirlwind of emotions, highlighting the challenges of student life, while exploring the fragile ties that bind these young adults in search of identity.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: Laetitia (Camille Raymond), a young student with a fragile heart, finds herself in a delicate situation after a tumultuous break-up with her former boyfriend Thomas (Rodolphe Delage). As she struggles to move forward, she chooses to take refuge in a group of boys, hoping to find comfort and advice in this difficult time. As the discussions progressed, she confided to them that despite the separation, her love for Thomas never really disappeared. His friends, though well-intentioned, cannot help but wonder about Thomas' true intentions, which seems determined to find her. As Laetitia navigates between her contradictory feelings and the advice of her new allies, tensions emerge, revealing the complex dynamics of friendship and love. This episode addresses with humour and tenderness the emotional challenges facing young adults, while exploring the themes of attachment and identity search.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: In this poignant episode of the series "The University Years", Virginia (Virginie Desarnauts) confides to Justine (Camille Raymond) about Serge, a young man who seems to play a central role in his life. As they prepare to go out, an unexpected moment awaits them: when they open the door, they discover a delicately arranged bouquet of flowers accompanied by a mysterious poem. This romantic gesture raises questions about the identity of the sender and the feelings Virginia might experience. While the two friends are wondering about the meaning of this present, they explore the themes of love, friendship and expectations of young adults in the academic setting. This episode highlights the doubts and hopes that accompany the first love relationships, while revealing the complex dynamics between the characters and the challenges they face in their quest for identity and belonging.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: In the early morning, Virginia (Virginie Desarnauts) woke up, with her heart still thrilling from the events of the previous night. In search of comfort and a attentive ear, she confides to her friend about the crazy adventure she has had with Serge, a charismatic and mysterious young man who was able to seduce her at the turn of a festive evening. As she narrates the details of this unexpected encounter, Virginia evokes the bursts of laughter, the exchanged eyes and the promises whispered in intimacy. However, behind this light facade, questions are hidden about the choices it has made and the consequences that might result. His friend, both fascinated and worried, encourages him to reflect on the nature of this connection. While the two young women share their hopes and doubts, Virginia realizes that this night may well be the turning point of her life, confronting her with her own desires and aspirations.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: Luc, a young student passionate about sport, is beginning to feel a growing discomfort in his relationship with Virginia, a classmate with undeniable charm. As they train together at the gym, Luc perceives disturbing evidence that Virginia is hiding a secret from him. His curiosity gradually turned into an obsession, fuelled by enigmatic conversations and mysterious behaviors on his part. Determined to discover the truth, Luke was carried away by his emotions and frustration. In a rage, he decides to leave the gym, leaving behind a universe he thought he knew. This unexpected departure led him to question not only his feelings for Virginia, but also his place in his group of friends. As tensions rise, Luke finds himself at a crucial crossroads in his student life, where loyalty and betrayal intertwine.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: On a vibrant campus of life, Virginia (Virginie Desarnauts) finds herself at an emotional crossroads after becoming aware of her true feelings for Luke (Christophe Rippert). As she struggles with her doubts and regrets, she realizes that their relationship, with its uncertainties and misunderstandings, deserves a second chance. Determined not to let this opportunity pass, she set out on a quest to find Luke, hoping to revive the flame that united them. However, their meeting will not be without obstacles. Each of them has evolved, and the experiences since their separation have changed them. Surrounded by their friends, including Camille (Camille Raymond) and Fabien (Fabienemblier), they will have to navigate through unexpected tensions, rivalries and revelations. As the past resurfaces, Virginia will have to face her choices and find out if love can really forgive everything.

As Annette and Aristide try to understand the reasons that led Luke to isolate themselves in this hostile environment, they realize that student life is not only about parties and success. The tensions and difficult choices they face force them to face their own fears and responsibilities. In this night of uncertainty, bonds of friendship will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about each one.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: Tension rises within the group of friends when Luke (Christophe Rippert), one of the most appreciated members, mysteriously disappears. Concerned for his safety, Annette (Virginie Desarnauts) and Ari (Fabien Rememblier) decided to conduct the investigation. Their quest leads them to cross the path of an enigmatic tramp who, with vague but disturbing information, reveals that Luke was seen heading towards the canal. As the rest of the band, composed of colourful characters, begins to gather to find their friend, internal tensions arise. Each one is confronted with his own doubts and fears, questioning their relationships and the strength of their friendship. Luke's search thus becomes a revealing of buried secrets and unfavorable desires, while the canal, both a place of mystery and danger, becomes the centre of their collective anguish.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Laure returns from Africa to seek care for Zacharia, a 10-year-old orphan. She's got a car accident with Jessica, who's having a miscarriage. Jessica and Baptiste opt for adoption and eventually welcome Zacharie. Laure cancels a trip to Africa to support Jessica, in the midst of depression. The yacht of Yannis Nomikos, David's father, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Yannis learns that he has an incurable disease but asks Lucie not to say anything. Grégory returns to Saint-Tropez after spending ten years in a Colombian prison. Caroline learns that she is pregnant but dare not tell David, who fears fatherhood. A season marked by the return of Frédéric Daban, in the role of Gregory.
programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Luka Kovac, a Croatian doctor, took his first steps in the emergency room, as did Abby Lockhart, a young obstetric nurse who had become a medical student. Elizabeth Corday and Mark Greene started an affair while his father gave the soul back. The actor Anthony Edwards, who was behind the camera for the film "Charlie et le Phantom" in 1994, directed the episode "Family affairs", after two first essays in seasons 2 and 4.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: The Doctor continues his spatiotemporal journey, surrounded by Amy, his boyfriend Rory and the archaeologist River Song. The crew members of the Tardis are faced with a multitude of new enemies, including the Gangers, clones created by humans, the religious order of Silence and Hitler himself. But a terrible taraudic secret the Doctor's three companions, who cannot reveal to him the nature of it. Steven Moffat, who has been in charge of the series since the start of Russel T. Davies, has been putting his foot on this beautiful sixth season, but perhaps a bit disconcerting for fans.
programme.desc-more: Amy, Rory and the Doctor, still looking for Melody Pound, came back in their own time. But under the threat of Mels, a childhood friend of Amy and Rory pursued by the police, the team was forced to board the Tardis again. Mels uses his gun and damages the device. In 1938, the Tardis crashed in Berlin in Hitler's office, and was invaded by toxic smoke.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Mary is arguing with Sheldon's drama teacher. The object of the discord is a fundraising project organized for the church on the occasion of Halloween. Georgie cracks for a rebellious teenage girl Sheldon gives private lessons...
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: The convoy of wagons is attacked by the Trig gang, which steal all their supplies. Benny, happy to find her daughter, decides to follow the gang in her den. Meanwhile, a religious community arrives and proposes to help repair the carts and fill up with supplies.
programme.desc-more: While the wagon train stops at Independence Rock, the excitement is palpable among the passengers, who are preparing to celebrate July 4, the day of American independence. In this festive atmosphere, the main characters, including the staggered Craig (Daniel Radcliffe) and the optimist Sanjay (Karan Soni), are at the heart of a series of unforeseen events. As the local community mobilizes to organize memorable festivities, tensions are mounting between those who want to respect tradition and those who want to bring a modern touch to the celebration. Geraldine Viswanathan is an ambitious young woman who dreams of turning this party into a spectacular event, creating conflicts with purists. Between fireworks, games, and confrontations, the characters will have to navigate through their differences to make this day an unforgettable moment, while discovering what independence really means, both personally and collectively.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: A murder was committed in prison. All accused the victim's co-convict, a Carrera. The murder took place in the middle of the night, when the two men were locked up together. At the same time, the body of a young ballet dancer is found lying on a stage...
programme.desc-more: After Maxime Vernon, who was in charge of the RIS department, the whole team is in a state of disbelief. Still in shock, the police welcome Lucie Ballack, who took over from Vernon. A serial killer, who engulfs his victims, forces them to go back into work. The murderer, who managed to remove Emilie, put the nerves of the experts to a severe test. Later, it was the mysterious death of a parachute, which burned in a jump, which posed a serious riddle to the agents. The final season of a quality police series at the renewed casting. This time, Delphine Rollin (Lucie Ballack) is entering the credits.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: Han's got to play hero when a thief panics at the restaurant. Employees therefore see it in another light. Caroline, on the other hand, did not shine by her courage, even using Max as a human shield in panic. The next day, in the movies, they fight...
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) is a waitress at the Williamburg Diner in Brooklyn, where she juggles between difficult clients and a modest daily. She came from a disadvantaged environment and learned to fight for survival. When Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs), a fallen heiress, was hired as a new waitress, their encounter seemed unlikely. Caroline, who has always lived in luxury thanks to her father's fortune, suddenly finds herself in a precarious situation after he was exposed to fraud. Despite their class differences, the two young women are building a strong bond and supporting each other. Together, they dream of opening their own cupcake business, while working hard at dinner. Through ups and downs, hilarious misadventures and daily challenges, Max and Caroline navigate the world of work, learning to overcome their obstacles while cultivating their friendship and entrepreneurial spirit.

programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Max, who had come from a modest environment and had experienced many difficulties, was cynical and disillusioned with life, while Caroline, once raised in luxury, saw her life change after her crooked father was imprisoned. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Jake and his father have to deal with family feuds. Meanwhile, Amy and Rosa are looking at a highly mediated case.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: In this episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale) decides to devote his day to raising the morale of his friend Shred, who is going through a difficult period because of the emerging relationship between Emily (Vella Lovell) and Rick (Ravi Patel). While Frank is trying to distract Shred with a lot of stuff, the brigade is shaken by unexpected news: Victoria (Grace Palmer) married a man in order to obtain a permanent resident card. This decision raises many questions within the team, who questions whether Victoria acted out of love or whether it was manipulated. While Frank and Shred are trying to find meaning in their own lives, tension is rising within the brigade, each facing their own emotional dilemmas. This episode combines humour and reflections on friendship, love and the difficult choices that one sometimes has to make.

Meanwhile, Emily (Vella Lovell), determined to face Templeton, a formidable competitor, is seeking the help of her teammates to win an animal adoption contest. This competition, which promises to be fierce, will test the skills and ingenuity of the team. At the same time, Patel (Ravi Patel) discovers an attractive investment opportunity that could change his life, but that requires juggling his professional responsibilities with his personal aspirations. In a context where loyalty and mutual support are essential, each member of the team will have to demonstrate creativity and solidarity to overcome these obstacles.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale), an animal service agent, finds himself facing a major scandal when he discovers an illegal animal trafficking network. In parallel, Shred (Michael Rowland), a somewhat clumsy colleague, made his debut at a night watch, diving into the surprising and sometimes confusing universe of "Fur evenings", where animals are at the centre of unexpected events. Meanwhile, Victoria (Vella Lovell) draws the attention of a secret admirer, adding a touch of mystery to his personal life. To top it all, Patel (Ravi Patel) and Templeton (Gerry Dee), two agents who often disagree, are forced to work together to resolve a delicate situation that forces them to set aside their differences. This episode promises a dose of humour, suspense and emotion, while highlighting the daily challenges facing those who work for the protection of animals.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: In the small town of Woodsboro, horror comes when two teenagers are brutally murdered by a masked killer. Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell), a young woman whose life was already marked by drama, finds herself plunged into a whirlwind of terror, especially since her own mother was murdered a year earlier. While she's alone at home, she's attacked by the mysterious killer, but her boyfriend, Billy Loomis (Skeet Ulrich), is just in time to get the killer to flee. The situation is complicated by the arrival of Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox), a thrill-loving journalist who comes to cover this series of murders. As fear settles in the community, suspicions turn on Billy and Sidney's father, revealing buried secrets and underlying tensions. Sidney's friends, trapped in this spiral of violence, will have to face their own demons to survive this new nightmare reality.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon and Meemaw are being caught by a video game that vamps their daily lives and becomes their sole concern. Georgie sympathizes with Herschel, which causes her father's jealousy...
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: A race of superhumans and a letter to Alf
programme.desc: Sheldon is experimenting with Missy, her twin guinea pig, while Georgie, the eldest of the siblings, joins Mary's Bible study group in order to spend more time with Veronica, her great love...
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: The migrant group arrives in Independence Rock for July 4, national holiday. But the notion of independence seems to be quite different.
programme.desc-more: While the wagon train stops at Independence Rock, the excitement is palpable among the passengers, who are preparing to celebrate July 4, the day of American independence. In this festive atmosphere, the main characters, including the staggered Craig (Daniel Radcliffe) and the optimist Sanjay (Karan Soni), are at the heart of a series of unforeseen events. As the local community mobilizes to organize memorable festivities, tensions are mounting between those who want to respect tradition and those who want to bring a modern touch to the celebration. Geraldine Viswanathan is an ambitious young woman who dreams of turning this party into a spectacular event, creating conflicts with purists. Between fireworks, games, and confrontations, the characters will have to navigate through their differences to make this day an unforgettable moment, while discovering what independence really means, both personally and collectively.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: Fred, Emilie and Claire, the new R.I.S. coroner, are called to a veterinary pharmaceutical laboratory, where a young woman seems to have succumbed to an explosion. The body is repatriated to the R.I.S. for autopsy. That's when Emilia and Claire are sick...
programme.desc-more: After Maxime Vernon, who was in charge of the RIS department, the whole team is in a state of disbelief. Still in shock, the police welcome Lucie Ballack, who took over from Vernon. A serial killer, who engulfs his victims, forces them to go back into work. The murderer, who managed to remove Emilie, put the nerves of the experts to a severe test. Later, it was the mysterious death of a parachute, which burned in a jump, which posed a serious riddle to the agents. The final season of a quality police series at the renewed casting. This time, Delphine Rollin (Lucie Ballack) is entering the credits.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: Max and Caroline are offering themselves a holiday in the apartment of a bourgeois couple whose dog they have agreed to keep. But when she learns that a bloggueur specializing in gastronomy is interested in their cupcake shop, Caroline resumes service. Max, she's not sure.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) is a waitress at the Williamburg Diner in Brooklyn, where she juggles between difficult clients and a modest daily. She came from a disadvantaged environment and learned to fight for survival. When Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs), a fallen heiress, was hired as a new waitress, their encounter seemed unlikely. Caroline, who has always lived in luxury thanks to her father's fortune, suddenly finds herself in a precarious situation after he was exposed to fraud. Despite their class differences, the two young women are building a strong bond and supporting each other. Together, they dream of opening their own cupcake business, while working hard at dinner. Through ups and downs, hilarious misadventures and daily challenges, Max and Caroline navigate the world of work, learning to overcome their obstacles while cultivating their friendship and entrepreneurial spirit.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: The girls eventually open their cupcake shop after a happy contest of circumstances. But managing such a case is not simple.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: On the occasion of a garage sale, the boys found a ring that had been used during the film The Lord of the Rings. They are constantly arguing about who owns the precious object. In the meantime, they're entrusting him to Penny...
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard borrows a robotic arm from NASA for a personal project. Sheldon and Amy are planning on having a baby. Penny advises Sheldon to get to know Amy better before she gets involved. Sheldon is planning a first date with Amy and asks Penny to accompany her...
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: While Doug Judy is back at the police station, events take on a more personal turn between him and Jake. Amy and Charles are looking for the perfect food distributor to install it in the office...
programme.desc-more: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: June 2020. In the midst of a covid epidemic, Rosa announces that she is resigning. Jake's reaction results in a series of events that end with a blackout. In the spring of 2021, the brigade met in a bar to celebrate Amy's return after her parental leave. That's when Rosa comes in.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: Frank tries to cheer Shred up, saddened by Emily and Rick's romance. Meanwhile, the brigade discovered Victoria's white wedding.
programme.desc-more: In this episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale) decides to devote his day to raising the morale of his friend Shred, who is going through a difficult period because of the emerging relationship between Emily (Vella Lovell) and Rick (Ravi Patel). While Frank is trying to distract Shred with a lot of stuff, the brigade is shaken by unexpected news: Victoria (Grace Palmer) married a man in order to obtain a permanent resident card. This decision raises many questions within the team, who questions whether Victoria acted out of love or whether it was manipulated. While Frank and Shred are trying to find meaning in their own lives, tension is rising within the brigade, each facing their own emotional dilemmas. This episode combines humour and reflections on friendship, love and the difficult choices that one sometimes has to make.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: Shred loves dating apps, Frank's great damn. Emily wants to beat Templeton at the adoption contest. Patel's looking for a good investment.
programme.desc-more: In this episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, the team is faced with a series of unexpected challenges that test their camaraderie and professionalism. Shred (Joel McHale), the team veteran, is regaining a renewed sense of motivation and enthusiasm, particularly for dating apps, which is not without a mixed reaction among his colleagues. Meanwhile, Emily (Vella Lovell), determined to face Templeton, a formidable competitor, is seeking the help of her teammates to win an animal adoption contest. This competition, which promises to be fierce, will test the skills and ingenuity of the team. At the same time, Patel (Ravi Patel) discovers an attractive investment opportunity that could change his life, but that requires juggling his professional responsibilities with his personal aspirations. In a context where loyalty and mutual support are essential, each member of the team will have to demonstrate creativity and solidarity to overcome these obstacles.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: Frank finds out about a pet trade. Shred explores night fur evenings. Victoria has a secret admirer and Patel is teaming up with Templeton.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale), an animal service agent, finds himself facing a major scandal when he discovers an illegal animal trafficking network. In parallel, Shred (Michael Rowland), a somewhat clumsy colleague, made his debut at a night watch, diving into the surprising and sometimes confusing universe of "Fur evenings", where animals are at the centre of unexpected events. Meanwhile, Victoria (Vella Lovell) draws the attention of a secret admirer, adding a touch of mystery to his personal life. To top it all, Patel (Ravi Patel) and Templeton (Gerry Dee), two agents who often disagree, are forced to work together to resolve a delicate situation that forces them to set aside their differences. This episode promises a dose of humour, suspense and emotion, while highlighting the daily challenges facing those who work for the protection of animals.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The small town of Woodsboro is shocked when the locals learn that two young people have just been killed. This double murder is mainly traumatizing Sidney, whose mother died a year ago. Her feeling is well founded: the girl is also being assaulted...
programme.desc-more: In the small town of Woodsboro, horror comes when two teenagers are brutally murdered by a masked killer. Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell), a young woman whose life was already marked by drama, finds herself plunged into a whirlwind of terror, especially since her own mother was murdered a year earlier. While she's alone at home, she's attacked by the mysterious killer, but her boyfriend, Billy Loomis (Skeet Ulrich), is just in time to get the killer to flee. The situation is complicated by the arrival of Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox), a thrill-loving journalist who comes to cover this series of murders. As fear settles in the community, suspicions turn on Billy and Sidney's father, revealing buried secrets and underlying tensions. Sidney's friends, trapped in this spiral of violence, will have to face their own demons to survive this new nightmare reality.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: While Doug Judy is back at the police station, events take on a more personal turn between him and Jake. Amy and Charles are looking for the perfect food distributor to install it in the office...
programme.desc-more: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny announces to Leonard that Justin, one of his guitarist and former lover friends, is coming to sleep at her house for a few days. He misrepresents the news and expresses his discontent. Penny and Leonard are fighting all the time. Sheldon feels very uncomfortable in this situation and thinks that their relationship is coming to an end...
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Sheldon proudly announces to his friends that he will be interviewed by the national radio station to discuss his research. But when Kripke, a scientist who hates him, sets a trap and ridiculs him, Sheldon refuses to leave his room, humiliated. Leonard then offers him revenge...
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: Drew, a very nicely provided high school girl by nature, was murdered by a masked killer. His classmates, Cindy, Bobby, Greg, Brenda, Buffy and Ray, fear that this crime might be linked to the tragic accident they caused a year earlier, which cost the life of a motorist...
programme.desc-more: In a small town where anxiety reigns, the brutal murder of Drew Becker, the most beautiful student in high school, plunges the campus into an atmosphere of terror. As a serial killer wanders around, Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) and her group of friends – including Buffy, Brenda, Bobby, Greg, Shorty and Ray – are embarking on a frantic quest for security. Their friendship will be tested as they try to defeat the mysterious murderer while facing situations as comical as they are terrifying. At the same time, journalist Gail Hailstorm (Carmen Electra) sees this tragedy as a golden opportunity to write a sensational article, unsightly about the impact on the community. Between laughter and shivering, this group of teenagers will have to navigate a series of crazy events, where absurdity and horror intertwine, and where each revelation might be the last.

programme.title: Falling Skies
programme.desc: An alien invasion has decimated the Earth's population. All infrastructure was destroyed and only a few humans survived the cataclysm. Tom Mason, a history teacher whose wife died during the attack on aliens, takes over the command of a group of resistance fighters...
programme.desc-more: After a devastating alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Cities are in ruins and the majority of the human population has been destroyed. In this sorry world, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, rises to lead a group of survivors, the 2nd Regiment of Massachusetts. As a leader, Tom must juggle his new responsibility as a fighter with his role as a father, caring for his sons, one of whom is a captive alien. While the regiment struggles for its survival, it also faces internal tensions and heartbreaking moral dilemmas. His group members, such as Anne Glass (Moon Bloodgood) and Hal Mason (Drew Roy), are fighting not only for their own lives, but also for the restoration of hope within humanity. As battles progress, alliances are formed and broken, while each one faces his own demons and the ubiquitous threat of invaders.

In this sorry world, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, rises to lead a group of survivors, the 2nd Regiment of Massachusetts. As a leader, Tom must juggle his new responsibility as a fighter with his role as a father, caring for his sons, one of whom is a captive alien. While the regiment struggles for its survival, it also faces internal tensions and heartbreaking moral dilemmas. His group members, such as Anne Glass (Moon Bloodgood) and Hal Mason (Drew Roy), are fighting not only for their own lives, but also for the restoration of hope within humanity. As battles progress, alliances are formed and broken, while each one faces his own demons and the ubiquitous threat of invaders.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: The girls eventually open their cupcake shop after a happy contest of circumstances. But managing such a case is not simple.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.sub-title: The last piece of the puzzle
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: While Doug Judy is back at the police station, events take on a more personal turn between him and Jake. Amy and Charles are looking for the perfect food distributor to install it in the office...
programme.desc-more: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Leonard is faced with a difficult choice: to visit the great collision driver of CERN, in Switzerland, or spend Valentine's Day with Penny. Sheldon is upset because he's dreaming of seeing the collisionr for a long time. He's trying to convince Leonard to change his mind, but Leonard's still faithful to his decision. However, Penny gets sick, which calls into question the romantic appointment...
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "Far and catch"Sheldon changes its attitude by discovering the possible impacts of stunting. Meemaw and Dr. Sturgis don't get along in the car.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: "The White Saviour" Benny decided to leave the convoy to resume his occupations but was captured by Indians. He imagines he has a mission as a savior of the Blackfoot tribe.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series, Benny (Daniel Radcliffe), a member of a convoy en route for an uncertain destiny, makes a bold decision by leaving his companions to resume his former activities. However, his initiative quickly turned against him when he was captured by an Indian tribe, the Blackfoot. Benny, who is plagued by a series of visions and reflections on his role, is convinced that he has been chosen to become the savior of this community. As he tries to gain the trust of the tribe members, he faces moral dilemmas and unexpected challenges that force him to question his deep motivations and identity. Through unforeseen encounters and moments of introspection, Benny discovers that the real act of rescue lies not only in heroic gestures, but also in understanding and respecting different cultures.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: "And the hold-up"Han takes on playing heroes when a thief panics at the restaurant. Peach, for his part, asks Max to take over the babysitting.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "Admiral Peralta"Jake and his father have to deal with family disputes. Meanwhile, Amy and Rosa are looking at a highly mediated case.
programme.desc-more: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "Not so common"Amy returns after maternity leave following the birth of her son Mac. Jack and Rosa, for their part, are collaborating on a complex investigation.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "The famous ring" On the occasion of a garage vacuum, the boys found a ring that had been used during the film "The Lord of the Rings" and entrusted it to Penny.
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "Sheldon in hospital"Sheldon, while in hospital, turns out to be the worst patient ever. Missy, for her part, has a glimpse of what life would be without her twin.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: "A mountain of obstacles"Finally, travelers reach the mountains, but unfortunately many obstacles still stand on their way.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the Miracle Workers series, the team of carts embarks on a perilous adventure through the majestic Blue Mountains. While the group, composed of colourful characters, faces a multitude of unexpected challenges, each has to use its unique skills to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Between the grandiose landscapes and the dangers inherent in this journey, tensions are rising and personalities are growing. The leader of the group, a man with a lively mind, must navigate between the ambitions of his companions and the unforeseen nature. As events unfold, unexpected alliances are formed, while old rivalries re-emergence. In this context, the characters will have to learn to work together to achieve their common goal, while discovering truths about themselves and their friendship.
