programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the credit card advance agreement
programme.desc: "And the prior credit card agreement" Girls get a prior agreement to receive a credit card. Immediately, they struggle to suppress a terrible desire for shopping.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "The ransom"Holt asks Jack for help in resolving an exceptional case while Charles and Terry are working together on secondary matters.
programme.desc-more: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "Not so common"Amy returns after maternity leave following the birth of her son Mac. Jack and Rosa, for their part, are collaborating on a complex investigation.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "Wheaton's Recurrence" Leonard's declaration of love to Penny goes wrong and threatens their relationship. In a bowling tournament, Sheldon settles his accounts with Wil Wheaton, his sworn enemy.
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.desc-more: In the frantic and often comic world of the Sacred Heart Hospital, young intern Elliot Reid (Sarah Chalke) is convinced that she has identified the voice of Dr. Bob Kelso (Ken Jenkins) singing "Tuscaloosa Heart" on a tape left by a patient. Convinced that this discovery could reveal a hidden aspect of Dr. Kelso's personality, she embarked on a humorous and touching investigation, bringing her friends and colleagues into her quest. J.D. (Zach Braff), his best friend and an intern often in the midst of his own emotional dilemmas, finds himself juggling his support for Elliot with his own love complications. Meanwhile, Turk (Donald Faison), his inseparable friend, tries to find a balance between his professional life and his relationship with Carla (Judy Reyes). Through the baffling situations and moments of sincere camaraderie, the characters navigate the challenges of hospital life while exploring their own identities.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: In a difficult context where survival is being tested, Ezekiel (Daniel Radcliffe), Benny (Karan Soni) and a group of farmers face devastating famine as a relentless blizzard attacks their community. They are isolated and faced with extreme conditions and must find creative ways to survive while maintaining the spirit of comradeship and solidarity that unites them. Meanwhile, Todd (Jon Bass), seeking recognition and power, decided to embark on politics, hoping to make significant changes to his community. This choice leads him to a complex world where alliances are formed and defeated, and the stakes are higher than ever. As the storm rages outside, characters must navigate between their personal aspirations and collective challenges, thus illustrating the human resilience to adversity.
programme.desc-more: In a world where chaos reigns on Earth, the disastrous consequences of climate change threaten to destroy humanity. Species disappear at an alarming rate, and madness takes hold of men, driven to desperate acts by the environmental distress. In this apocalyptic context, God, the eccentric boss of Heaven Inc., is totally overwhelmed by events beyond his control. As he tries to manage a team of angels with varying skills, each facing existential crises, he also has to deal with the incessant complaints of desperate humans. The employees of Heaven Inc. find themselves involved in situations as bad as they can be, navigating between the absurd and the tragic. The series explores with humour and derision the challenges of divine creation in the face of a humanity in perdition, while questioning the sense of faith and responsibility in a world in crisis.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.
programme.desc-more: Sandrine, 30, is found stabbed in the elevator of a large Parisian hotel. Venturi and his team are on the spot to collect clues. They found that before she died, the young woman had participated in a bachelor's party organized in the hotel. Besides, his room was sacked. Nathalie and Malik, for their part, investigate the death of another woman left for dead on the roadside.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And three stallions in the stable
programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Max, who had come from a modest environment and had experienced many difficulties, was cynical and disillusioned with life, while Caroline, once raised in luxury, saw her life change after her crooked father was imprisoned. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.title: Scrubs
programme.desc: Jordan's revelations have thrown a cold. Nobody talks in the hospital halls anymore. But the care goes first, so Carla always ends up falling on Turk and Elliot has a hard time avoiding JD. The second season continues to explore the characters of the characters and highlights less developed relationships, such as Cox and Elliot, or advances already well-established relationships, such as Turk and Carla.
programme.desc-more: In the frantic and often comic world of the Sacred Heart Hospital, young intern Elliot Reid (Sarah Chalke) is convinced that she has identified the voice of Dr. Bob Kelso (Ken Jenkins) singing "Tuscaloosa Heart" on a tape left by a patient. Convinced that this discovery could reveal a hidden aspect of Dr. Kelso's personality, she embarked on a humorous and touching investigation, bringing her friends and colleagues into her quest. J.D. (Zach Braff), his best friend and an intern often in the midst of his own emotional dilemmas, finds himself juggling his support for Elliot with his own love complications. Meanwhile, Turk (Donald Faison), his inseparable friend, tries to find a balance between his professional life and his relationship with Carla (Judy Reyes). Through the baffling situations and moments of sincere camaraderie, the characters navigate the challenges of hospital life while exploring their own identities.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: In 1906, in Oklahoma territory, widower Henry McCarthy worked hard on the land with his son Wyatt and brother-in-law Al. One morning, his attention is drawn to a horse wandering alone in the distance. He catches him up and discovers a man seriously shot and holding a bag full of money. After a moment of hesitation, he takes the bag and takes the man home to try to cure him. As he entrusts the wounded, tied up, to his son, Henry goes to town to get a doctor. But in the meantime, Ketchum and his man tomorrow, thrown on the injured man's track, are getting closer to him.

programme.title: Thanksgiving: The Week of Horror
programme.desc: In Plymouth, Massachusetts, Thanksgiving is taking a tragic turn for Mitch Collins (Patrick Dempsey) and his family. As they gather to celebrate this tradition, Mitch, head of a department store, has to go to his workplace for the opening at midnight, marking the beginning of the Black Friday's sales. The night darkens when the crowd of customers who are hungry for good business creates a real fuss, quickly turning into a deadly tragedy. A year later, the city is still haunted by the memories of this traumatic event. The inhabitants are trying to find a semblance of normality, but a new macabre incident is disturbing peace: a masked killer, disguised as a pilgrim, is beginning to attack members of the community. As fear settles, Sheriff Eric Newlon (Milo Manheim) and Mitch's relatives face an insidious evil that threatens to revive the wounds of the past.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon has decreed the boycott of her favorite bread brand. More of a question of touching for him, but this measure soon takes on a somewhat unconsidered proportion. Georgie, for her part, is trying to console Veronica, who just broke up with her boyfriend...
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: After Dr. Sturgis' nervous depression, Mary Cooper fears that the same will happen to Sheldon. But he also asks questions about his mother's mental health. When a store goes bankrupt, Georgie wants to buy snowballs that have not been sold. He discovers a talent for sale...
programme.desc-more: At the dawn of her last year of high school, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) found herself facing a decisive turning point in her life. Invited to a prestigious conference in Caltech, he aspires to convince his mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), to let him continue his university studies. While her father, George (Lance Barber), is involved in this process, Mary struggles with her own fears and the role of a protective mother. At the same time, Georgie (Montana Jordan) began exploring the world of work while initiating romantic relationships, while Missy (Raegan Revord) discovered a passion for sport, which led him to romantic adventures. Despite their own concerns, the two teenagers are not missing an opportunity to tease their gifted brother. In this third season, the series continues to portray with humour and tenderness the family dynamics and challenges of the transition to adulthood of Sheldon and his loved ones.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.sub-title: At the end of the trail
programme.desc: The wagon convoy is facing its last test of force.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Miracle Workers", the convoy of wagons, led by the charismatic and daring Craig (Daniel Radcliffe), finds itself confronted with a final challenge that puts to the test not only their determination, but also their team spirit. While the members of the group, including the pragmatic and ingenious Eliza (Geraldine Viswanathan) and the comic but loyal Benny (Karan Soni), have to overcome unexpected obstacles, internal tensions are beginning to emerge. Tensions between personalities and individual ambitions threaten to undermine their mission. In this chaotic context, they must show courage and ingenuity to navigate through perilous situations, while striving to remain united in the face of adversity. Pressure rises as they head towards their final destination, where the ultimate test of strength awaits them, forcing them to redefine their priorities and discover the true value of friendship.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: A bomb in a church explodes, seriously wounding a sacristan. The R.I.S. discovers that the explosive, composed of weed remover, had been hidden in a candle. After returning from their sampling mission, Malik and Hugo witness an accident: a bicycle child is hit by a motorcycle...
programme.desc-more: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: The opening of their upcoming cupcake shop gives Max and Caroline work. The tandem decided to employ a trainee to perform certain tasks, but the attitude to adopt towards the young woman divided them. Caroline is too strict, while Max is lax at the extreme...
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the weekend in the mountains
programme.desc: The girls have won a relaxing weekend in the mountains and are looking forward to spending a little time doing nothing. But Caroline accidentally invites Andy to join them during this vacation. Spending the night all three in a cabin in the middle of the woods wasn't really planned for the program...
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: O'Sullivan causes the uniformed officers to be disconnected by claiming to be ill following an incident. Desiring to deepen the investigation and force the officers to return to work, Holt ordered the squad to investigate the incident and took care to find replacements in other police stations.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Penny and Leonard spend a crazy night, which Leonard hastened to interpret as something other than a regrettable mistake: contempt is blatant.
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard borrows a robotic arm from NASA for a personal project. Sheldon and Amy are planning on having a baby. Penny advises Sheldon to get to know Amy better before she gets involved. Sheldon is planning a first date with Amy and asks Penny to accompany her...
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: Zookeeper
programme.desc: After his girlfriend Stephanie refused his proposal, Griffin Keyes is considering leaving Franklin Park Zoo where he works. But the animals he cares about do not want to let their favorite guardian leave. To help him, they reveal their secret: they speak...
programme.desc-more: At Franklin Park Zoo, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James), the caretaker with a big heart, stands out for his unique connection to animals, who consider him one of their own. Unfortunately, his love life is chaotic; His girlfriend, Stephanie (Leslie Bibb), refused his proposal, leaving him distraught. Convinced that his sentimental situation can only improve through radical change, Griffin decided to leave his post to seek a more prestigious job. However, animals, attached to their human friend, come together to develop a clever plan to convince them to stay. Through hilarious dialogues and nasty situations, they reveal Griffin the true values of love and friendship. As he enters this unexpected adventure, he discovers that happiness can reside where one least expects it, while learning to overcome his fears of love.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: An alien power sent video games to the Earth. At least this is Ludlow Lamonsoff's theory, ace of the arcade game Centipède. Like him, Sam Brenner, world champion of Pacman, and Eddie Plant, the cador of Donkey Kong, are charged by their friend, President Cooper, to save the planet...
programme.desc-more: In the summer of 1982, Sam Brenner and his friends were teens who were passionate about video games in a small suburban town. Sam, the most talented of them, competed in the World Arcade Championship, but lost to champion Eddie Plant. Thirty years passed and Sam, who never evolved, remained President Will Cooper's best friend. But the situation is changing when an alien invasion of pixels occurs.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: Climate change, endangered species, God wants to send an asteroid to start all over again. But Eliza and Craig have a plan.
programme.desc-more: In a world where chaos reigns on Earth, the disastrous consequences of climate change threaten to destroy humanity. Species disappear at an alarming rate, and madness takes hold of men, driven to desperate acts by the environmental distress. In this apocalyptic context, God, the eccentric boss of Heaven Inc., is totally overwhelmed by events beyond his control. As he tries to manage a team of angels with varying skills, each facing existential crises, he also has to deal with the incessant complaints of desperate humans. The employees of Heaven Inc. find themselves involved in situations as bad as they can be, navigating between the absurd and the tragic. The series explores with humour and derision the challenges of divine creation in the face of a humanity in perdition, while questioning the sense of faith and responsibility in a world in crisis.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.
programme.desc-more: Sandrine, 30, is found stabbed in the elevator of a large Parisian hotel. Venturi and his team are on the spot to collect clues. They found that before she died, the young woman had participated in a bachelor's party organized in the hotel. Besides, his room was sacked. Nathalie and Malik, for their part, investigate the death of another woman left for dead on the roadside.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the credit card advance agreement
programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Max, who had come from a modest environment and had experienced many difficulties, was cynical and disillusioned with life, while Caroline, once raised in luxury, saw her life change after her crooked father was imprisoned. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Max, who had come from a modest environment and had experienced many difficulties, was cynical and disillusioned with life, while Caroline, once raised in luxury, saw her life change after her crooked father was imprisoned. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In the vibrant Brooklyn area, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) faced a major challenge when he was appointed to head a police station known for his chaotic atmosphere. His team, made up of eccentric personalities, is a light-years away from his vision of an exemplary police service. At the heart of this dynamic is Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant yet immature investigator whose staggered humour and idleness test the captain's patience. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), is a young student and ambitious inspector, obsessed with the idea of proving her worth in Holt's eyes. At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.

programme.desc: In the vibrant Brooklyn area, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) faced a major challenge when he was appointed to head a police station known for his chaotic atmosphere. His team, made up of eccentric personalities, is a light-years away from his vision of an exemplary police service. At the heart of this dynamic is Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant yet immature investigator whose staggered humour and idleness test the captain's patience. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), is a young student and ambitious inspector, obsessed with the idea of proving her worth in Holt's eyes. At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: In this episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale) finds himself in a difficult situation when his colleague Emily (Vella Lovell) joins him for a patrol. While Frank prefers a more relaxed approach, Emily is known for her strict adherence to the rules, which promises to make the day particularly chaotic. Tensions are rising as they face unforeseen situations involving wandering animals and eccentric owners. At the same time, Shred (Michael Rowland) and Patel (Ravi Patel) are celebrating a significant event: their accession to the property. To mark this new stage in their lives, they are organizing a festive evening that attracts the attention of their friends and neighbours. The two intrigues intertwine while Frank has to navigate between Emily's demands and Shred and Patel's festivities, while managing the unforeseen nature reserves for him.

programme.title: Hollow Man: The Man Without Shadows
programme.desc: In a state-of-the-art laboratory, the brilliant but arrogant scientist Sebastian Caine (Kevin Bacon) dedicates his life to research on invisibility. After many years of hard work and hard work, he and his team, composed of biologist Linda McKay (Elisabeth Shue) and engineer Matt Kensington (Josh Brolin), finally discovered a revolutionary formula. However, in an effort to prove his superiority, Caine hides his advances from the army, his employer, to carry out experiments on himself. Once invisible, he frees himself from all the moral constraints that held him, leaving room for his darkest desires. This power of invisibility quickly becomes a curse, for Caine, in the midst of violent impulses, begins to manipulate and terrorize those around him. As his colleagues realize the gravity of the situation, they must find a way to stop Caine before he completely loses his humanity and causes irreversible devastation.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: On April 11, 1970, the American space program decided to send the Apollo 13 mission, with the three astronauts Jim Lovell, Jack Swigert and Fred Haise on board. The take-off and the first phases of the flight are unadulterated. But two days later, Jim Lovell alerted NASA's centre in Houston: an explosion damaged the shuttle's oxygen supply and the air filtration system. A race against the clock is then set to save these three shipwrecked from space, who cannot turn back.

programme.title: Falling Skies
programme.desc: After a devastating alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Cities are in ruins and the majority of the human population has been destroyed. In this sorry world, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, rises to lead a group of survivors, the 2nd Regiment of Massachusetts. As a leader, Tom must juggle his new responsibility as a fighter with his role as a father, caring for his sons, one of whom is a captive alien. While the regiment struggles for its survival, it also faces internal tensions and heartbreaking moral dilemmas. His group members, such as Anne Glass (Moon Bloodgood) and Hal Mason (Drew Roy), are fighting not only for their own lives, but also for the restoration of hope within humanity. As battles progress, alliances are formed and broken, while each one faces his own demons and the ubiquitous threat of invaders.
programme.desc-more: In a world devastated by an alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Within a few days, infrastructure was destroyed and 90% of the human population disappeared, leaving survivors in a desperate struggle for their survival. In Boston, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a history teacher, finds himself alongside his sons in this fierce struggle against the invaders. While the alien forces capture and enslave the still alive teenagers, Mason becomes the leader of a group of resistors determined to regain their planet. Together, they try to decipher the motivations and strategies of these hostile creatures. By exploring family dynamics and human resilience to adversity, "Falling Skies" plunges spectators into an odyssey of survival, hope and sacrifice, while questioning the very nature of humanity in the face of the unknown.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Max, who had come from a modest environment and had experienced many difficulties, was cynical and disillusioned with life, while Caroline, once raised in luxury, saw her life change after her crooked father was imprisoned. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. programme.title: Scrubs
programme.desc: Jordan's revelations have thrown a cold. Nobody talks in the hospital halls anymore. But the care goes first, so Carla always ends up falling on Turk and Elliot has a hard time avoiding JD. The second season continues to explore the characters of the characters and highlights less developed relationships, such as Cox and Elliot, or advances already well-established relationships, such as Turk and Carla.
programme.desc-more: In the frantic and often comic world of the Sacred Heart Hospital, young intern Elliot Reid (Sarah Chalke) is convinced that she has identified the voice of Dr. Bob Kelso (Ken Jenkins) singing "Tuscaloosa Heart" on a tape left by a patient. Convinced that this discovery could reveal a hidden aspect of Dr. Kelso's personality, she embarked on a humorous and touching investigation, bringing her friends and colleagues into her quest. J.D. (Zach Braff), his best friend and an intern often in the midst of his own emotional dilemmas, finds himself juggling his support for Elliot with his own love complications. Meanwhile, Turk (Donald Faison), his inseparable friend, tries to find a balance between his professional life and his relationship with Carla (Judy Reyes). Through the baffling situations and moments of sincere camaraderie, the characters navigate the challenges of hospital life while exploring their own identities.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 3 of the Superstore series
programme.desc-more: In the suburbs of Saint-Louis, the Cloud 9 supermarket is the scene of the colourful daily life of its employees. Amy (America Ferrera), a clever saleswoman, juggles her professional responsibilities with her personal life, while navigating in the often hilarious dynamics of her colleagues. At his side, Dina (Lauren Ash), the manager's assistant, imposes an authoritarian management style that leaves no room for challenge. Garrett (Colton Dunn), a paraplegic and micro ad person, brings a unique perspective on the world of work, while Cheyenne (Nichole Bloom), a naive teenager, brings a dose of innocence and enthusiasm to the team. Through the daily drama and bumpy situations, the series explores the challenges of modern working life and consumer culture, offering a satirical and touching look at human relations and solidarity in a often chaotic working environment.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: Starsky and Hutch
programme.desc: In the vibrant city of Bay City, California, two detectives with opposite personalities are forced to work together. David Starsky (Ben Stiller) is a rigid and methodical policeman, firmly committed to law enforcement. He is joined by Ken Hutchinson, nicknamed Hutch (Owen Wilson), who embodies a free spirit that does not hesitate to circumvent the rules to achieve its goals. Their chief, Captain Dobey, gave them a delicate investigation after a body was discovered on the beach, plunging both partners into a complex case related to organized crime. Accompanied by their eccentric informant, Huggy-les-bons-tuiaux (Snoop Dogg), they will have to navigate through a world of false-likers, betrayals and unbridled prosecution. As they try to break through the mysteries of this murderous affair, the tension between their opposite style of work continues to increase, promising moments as hilarious as it is hilarious.

programme.title: Star Trek : Nemesis
programme.desc: Commander Riker is marrying Councillor Deanna Troi. Is both members of the Enterprise and the assembled crew celebrates the event. But no question of a wedding trip for the newlyweds, because Captain Jean-Luc Picard is given the mission of driving the Enterprise to the planet Romulus and of renewing diplomatic relations with the Romulans. The ship is moving on when an unknown planet is spotted, on which the carcass of an android is discovered, clearly designed on the model of Data, the android of Enterprise.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: A proposal for a marriage and a crucifix
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: At the dawn of her last year of high school, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) found herself facing a decisive turning point in her life. Invited to a prestigious conference in Caltech, he aspires to convince his mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), to let him continue his university studies. While her father, George (Lance Barber), is involved in this process, Mary struggles with her own fears and the role of a protective mother. At the same time, Georgie (Montana Jordan) began exploring the world of work while initiating romantic relationships, while Missy (Raegan Revord) discovered a passion for sport, which led him to romantic adventures. Despite their own concerns, the two teenagers are not missing an opportunity to tease their gifted brother. In this third season, the series continues to portray with humour and tenderness the family dynamics and challenges of the transition to adulthood of Sheldon and his loved ones.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: Climate change, endangered species, God wants to send an asteroid to start all over again. But Eliza and Craig have a plan.
programme.desc-more: In a world where chaos reigns on Earth, the disastrous consequences of climate change threaten to destroy humanity. Species disappear at an alarming rate, and madness takes hold of men, driven to desperate acts by the environmental distress. In this apocalyptic context, God, the eccentric boss of Heaven Inc., is totally overwhelmed by events beyond his control. As he tries to manage a team of angels with varying skills, each facing existential crises, he also has to deal with the incessant complaints of desperate humans. The employees of Heaven Inc. find themselves involved in situations as bad as they can be, navigating between the absurd and the tragic. The series explores with humour and derision the challenges of divine creation in the face of a humanity in perdition, while questioning the sense of faith and responsibility in a world in crisis.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.
programme.desc-more: Sandrine, 30, is found stabbed in the elevator of a large Parisian hotel. Venturi and his team are on the spot to collect clues. They found that before she died, the young woman had participated in a bachelor's party organized in the hotel. Besides, his room was sacked. Nathalie and Malik, for their part, investigate the death of another woman left for dead on the roadside.
