programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the weekend in the mountains
programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Max, who had come from a modest environment and had experienced many difficulties, was cynical and disillusioned with life, while Caroline, once raised in luxury, saw her life change after her crooked father was imprisoned. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: While Bonnie (Allison Janney) and Adam (William Fichtner) fly off for a long-awaited honeymoon, Christy (Anna Faris), their daughter, sees this as a golden opportunity to take over the reins of the family bar. Taking advantage of her parents' absence, she is tackling a series of changes she considers necessary to modernize the institution and attract younger clientele. However, this initiative is not proceeding smoothly. Christy faces unexpected challenges, including resistance from employees, who are attached to Bonnie's traditional methods. Between whoproquos and tensions, she must juggle her ambitions and respect for family heritage. Meanwhile, Bonnie and Adam, immersed in the carelessness of their romantic getaway, do not doubt the upheavals that are preparing for their return. The reunions are rich in surprises and emotions.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: In this episode of "Mom", the dynamics between Christy (Anna Faris) and Adam (William Fichtner) is tested when an argument breaks out about an embarrassing incident in a bar. Tensions are rising and Christy, determined to deal with his problems, finds himself in conflict with Adam, leaving Bonnie (Allison Janney) in a state of distress, struggling to manage the situation. At the same time, Jill (Jaime Pressly) tries to impress his new boyfriend, Andy, but he seems to have difficulty meeting his expectations. As relationships become complicated and everyone has to navigate through their own emotional challenges, characters have to face their insecurities and learn to support each other. This episode addresses the themes of communication, trust and challenges of love relationships, while maintaining the humour characteristic of the series.

programme.title: Scrubs
programme.desc: Jordan's revelations have thrown a cold. Nobody talks in the hospital halls anymore. But the care goes first, so Carla always ends up falling on Turk and Elliot has a hard time avoiding JD. The second season continues to explore the characters of the characters and highlights less developed relationships, such as Cox and Elliot, or advances already well-established relationships, such as Turk and Carla.
programme.desc-more: In the frantic and often comic world of the Sacred Heart Hospital, young intern Elliot Reid (Sarah Chalke) is convinced that she has identified the voice of Dr. Bob Kelso (Ken Jenkins) singing "Tuscaloosa Heart" on a tape left by a patient. Convinced that this discovery could reveal a hidden aspect of Dr. Kelso's personality, she embarked on a humorous and touching investigation, bringing her friends and colleagues into her quest. J.D. (Zach Braff), his best friend and an intern often in the midst of his own emotional dilemmas, finds himself juggling his support for Elliot with his own love complications. Meanwhile, Turk (Donald Faison), his inseparable friend, tries to find a balance between his professional life and his relationship with Carla (Judy Reyes). Through the baffling situations and moments of sincere camaraderie, the characters navigate the challenges of hospital life while exploring their own identities.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 3 of the Superstore series
programme.desc-more: In the suburbs of Saint-Louis, the Cloud 9 supermarket is the scene of the colourful daily life of its employees. Amy (America Ferrera), a clever saleswoman, juggles her professional responsibilities with her personal life, while navigating in the often hilarious dynamics of her colleagues. At his side, Dina (Lauren Ash), the manager's assistant, imposes an authoritarian management style that leaves no room for challenge. Garrett (Colton Dunn), a paraplegic and micro ad person, brings a unique perspective on the world of work, while Cheyenne (Nichole Bloom), a naive teenager, brings a dose of innocence and enthusiasm to the team. Through the daily drama and bumpy situations, the series explores the challenges of modern working life and consumer culture, offering a satirical and touching look at human relations and solidarity in a often chaotic working environment.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In the vibrant Brooklyn area, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) faced a major challenge when he was appointed to head a police station known for his chaotic atmosphere. His team, made up of eccentric personalities, is a light-years away from his vision of an exemplary police service. At the heart of this dynamic is Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant yet immature investigator whose staggered humour and idleness test the captain's patience. programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Contraband
programme.desc: A true legend of smuggling, Chris Farraday has been putting away cars for a few years to make an honest living with his small security system company. But his brother-in-law, not too smart, took over without his knowledge. And threw a large amount of drugs in the water to escape the fluvial police. His sponsors therefore forced him to make a very big blow to pay them back. A far too complicated operation for him. Chris, in a family spirit, is returning to service on a ship the captain of which hates him cordially.

programme.title: Will Hunting
programme.desc: Will Hunting (Matt Damon) is an authentic genius, but also a rebel with unpredictable impulses. He was born in the popular neighborhood of South Boston and stopped his studies early, refusing the bright future his intelligence could provide. He now lives surrounded by a bunch of friends and spends his time in bars looking for a fight. His prodigious gifts in mathematics then attracted the attention of Professor Lambeau (Stellan Skarsgård), of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

programme.title: Behind the scenes of Raphaël Mezrahi's interviews
programme.desc: For years on television, Raphaël Mezrahi played the fake journalist and interviewed celebrities in meetings full of surreal humor. Of these meetings, the public mainly held the anger of Jean-Pierre Castaldi, convinced to deal with an authentic but incompetent journalist. Through a few interviews, other personalities have revealed themselves, such as Thierry Roland or Michdel Galabru. Mezrahi became too famous in France and continued his interviews abroad. Daryl Hannah, Georges Clooney, Samuel Jackson and many other stars have thus suffered the fire of his stupid questions, some losing their nerves, others remaining pros until the end. In this show, the comedian goes back to the scenes of these famous interviews and reveals what viewers did not see at the time.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: The Guignols de l'info are a robot portrait of the police in France, with a compilation of their best excerpts from the years 1990 to 2018. Among other things, Nicolas Sarkozy and Brice Hortefeux are super cops who are responsible for carrying out fist-and-mouth interventions themselves or, even, iconic Sylvester Stallone, world police chief, special envoy on security issues in the United States.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: The famous puppets of the Guignols de l'info tell us about health in France with a compilation of their best sketches from the years 1990 to 2018. From pharmacy to doctor, through Cantona and its prognosis, Chirac and his memory loss and of course the famous Doctor Sylvestre and his famous vaccines... We take health seriously in France!

programme.title: Decaffeinated: The last 2 friends of the world
programme.desc: In a world where no one can get along, Rémi Deval and Clement Parmentier are the last two true friends, making them pariahs. To get back to normal, they're gonna do everything they can to get confused. Written in collaboration with La Bajon and Vincent Leroy, their show explores the absurdities of the time.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Fools, spectacular falls, unusual characters... The zap offers a florileg of the best sequences that make buzz on the Web. For better or worse, the Internet offers everyone the possibility to become famous in just a few clicks. This results in amazing videos, both on talented personalities and on Internet users who are not afraid of ridiculous. The program also allows you to discover original television sequences or advertisements that have toured the world via the Internet.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Jamel, Sabri and Aymé continue their misadventures in the hospital's orthopaedic department. Sabri has more than one stupid idea in his bag and he's hired as a bartender in a restaurant. Aymé is still a sexually-reducing applicant and is constantly on the lookout as soon as a pretty woman presents herself. Jamel learns that his brother Maurad is gay. A second season of 20 episodes, mostly directed by Jean-Luc Moreau. If Catherine Benguigui leaves sitcom during the season, Edgar Givry appears in the role of the hospital director. With a guest star ribbelle.

programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Jamel, Sabri and Aymé continue their misadventures in the hospital's orthopaedic department. Sabri has more than one stupid idea in his bag and he's hired as a bartender in a restaurant. Aymé is still a sexually-reducing applicant and is constantly on the lookout as soon as a pretty woman presents herself. Jamel learns that his brother Maurad is gay. A second season of 20 episodes, mostly directed by Jean-Luc Moreau. If Catherine Benguigui leaves sitcom during the season, Edgar Givry appears in the role of the hospital director. With a guest star ribbelle.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Sabri and Jamel always have unlikely combinations to achieve their ends. Aymé, on her side, is ready to do anything to seduce a woman. Charlotte, Professor Strauss' very pretty daughter, arrives from the United States and starts working in the hospital. She's gonna become the three boys' favorite and fantasy. Her father still considers her a little girl when she's 25 years old. Sabri is still a bartender, not far from the hospital, and there are always mishaps in his bar. A third season of 20 episodes still as effective. Former Miss France Linda Hardy integrates casting into the role of Professor Strauss' daughter.

programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: It is not easy to be parents and combine family obligations with professional constraints while preserving moments of intimacy.
programme.desc-more: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: On the heads of the children!
programme.desc: One evening, Julie and Alban, in love and superstitious, swear ten years of loyalty to their children's heads. After holding 9 years, 11 months and 15 days, each prepares for the arrival of the fateful date. What happens between them once the couple is freed from their reciprocal oath?

programme.title: Dear parents
programme.desc: When Jeanne and Vincent asked their children to join them urgently to make an important announcement, Pierre, Jules and Louise ran on the spot, worried and fearing the worst. The news their parents tell them will break the beautiful family unit.
programme.desc-more: When Jeanne and Vincent call their three children to tell them important news, they rush, fearing the worst. However, the news is not bad, but it will make the beautiful family unit burst. The retired couple decided to pack their bags and settle in Cambodia. This decision follows the acquisition of a nice sum by the couple. Some masks will fall, jealousy will take place and old grudges will resurface.

programme.title: The most beautiful in all this
programme.desc: Claudine is in a relationship with Octave, a man who is a very interesting, well-educated boy, but at least in the physical. Similarly, when Matt, his ex, left in the United States ten years ago to make a great career in modeling, resurfaces, his heart swings, necessarily. It promises a hilarious and fierce duel between the two men because they want the same thing: conquer the heart of the beautiful Claudine who, with the help of her best friend Joëlle, will have to choose "the most beautiful in all this". And she's even ready to go through "Turn ride!" to decide.

programme.title: Decaffeinated: The last 2 friends of the world
programme.desc: In a world where no one can get along, Rémi Deval and Clement Parmentier are the last two true friends, making them pariahs. To get back to normal, they're gonna do everything they can to get confused. Written in collaboration with La Bajon and Vincent Leroy, their show explores the absurdities of the time.

programme.title: Roland Magdane : Unhappiness
programme.desc: After 40 years of career following one man show, films, theatre and television, Roland Magdane returns, surrounded by his mythical characters, with the same energy for a humor-rich evening. He's having a fight with his family, his wife. He struggles in his life, all the time! The art of this comedian is to observe his quidams under a humorous microscope to make it a totally crazy spectacle. The trubillon takes the opportunity to interpret all the characters of his previous shows like Pépé and Mémé, more wild than ever.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: In a Parisian hospital, three young employees, Jamel, the standardist, Aymé, the nurse, and Sabri, the brancardier, work in a sleazy atmosphere and multiply gaffes and professional mistakes. They met daily with the fantasy of Professor Maximilien Strauss, Beatrice, physician of the Orthopaedic Service, and Clara, the chief nurse of the same service. Jamel constantly invents lies so that he doesn't work. Aymé suffers from hypersexuality and counts the conquests in love. Sabri, he's accumulating the blunders. A first season of 20 episodes, largely by Edouard Molinaro, in AB Productions' studios, and which was a great success on Canal+.
programme.desc-more: Between blunders, bad taste jokes and other mistakes, you never get bored with Sabri, Aymé and Jamel!

programme.title: The new faces: Just for laughs (2nd edition)
programme.desc: With the success of his first edition, "Les Nouveaux Faces Juste pour laughter" reappeared with a new selection of talents ready to mark the future of Francophone humour. Spotted across the French-speaking world, these emerging artists are on stage to share their best creations and reveal worlds as unique as they are audacious. A veritable springboard for the next generation, this iconic tray of Just for Laughs offers the public the opportunity to discover today the comedians we will talk about tomorrow.
programme.desc-more: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 2 of the series The new faces: Just for laughs (2nd edition)

programme.title: New faces: Just for laughs (1st edition)
programme.desc: Spotted across the French-speaking world, these emerging artists are on stage to share their best creations and reveal worlds as unique as they are audacious.
programme.desc-more: The first edition of the "New Faces of Humor" was led by Pascal Cameron, and brought together 55 emerging talents from Quebec, Canada and the Francophone community. Among them were Erickson Alisme, Laurianne Lalonde, Steve Biko, Mimo Larzak, Nikoz, Mibenson Sylvain, Ilona Dufresne and Leonardo De Hemptinne, offering an overview of the French humorous succession.

programme.title: The big comedy show
programme.desc: Combining the most significant moments of the Just for Laughs Festival in Montreal, this evening is a series of novel sets of cults, parodys and duos formed for the occasion.
programme.desc-more: The evening is dedicated to women. "The great show of humorists" proposes to relive the most significant moments of the festival "Just for Laughs", an essential rendezvous of humor, performed by the greatest French-speaking stars, through cult sketches, hilarious parodys and unreleased duos. With Blanche Gardin, Laurent Gerra, Anne Roumanoff, Michael Youn, Franck Dubosc, Elie Semoun, Jean Luc Lemoine, Patrick Timsit, Dany Boon, Florence Foresti, Claudia Tagbo and Nadia Roz.

programme.desc: L-humorist Druski becomes the first content creator to animate the SNL. An episode that was rigged by political news following the mid-term elections, crazy characters and a surprise appearance of Emma Stone. The Strokes is the musical guest.

programme.title: Philippe Bouvard : The art of laughter
programme.desc: Portrait of Philippe Bouvard, writer with high verb, talented discoverer and iconic host of the popular show "The Big Heads".
programme.desc-more: With his bonhommie and insolence, Philippe Bouvard made France laugh for more than 40 years. From the Théâtre de Bouvard to the Big Heads, a successful audience for talent discoveries, this mediaman managed to impose his inimitable style in the PAF. This documentary is an opportunity to relive its cult moments of television through archives, unpublished anecdotes and interviews of the personalities who have accompanied it. With the participation of Bernard Mabille, Jacques Mailhot, Anne Roumanoff, Stéphane Bern, Chantal Ladesou, Philippe Chevallier, Mimie Mathy, Enrico Macias and Smain.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Fools, spectacular falls, unusual characters... "Le Zap" offers a florileg of the best sequences that are buzzing on the Web. For better or worse, the Internet offers everyone the possibility to become famous in just a few clicks. The result is amazing videos, both about talented personalities and about Internet users who are not afraid of ridiculous. The show also allows you to discover TV images or original advertisements that have toured the world via the Internet.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Amateur videos, stars in unfortunate posture, missed TV shows... Internet is full of funny and unusual sequences. The show also compiles the most beautiful falls, the most memorable laughter and the most amazing performances seen on television. While there are obviously many technical mishaps and incidents in this florileg, the palm is probably the responsibility of those who have participated in reality TV programmes that have been victims of the direct. And while the excerpts presented often show surprising situations, everything always ends in a good mood.

programme.title: Comedy @ Home
programme.desc: A group of five artists are invited to perform in a private apartment and in front of a privileged audience. The comedians were welcomed by Blandine Lehout.

programme.title: Comedy @ Home
programme.desc: Comedie@Home is back for a new season! Who ever dreamed of having comedians in his living room? "A band of five artists are invited to perform in a private apartment and in front of a privileged audience." The comedians are greeted by Blandine Lehout, their MC for the evening, and each play a sketch in front of a few lucky spectators. Each show has a new band, a new audience and a new apartment.

programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: Isa and Gaby have three children, Paul, Laetitia and Jules, aged 8 to 16. Every day, they fluctuate between contradictions and bad faith, great principles and small disappointments, marital and parental duties, small clashes and great effluences, passing resignations and unfavorable tricks to limit conflicts. Together, they try to control the situation but often crash in a rather lamentable way. In this first season, only Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret appear, their children are still filmed from the back.
programme.desc-more: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Sabri and Jamel always have unlikely combinations to achieve their ends. Aymé, on her side, is ready to do anything to seduce a woman. Charlotte, Professor Strauss' very pretty daughter, arrives from the United States and starts working in the hospital. She's gonna become the three boys' favorite and fantasy. Her father still considers her a little girl when she's 25 years old. Sabri is still a bartender, not far from the hospital, and there are always mishaps in his bar. A third season of 20 episodes still as effective. Former Miss France Linda Hardy integrates casting into the role of Professor Strauss' daughter.
programme.desc-more: Between blunders, bad taste jokes and other mistakes, you never get bored with Sabri, Aymé and Jamel!

Charlotte, Professor Strauss' very pretty daughter, arrives from the United States and starts working in the hospital. She's gonna become the three boys' favorite and fantasy. Her father still considers her a little girl when she's 25 years old. Sabri is still a bartender, not far from the hospital, and there are always mishaps in his bar. A third season of 20 episodes still as effective. Former Miss France Linda Hardy integrates casting into the role of Professor Strauss' daughter.
programme.desc-more: Between blunders, bad taste jokes and other mistakes, you never get bored with Sabri, Aymé and Jamel!

programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: Roland Magdane : Unhappiness
programme.desc: Roland Magdane is coming back, even more crazy and crazy. In his new show, the humorist transforms the situations of the daily life into hilarious sketches that stage his usual characters, like Pépé and Mémé, more raging than ever. Roland Magdane also struggles with his family and his wife and looks at the health situation and its sometimes ubiquitous consequences on everyday life.
programme.desc-more: After 40 years of career following one man show, films, theatre and television, Roland Magdane returns, surrounded by his mythical characters, with the same energy for a humor-rich evening. He's having a fight with his family, his wife. He struggles in his life, all the time! The art of this comedian is to observe his quidams under a humorous microscope to make it a totally crazy spectacle. The trubillon takes the opportunity to interpret all the characters of his previous shows like Pépé and Mémé, more wild than ever.

programme.title: The most beautiful in all this
programme.desc: Claudine is in a relationship with Octave, a man who is a very interesting, well-educated boy, but at least in the physical. Similarly, when Matt, his ex, left in the United States ten years ago to make a great career in modeling, resurfaces, his heart swings, necessarily. It promises a hilarious and fierce duel between the two men because they want the same thing: conquer the heart of the beautiful Claudine who, with the help of her best friend Joëlle, will have to choose "the most beautiful in all this". And she's even ready to go through "Turn ride!" to decide.

programme.title: Decaffeinated: The last 2 friends of the world
programme.desc: In a world where no one can get along, Rémi Deval and Clement Parmentier are the last two true friends, making them pariahs. To get back to normal, they're gonna do everything they can to get confused. Written in collaboration with La Bajon and Vincent Leroy, their show explores the absurdities of the time.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: In a Parisian hospital, three young employees, Jamel, the standardist, Aymé, the nurse, and Sabri, the brancardier, work in a sleazy atmosphere and multiply gaffes and professional mistakes. They met daily with the fantasy of Professor Maximilien Strauss, Beatrice, physician of the Orthopaedic Service, and Clara, the chief nurse of the same service. Jamel constantly invents lies so that he doesn't work. Aymé suffers from hypersexuality and counts the conquests in love. Sabri, he's accumulating the blunders. A first season of 20 episodes, largely by Edouard Molinaro, in AB Productions' studios, and which was a great success on Canal+.
programme.desc-more: Between blunders, bad taste jokes and other mistakes, you never get bored with Sabri, Aymé and Jamel!

programme.title: New faces: Just for laughs (1st edition)
programme.desc: The first edition of the "New Faces of Humor" was led by Pascal Cameron, and brought together 55 emerging talents from Quebec, Canada and the Francophone community. Among them were Erickson Alisme, Laurianne Lalonde, Steve Biko, Mimo Larzak, Nikoz, Mibenson Sylvain, Ilona Dufresne and Leonardo De Hemptinne, offering an overview of the French humorous succession.

programme.title: The legends of war aviation
programme.sub-title: Me-109: The Epic Hunter of the Luftwaffe
programme.desc: Used in 1937 during the Spanish Civil War, the Me-109 became the Luftwaffe's most efficient fighter aircraft during the Second World War.

programme.title: The little girl at napalm: a photograph's story
programme.desc: On 8 June 1972, in Trang Bang, South Vietnamese aircraft bombed a temple at the napalm. It is home not to vietcong fighters, but to their own soldiers and civilians. A young photographer, Nick Ut, is witnessing the emergence of a naked girl, screaming with pain, from the gigantic flame wall, which is found in her objective. He doesn't know yet, but he's going to freeze forever the one who's going to embody Vietnam's hell. A review of Kim Phuc's third-degree burn, whose infamous cliché will help, by its power, to reverse world opinion about the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Khrushchev to the conquest of America
programme.desc: In September 1959, the first secretary of the Communist Party of USSR went to Washington. Hosted by President Eisenhower, Nikita Khrushchev then crossed the United States from East to West for two weeks, accompanied by her family and surrounded by officials. The causes of this accident are clear: a simple fuel failure and the fact that the crew delayed admitting the seriousness of the situation.

programme.title: Air Crash
programme.desc: On 19 July 1989, after leaving Denver, Colorado, the rear engine of the United Airlines flight 232 aircraft was destroyed in flight. The pilots were then forced to make an emergency landing on the runway at Sioux City Airport, Iowa. But when the aircraft touched the ground, it broke and caught fire. One hundred and twelve passengers died in the tragedy.

programme.title: The Lost Kingdom of Easter Island
programme.desc: Since 1722, Easter Island, a rock lost in the middle of the Pacific, and its 900 immense statues weighing up to 86 tons, fascinates the world.
programme.desc-more: Since the arrival of the first Europeans in 1722, Easter Island, a rock lost in the middle of the Pacific, and its 900 immense statues weighing up to 86 tons, fascinates the world. Scientists are wondering about recent controversies that are undermining decades of prejudice against islanders, including those accused of ecocide and cannibalism. According to a new theory, the Raphanuis used strings to erect the famous statues. By means of a 15 tonne replica, the National Geographic teams will test this high-risk thesis in order to shed light on one of the most fascinating puzzles of antiquity.

programme.title: Air Crash
programme.sub-title: The disaster of the Grand Canyon, flights United Airlines 718 and Trans World Airlines 02
programme.desc: Return to the accident, January 30, 1956, between United Airlines Flight 718 and Trans World Airlines Flight 2. Both aircraft collided at several kilometres above sea level and crashed into the Grand Canyon, resulting in the death of 128 passengers.
programme.desc-more: On 28 November 2016, LaMia flight 2933, connecting Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia, and Medellín, Colombia, crashed against the side of a hill five minutes from the runway of the arrival airport. On board, the Brazilian football team from Chapecoense was preparing to play the go-to match of the Copa Sudamericana final. Seventy-seven people were on board, of whom only six survived the crash. The causes of this accident are clear: a simple fuel failure and the fact that the crew delayed admitting the seriousness of the situation.

programme.title: Air Crash
programme.desc: From Detroit, Northwest Airlines Flight 85 flies towards Narita, Japan, with 400 passengers on board. Suddenly, he flips violently to the left and starts to lose altitude. The pilots managed to stabilize the Boeing 747, but they had difficulty controlling it and decided to turn back in the hope of reaching Anchorage Airport, 1300 kilometres away. Two hours later, a turbulent but trouble-free landing completed the pilot and passenger calvary, and an investigation was opened to determine the causes of the aircraft's malfunction.
programme.desc-more: On 28 November 2016, LaMia flight 2933, connecting Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia, and Medellín, Colombia, crashed against the side of a hill five minutes from the runway of the arrival airport. On board, the Brazilian football team from Chapecoense was preparing to play the go-to match of the Copa Sudamericana final. Seventy-seven people were on board, of whom only six survived the crash. The causes of this accident are clear: a simple fuel failure and the fact that the crew delayed admitting the seriousness of the situation.

programme.title: Planet Crash Recreated
programme.desc: "Air France 4590 / Paris"Back to the disaster of the flight Air France 4590, which caused 113 casualties in total, notably through the testimony of the air controller who witnessed it.
programme.desc-more: On July 25, 2000, Air France 4590 took off from Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle airport to New York. It is provided by an iconic plane: the Concorde. As the aircraft accelerates on the runway, a violent fire is declared under its left wing. The crew struggled to maintain control, but the aircraft was struggling to gain speed and altitude. Shortly after takeoff, he crashed into a hotel in Gonesse, killing the 109 people on board and four people on the ground. This episode traces the disaster through the testimony of the air traffic controller who witnessed it. The lead investigator is looking back at the sequence of events that caused the fire. The accident marks a turning point in the history of supersonic commercial flights, a few years before the Concorde withdrawal.

programme.title: Planet Crash Recreated
programme.desc: "British Airways 9 / Kuala Lumpur"Focus on the disaster of British Airways flight 009, victim, in 1982, of one of the most amazing emergencies in aviation history.
programme.desc-more: In 1982, British Airways flight 009 was the victim of one of the most amazing emergencies in aviation history: its four engines were extinguished while the aircraft was flying over Java. The aircraft turned into a glider, plunged into darkness and losing altitude without any operating engines. The pilots finally managed to re-light the engines, but the reduced visibility prevented them from distinguishing the runway as they approached Jakarta. After a miraculous landing, all passengers and crew members evacuated the aircraft safely. The investigation revealed that BA009 had passed through a cloud of volcanic ash, causing the engines to go out.

programme.title: Planet Crash Recreated
programme.desc: "Air France 4590 / Paris"Back to the disaster of the flight Air France 4590, which caused 113 casualties in total, notably through the testimony of the air controller who witnessed it.
programme.desc-more: On July 25, 2000, Air France 4590 took off from Paris-Charles-de-Gaulle airport to New York. It is provided by an iconic plane: the Concorde. As the aircraft accelerates on the runway, a violent fire is declared under its left wing. The crew struggled to maintain control, but the aircraft was struggling to gain speed and altitude. Shortly after takeoff, he crashed into a hotel in Gonesse, killing the 109 people on board and four people on the ground. This episode traces the disaster through the testimony of the air traffic controller who witnessed it. The lead investigator is looking back at the sequence of events that caused the fire. The accident marks a turning point in the history of supersonic commercial flights, a few years before the Concorde withdrawal.

programme.title: Planet Crash Recreated
programme.desc: "British Airways 9 / Kuala Lumpur"Focus on the disaster of British Airways flight 009, victim, in 1982, of one of the most amazing emergencies in aviation history.
programme.desc-more: In 1982, British Airways flight 009 was the victim of one of the most amazing emergencies in aviation history: its four engines were extinguished while the aircraft was flying over Java. The aircraft turned into a glider, plunged into darkness and losing altitude without any operating engines. The pilots finally managed to re-light the engines, but the reduced visibility prevented them from distinguishing the runway as they approached Jakarta. After a miraculous landing, all passengers and crew members evacuated the aircraft safely. The investigation revealed that BA009 had passed through a cloud of volcanic ash, causing the engines to go out.

This face-to-face between loyalty, survival and ethics raises deep questions about the morality of human choices in desperate circumstances, testing the bonds that bind these men at sea.

programme.title: Sagah
programme.desc: After filing a complaint, Sagah is summoned to the police station. But how can we tell the indescribable when we suffer from post-traumatic stress?
programme.desc-more: After deciding to file a complaint, Sagah finds himself at the police station, faced with the difficulty of putting words on his traumatic experience. In the midst of post-traumatic stress, she struggles to tell the indescribable, while the memories of her past haunt her. The young woman, determined to free herself from this weight, tries to navigate through a judicial system that she often finds incomprehensible and insensitive. Interactions with police officers, although sometimes benevolent, are often tinted with mistrust and misunderstanding, making it even more difficult to move forward. As the interviews progressed, Sagah also discovered the power of solidarity, while other victims joined her in sharing their stories. This path of resilience leads him to redefine his own strength, while seeking justice for himself and for those who have suffered in silence.

programme.title: Disappearance of concern
programme.desc: In Strasbourg, a teacher died suddenly while accompanying a group of students from CM2 for a visit to the cathedral. The kids are disappearing.
programme.desc-more: In Strasbourg, a cold day takes a tragic turn when nine students of a Protestant school mysteriously disappear during a visit to the majestic cathedral of the city. As anxiety grows, the child's mistress collapses and dies on the spot, leaving the community in disarray. No leads, no witnesses can provide clues about the fate of children, plunging the city into an atmosphere of tension and despair. Maya Rosetti (Sara Forestier), a young and determined commissioner, is responsible for this delicate investigation. However, to solve this mystery, she has to face her own demons by reconnecting with her ex-compagnon, a man who prefers to turn the page. In addition, the prosecutor, in disagreement with her methods, further complicates her work. In this fight against time, Maya will have to juggle her personal relationships with the professional stakes to find the missing children.

programme.desc: After filing a complaint, Sagah is summoned to the police station. But how can we tell the indescribable when we suffer from post-traumatic stress?
programme.desc-more: After deciding to file a complaint, Sagah finds himself at the police station, faced with the difficulty of putting words on his traumatic experience. In the midst of post-traumatic stress, she struggles to tell the indescribable, while the memories of her past haunt her. The young woman, determined to free herself from this weight, tries to navigate through a judicial system that she often finds incomprehensible and insensitive. Interactions with police officers, although sometimes benevolent, are often tinted with mistrust and misunderstanding, making it even more difficult to move forward. As the interviews progressed, Sagah also discovered the power of solidarity, while other victims joined her in sharing their stories. This path of resilience leads him to redefine his own strength, while seeking justice for himself and for those who have suffered in silence.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: After a devastating fire in a surgical center, Kidd is looking for the cause of the fire's departure. Violet, Novak and Vasquez are trapped in complicated relationships.
programme.desc-more: Chicago Fire is a captivating drama series that plunges into the heart of firefighters and paramedics at Barrack 51 in Chicago. Under the leadership of Lieutenant Matthew Casey (Jesse Spencer), the team often finds itself confronted with overwhelming emergencies, ranging from devastating fires to heroic rescues in the middle of the night. Each member of this team, such as the charismatic firefighter Kelly Severide (Taylor Kinney) and the determined paramedic Sylvie Brett (Kara Killmer), brings his own expertise and experience, while facing personal challenges that affect their work. Beyond dramatic interventions, the series explores the interpersonal relationships that form in this intense setting, the camaraderie between team members and rivalries with other emergency services. Chicago Fire pays tribute to the heroes of everyday life.

programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. programme.desc: Lewansky receives a text from a 17-year-old girl who tells her that she left her baby alone in her studio, feeling too young to be a mother.
programme.desc-more: Esther Lewanski (Alix Poisson), recently promoted judge, finds himself drawn between her new career and her instincts as an investigator. When she learned of the disappearance of Julia Royer (Sara Forestier), a young mother she knew, her anxiety grew. Julia is suspected of having abandoned her baby, Zoe, but Esther is convinced that her knowledge of Julia would never allow her to commit such an act. Driven by her intuition, she is involved in the investigation, which takes a disturbing turn with the discovery of another young woman, Charlie, whose death, originally considered a suicide, turns out to be a homicide. The links between Julia and Charlie are disturbing, especially through a threat made by Julia just before her disappearance. Esther then finds herself immersed in a complex mystery where secrets, lies and tragedies interlacent, testing her convictions and her commitment to justice.

programme.sub-title: At the end of the night
programme.desc: Laurent, Yann's brother, is being questioned by a woman who accuses him of having harassed him on the road. He's denying it. The next day, the woman was found dead.
programme.desc-more: In the Centre-Val de Loire region, Justine is driving quietly when she notices that a car is following her closely. When he leaves his vehicle to confront the driver, he tries to hit her, barely approaching her. Shocked but determined, Justine goes to the hotel where she plans to spend the night. There she thinks she recognizes her attacker and confronts her. This is Laurent, Yan Kandinsky's brother. A tense exchange and violent disputes ensued. The next morning, Justine was found dead in her room. The investigation takes a dramatic turn when a surveillance camera reveals Laurent leaving the victim's room at the time of the alleged crime, immediately placing him under arrest. But the truth may well be more complex than it seems.

programme.title: Black as snow
programme.desc: In a ski resort, an adjutant from the Peloton de Gendarmerie de Haute Montagne and a Swiss police officer investigate the suspicious death of a teenager.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the snowy and majestic Alps, the Nobleval ski resort hides a mystery as glazed as its decor. As a storm struck the area, the body of Stephan Wicht, a 19-year-old, was discovered in the bottom of a ravine, frozen by the cold, with his left hand brutally cut apart. This grim discovery plunges the authorities into an investigation as complex as it is worrying. Who could have committed such a barbaric act in this idyllic setting, and why? Warrant Officer Constance Vivier, member of the High Mountain Gendarmerie Peloton, is in charge of the investigation. programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: A group of teenagers terrorizing tourists has the U.S.V. team do overtime. McGrath is joining the Bronx gang unit.
programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.

programme.title: A confession
programme.desc: A prognosisal and reckless police officer is called to investigate the death of a young woman who fell from a cliff in front of her husband.
programme.desc-more: Maud Duberry's body, the charismatic director of a renowned wine estate, is found without life at the foot of a rocky peak of the majestic Sainte-Victoire mountain in southern France. Her husband, Jean (Laurent Gerra), witnessed this tragedy. When questioned by the local gendarmerie, he states that Maud accidentally fell as they were walking on a steep road. The case is quickly classified as an unfortunate accident. However, two weeks later, a mysterious witness emerged, sowing the trouble and doubt about the circumstances of this fall. The young constable Clarisse Marquand (Diane Rouxel), determined and insightful, asks her superior to reopen the investigation, convinced that there is more to be discovered behind this accident facade. As the secrets of Maud and his entourage begin to emerge, the truth turns out to be much more complex and darker than it seems.

programme.title: The promise of water
programme.desc: In the Gulf of Lion, off Montpellier, a diver discovers a Greek archaeological treasure in a wreck. His boat is found empty.
programme.desc-more: Off Montpellier, in the crystal clear waters of the Gulf of Lion, young diver Thibault Gagneur (Nicolas Gob) makes a sensational discovery: the gold mask of Méduse, a mythological relic of invaluable value, buried in the heart of a forgotten wreck. Excited by his finding, he does not know that this maritime adventure will quickly turn into a drama. The next day, his boat was found drifting, without trace of Thibault. The situation is alarming, and Guillaume Le Guen (Thomas Jouannet), captain of the Montpellier Regional Judicial Police Service, and his brother Damien, captain of the gendarmerie, are in charge of the investigation. As they investigate, a tied body is discovered at the bottom of the water, revealing mysterious and disturbing circumstances. As the brothers try to unravel the thread of this riddle, they realize that dark forces could be at work, linked to mythology and the lust of forgotten treasures.

programme.title: Silencers
programme.desc: On board the French fishing vessel Perman-Elk, a modest trawler, the crew was deeply frustrated after several days of unsuccessful fishing. The holds remain desperately empty, and the pressure to return to port empty hands weighs heavily on their shoulders. As the deadline approaches, a moral dilemma arises: do they have to comply with the rules and go home in a bad way, or risk venture into a prohibited fishing zone to brace? This debate divided the crew, some like Jorick, determined to convince his colleagues to cross the line of legality, while others, guided by ethical principles, categorically refused to yield to temptation. This face-to-face between loyalty, survival and ethics raises deep questions about the morality of human choices in desperate circumstances, testing the bonds that bind these men at sea.

programme.title: Storm warning
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, a child disappeared. His sister, who has never recovered, has to face the past when her former teacher is murdered.
programme.desc-more: Julie Meynard, a child psychiatrist recognized for her expertise, sees her daily life change when she receives an enigmatic letter from her former mentor, Professor Le Goff. The latter, based in Perros-Guirec, seems to have crucial information – but upon his arrival, Julie discovers her lifeless body, victim of a murder as brutal as inexplicable. The investigation is entrusted to Erwan Kervadec, a police officer with a perceiving look and determination. Their meeting revived a wound that had never been closed: twenty years earlier, on a night of raging storm, Joseph, Julie's younger brother, had disappeared under their common responsibility, while they were only careless teenagers. Time did not erase guilt, nor the shadows surrounding this tragic disappearance. As Julie and Erwan join forces to elucidate the professor's murder, each clue inevitably brings them back to the past they tried to bury. Who wanted to silence Le Goff? And what connection does his assassination have with the storm of 1999, whose echoes seem to haunt the present?
programme.desc: Julie Meynard, a child psychiatrist recognized for her expertise, sees her daily life change when she receives an enigmatic letter from her former mentor, Professor Le Goff. The latter, based in Perros-Guirec, seems to have crucial information – but upon his arrival, Julie discovers her lifeless body, victim of a murder as brutal as inexplicable. The investigation is entrusted to Erwan Kervadec, a police officer with a perceiving look and determination. Their meeting revived a wound that had never been closed: twenty years earlier, on a night of raging storm, Joseph, Julie's younger brother, had disappeared under their common responsibility, while they were only careless teenagers. Time did not erase guilt, nor the shadows surrounding this tragic disappearance. As Julie and Erwan join forces to elucidate the professor's murder, each clue inevitably brings them back to the past they tried to bury. Who wanted to silence Le Goff? And what connection does his assassination have with the storm of 1999, whose echoes seem to haunt the present?

programme.title: Mom's missing.
programme.desc: Two sisters who have been distant from life are found after their mother's disturbing disappearance. Their research will reveal family secrets.
programme.desc-more: Louise (Claire Borotra) and Céline (Claire Keim), two sisters with diametrically opposed personalities, met after their mother's mysterious disappearance. Their separation over the years has widened a gap between them, but the urgency of the situation has prompted them to set aside their differences to investigate what really happened. Convinced that their mother did not disappear without a hidden reason, they are engaged in a frantic quest to reveal the truth. As they investigate, they discover a multitude of clues that reveal deep buried family secrets. Tensions are rising as they face unexpected revelations that threaten to upset their understanding of their own history. Their search will also bring them into contact with unexpected allies and formidable opponents, each having their own reasons to intervene in this mystery. In a world where the past and present intertwine, Louise and Céline's quest to find their mother will force them to question their own identity and values.

programme.title: Hudson and Rex
programme.desc: Charlie investigates Vicky, presenter of a television morning whose husband Chris, boss of Harrison Media, was found dead in her office, the same time she was on the air. The murder weapon is very unusual: peanut oil! Who could have wanted her dead? His widow seems to be well placed on the list of suspects, especially since Charlie discovered that his two previous husbands had died under suspicious circumstances. Would he be in the presence of a black widow?
programme.desc-more: In Saint John, the capital of the province of Newfoundland, a valiant police detective formed a shock team with a specially trained German shepherd. Thanks to Rex's sense of smell and hearing, they will solve many investigations together.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: Barrack 51 is in a state of rapids with the arrival of Emily Foster (Kara Killmer), who replaces the absente Dawson. This integration is done in a tense context where Chief Boden (Eamonn Walker) faces a difficult assistant commissioner, adding to the pressure already present on the team. As the firefighters prepare to intervene on a devastating fire in a 25-storey building, people find themselves trapped on the roofs, making each second crucial. Severide (Taylor Kinney), in full action, embarks on a heroic mission to save a child trapped in a car, while Emily, well integrated, gives advice to Cruz (Joe Minoso). However, the situation is complicated by tragic explosions that mourn Chicago, testing the cohesion and courage of firefighters. This seventh season promises to be full of emotions and challenges for the team at barracks 51.
programme.desc-more: Chicago Fire is a captivating drama series that plunges into the heart of firefighters and paramedics at Barrack 51 in Chicago. Under the leadership of Lieutenant Matthew Casey (Jesse Spencer), the team often finds itself confronted with overwhelming emergencies, ranging from devastating fires to heroic rescues in the middle of the night. Each member of this team, such as the charismatic firefighter Kelly Severide (Taylor Kinney) and the determined paramedic Sylvie Brett (Kara Killmer), brings his own expertise and experience, while facing personal challenges that affect their work. Beyond dramatic interventions, the series explores the interpersonal relationships that form in this intense setting, the camaraderie between team members and rivalries with other emergency services. Chicago Fire pays tribute to the heroes of everyday life.

programme.title: Chicago Police Department
programme.desc: In the tumultuous streets of Chicago, the Hank Voight (Jason Beghe) brigade continues to fight crime relentlessly. Determined to protect their city, the team members do not hesitate to cross the limits of legality to achieve their goals. However, this seventh season is marked by internal tensions, including the arrest of Ruzek (Patrick John Flueger) for professional misconduct and obstruction, an incident that challenges the team's loyalty and integrity. At the same time, Voight is in the spotlight as the main suspect in the murder of Brian Kelton, the recently elected mayor. As the internal affairs investigation is intensifying, each member of the team faces difficult choices and moral dilemmas. The arrival of new characters, including those performed by Anne Heche and Paul Adelstein, promises to add even more complexity to this season full of twists.
programme.desc-more: After a friendly dinner with her father, Sergeant Trudy Platt (Amy Morton) found herself brutally assaulted as she returned to her car, diving in a critical state. She was taken to hospital as a matter of urgency, and faced the consequences of this violent attack, while her attacker, a daring malfrat, fled with her service weapon. Chicago police, under the direction of Detective Hank Voight (Jason Beghe), are mobilizing to solve this shocking crime. Antonio Dawson (Jon Seda) took the initiative to screen the crime scene for critical clues. Voight soon began to suspect that the attack on Platt might not be the result of chance, prompting the team to explore the recent cases she had dealt with. As investigations continue, tensions rise and hidden truths threaten to rise to the surface, making this case even more complex.

programme.title: The ghost of the saints
programme.desc: In the Saintes, the paradise island of the West Indies, the tranquility is suddenly broken when Caroline Boissaux' lifeless body, the owner of the Tourment d'Amour hotel, is discovered at the foot of a cliff. Captain Gaëlle Boissaux (Anne Décis), from Terre-de-Haut and sister of the victim, is in charge of the investigation. As she immerse herself in the meandering of this troubling affair, she is joined by Ludovic Augustin (Denis Marshal), her former youthful love, sent to assist her. Together, they must navigate through the secrets of the island and the tensions that are intensifying among the inhabitants. The investigation took a surprising turn with the reappearance of a local legend, that of a Saintoise in love with the Chevalier de Fréminville, who had committed suicide in the same place two centuries earlier. As the mystery thickens, a ghost seems to haunt the place, sowing fear and uncertainty within the island community.

programme.title: Hudson and Rex
programme.desc: "All art"A thief steals a statue in an art gallery. Police officers who arrived there discovered the body of the gallery owner.
programme.desc-more: A thief steals a statue from an art gallery. Police officers who arrived there discovered the corpse of a man killed with a cutter. The victim is the owner of the gallery, Joshua Spall. Hudson visits Phoenix, the artist exhibited at the gallery. The sculptor refers to a certain Veronica Kaatchi, a rich gift-maker passionate about art who has a lot of influence on the gallery and who had forced Spall to expose Phoenix. Thanks to his network, Jesse managed to provide Charlie and Sarah with invitations to attend a large auction where the patron should appear.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: "Plays hands..." Benson tries to help a pop star, while Rollins fights the stress of working at home. Finally, give a recruit a lesson of respect.
programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.

programme.title: The taste of crime
programme.desc: Former chef who became a gastronomic critic, Laure Grenadier investigates with her ex-husband police about the murder of her uncle restaurant in Lyon.
programme.desc-more: When Laure Grenadier decided to film behind the scenes her uncle's starred chef's restaurant to feed her successful blog, she did not know that the renowned cook would be found murdered in her restaurant a few hours later. A discontented supplier? Ex-driving? Vibrant vegan activists? All tracks remain open. To help resolve the investigation, the young woman will have to accept a bad grace to cooperate with police captain Nicolas Garnier: this is her ex, who left her for a while for a younger woman.

programme.title: Internal kitchen
programme.desc: At the heart of the vibrant city of Paris, Adriana, a French-Senegalese chef with exceptional potential, feeds a fiery dream: to get the star so much coveted of the Michelin guide for his restaurant, the Balalst. Passionate and determined, she invested herself body and soul in her kitchen, hoping to make her establishment shine on the culinary scene. However, his ascension took an unexpected turn with the arrival of brothers and sisters Jeff and Angèle Rubens, who presented themselves as new "associates". Their initial commitment seems promising, but their real intention is quickly revealed: to turn the back room of the Balalst into a clandestine poker circle, attracting a clientele from the Parisian community to the tedious activities. As poker games grow, the restaurant becomes a respected facade for a growing criminal empire. Adriana is then torn between her gastronomic aspirations and the reality of a dark world that threatens not only her dream, but also the integrity of her establishment. In this context of increasing tension, it must navigate through difficult choices to try to save what it has built, while confronting the dangers surrounding it.

programme.title: Snow
programme.desc: Dive into the snowy and hostile landscapes of the Alps, where silence stifles secrets like snow stifles the tracks. Here, the cold is not just a question of weather: it is insinuated in souls, freezes consciousness and reveals the fractures of a society where appearance often hides the infamous. In the middle of this storm, Captain Thomas Delhaye (Frédéric Diefenthal), an experienced cop but weakened by progressive deafness that isolates a little more each day. When two notables of the region, respected and untouchable figures, are found murdered in macabre and strangely familiar conditions, Delhaye feels her blood iced. The killer's methods recall with disturbing precision those of Hugo Czarlewski, a charismatic and manipulative psychopath who had terrorized Savoy seven years earlier. Officially, Czarlewski is serving a life sentence... But the coincidences are too many to be accidental. To break the mystery, Delhaye takes a new risk: to have Juliette Hémon (Murielle Huet des Aunay), the ex-companion of Czarlewski, temporarily released, sentenced to twenty years in prison for complicity and homicide. A woman broken by her past, Juliette may have the keys to the riddle, but her collaboration is a dangerous bet. Between lies, unsaid and ambiguous loyalties, the border quickly blurs: who manipulates who? Are recent murders the work of an imitator, a forgotten accomplice... Or the sign that a repressed nightmare is coming back?

programme.title: False-likers

programme.title: Chicago Police Department
programme.desc: «Under the blows "An armed robbery case turns into an investigation for homicide. A woman, who was one of the suspects, was reportedly subjected to violence during her childhood.
programme.desc-more: In Chicago district 21, police officers fight daily against a pervasive crime, ranging from murder to drug trafficking. Under the leadership of Sergeant Hank Voight (Jason Beghe), this elite team must navigate a constantly changing environment, marked by a controversial reform that challenges the traditional methods of police. As the city faces the consequences of the Covid-19 pandemic, tensions are rising and challenges are increasing, testing the resilience of agents. Kevin Atwater (LaRoyce Hawkins), particularly affected by the challenges of police violence, finds himself at the heart of difficult debates, while seeking to make his voice heard in an era of radical change. This eighth season, although shortened to 16 episodes, plunges into the heart of moral dilemmas and internal struggles that define the daily life of the law enforcement forces, while maintaining a haunting and captivating rhythm.

Rosalee, for her part, is confronted with the ghosts of her past. This fifth season is rising in intensity, with the arrival of new particularly dangerous enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the fantastic is close to everyday life, the series "Grimm" plunges spectators into a world of mythological creatures, the Wesen, who hide behind the faces of humans. Nick Burkhardt (David Giuntoli), a detective of the Portland police, discovers that he is the heir of a line of monster hunters called the Grimms. As he tried to reconcile his professional life with his new responsibilities, Nick found himself plunged into an ancestral conflict between the Wesen and the human. In this thrilling episode, tension rises as Renard's mother (Sasha Roiz) arrives at the hospital in a critical state, using her powers to try to save her son. Meanwhile, Adalind (Claire Coffee), who had successfully completed his mission in Austria, found himself trapped in Viktor Castle, which questioned his loyalty following the mysterious death of one of his agents. While Theresa (Bree Turner) follows a Wesen with tentacles, Monroe (Silas Weir Mitchell) and Rosalee (Bree Turner) are trying to find a way to restore Nick's powers, adding a layer of complexity to this struggle for survival. The stakes are increasing, and each character faces crucial choices, while the danger is around every corner, making their quest even more perilous.

programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: In the near future, humanity faces an unprecedented threat when aliens launch a devastating attack on the United States, annihilating the capital, Washington, D.C. In this chaotic context, the president (Ari Hader) manages to escape on a helicopter. However, his flight is short-lived, as he crashes near a small town in Connecticut, leaving the leader isolated and vulnerable. The inhabitants of this peaceful village quickly find themselves plunged into horror when extraterrestrial soldiers invade their territory, determined to capture the president and to get hold of a mysterious apparatus that could change the course of the war. In the midst of panic and desolation, a diverse group of citizens, including local figures such as a veteran (Matthew Pohlkamp) and a young mother (Christina Licciardi), unite to defend their city and protect the president. As tensions rise and aliens intensify their research, the inhabitants must navigate between fear and courage, seeking ways to resist this ruthless invasion. In this struggle for survival, each one will have to face his own demons and discover how far he is ready to go to save not only his city, but all humanity.

programme.title: Pacific Rim : Uprising
programme.desc: In Pacific Rim: Uprising (2018), following the successful film by Guillermo del Toro, the story unfolds ten years after the human victory over the mysterious aliens known as Precursors, who had unleashed the terrifying Kaijus on our planet. The scars of this titanium war are still visible in the devastated landscapes, especially in Santa Monica, where reconstruction is difficult to advance. Jake Pentecost, incarnated by John Boyega and son of Stacker Pentecost, the legendary hero of the first battle, chose to lead a marginal life, far from the honours and glory of his father. He is involved in various trades, and is particularly famous in the illegal trade in Jaegers technologies, these gigantic robots designed to confront monsters. His life took an unexpected turn when he crossed the path of Amara Namani (Cailee Spaeny), an orphaned teenage girl with exceptional talent to hack the systems of combat robots. As a new threat emerges, endangering precarious peace on Earth, Jake and Amara find themselves being trained in a race against the clock to form a new generation of Jaegers pilots. This unlikely duo, both opposite and complementary, must bring together a heteroclite team to relive the spirit of camaraderie and sacrifice that had allowed to triumph over Kaijus. By rubbing themselves with the challenges of constantly evolving technology and an unexpected threat, they will have to face their own demons and accept their legacy to save humanity.

programme.title: When the chamois shut up
programme.desc: During a mountain hike, Romy, an imaginative teenage girl, bores herself with the verbose Sacha, her little sister. To channel her overflowing energy, she proposes a bold game: Sacha will have to embody a chamois, a discreet and mysterious creature, in order to silence her incessant chatter. At first, Romy had fun pushing Sacha into her role, giving her increasingly farfelus challenges that plunge her into a world of play and improvisation. Sacha, first amused, starts taking this game too seriously, being carried away by the illusion of its transformation into a chamois. As they travel in the middle of nature, the two sisters will have to navigate between imagination and reality, thus revealing unsuspecting facets of their fraternal relationship. This initiatory journey then becomes an exploration of family ties, childhood and the need to grow up while preserving a touch of magic.

programme.title: Dinosaurs : The True Story
programme.desc: In a future where dinosaurs have not only evolved but have also succeeded in reaching the Moon, peace reigns on their planet. However, this tranquillity is threatened by the imminent arrival of a giant asteroid heading straight to Earth. The inhabitants, huge feathered and scaled creatures, are facing a catastrophe that could upset their lives. Among them, a group of young dinosaurs, led by the courageous Rex (Paul-Louis Aeberhardt), is running against the clock to find a way to divert the asteroid and save their world. Along the way, they meet unexpected allies and formidable opponents, while discovering secrets about their own history and the origin of their evolution. As the countdown accelerates, Rex and his friends will have to join forces and demonstrate ingenuity in trying to save their blue planet from certain destruction.

programme.title: Grimm
programme.desc: Nick Burkhardt is not a cop like the others. His mother recently told him that he was one of the worthy heirs of the Grimm family. Grimms have the amazing ability to unmask evil creatures who coexist with humans in a perfectly normal appearance. When he met Eddy Monroe, a werewolf, during an investigation, he immediately made him his ally. Together, they track down supernatural beings who commit bloody crimes. Nick's colleague Hank Griffin eventually learns the truth and does not spare his efforts to seek out the enemies of humans. A fantastic, captivating police series, with quite successful special effects.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the fantastic is close to everyday life, the series "Grimm" plunges spectators into a world of mythological creatures, the Wesen, who hide behind the faces of humans. Nick Burkhardt (David Giuntoli), a detective of the Portland police, discovers that he is the heir of a line of monster hunters called the Grimms. As he tried to reconcile his professional life with his new responsibilities, Nick found himself plunged into an ancestral conflict between the Wesen and the human. In this thrilling episode, tension rises as Renard's mother (Sasha Roiz) arrives at the hospital in a critical state, using her powers to try to save her son. Meanwhile, Adalind (Claire Coffee), who had successfully completed his mission in Austria, found himself trapped in Viktor Castle, which questioned his loyalty following the mysterious death of one of his agents. While Theresa (Bree Turner) follows a Wesen with tentacles, Monroe (Silas Weir Mitchell) and Rosalee (Bree Turner) are trying to find a way to restore Nick's powers, adding a layer of complexity to this struggle for survival. The stakes are increasing, and each character faces crucial choices, while the danger is around every corner, making their quest even more perilous.
