programme.title: Spiderwick's Chronicles
programme.desc: After having barely escaped the dangers of a fairy world, Jared (Lyon Daniels), Simon (Noah Cottrell) and Mallory (Mychala Lee) returned home to Spiderwick, but their return proved much more disturbing than expected. The family mansion is being ransacked, showing a recent struggle, and the children find out with horror that Mulgarath, a powerful ogre with sinister ambitions, has taken away their mother and stolen the precious guide that contains secrets about the world of fairies. Faced with this threat, young heroes must join forces to find Mulgarath and rescue their mother. Their quest leads them into a thrilling adventure, full of fantastic creatures and mysteries to solve. They will have to show courage, ingenuity and strong solidarity to overcome obstacles and to face the dangers that lie ahead. The stakes are crucial: saving their families and protecting the fragile balance between the two worlds.

programme.title: Highlander
programme.desc: In the Bronze Age, four riders travelled the world, reducing everything to nothing in their passage. They find themselves and continue their work of destroying the universe.
programme.desc-more: Duncan MacLeod (Stan Kirsch), an immortal from the MacLeod lineage, lives in the shadow of his illustrious ancestor, Connor MacLeod. Like his grandfather, he was condemned to go through the centuries, only to die by beheading. But Duncan is not alone in this eternal quest: other immortals, also endowed with this supernatural power, are surveying the world, driven by a devouring ambition. Their goal is clear: to eliminate others to appropriate their vital energy, thus becoming more and more powerful. In this context, Duncan is fighting for his survival, supported by his companion Tessa (Alexandra Vandernoot), who shares his tumultuous life. Together, they often find themselves engaged in spectacular duels, where honour and loyalty are put to the test. While the threat of other immortals is becoming clearer, Duncan must navigate between friendship, betrayal and an endless struggle for life.

programme.title: Grimm
programme.desc: Nick Burkhardt is not a cop like the others. His mother recently told him that he was one of the worthy heirs of the Grimm family. A fantastic, captivating police series, with quite successful special effects.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the fantastic is close to everyday life, the series "Grimm" plunges spectators into a world of mythological creatures, the Wesen, who hide behind the faces of humans. Nick Burkhardt (David Giuntoli), a detective of the Portland police, discovers that he is the heir of a line of monster hunters called the Grimms. As he tried to reconcile his professional life with his new responsibilities, Nick found himself plunged into an ancestral conflict between the Wesen and the human. In this thrilling episode, tension rises as Renard's mother (Sasha Roiz) arrives at the hospital in a critical state, using her powers to try to save her son. Meanwhile, Adalind (Claire Coffee), who had successfully completed his mission in Austria, found himself trapped in Viktor Castle, which questioned his loyalty following the mysterious death of one of his agents. While Theresa (Bree Turner) follows a Wesen with tentacles, Monroe (Silas Weir Mitchell) and Rosalee (Bree Turner) are trying to find a way to restore Nick's powers, adding a layer of complexity to this struggle for survival. The stakes are increasing, and each character faces crucial choices, while the danger is around every corner, making their quest even more perilous.

programme.title: Curvature
programme.desc: In the near future, where technology has reached unimaginable heights, Helen (Lyndsy Fonseca) finds herself plunged into a whirlwind of tragic events after the loss of her husband, a brilliant engineer whose suicide left deep scars. As she tries to mourn, a mysterious call turns her reality: a voice that looks strangely like her warns her that a murderer is about to end his life. Desperate and perplexed, Helen discovers that she was projected in time, a direct consequence of her husband's research on a time machine. While she struggles to thwart the plans of her aggressor, she realizes that her own past could be linked to a series of tragic events, including a murder she has not yet committed. As Helen travels, she must navigate between the meanderings of temporality and the difficult choices she has to make. With the help of key characters, such as the determined FBI agent (Linda Hamilton) and a loyal friend (Glenn Morshower), she finds herself facing unexpected obstacles that put her will to the test to change her destiny. In a world where every decision can have devastating consequences, Helen will not only have to save her own life, but also decipher the mysteries of her past to avoid a tragic future.

programme.title: Highlander
programme.desc: In the Bronze Age, four riders travelled the world, reducing everything to nothing in their passage. They find themselves and continue their work of destroying the universe.
programme.desc-more: Duncan MacLeod (Stan Kirsch), an immortal from the MacLeod lineage, lives in the shadow of his illustrious ancestor, Connor MacLeod. Like his grandfather, he was condemned to go through the centuries, only to die by beheading. But Duncan is not alone in this eternal quest: other immortals, also endowed with this supernatural power, are surveying the world, driven by a devouring ambition. Their goal is clear: to eliminate others to appropriate their vital energy, thus becoming more and more powerful. In this context, Duncan is fighting for his survival, supported by his companion Tessa (Alexandra Vandernoot), who shares his tumultuous life. Together, they often find themselves engaged in spectacular duels, where honour and loyalty are put to the test. While the threat of other immortals is becoming clearer, Duncan must navigate between friendship, betrayal and an endless struggle for life.

programme.title: Tomb Invader
programme.desc: Nicknamed Ally, Alabama Channing is an ambitious young archaeologist. One day, she was recruited by a mysterious billionaire who asked her to go hunting for a Chinese relic. His mother was looking for this artifact at the time of his disappearance.

programme.title: The Return of the Mummy
programme.desc: London, 1933. After their turbulent adventures in Egypt, Rick O的Connell (Brendan Fraser) and Evelyn Carnahan (Rachel Weisz) finally found a peaceful life, far from the pharaoh curses and supernatural creatures. Set in a comfortable London home, they raise their son Alex (Freddie Boat), an eight-year-old boy as lively as he is curious, heir despite him of blood mixed with the history of ancient mysteries. The shelves are full of Egyptian artifacts, memories of a past they thought was permanently buried, and Evelyn, now a successful author, draws inspiration from these extraordinary stories for her novels. But fate, like mummies, has the unfortunate habit of coming back when one least expects it. When a mysterious Egyptian bracelet is discovered during excavations, troubles start again. This simple object, charged with evil energy, awakens much more than a memory: it revives Imhotep (Arnold Vosloo), the cursed high priest, whose mummy, reduced to ashes a decade earlier, is restored in the shadow, thirsty for revenge. Worse still, this resurrection is accompanied by a procession of infernal, half-human, half-scorpions creatures who sow terror in the streets of London. The legends that Rick and Evelyn thought they had sealed forever surfaced, more threatening than ever.

programme.title: The mummy: the tomb of the dragon emperor
programme.desc: Rick (Brendan Fraser) and Evelyn O'Connell (Maria Bello) are bored in their English mansion. Their son, Alex (Luke Ford), abandoned his studies to lead an archaeological excavation site in China, where he hopes to discover the entrance to the tomb of the first Emperor of the Middle. One day, his parents were contacted by an agent of the Foreign Office to transport an extraordinary diamond to Shanghai. The O'Connells accept with pleasure.

The captors, among whom is an immortal, leave no trace, plunged MacLeod into a desperate quest to find the one who captivated his heart. His research leads him to the vibrant neighbourhood of the National Library, where he discovers a mysterious tower housing the offices of a video game designer. The latter, at the heart of a complex intrigue, seems to be linked to Margo's abduction. As Duncan explores the meanderings of this digital universe, he faces formidable enemies and unexpected revelations. With the help of his allies, he entered a race against the clock to foil the plans of his opponents and save Margo, while facing the ghosts of his past.

programme.title: Highlander
programme.desc: In October 1929, an atmosphere of mystery and tension arose when Hugh Fitzcairn (Roger Daltrey) collapsed during a reception in the presence of his friends. Ignoring the immortality of their host, his guests set out to prepare for his funeral, believing that they had lost a dear friend. Sadness and anxiety dominate the event, but the situation takes an unexpected turn when Duncan MacLeod (Adrian Paul) makes his appearance, relaxed and serene, conscious that his friend has not really left. As funeral preparations continue, MacLeod, with his immortal experience, must navigate between the emotions of those around him and the truth about Fitzcairn's nature. This mixture of drama and mystery raises questions about friendship, life and death, while the characters face the reality of immortality and the secrets surrounding it.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: The animated series Phineas and Ferb follows the adventures of Phineas Flynn and his English half-brother, Ferb Fletcher, during their summer holidays. Every day, boys start ambitious projects, sometimes to help someone, but often just to create something fun. It pisses off their sister, Candace, who is still trying to get them into trouble trying to show their inventions to their mother. Meanwhile, Professor Doofenschmirtz tries to take control of the sector of the Three States with the help of his inventions, but Perry, the boys' ornithorync, secret agent within the OSAS under the orders of Major Monogram, always manages to thwart his plans.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb

programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Fonce Phineas / A beach in the garden
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the inseparable brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), embark on a new thrilling adventure by transforming their mother's car into a racing car. Motivated by adrenaline and the desire to participate in a stock-car race, they implement their legendary ingenuity to create a fast and spectacular vehicle. Meanwhile, their sister, Candace Flynn (Ashley Tisdale), is desperately trying to report them to their mother, but her efforts are regularly thwarted by unlikely circumstances. At the same time, the overwhelming heat of summer pushes Phineas and Ferb to imagine an oasis of freshness in their own garden. In no time, they transform their outdoor space into a sunny beach, offering their friends a perfect refuge to escape the heat. The two intrigues intertwine, promising laughter and surprises at each turn.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Superchatons and the rescue of Miaoubus / Superchatons and the problem of peanut butter
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: In a vibrant and colourful world, Kiff (Kimiko Glenn) and his friend Barry form an inseparable duo, living thrilling adventures in their small town. Their complicity is tested when, to celebrate a special event, an unexpected little gift comes in, disturbing their daily playful. This seemingly innocent present leads them into a series of unforeseen events that prompt them to explore the mysterious corners of the surrounding forest. As they sink into this wild nature, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with strange situations and unexpected encounters. A threatening shadow glides on their escapade, and they discover that they are not alone in the woods. Their friends, also trained in this adventure, will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the trials that await them. Between laughter and thrills, this episode promises a captivating exploration of friendship and unexpected.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette wants to make sure that Alix can spend her birthday with her friends and family. But a super-villain of a new kind will upset his plans.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: Billie, a young and powerful witch at the centre of a mysterious prophecy, is sent to the mortal world with the only sorcerer teacher who can help her master her powers, Justin Russo.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), the two inventors, are in a state of flux as the Convention on Science Fiction and Fantasy approaches. Enthusiastic about meeting a famous master of special effects, they are preparing to present their own impressive creations in the field. With the help of their friend Candace Flynn (Ashley Tisdale), who dreams of seeing them finally recognized for their talents, they are putting in place an ambitious project. As they move towards the event, the two brothers must also juggle with the plans of their sister, who wishes to report them to their mother. For his part, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Diedrich Bader) is developing a new Machiavellical Plan to conquer the world, while their company ornithorync, Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), is turning into a secret agent to prevent it. This adventure promises unexpected twists, mixing science, creativity and humour.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of the series, Cricket, a young boy with a lot of energy, finds himself facing a big dilemma: finding the perfect birthday gift for his best friend, Rémy. As he navigates the world of gift options, an unexpected incident with a motocross leaves him with a deep fear that prompts him to reconsider his life choices. Fearing the dangers of the outside world, Cricket decided to retreat to a shelter, seeking refuge away from the hazards of daily life. This choice leads him to an intense introspection, where he must assess what is really important to him and to his friendship with Rémy. As this episode unfolds, Cricket will learn that real gifts are not always found in material objects, but in shared moments and woven bonds. The humour and tenderness of this quest for identity and friendship resonate through each scene, offering a reflection on bravery and vulnerability.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", the Green family goes to the library looking for a book essential for their project. However, their quest becomes complicated when the librarian, a man with a disturbing appearance and threatening tone, is intimately silenced in a way that makes the bravest simmer. This unexpected encounter plunges Chip Green (Chris Houghton) into a deep reflection on himself, as he begins to doubt his abilities. Indeed, his brother's mockery, Cricket Green (Shane Houghton), leads him to wonder if he really is the failure his brother claims. In this tense atmosphere, family members try to navigate between the anxiety of the librarian's authority and the doubts that gnaw them. The episode explores the themes of self-confidence and the importance of the family in facing the challenges of urban life.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", the peace of the Greens is being undermined by the ambitious Chip Whistler (Chris Houghton), who plans to shave the surrounding buildings to build a new food store. As Chip advances in its destruction plan, the Green family members, determined to defend their home and community, are mobilizing to counter its plans. They quickly discover that Chip's schemes go well beyond a simple commercial project: it is an insidious strategy to establish itself in the neighborhood. Between tricks and confrontations, the Greens must join forces and be creative in stopping Chip before he turns their neighbourhood into an impersonal shopping mall. In a fierce struggle between ambition and community spirit, the family will have to overcome unexpected obstacles to protect their way of life and home.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: A fishing competition is threatened and Gretel must win it to protect the competitors; Hamster and Churro exchange their bodies while a super naughty bodybuilder attacks.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.desc: In a park of energy-stimulating attractions, a mysterious woman appears, inciting curiosity and distrust among visitors. Bailey and Gretel, two young adventurers who can't be separated, decide to spend an unforgettable day at Nordle, a park renowned for its spectacular rides and delusional attractions. As they immerse themselves in the fascinating universe of the park, they begin to notice strange events surrounding this enigmatic woman, who seems to have a particular connection to the mysteries of the park. In parallel, Bailey and Gretel are searching for the secrets of this intruder while enjoying the attractions and shows that make Nordle famous. Laughter and excitement mix with an atmosphere of increasing tension, while the two friends discover that what lies behind the woman's smile may well upset their day in unexpected ways.

programme.sub-title: Nano a Nano / The Unnatural History of Dr. MedusaSaurus
programme.desc: During a school trip to a robotics factory, young Kelly, a Gretel comrade (Melissa Povenmire), accidentally finds herself under the influence of a nanorobot, resulting in unexpected and comical events. Meanwhile, Kevin (Michael Cimino) and his loyal companion Hamster are trying to help their friend Fred get rid of disturbing memories of past battles. However, they discover that one of these memories is particularly tenacious, making their mission more complex than they anticipated. At the same time, at the Natural History Museum, an even more disturbing situation is taking place. Extraterrestrials, in a daring act, managed to awaken the deceased paleontologist, Dr. Medusa Saurus. The latter, reinvigorated by mysterious energy, is unleashed alongside an army of reanimated fossils, threatening to plunge the museum into chaos. While the protagonists have to deal with both crises, friendship, bravery and ingenuity will be tested in a thrilling adventure.

programme.desc: In a colorful and adventure-filled world, the SuperChatons, a band of young, fearless felines, are embarking on a thrilling quest to find the precious Amara diadem, a magical artifact with extraordinary powers. As they explore unknown territories, they discover that the diadem was stolen by a mysterious thief who attacks everything that shines in their kingdom. The SuperChatons, led by the determined Lila (Emma Berman), unite to defeat the evildoer's plans and restore peace. As they travel, they meet with colorful characters, including unexpected allies and fantastic creatures who will help them in their mission. In parallel, each team member will face their own fears and doubts, thus strengthening the bonds of friendship that unite them. This epic quest is a journey of discovery, friendship and courage.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: One of Clarabelle's songbirds is missing. It's up to Mickey and his friends to find him so Clarabelle can finish his morning song with them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.desc: The adventures of Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales, who join with Superheroes to defeat their enemies and discover that teamwork is the best way to save the situation. The third season introduced a new plot called
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the two brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decide to spend their day in a ranch, a place that evokes adventure and outdoor life. Their escape takes an unexpected turn when all the cows of the ranch escape to the city, causing real chaos. Phineas and Ferb, who are always ready to face challenges, are embarking on a mission to bring the cows back to their owner, while facing various obstacles and using their legendary ingenuity. At the same time, their sister Candace (Ashley Tisdale) is trying to prove to adults that his brothers are creating a disaster. In another intrigue, their father offers them an ice cream machine, which inspires Phineas and Ferb to carry out a bold project: creating a magical winter in the middle of summer, transforming their garden into a snowy landscape. The two stories intertwine, offering a mix of humour, adventure and creativity typical of the series.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: Billie, a young and powerful witch at the centre of a mysterious prophecy, is sent to the mortal world with the only sorcerer teacher who can help her master her powers, Justin Russo.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 3 of the series Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.desc: In this episode of season 2 of "The Greens in Big City", the family dynamics are tested when beautiful Gabriella, former classmate of Cricket (Zeno Robinson), returns to town. Rémy (Shane Houghton), Cricket's brother, is becoming a corporate agent who wants to help his brother reconnect with this girl who makes him capsize. As Cricket tries to navigate his feelings, the Green family prepares for a festive outing at the fair, full of games and attractions. However, Bill (Danny Trejo), the wise and prudent patriarch, strongly opposed this idea, convinced that it was better to save every penny. This dilemma between the desire to enjoy the pleasures of life and the need to save creates tensions, highlighting the values of each and the priorities that drive them.

The stakes are increasing as each one faces his own desires and priorities.

programme.sub-title: The fine flower of the school / Nose for victory
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of the series "Hamster & Gretel", Nordle, an ambitious and cunning character, is entering an orchid competition with the intention of winning the first prize at any price. However, his attempt to cheat turned against him, with catastrophic consequences that disrupted not only the competition, but also the dynamics of the local community. Meanwhile, Gretel and Bailey, two young heroines looking for popularity, decided to go into fashion with state-of-the-art headphones. Their desire to be at the forefront of trends, however, leads them to a trap orchestrated by a devious naughty, devious man, who tests their ingenuity and courage. As tensions rise, friends will have to navigate through these unexpected challenges, joining forces to overcome obstacles and learn valuable lessons about honesty and friendship.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

Between professional rivalries and supernatural confrontations, this episode promises moments of tension and humour.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and the Lost Gift / The SuperChatons and the Bitsy Cannon Boobo
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "SuperChatons", young fur heroes find themselves facing a major challenge when Sparks (Cruz Flateau), a daring kitten, loses his confidence in him after an unexpected fall of his Robochaton. The team, determined to help their friend, makes every effort to give him courage and show him that he can overcome his fears. At the same time, Bitsy (Emma Berman), the greedy kitten, finds herself in a delicate situation after having abused the treats, preventing her from assisting her comrades in their mission. As the SuperChatons unite to encourage Sparks to take over the control of his Robochaton, they also face Rastic, a cunning opponent who does not step back in front of anything to sow chaos. This episode, rich in emotions and teachings about trust and friendship, shows how solidarity can help overcome the most difficult obstacles.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Thanks to some clever Maxi-Tools, Mickey, Donald and Dingo are organizing a surprise for Pat's birthday.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Fonce Phineas / A beach in the garden
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the inseparable brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), embark on a new thrilling adventure by transforming their mother's car into a racing car. Motivated by adrenaline and the desire to participate in a stock-car race, they implement their legendary ingenuity to create a fast and spectacular vehicle. Meanwhile, their sister, Candace Flynn (Ashley Tisdale), is desperately trying to report them to their mother, but her efforts are regularly thwarted by unlikely circumstances. At the same time, the overwhelming heat of summer pushes Phineas and Ferb to imagine an oasis of freshness in their own garden. In no time, they transform their outdoor space into a sunny beach, offering their friends a perfect refuge to escape the heat. The two intrigues intertwine, promising laughter and surprises at each turn.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Superchatons and the rescue of Miaoubus / Superchatons and the problem of peanut butter
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.sub-title: Dad puts Bingo and Bluey in bed.
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: In a vibrant and colourful world, Kiff (Kimiko Glenn) and his friend Barry form an inseparable duo, living thrilling adventures in their small town. Their complicity is tested when, to celebrate a special event, an unexpected little gift comes in, disturbing their daily playful. This seemingly innocent present leads them into a series of unforeseen events that prompt them to explore the mysterious corners of the surrounding forest. As they sink into this wild nature, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with strange situations and unexpected encounters. A threatening shadow glides on their escapade, and they discover that they are not alone in the woods. Their friends, also trained in this adventure, will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the trials that await them. Between laughter and thrills, this episode promises a captivating exploration of friendship and unexpected.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette wants to make sure that Alix can spend her birthday with her friends and family. But a super-villain of a new kind will upset his plans.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.desc: Billie, a young and powerful witch at the centre of a mysterious prophecy, is sent to the mortal world with the only sorcerer teacher who can help her master her powers, Justin Russo.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), the two inventors, are in a state of flux as the Convention on Science Fiction and Fantasy approaches. Enthusiastic about meeting a famous master of special effects, they are preparing to present their own impressive creations in the field. With the help of their friend Candace Flynn (Ashley Tisdale), who dreams of seeing them finally recognized for their talents, they are putting in place an ambitious project. As they move towards the event, the two brothers must also juggle with the plans of their sister, who wishes to report them to their mother. For his part, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Diedrich Bader) is developing a new Machiavellical Plan to conquer the world, while their company ornithorync, Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), is turning into a secret agent to prevent it. This adventure promises unexpected twists, mixing science, creativity and humour.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: New Powers / A Hit to Take
programme.desc: In a world where the extraordinary is close to everyday life, Hamster (Melissa Povenmire) and Gretel (Joey King), two inseparable brothers, find themselves endowed with super powers after an unexpected encounter with aliens. While Hamster flourishes in his new role as superhero, Gretel, full of enthusiasm, embraces this adventure with an overflowing energy. However, their brother Kevin (Michael Cimino), who aspires to be a hero in his own right, is relegated to the role of "collateral damage", which creates tensions within the fratry. As a threatening meteorite moves towards Earth, the differences between Gretel and Kevin's views on how to stop it may jeopardize their mission. Their disagreements and the challenges that result will test their family ties, forcing them to learn to work together and accept their differences to protect their city and save the world.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: The Epi-Browse / Rodeo Mounting of Sheep
programme.desc: Far from his native campaign, Cricket Green learned how to adapt to life in a big city, where he moved with his family. But integration is not a rest.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Tilly Green (Marieve Herington) disagrees with family traditions during his epi-breast, a symbolic event that marks the transition to adulthood. His decision to derogate from established rites caused the anger of his grandmother (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who saw this break as an infringement of family heritage. At the same time, his brother Cricket (Chris Houghton) has a dream of becoming an expert in sheep rodeo. However, his enthusiasm led him to a series of hilarious misadventures as he found himself trapped in an endless set of challenges related to his training. This episode skillfully blends humour and tenderness, illustrating the generational struggles within the Green family, while highlighting the individual aspirations that drive them. The tensions between tradition and modernity create a rich and dynamic context for the characters.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and St. Valentine's Cards stolen / SuperChatons and Golden Grelot
programme.desc: If a problem occurs in the fictitious city of Kittydale, four cute little cats instantly become superheroes with special skills and are ready to help their fellow citizens at any time. Their mission is to show that even the most difficult problem can be solved with good behavior and kindness.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and playful world, Mr. Petites-Pattes, a clever feline, implements his Machiavellic plan using his Drago-paillettes to steal the precious Valentine's Day cards from the city's inhabitants. This orchestrated flight disrupts festive preparations, sowing chaos and confusion among the SuperChatons. Meanwhile, Ginny, one of the SuperChatons, finds himself in a difficult situation after accidentally damaging the grelot of friendship that his comrade Bitsy had offered him. Rather than admitting her mistake, she chooses to hide the truth, fearing to hurt Bitsy's feelings. While the SuperChatons are trying to solve the mystery of card theft, Ginny also has to face the consequences of his lie. The episode explores themes of friendship, trust and honesty, while leading young spectators into a thrilling adventure where team spirit and loyalty are tested.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.sub-title: Dad puts Bingo and Bluey in bed.
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: In the mountainous city of Table-Ville, animals live in harmony with magical creatures. The two best friends, Kiff, an optimistic squirrel with a big heart, and Barry, a soft, nonchalant rabbit, find their marks at school and learn to deal with members more eccentric than the others who form their community.
programme.desc-more: In this sparkling episode of the series "Kiff", Helen (Kimiko Glenn), a student passionate about sewing, decides to make a pair of magic socks for the principal's secretary, hoping that he can win it in a dance contest against a rival institution. Put on these socks and get ready to discover a world where dance and magic intertwine. With the help of his new enchanted accessories, the secretary quickly impressed all the spectators with his dazzling movements, attracting attention and admiration. However, this sudden success comes to his head, and he begins to neglect his responsibilities and to be carried away by glory. Helen, witness to this transformation, realizes that the true essence of dance lies not only in performance, but also in humility and teamwork. The stakes rise as tensions increase, testing the relationships and ambitions of each.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: Far from his native campaign, Cricket Green learned how to adapt to life in a big city, where he moved with his family. But integration is not a rest.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Marieve Herington) finds himself facing a serious creative block as he prepares to celebrate the traditional April Fish. He was accustomed to being the band's farcer, and felt compelled by the pressure to concoct a memorable joke, which plunged him into a state of growing frustration. Meanwhile, Bill (Chris Houghton), his father's protector, hides a secret from his mischievous daughter, Tilly (Artemis Pebdani), who convinced her that everything was fine as he struggled with his own concerns. As preparations for this day of jokes intensify, family tensions rise and hidden truths begin to emerge. Between Cricket's attempts to overcome his blockage and Bill's lies that threaten to change everything, this episode explores the themes of creativity, trust and family relations, all in a humorous and touching setting.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: Far from his native campaign, Cricket Green learned how to adapt to life in a big city, where he moved with his family. But integration is not a rest.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Christopher Houghton) faces an unexpected challenge when he has to look after a particularly agitated child. His patience is tested as he tries to channel the overflowing energy of his young protégé. Meanwhile, Tilly (Marieve Herington), her sister, discovers the pleasure of being idolized by a group of children fascinated by her charismatic personality and her sense of adventure. This new momentum of popularity prompts her to ask about her own identity and aspirations. At the same time, Nancy (Artemis Pebdani), the matriarch of the family, struggles to prove her value on the farm, seeking to demonstrate her skills in agriculture in the face of daily challenges. Finally, Bill (Bob Joles) desperately tries to relax in a spa with his grandmother, but the exuberant presence of her latter makes her quest for serenity more difficult. This episode promises moments of tenderness and humour while exploring family relationships.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: Far from his native campaign, Cricket Green learned how to adapt to life in a big city, where he moved with his family. But integration is not a rest.
programme.desc-more: In this thrilling episode of "The Greens in Big City", the Green family goes to the beach for a relaxing day, but things are quickly taking an unexpected turn. Cricket (Luke Lowe), always looking for entertainment, decides to play a prank with the bathers, hoping to create laughter and fun. However, his joke plans are met with unforeseen consequences, putting the peace of the beach at risk and leading to nasty and chaotic situations. At the same time, in the "Cricket puppeteer" segment, Cricket discovers a new intriguing ability: he can penetrate into his family's dreams and exert a malicious influence. As he interferes with the unconscious of his loved ones, he turns their dreams into real nightmares, causing tensions and strife within the home. This episode explores with humour the themes of family, imagination and the repercussions of jokes, while offering hilarious moments and unexpected lessons.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: During a visit to the museum, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) decided to embark on a bold project: creating a time machine. Their curiosity and ingenuity prompt them to experiment with technologies that few children of their age could consider. When their invention mysteriously starts to take place, the two brothers are projected into a prehistoric world of fascinating creatures and unexpected adventures. Meanwhile, their sister Candice (Ashley Tisdale) is desperately trying to prove to their mother that her brothers are doing stupid things, but her efforts are constantly being thwarted by unlikely circumstances. As Phineas and Ferb explore this new environment, they discover the challenges and joys of life in the dinosaur era, while learning lessons about friendship and adventure. Events take an unexpected turn as they realize that their actions in the past could have consequences for their present.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.
