programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: Heroic brotherly rivalry / The goat is a mystery!
programme.desc: In a world where the ordinary is close to the extraordinary, Hamster and Gretel, two brothers united by an unfailing bond, receive super powers from a mysterious race of aliens. While Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) embraces her new role as superhero with enthusiasm and determination, her brother Kevin (Michael Cimino), although not having received any powers, finds himself in a delicate position, acting as "collateral damage" to their adventures. While a meteorite threatens to crash into their city, a divergence of opinion is emerging between Kevin and Gretel on how best to deal with this imminent crisis. Kevin, a pragmatic, advocates a strategic approach, while Gretel, driven by his boldness, leans for direct intervention. This fraternal rivalry puts their relationship to the test, while they must learn to collaborate to save their community. Between humour, action and life lessons, this episode explores the complex dynamics between power, responsibility and family ties.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: The Black Knight's Ghost / Phinedroids & Ferbots
programme.desc: On their vacation in England with Ferb's grandparents, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and his brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) discovered the fascinating legend of the Black Knight, a mysterious hero whose exploits resonate throughout the ages. Enthusiasmous by this story, they decide to organize a medieval tournament of life-size, inviting their friends to participate in chivalry and relive heroic times. Meanwhile, Phineas' sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), desperately tries to unmask her brothers' plans to expose them to their parents. At the same time, in another intrigue, the two boys, faced with the impossibility of carrying out all their summer projects, are starting to create robots called "Phinedroids" and "Ferbots". These ingenious creations are designed to help them carry out their summer activities, but they soon provoke hilarious and unexpected situations.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Meg Birthday Mom / Travel to Candice Center
programme.desc: For their mother's birthday, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are embarking on a grand quest to offer her memorable gifts, which may cause her daughter Candice (Ashley Tisdale) to forget those carefully prepared. Determined not to be overshadowed, Candice strives to do everything possible to thwart the plans of her brothers, hoping to prove to their mother that her gifts are the best. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb, still looking for adventure, decided to build a mini submarine to explore the mysterious world that is hidden inside the dog of Isabella (voice of Kelly Hu). However, their experience takes an unexpected turn when they accidentally find themselves inside Candice's body, diving into a fantastic universe where they will have to navigate through his thoughts and emotions. The crazy situations are going on, mixing humour and imagination, while the two brothers try to find their way back and celebrate their mother's birthday in an unforgettable way.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: While Kevin is on a quest to find a new secret den, Hamster and Gretel are facing each other with two mysterious workers with formidable psychic powers. These unexpected opponents, who seem to come from another world, threaten the tranquillity of their neighbourhood. To deal with this threat, Hamster (Melissa Povenmire) and Gretel (Emma Ramos) must unite and strengthen their skills, while learning to master their own powers. In this tense context, Tobor (Beck Bennett), the robot coach, plays a crucial role in guiding them and helping them develop strategies to counter their enemies. As tension rises and danger approaches, our heroes will have to draw from their inner resources and show courage to protect their city from an alien threat that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: High-risk delivery / Not very on horseback
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of the series, the Green family finds themselves in a messy situation when they decide to order a pizza. As the attractive smell of delivery begins to invade their home, Tilly (Marieve Herington), the youngest in the family, finds herself confronted with an unexpected phobia: she hates horses. This unexpected aversion for equidae will take on hilarious proportions when the pizza order comes with an unexpected equestrian event in the neighborhood. Family members, each with their unique personality, try to support Tilly while juggling the complications that this situation imposes on them. Between whoproquos and moments of frank laugh, this episode brilliantly illustrates the family dynamics and small crises of everyday life, while addressing themes of acceptance and humour in the face of irrational fears.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: In the charming town of Kittydale, life seems peaceful for the adorable Bitsy kittens, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy, who spend their days playing and lounging in the Purr 'N' Play space. However, this tranquillity is often disturbed by the arrival of wicked determined to sow chaos. When troubles arise, these four friends become SuperChatons, feline heroes who do not hesitate to defend the animals and the inhabitants of their city. With impressive superpowers, cat-martre gadgets and unwavering team spirit, they face antagonists such as Mr. Puppypaws, Lab Rat, Cat Burglar and Zsa-Zsa. Their mission is to correct the wrongs and make the world more cat-like, while showing kindness and empathy. Together, the SuperChatons prove that even the smallest can accomplish great things when they act with courage and solidarity.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends clean the Garden with their maxi tools. Once the cleaning is done, they enjoy their little party by the pool.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: Phineas and Ferb, two brothers who are full of imagination, are delighted to spend the summer with their grandparents in the countryside. Accompanied by their friends, they are embarking on an ambitious project: to renovate two tree huts to make them extraordinary play places. While Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are implementing their creative plans, their sister Candace (Ashley Tisdale) does not lose a second to try to report them to their mother. At the same time, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a luscious inventor, is concocting a new Machiavellic plan to dominate the city, while his eternal rival, Agent P (Perry the Ornithorync), is preparing to face it. The adventures of Phineas and Ferb take an unpredictable turn, mixing laughter, fraternal rivalries and unbridled creativity, while every day is the occasion of a new farfetched invention and a dose of unexpected.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Max's mom's on a space mission and the teenager's gonna have to learn to live without her. Marinette's looking for an idea to make Max live this separation well.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and the Mega-Mouse / SuperChatons and the jungle
programme.desc: The SuperChatons have a mission to prevent Rastic from chasing cats with his mega-mouse! The SuperChatons visit Willa in the wild jungle.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: In a colorful and adventure-filled universe, Kiff, a young creature full of life, finds herself in a delicate situation when her magical hat disappears. This hat is not just an accessory: it is the key to the self-confidence of his friend Barry (Michael Croner), who relies on him to believe in his own abilities. Determined to restore this confidence, Kiff embarks on a frantic quest to find the hat, exploring unexpected places and meeting colorful characters. At the same time, Kiff and Barry are confronted with another mystery: a lost diary whose personal content could endanger the privacy of its owner. Together, they must navigate through the challenges of friendship, trust and responsibility, while ensuring that the newspaper's secrets remain well-kept, for the good of all in their small town.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Max's mom's on a space mission and the teenager's gonna have to learn to live without her. Marinette's looking for an idea to make Max live this separation well.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: Billie, a young and powerful witch at the centre of a mysterious prophecy, is sent to the mortal world with the only sorcerer teacher who can help her master her powers, Justin Russo.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: The One-Day Tour of the World
programme.desc: Phineas and Ferb are already arriving at half their vacation and feel they have not yet taken advantage of it. For the longest day of the year, they want to hit hard and start, together with their friends, to embark on a round the world.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. programme.desc: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: The honey casa / The dog mayor
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of season 3 of "The Greens in Big City", the children, driven by a spirit of adventure and camaraderie, are developing a bold plan to take over the honey from Bill's hive, a local beekeeper. Cricket (Chris Houghton) and Rémy (Zeno Robinson) take over this exciting mission, determined to overcome all the obstacles that stand in their way. At the same time, another issue is on the horizon: the dog Phoenix, a charismatic and loyal animal, becomes the ideal candidate for municipal elections. Cricket and Rémy, convinced that Phoenix can make positive changes to their city, are launching a frantic campaign to get him elected mayor. Between election strategies and holding-up plans, this episode explores the themes of friendship, ambition and creativity, while offering a good dose of humor and unexpected adventures.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City

programme.desc: In this episode of "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Chris Houghton) discovers that the serenity of the lake brings out the fun and carefree side of his friend Bill. Their complicity is reinforced over the days spent together, where laughter and games seem to drive away the worries of everyday life. However, this tranquillity is threatened when hungry rabbits begin to invade Bill's fields, endangering his precious harvest. Faced with this unexpected invasion, Nancy (Marieve Herington) took charge and decided to call on their friends in the campaign to try to save the situation. Together, they develop a clever plan to keep rodents away while preserving the lake's harmony. This episode highlights the importance of friendship and community in the face of adversity, while providing a touch of humour and tenderness that characterizes the series.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and the disappearance of hot dog / SuperChatons and the mysterious magician
programme.desc: In the charming town of Kittydale, Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are much more than just kittens. When they don't play innocent games and cozy naps in their Purr 'N' Play space, they turn into SuperChatons, feline heroes with a big heart. Their mission? Protecting animals and inhabitants of Kittydale from the evil men who threaten peace, such as the devious Mr. Puppypaws, the cunning Lab Rat, the thief Cat Burglar and the glamour Zsa-Zsa. Armed with unique superpowers and a variety of chat-mart gadgets, this dynamic quartet uses its intelligence and benevolence to thwart the machiavelic plans of their opponents. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where friendship, bravery and empathy are the true keys to success. The SuperChatons remind everyone that even the smallest can achieve great things by joining forces to make justice and kindness triumph.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: During a visit to the museum, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) decided to embark on a bold project: creating a time machine. Their curiosity and ingenuity prompt them to experiment with technologies that few children of their age could consider. When their invention mysteriously starts to take place, the two brothers are projected into a prehistoric world of fascinating creatures and unexpected adventures. Meanwhile, their sister Candice (Ashley Tisdale) is desperately trying to prove to their mother that her brothers are doing stupid things, but her efforts are constantly being thwarted by unlikely circumstances. As Phineas and Ferb explore this new environment, they discover the challenges and joys of life in the dinosaur era, while learning lessons about friendship and adventure. Events take an unexpected turn as they realize that their actions in the past could have consequences for their present.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.
programme.desc: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of season 6 of "Miraculous, Ladybug's and Chat Noir's adventures", Ladybug (Carrie Keranen) and her faithful partner Chat Noir (Bryce Papenbrook) find themselves confronted with a new formidable enemy, a villain with impressive artistic talent that turns his overflowing imagination into formidable weapons. This wicked man, able to bring his wildest creations to life, sows chaos in Paris by using animated works of art to sow terror among the inhabitants. While the city is plunged into disarray, Ladybug and Chat Noir must join forces with their allies, Alya (Cristina Valenzuela) and Luka (Zeno Robinson), to counter this unexpected threat. They will not only have to show courage and ingenuity, but also discover the weaknesses of this imaginative opponent to restore order in the light city. The episode explores the themes of creativity, friendship and the fight against the forces of evil.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.desc: Dressed as a tooth fairy, Zsa-Zsa undertakes to steal Bitsy's tooth and collect a gift! The SuperChatons save Feliville from the stinking muffins of Rashtucious.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.sub-title: Two truths and one rabbit / nicknames
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Kiff", the plot focuses on Kiff (Kimiko Glenn) and his friend Barry (Michael Croner), who are looking to integrate a very exclusive band. Their bold mission is based on the art of lying, and Barry must be creative in order to be able to fool the members of the group. In parallel, Kiff and Barry are embarking on an original quest to get nicknames, an approach they hope to achieve with the help of a cinema counter. This quest for recognition and identity leads them into crazy situations, where their friendship will be tested. Interactions with colourful characters, such as the enigmatic countertop, add a humorous and playful dimension to their adventure. As they navigate between truth and lie, Kiff and Barry will discover that authenticity can sometimes be the best nicknames.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.sub-title: The One-Day Tour of the World
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 3 of the series Phineas and Ferb

Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and his brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) join their friends in taking up this challenge. At the same time, Phineas and Ferb are embarking on an ambitious project: the construction of a giant observatory to follow the passage of comet Kermilian. With the help of Alyson Stoner and other friends, they transform their garden into a true astronomical observation centre, combining science and fun. The two intrigues cross, promising moments of laughter, adventure and team spirit.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: Isabella (Alyson Stoner) is in a difficult situation with a persistent hiccup that disrupts her daily life. To help him get rid of this evil, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) decided to build the most terrifying haunted house that could be, hoping that the experience of intense fear would heal their friend. Their project quickly takes on extravagant proportions, involving impressive special effects and surprises at each corner of the corridor. Meanwhile, Candice (Ashley Tisdale) faces a new challenge: Jeremy's little sister, a mischievous and determined girl, who seems determined to monopolize her brother's attention. Candice must then juggle his jealousy with his will to make his own interests triumph, while attempting to denounce the inventions of Phineas and Ferb. The two intrigues cross, mixing thrills and comedy in a colourful episode.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and the Missing Vegetables / SuperChatons and Octopus Candies
programme.desc: The SuperChatons are tasked with preventing the Glamsters from stealing all Feliville's vegetables. The SuperChatons save Feliville from the purple octopus candy of Rashtucious.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.sub-title: The spread / Love and rose water
programme.desc: Kiff, a character full of good will, finds himself at the heart of a delicate mission: to save the friendship between Chandelle and Trevor, two friends in a state of misunderstanding. As tension rises between them, Kiff tries to restore communication and revive their complicity. At the same time, Mrs.Renne des Neiges, a beloved figure of their entourage, is seeking Kiff's help in navigating her tumultuous sentimental life. Ignoring that the advice she gave her is inspired by a television series, Kiff embarks on a comical and touching quest to help Mrs.Renne find love. In the course of the adventures, the stakes of friendship and love intertwine, revealing the hidden truths and the aspirations of the characters. With humour and tenderness, this episode explores the complexities of human relations and the lessons that can be learned from fiction to inform reality.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: Hard decision / You win, I win
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Christopher Houghton) is confronted with a personal crisis when his girlfriend decides to break up with him. Determined to win her back, he embarked on a process of personal transformation, striving to become a better man. Meanwhile, Bill (Bob Joles), his competitive friend, jealously observed Cricket's progress. Bill's obsession with victory led him to compete with Cricket in all aspects of their lives, even defying his friend on a variety of activities, whether it was sports or everyday challenges. This friendly competition quickly turns into a wild race, where personal and emotional issues are mixed. As the trials progressed, the two friends discovered that the true meaning of victory lay not only in success, but also in friendship and mutual understanding.

programme.sub-title: Happy end of the world to all
programme.desc: Our heroes are preparing to deliver a final, massive battle against Mordam, who is about to unleash Original Evil on Earth. But they're breaking the number one rule of horror movies... separating. Everyone has their hair-drawn plan to defeat Mordam, who uses magic to prevent them from regrouping. Doug's mentor's spirit reincarnates to complete his disciple's training as a matter of urgency. Our heroes end up working together against Mordam, but will that be enough?

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.desc: It's Friends Day, Minnie's on the adventure to save Mickey.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of the series, the playful world of the Greens in Big City is revealed from a fascinating angle. In "The Animal Football", Cricket (Marieve Herington) finds himself in a delicate situation after inadvertently sending all his balloons to the Big Café during a football-animal match. Desperate to recover his equipment, he must face Gloria (Artemis Pebdani), a formidable opponent who does not step back in front of anything to win. Tensions rise as the two characters enter a fierce competition, testing their ingenuity and sportsmanship. In "Fits like raccoons," Bill (Chris Houghton) and Cricket face another unexpected challenge: raccoons have taken up residence in Grand-Mère's garage (Lauren Tom). To protect their homes, the family must join forces and develop a clever plan to drive away these malicious intruders, thus revealing the family ties and team spirit that unite them.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.desc: In season 2, Billie is confronted with the fact that belonging to the Russo family could be more complicated than she thought, especially since she is no longer the only witch in the house. programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: The Greens, an eccentric and endearing family, make the decision to leave Big City to return to their farm in the countryside, hoping to reconnect with the simplicity and authenticity of their past. However, their return is far from the sweet dream they had imagined. Upon arriving, they discover that their former haven of peace has radically changed, and the idyllic memories of their childhood fade in the face of a disconcerting reality. The landscapes are unrecognizable, and relations with the former neighbours are tinted with a feeling of strangeness. The Greens must then navigate through unexpected challenges and comical misunderstandings that test their family unity. Between the longing for past days and adapting to an uncertain present, each family member must learn to redefine what really means "to go home". Laughters and tears mix as the Greens try to regain their place in a world that has evolved without them.

programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Hamster & Gretel", Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) finds herself in a difficult situation after neglecting her household responsibilities to investigate a mysterious UFO. Because of her reckless behavior, she is punished by her parents, Dave and Carolina, and is forced to spend the whole weekend confined to her room. However, this punishment does not prevent him from facing a new threat: a formidable mutant who sows panic in the city. In parallel, Gretel's and her best friend Bailey's pajamas evening projects are upset by the arrival of Tina, a new student who seems to be hiding surprising talents. While Gretel tries to juggle her family responsibilities with her heroic ambitions, she must also discover Tina's true intentions, adding an intriguing dimension to this already tumultuous adventure.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Giant Rat / The Theft of Collars
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: When Dingo builds his house upside down, he has to go to the Magical Isle with Mickey and Minnie to find a magic potion that would put it back in the right direction.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: The Black Knight's Ghost / Phinedroids & Ferbots
programme.desc: On their vacation in England with Ferb's grandparents, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and his brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) discovered the fascinating legend of the Black Knight, a mysterious hero whose exploits resonate throughout the ages. Enthusiasmous by this story, they decide to organize a medieval tournament of life-size, inviting their friends to participate in chivalry and relive heroic times. Meanwhile, Phineas' sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), desperately tries to unmask her brothers' plans to expose them to their parents. At the same time, in another intrigue, the two boys, faced with the impossibility of carrying out all their summer projects, are starting to create robots called "Phinedroids" and "Ferbots". These ingenious creations are designed to help them carry out their summer activities, but they soon provoke hilarious and unexpected situations.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the Miraculous series, the adventures of Ladybug and Chat Noirs, with Anouck Oboe, Benjamin Bollen, Antoine Tomé
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: The SuperChatons and the Catastrosis / The SuperChatons and the War of the Bad
programme.desc: The SuperChatons are tasked with preventing Zsa-Zsa from stealing all pink objects from Feliville. Mr. Petites-Pattes and Chapardeur are fighting for the title of the city's best villain.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: The Greens, an eccentric and endearing family, celebrate their 100th adventure in Big City, a landmark event that promises unexpected twists. As they prepare to hold a big celebration to commemorate this milestone, each member of the family is faced with personal challenges. Marieve, Herington, the dynamic matriarch, tries to juggle the preparations for the celebration and the management of tensions between her children. Chris (Houghton), the dreamer son, has to face his own doubts about his future, while Bob (Joles), the wise grandfather, shares memories that bring back long buried family secrets. Artemis (Pebdani), the farfetched aunt, brings a touch of offbeat humour and wild ideas that make things even more difficult. As this celebration unfolds, the Greens will discover that family ties are being tested, but that love and humour can overcome all trials.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: The Doomies
programme.desc: Bobby and his best friend Romy are convinced that their French coast town is home to evil forces. During one of their monster hunts, they discover a megalith: Subterra's door. They're opening it by accident. Bobby finds himself a victim of a curse, and a monster of fog soon takes them out. It was then that they met a mysterious warrior with superhuman powers.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the Miraculous series, the adventures of Ladybug and Chat Noirs, with Anouck Oboe, Benjamin Bollen, Antoine Tomé
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: When Dingo builds his house upside down, he has to go to the Magical Isle with Mickey and Minnie to find a magic potion that would put it back in the right direction.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: In season 2, Billie is confronted with the fact that belonging to the Russo family could be more complicated than she thought, especially since she is no longer the only witch in the house. Thanks to the new magical powers of Roman and Milo, Justin now has to train three young sorcerers for the family witchcraft competition. As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the inventor brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decided to take up a new challenge by building an artificial biosphere. Their aim is to allow a group of scouts to win new badges, even in the event of torrential rain. As they implement their bold plan, their project quickly takes on unexpected dimensions, mixing science, adventure and a good dose of humor. At the same time, Candice Flynn (Ashley Tisdale), Phineas' sister, finds herself in a difficult situation. She promised her best friend Stacy to spend a day with girls, but she was forced to juggle her friendly obligations with her boyfriend, which made her schedule difficult. Quiproquos and twists are bound up, offering a mixture of adventure and comedy, while stressing the importance of friendly and family relations.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb

programme.sub-title: The Epi-Browse / Rodeo Mounting of Sheep
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Tilly Green (Marieve Herington) disagrees with family traditions during his epi-breast, a symbolic event that marks the transition to adulthood. His decision to derogate from established rites caused the anger of his grandmother (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who saw this break as an infringement of family heritage. At the same time, his brother Cricket (Chris Houghton) has a dream of becoming an expert in sheep rodeo. However, his enthusiasm led him to a series of hilarious misadventures as he found himself trapped in an endless set of challenges related to his training. This episode skillfully blends humour and tenderness, illustrating the generational struggles within the Green family, while highlighting the individual aspirations that drive them. The tensions between tradition and modernity create a rich and dynamic context for the characters.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: A fishing competition is threatened and Gretel must win it to protect the competitors; Hamster and Churro exchange their bodies while a super naughty bodybuilder attacks.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: Passion for ice / Chip, the return
programme.desc: When he decides to go to the hockey party organized by his grandmother, Nick (Bob Joles) does not expect tension to rise rapidly among the guests. As spirits warm up around the ice, rivalries and old quarrels resurface, revealing long-suffering conflicts. Chip Whistler (Billy West), a former resident of Big City, takes the opportunity to tell his story and the circumstances that led him to be banished from the city. As the discussions progress, the characters, each with their own emotional background, share anecdotes and memories, oscillating between laughter and argument. The evening then takes an unexpected turn, highlighting the complex links that unite these characters. The spectators are invited to dive into a mood mixing humor and nostalgia, as the secrets of Big City begin to emerge, driving everyone into a whirlwind of emotions and revelations.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: Internet / We need to help Gregly.
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series, Tilly (Marieve Herington) is embarking on a thrilling digital adventure, determined to discover the mystery of the disappearance of her favorite ice. Dive into the Internet's meanderings, she discovers a fascinating and confusing universe, populated by eccentric characters and unsuspecting secrets. Meanwhile, his brother Cricket (Shane Houghton) takes under his wing Gregly (Zeno Robinson), a somewhat clumsy young boy who struggles to make friends. Cricket tries to help him overcome his shyness and establish ties with his comrades, while sailing in the highs and lows of juvenile friendship. The two intrigues join each other while Tilly and Cricket realize that human connection, whether virtual or real, is essential to overcome the challenges of life. Between laughter and life lessons, this episode explores the themes of friendship and curiosity in the digital age.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.desc: Thanks to some clever Maxi-Tools, Mickey, Donald and Dingo are organizing a surprise for Pat's birthday.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.
