programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Meg Birthday Mom / Travel to Candice Center
programme.desc: For their mother's birthday, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are embarking on a grand quest to offer her memorable gifts, which may cause her daughter Candice (Ashley Tisdale) to forget those carefully prepared. Determined not to be overshadowed, Candice strives to do everything possible to thwart the plans of her brothers, hoping to prove to their mother that her gifts are the best. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb, still looking for adventure, decided to build a mini submarine to explore the mysterious world that is hidden inside the dog of Isabella (voice of Kelly Hu). However, their experience takes an unexpected turn when they accidentally find themselves inside Candice's body, diving into a fantastic universe where they will have to navigate through his thoughts and emotions. The crazy situations are going on, mixing humour and imagination, while the two brothers try to find their way back and celebrate their mother's birthday in an unforgettable way.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Giant Rat / The Theft of Collars
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this explosive episode of season 4 of "The Greens in Big City", Chip (Chris Houghton) embarks on a Machiavellian plan to avenge the Greens, whom he considers responsible for his misfortunes. Obsessed with destroying their reputation, he worked to manipulate the people of Big City by persuading them that the Greens were responsible for the degradation of their community. To do this, Chip staged deceptive events, orchestrating incidents that put the Greens in an unfavorable light. Meanwhile, members of the Green family, faced with this denigration campaign, are trying to prove their innocence and restore the truth. As tension rises and alliances develop, each one must navigate in a climate of growing distrust. This conflict highlights the themes of loyalty, revenge and the consequences of manipulation in this city full of surprises.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: In season 2, Billie is confronted with the fact that belonging to the Russo family could be more complicated than she thought, especially since she is no longer the only witch in the house. Thanks to the new magical powers of Roman and Milo, Justin now has to train three young sorcerers for the family witchcraft competition. As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: As the harbour festival in Danville approaches, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are not reluctant to test their creativity by building an impressive metal shark. Their bold project draws the attention of their sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), who is determined to prove to their mother that her brothers are doing something incredible. At the same time, the two inventors embark on an intergalactic adventure by going to the Moon to create the most delicious ice cream ever tasted. In another corner of Danville, Irving (Tyler Alexander Mann) is preparing a surprise for Phineas' birthday by making a video clip, while Carl (Dan Povenmire) is embarking on an infiltration mission to spy on the activities of Phineas and Ferb. Finally, the day ends with the grand parade of the Unification of the Three States, where all the creations of the two brothers are put to the honor, mixing magic, inventions and a hint of chaos.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Father-daughter competition / One afternoon with Suzy
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the father of the two boys, eager to spend a moment complicit with them, accidentally discovers the secret of their pet, Perry the Ornithoryncus. To protect Perry's secret identity, he finds himself facing a dilemma: entering a memory eraser, an invention of his sons. Meanwhile, Candice, the boys' sister, was given the custody of Suzy, a little girl she feared she would have to watch over an entire afternoon. At first, Candice thinks that Suzy could be an obstacle to his plans to trap Phineas (Mitchel Musso) and Ferb (Dan Povenmire). However, she quickly discovers that Suzy is more than just a little girl to watch. Indeed, the latter proved to be a valuable ally in his attempts to expose his brothers' wild inventions, transforming their afternoon into an unexpected adventure.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: Who's afraid of Mordros the annihilator?
programme.desc: Mordros disembarks and reveals his evil plan to destroy humanity; Gretel is more alone than ever, and she and Hiromi must ally to defeat Mordros.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: New Powers / A Hit to Take
programme.desc: In a world where the extraordinary is close to everyday life, Hamster (Melissa Povenmire) and Gretel (Joey King), two inseparable brothers, find themselves endowed with super powers after an unexpected encounter with aliens. While Hamster flourishes in his new role as superhero, Gretel, full of enthusiasm, embraces this adventure with an overflowing energy. However, their brother Kevin (Michael Cimino), who aspires to be a hero in his own right, is relegated to the role of "collateral damage", which creates tensions within the fratry. As a threatening meteorite moves towards Earth, the differences between Gretel and Kevin's views on how to stop it may jeopardize their mission. Their disagreements and the challenges that result will test their family ties, forcing them to learn to work together and accept their differences to protect their city and save the world.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: The recipe for disaster / Fracasse Maths
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Hamster & Gretel", Kevin and Gretel face a major challenge: saving the family dinner that is going to be catastrophic. As tension rises in the kitchen, Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) faces a cowboy who is as unpredictable as he is fearsome, threatening to disrupt their plans. At the same time, their father, Dave (Matt Jones), is struggling to find the perfect birthday gift for Caroline (Liza Koshy), but his efforts seem doomed to failure. In a whirlwind of comedic events and unpredictable actions, the characters navigate between humour and thrills. The interactions between Kevin (Michael Cimino), Gretel and other family members bring a touch of emotion and camaraderie, while unexpected twists test their ingenuity and determination. This mixture of family adventure and comedy promises to captivate the public, while exploring the themes of responsibility and brotherly love.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of season 4 of "The Greens in Big City", Bill (Chris Houghton) finds himself facing a family dilemma when his daughter Tilly (Marieve Herington) climbs to a tree, stubbornly refusing to go down. His growing concern for Tilly's safety prompted him to consider unorthodox methods to convince her to return to the ground. At the same time, Remy (Zeno Robinson) told Vasquez (Danny Trejo) that he no longer needed protection, a statement that led to a series of unexpected events. Vasquez, determined to understand this change, decided to consult a therapist, seeking to explore the implications of this new dynamic. This episode explores the themes of parenting, autonomy and vulnerability, while highlighting the humorous and touching interactions between the characters. Tensions rise as each protagonist faces his own challenges, making this episode both comical and emotionally rich.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", a documentary on nature reveals the mysteries of Big City, portrayed as a wild and vibrant ecosystem. At the heart of this adventure, Rémy (Chris Houghton), a passionate collector, finds himself in a crisis of existential existence when he discovers that his friend Cricket (Marieve Herington) has taken hold of the rarest and most coveted collection map of all. This moment of revelation triggers a series of reflections on Rémy's devouring passion for collectibles and human relations. As he tries to overcome this disappointment, he embarks on a frantic quest to prove his worth and regain his place in the world of collectors. This episode explores the themes of friendship, rivalry and redefinition of self within a complex and fascinating urban environment.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Bazaar at the museum / Big work
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: One of Clarabelle's songbirds is missing. It's up to Mickey and his friends to find him so Clarabelle can finish his morning song with them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.sub-title: The clones of Zola / Electro robot fireflies
programme.desc: The adventures of Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales, who join with Superheroes to defeat their enemies and discover that teamwork is the best way to save the situation. The third season introduced a new plot called
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this dynamic episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the inseparable brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decided to dive into the flamboyant world of fashion by creating their own line of summer clothes. With an overflowing creativity and an unparalleled sense of style, they tackle the design of unique pieces that capture the essence of summer holidays. Meanwhile, their friend Isabella Garcia-Shapiro (Alyson Stoner), recently operated on tonsils, became their muse. In parallel, Perry's plans for the Ornithoryncus (voice of Dan Povenmire), who leads a double life as a secret agent, intersect with the adventures of his young masters. The episode promises an avalanche of laughter, surprises and touching moments as the characters juggle between creative ambition and the hazards of everyday life. A fun exploration of friendship and personal expression in the heart of summer.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. programme.sub-title: Giant Lizard / The Wild Band of Rhino

programme.title: Kiff
programme.sub-title: The shopping center / The art of the Spirit of the Wolf
programme.desc: In this episode of the series "Kiff", Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a young optimistic and energetic, embarks on a bold mission: she trains her group of friends at the mall in the hope of finding a free pretzel. However, this adventure turns out to be more complex than it imagined. By taking over the group, Kiff discovers that leadership involves many responsibilities, including managing dynamics between friends and making crucial decisions. At the same time, Kiff and his faithful companion Barry (Michael Croner) are intrigued by rumours about a ghost wolf that haunts the place. Determined to break this mystery, they are embarking on an investigation that will lead them to meet unexpected characters and face nasty situations. Between friendship, humour and discovery, this episode highlights the challenges of growing up while keeping his spirit of adventure.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

This conflict highlights the themes of loyalty, revenge and the consequences of manipulation in this city full of surprises.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: In season 2, Billie is confronted with the fact that belonging to the Russo family could be more complicated than she thought, especially since she is no longer the only witch in the house. Thanks to the new magical powers of Roman and Milo, Justin now has to train three young sorcerers for the family witchcraft competition. As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: To celebrate the anniversary of Phineas (Vincent Martella), Irving, the best friend of the two brothers, is embarking on an ambitious project: to make a memorable video clip in honour of Phineas. He called on Baljeet (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), the genius of technology, Isabella (Ashley Tisdale), the neighbor in love with Phineas, and Buford (Dan Povenmire), the soft hearted force, to help him conceive this surprise. Meanwhile, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), Phineas' sister, sees this as a golden opportunity to accumulate evidence to expose her brothers and prove to their mother that their farfetched inventions are not just child games. The tension rises as the group makes every effort to create a clip that captures the spirit of adventure and creativity of Phineas, while struggling with Candice's plans that threatens to ruin everything.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: The Greens, an eccentric and endearing family, make the decision to leave Big City to return to their farm in the countryside, hoping to reconnect with the simplicity and authenticity of their past. However, their return is far from the sweet dream they had imagined. Upon arriving, they discover that their former haven of peace has radically changed, and the idyllic memories of their childhood fade in the face of a disconcerting reality. The landscapes are unrecognizable, and relations with the former neighbours are tinted with a feeling of strangeness. The Greens must then navigate through unexpected challenges and comical misunderstandings that test their family unity. Between the longing for past days and adapting to an uncertain present, each family member must learn to redefine what really means "to go home". Laughters and tears mix as the Greens try to regain their place in a world that has evolved without them.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of the series, Cricket Green (Chris Houghton) decides to organize a family dinner, hoping to create unforgettable memories with his loved ones. However, his father, Bill Green (Jim Piddock), cannot help but wonder how his son will fund this evening. Tension is rising as preparations progress, and Bill, pragmatic, is beginning to consider the financial implications of this seemingly innocent project. At the same time, Tilly Green (Marieve Herington) and Cricket are starting a hilarious quarrel over whether their father really enjoyed the gifts he received for Father's Day. This fraternal competition highlights the complex family dynamics and misunderstandings that can occur even during the most joyful moments. Over the evening, laughter and tension intertwine, revealing the hidden truths and feelings that animate this eccentric family.

programme.desc: In a world where the ordinary is close to the extraordinary, Hamster and Gretel, two brothers united by an unfailing bond, receive super powers from a mysterious race of aliens. programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Quat' quat' candice! / Curse of old beard
programme.desc: In this colourful episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the two brothers, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decided to raise the morale of their sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), who seems concerned about her daily problems. For this, they imagine and build a giant SUV, an imposing vehicle that should give it a smile and allow it to live thrilling adventures. Meanwhile, the bad luck is on Candice when she comes into contact with a mysterious orange foam. This strange substance plunges her into a world of hallucinations, transforming her perception of reality and making her vulnerable to the events surrounding her. At the same time, Phineas and Ferb are launching a treasure hunt, taking themselves as formidable pirates looking for the legendary treasure of Old Barbe. The two intrigues intertwine, mixing humor, adventures and unexpected twists.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Bazaar at the museum / Big work
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the "Kiff" series, the team finds itself immersed in an unexpected imbroglio when tensions arise around a new collection. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), always curious and fearless, decides to spy on Harry (Michael Croner) and Terri (Nichole Bloom), who, for their part, carefully watch Kristophe (Josh Johnson). This delicate situation highlights the challenges of leadership, while Kiff discovers that the role of leadership is not as simple as she imagined. Interactions between the characters reveal complex dynamics and underlying conflicts, while the team must navigate between creativity and pressure. Misaddresses and misunderstandings are accumulating, testing their friendship and collaboration. As Kiff tries to understand the issues involved in this responsibility, she realizes that every decision can have unexpected consequences, and that teamwork is essential to overcome obstacles.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. programme.title: Valerian and Laureline
programme.desc: Valerian and Laureline are travelling to the planet Ukbar, whose population has been contaminated by a horde of schniarfeurs. These aggressive creatures have a venom that makes their victims mean and violent...
programme.desc-more: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.

programme.title: Valerian and Laureline
programme.desc: While Valerian and Laureline are driving the two crooks Bart and Garp on the Androgune system to be judged, their space-time vessel is caught in a magnetic storm...
programme.desc-more: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.

programme.desc-more: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.

programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.title: Valerian and Laureline
programme.desc: Valerian is the main witness in the trial of Zag Mordan, a dangerous smuggler. To defeat the trial, he had Valerian kidnapped by his accomplices...
programme.desc-more: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.

programme.desc-more: On the advice of a friend, the young and fervoury d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover) left his native Gascony to go to Paris, animated by the dream of serving his majesty, the King. However, when he arrived, he discovered that the path to glory and honor was sown with obstacles. D'Artagnan is confronted with rivalries and intrigues of court that complicate his ascension. In search of recognition, he crossed the road of the famous Musketeers: Athos (Jesús Nieto), Porthos (Manuel Peiró) and Aramis (Rafael de Penagos), each with its own character and secrets. Together, they face conspiracies that threaten the security of the kingdom. D'Artagnan, although novice, quickly found himself involved in exciting and dangerous adventures, learning to navigate in this complex world where loyalty and honour are put to the test. Will his determination and courage be sufficient to gain his place among the legendary Musketeers?

programme.desc-more: On the advice of a friend, the young and daring d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover) left the quietness of his native Gascony to reach the flamboyant city of Paris. His dream: to enter the service of the King and join the famous Musketeers. However, upon his arrival, he quickly discovered that reality was much more complex and perilous than he had imagined. Faced with a court full of intrigues and rivalries, d'Artagnan must navigate a world where honour and loyalty are often put to the test. He met emblematic figures such as Athos (Manuel Peiró), Porthos (Jesús Nieto) and Aramis (Javier Dotú), who welcomed him into their world of bravery and camaraderie. Together, they will face threatening conspiracies, formidable enemies and unexpected challenges, while defending the honor of the kingdom and their own friendship.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: "A life of puppy"Why would Kerubim be the only one to live great adventures? Pupuce also has a very exciting life that deserves to be told... especially when a misunderstanding leads Luis to throw her out! Lost in the streets of Joris' best friend Astrub, will she be okay? Will she succeed in finding the way home?
programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.desc: "The difficult times" While Valerian, Laureline and the Free Traders are on their way to Central Point, the armada vlagos launched a massive offensive against the Antares system.
programme.desc-more: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.

programme.desc-more: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.

programme.title: D'Artagnan and the three Musketeers
programme.desc: "The King's Gift"D'Artagnan and his friends are chosen by the King to bring them back to Spain, which is a disconcerting thing for Richelieu, because of their role in the recovery of Spanish jewels.
programme.desc-more: On the advice of a faithful friend, the young and intrepid d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover) left his peaceful Gascony to go to Paris, with the ambition to serve King Louis XIII. Upon his arrival, he discovered that the court was a fascinating and dangerous place, filled with noble intriguing and devious rivalries. D'Artagnan quickly came up against the arrogance of Musketeers, notably in Athos (Jesús Nieto), Porthos (Manuel Peiró) and Aramis (Rafael de Penagos), who saw him as a novice who wanted to prove his worth. As he tried to win and win their respect, d'Artagnan was involved in political conspiracy and manipulations that threatened the security of the kingdom. Navigating between bravery and naivety, he will have to be intelligent and loyal in order to overcome obstacles and build a place within this legendary brotherhood.

programme.title: D'Artagnan and the three Musketeers
programme.desc: "The Count of Rochefort"Richelieu tried to prevent D'Artagnan and the Musketeers from reaching Spain, but they managed to thwart all of his traps.
programme.desc-more: On the advice of a faithful friend, the young d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover), a impetuous Gascon, leaves his home to join the King's court in Paris, animated by dreams of glory and honour. When he arrived, he quickly discovered that life at the court was a veritable maze of intrigues and conspiracies, where loyalty was rare and betrayal frequent. In search of a place within the Musketeers, he must navigate between rivalries and fluctuating alliances, while facing formidable opponents, including the sinister Count of Rochefort, a mysterious man with obscure intentions. The encounters with emblematic figures of the court, as well as the trials that stand on his way, will test his courage and determination. As d'Artagnan strives to prove his worth, he will also have to face his own demons and those who seek to destroy him.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: "The Fountain of Nooffoub"Who doesn't know the Fountain of Nooffoub? This magical fountain of Astrub, which contains a riddle that has not yet been resolved by anyone. Joris knows this place, of course, but what he doesn't know is that his Papycha has been trying to break the secret of it since he was a teenager! It's decided, he'll try his luck too.
programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.title: D'Artagnan and the three Musketeers
programme.desc: In his native village near Tarbes, young D'Artagnan dreams of becoming an emeritus epherist and being one of the famous Musketeers. D'Artagnan was sent to Paris with only one sword, an old horse and a letter of introduction to the captain of the Musketeers, Mr. De Treville.
programme.desc-more: On the advice of a friend, the young d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover), full of dreams and ambitions, leaves his peaceful Gascogne to join Paris, where he hopes to join the ranks of Musketeers in the service of his Majesty, the King. Upon his arrival, he discovered a capital in the midst of political intrigues and devious plotting. Far from the romantic image he had forged, life in Paris proved to be a major challenge. D-Artagnan quickly encountered unexpected rivalries and dangers, including crossing the path of the enigmatic Milady of Winter, whose obscure motivations intrigue and frighten him at once. In seeking to prove his worth, he immerse himself in a world of bravery and loyalty, while associating with the famous Musketeers, Athos, Porthos and Aramis, who will help him navigate the turbulent waters of the court. D-Artagnan must be cunning and courageous to overcome the obstacles that stand in his way.

programme.title: D'Artagnan and the three Musketeers
programme.desc: Back in France, the jealous Richelieu wants to get rid of D'Artagnan at all costs. His three accomplices each have their own ideas on how to get rid of him.
programme.desc-more: In a context of political tensions and conspiracy in the heart of Paris, the young d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover), ardent and determined, left his native Gascony on the advice of a friend, with the hope of making a name for himself by serving the King. When he arrived in the capital, he quickly realized that Musketeer life was not a path paved with roses. Faced with rivalries and court intrigues, d'Artagnan must navigate between loyalty and betrayal. His meeting with the legendary Musketeers Athos (Manuel Peiró), Porthos (Jesús Nieto) and Aramis (Javier Dotú) opened the doors to a world that was both fascinating and dangerous. Together, they will face formidable enemies, while defending honor and justice. Between sword fighting and ploys, d'Artagnan will learn that friendship and courage are the real keys to overcoming the challenges ahead.

This is the boy who is imprisoned by the legendary "key-to-head claps ". How can I get him out of here? Easy, according to Kerubim, just say the right password. You have to remember that again!
programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.
